description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country run around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, where runners of all levels meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing rather than time. The course includes various surfaces, long straight sections, narrow paths, and a challenging climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain. The event is the largest sporting running event in the Pardubice Region held on a weekday and is part of a series of Wednesday races.
course_highlights: Short loop of 4.5 km suitable for all runners
Long loop of 9 km with terrain, narrow paths, and a climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the parking lot near the Old Czech Inn under Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. The race is held in all weather conditions unless safety is at risk. An isotonic drink is available after the race. Results are not announced on-site but are published within 24 hours on the website. The start number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 CZK once at the first start of the year. Terrain running routes with on-site registration, a series of races with scoring and categories for different age groups.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a cross-country race organized by volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov, which is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The race offers a challenging route approximately 10.7 km long with an elevation gain of 418 meters, starting from the football field in Bratrušov. There is a shorter course for children, 2 km long with an elevation gain of 80 meters. The race is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: Route length of 10.7 km with an elevation gain of 418 m
Children's course 2 km with an elevation gain of 80 m
Start at the football field in Bratrušov
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. Organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Bratrušov. In 2025, the race was held on April 16th starting at 17:00. The race will take place on April 15th, 2026, as part of the Chlapácký běh series, with results available on the organizer's website.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The Zbraslavská VAŠE LIGA 2026 is a mountain cross race in Prague-Zbraslav, presenting a challenging challenge with a elevation gain of 500 meters over a 7 km course. During the race, participants will face three demanding ascents and descents that test their strength and endurance. The race starts at 6:00 PM at the Prague-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners seeking an intense trail experience in an urban environment with natural elements. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA under the leadership of Petr Lundák.
course_highlights: 7 km mountain cross/trail race
Elevation gain of 500 meters
Three demanding ascents and descents
additional: The race is a mountain cross/trail with significant elevation gain and challenging sections. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA, contact person Petr Lundák. The start is at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of the VAŠE LIGA series. The course is designed for trail runners, registration is possible online, and the start and finish are at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of a series of mountain runs and offers both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
description: Spring Olymp Run is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7, at the OLYMP CSMV complex. It offers three courses of different lengths (5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km), which run through nature and are suitable for runners of various levels. The race is organized by PSK Olymp Prague and is part of the running community of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 18:55, allowing runners to enjoy the evening atmosphere of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the courses in Stromovka Park
Three course lengths: 5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km
Start and finish at the OLYMP CSMV complex in Prague 7
additional: Registrations are only possible online until October 8, 2026, at midnight; registrations on the race day are not accepted by the organizers. The first category starts at 16:00, the main category starts at 18:55. The organizer is PSK Olymp Prague, z.s., contact person Jindřich Linhart. The race takes place in the Olymp complex area, with various age categories, online registration until October 8, 2026, course lengths of 3.3 km, 4.4 km, and 5.5 km, and is open to the general public.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The course runs on asphalt paths and participants complete three laps of 3.343 km each, with the first lap being slightly shorter. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and offers categories based on age as well as an open run regardless of age. The award ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion, and runners receive small sweet gifts for placing on the podium.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km lap on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady
The race is run 3 times, with the first lap being 28 meters shorter
Start and finish at the Music Pavilion in Smetanovy Sady
additional: Pre-registration of participants takes place on-site. Runners must have a chip card with a credit of at least 70 CZK, which will be deducted during registration. Items can be stored in the start/finish area. The race is run according to road running rules, each participant at their own risk. The event takes place in April 2026, with information available about registration, prices, and rules, and is part of the local running series organized by TJ Liga stovkařů.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity run held on April 16, 2026, in Flora Park. The race starts at 9:00 PM, and participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which covers the event costs and the other half goes to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program including a concert and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband. Capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort.
course_highlights: Course in Flora Park in Olomouc
Option to choose between 2.5 km and 5 km routes
Night run with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 7:00 PM. Starter packs are available with options including a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free and can purchase a starter pack on-site for 250 CZK. The event capacity is limited for safety and comfort. The accompanying program includes a concert by Rodan from 8:00 PM. The route is also suitable for walking. The registration fee supports the visually impaired. The start is from 7:00 PM to 8:45 PM, the accompanying program runs from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and the starter pack includes a headlamp or sports headband.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Kostel svaté Kateřiny, Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena je při registraci a zaplacení do 15.4.2025
description: We invite all runners to the traditional 18th edition of the Kateřinský Run in Hrabová, which will take place on April 16, 2026, in Ostrava-Hrabová. The main route runs around the historic St. Catherine's Church, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, children's races, and Nordic Walking on 5 km. Participants will enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route runs around St. Catherine's Church in Ostrava-Hrabová
Available courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, including children's races and 5 km Nordic Walking
Start and registration at the Cultural House Ostrava - Hrabová, Bažanova Street
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The start number is with a chip and is refundable. The registration fee includes a medal for those registered by April 13, 2026, post-race refreshments, changing rooms and toilets, SMS result service, and participation in the Hrabovský and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for 5 km). Recommended transportation is buses DPO lines 27, 41, 39, 77 with a stop at Hrabová, kostelík. Results are announced within 20 minutes at the registration site after the race. For safety reasons, the use of headphones during the race is not allowed. The 5 km and 2.5 km courses include running, Nordic Walking, and children's races (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1000 m). The surface is asphalt, suitable for all age groups, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov je tradičné bežecké podujatie v meste Vranov nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka nočný zážitok z behu mestom. Pretek sa koná v areáli Základnej školy Sídlisko II. a je určený pre mužov, ženy aj deti. Štart hlavnej kategórie je o 19:30, detský beh začína o 17:00. Organizátormi sú OZ S rukou v ruke, Základná škola Sídlisko II, Mesto Vranov nad Topľou a OZ Vranovské Vydry, ktorí srdečne pozývajú všetkých bežcov na priateľskú atmosféru a športový zážitok.
course_highlights: Nočný beh mestom Vranov
Štart a cieľ pri Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti
additional: Detský beh štartuje o 17:00 hod. Štartovné na mieste je 20 €. Nočná trať, registrácia online a na mieste, detský beh, štafetové behy

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia je jubilejný 40. ročník tradičného bežeckého podujatia v Galante, ktoré ponúka rôzne disciplíny pre všetky vekové kategórie. Podujatie je určené nielen pre športovcov, ale aj pre všetkých, ktorí chcú zažiť atmosféru plnú emócií, radosti z pohybu a prekonávania samých seba. Každý účastník dostane pamätnú medailu, pitný režim a občerstvenie, deti navyše vstupenku do Vodného sveta Galandia a balíček od COOP Jednota Galanta. Najlepší bežci získajú finančné odmeny a hodnotné ceny, vrátane televízorov v špeciálnych kategóriách. Po behu je pripravený kultúrny program v Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku v Galante.
course_highlights: Trate pre začiatočníkov aj pokročilých bežcov
Pamätná medaila pre každého účastníka vrátane detí
Viac než 40 hodnotných cien v záverečnej tombole
additional: Registrácia sa otvára v deň podujatia o 8:00 a uzatvára 20 minút pred štartom kategórie. Deti dostanú vstupenku do Vodného sveta Galandia a balíček od COOP Jednota Galanta. Najlepší bežci nedostanú poháre, ale hodnotné brúsené sklo. Výhercovia špeciálnych kategórií musia byť držiteľmi GalaKARTY. Po behu je pripravený kultúrny program v Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne disciplíny, odmeny, občerstvenie a kultúrny program. Registrácia je online a očakávajú sa uzávierky ulíc počas pretekov.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramaratón Košice - Miskolc je náročný medzinárodný ultrabežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 18. apríla 2026. Trasa vedie z centra Košíc do Miskolca, ponúkajúc bežcom výzvu v podobe dlhého a rozmanitého terénu. Podujatie je súčasťou série bežeckých akcií organizovaných Maratónskym klubom Košice a je určené pre vytrvalostných bežcov, ktorí hľadajú jedinečný zážitok na hranici svojich možností. Štart je na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach, čo dodáva preteku historickú atmosféru a podporu miestnych divákov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie z Košíc do Miskolca cez rôzne terény
Štart a cieľ v historickom centre Košíc na Hlavnej ulici
Medzinárodný charakter preteku s prechodom cez hranice
additional: Štart preteku je na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach medzi hotelom DoubleTree by Hilton a obchodným domom Dargov. Podujatie je súčasťou série Košice Marathon eventov a organizuje ho Maratónsky klub Košice. Nie sú uvedené konkrétne informácie o vlnách štartu, kapacitách, alebo poplatkoch. Pretek začína o 6:00 a 7:00, registrácie majú stanovené termíny a poplatky, preteky sa konajú na Hlavnej ulici a Dolnej bráne v Košiciach, je určený pre bežcov od 16 rokov a starších, kategórie zahŕňajú individuálne, dvojice a štafety.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramaratón Košice - Miskolc je prestížne bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná 18. apríla 2026. Pretekári prechádzajú z Košíc na Miskolc, čo predstavuje náročnú ultramaratónsku trasu. Podujatie je súčasťou bohatého bežeckého kalendára v regióne a ponúka jedinečný zážitok pre vytrvalostných bežcov. Organizátorom je Maratónsky klub Košice, ktorý zabezpečuje profesionálnu prípravu a organizáciu.
course_highlights: Ultramaratónska trasa z Košíc do Miskolca
Náročný terén vyžadujúci vytrvalosť a kondíciu
Prechod cez dve krajiny - Slovensko a Maďarsko
additional: Podujatie je súčasťou série bežeckých udalostí v Košiciach vrátane Medzinárodného maratónu mieru a ďalších sprievodných podujatí. Organizátori ponúkajú možnosť zapojiť sa ako dobrovoľník, vodič alebo tempár. Pretekári majú k dispozícii komplexnú organizačnú podporu a benefity spojené so štartovným. Trať prechádza cyklocestami a má nízku dopravnú záťaž, s kategóriami pre jednotlivcov, dvojčlenné, päťčlenné a desaťčlenné štafety; štartové časy sú o 6:00 a 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN je bežecké podujatie v areáli TJ Slavoj Boleráz, ktoré ponúka trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, dorastu a dospelých. Pretekári môžu súťažiť na tratiach od 50 metrov až po 10 km, pričom štart detí je o 13:00 a dospelých o 14:00. Organizátorom je obec Boleráz v spolupráci s iniciatívou Boleráz - Hýb sa. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých bežcov od 9 rokov a viac, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať pre dospelých 10 km a 5 km
Trať pre dorast od 10 do 14 rokov - 2 km
Trať pre deti do 9 rokov od 50 metrov do 1 km
additional: Štart detí o 13:00 hod., štart dospelých o 14:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a dĺžky trate. Organizátorom je Obec Boleráz a iniciatíva Boleráz - Hýb sa. Registrácia je pravdepodobne uzavretá k aprílu 2024; podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre deti aj dospelých, s elektronickým meraním času a účastníckou medailou.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: Šarišská míľa je bežecké podujatie organizované BK ZasRun v Šarišských Bohdanovciach na futbalovom ihrisku. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, mládeže, dospelých a Nordic Walking. Štart je rozdelený na detskú míľu, beh a Nordic Walking pre ženy a mužov, pričom účasť na preteku je zdarma s možnosťou dobrovoľného príspevku pri prezentácii. Podujatie ponúka príjemnú atmosféru pre bežcov všetkých úrovní a vekových skupín.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Šarišských Bohdanovciach
Kategórie pre deti, mládež, dospelých a Nordic Walking
Štart rozdelený na detskú míľu, beh a Nordic Walking pre ženy a mužov
additional: Účasť na preteku je zdarma, možnosť dobrovoľného príspevku pri prezentácii. Štart detskej míle o 16:00, beh a Nordic Walking ženy o 16:20, beh a Nordic Walking muži o 16:45. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia vrátane absolútnych porád pre Nordic Walking. Pretek začína o 16:00, je určený pre širokú verejnosť a je vhodný pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Chlieb Náš je remeselná pekáreň v Hronskom Beňadiku, ktorá vyrába kváskový chlieb tradičnými postupmi z kvalitných surovín. Zakladá si na poctivej pekárskej práci, ktorá sa prejavuje v chrumkavej kôrke, živom kvásku a vláčnom vnútri chleba. Pekáreň ponúka autentický zážitok, kde si môžete vybrať čerstvý chlieb priamo z pece. Okrem kvality chleba je pekáreň známa aj unikátnym barokovým stropom, ktorý je jedným z najoriginálnejších v Trnave.
course_highlights: Tradičné pečenie kváskového chleba z kvalitných surovín
Chrumkavá kôrka a vláčne vnútro chleba
Unikátny barokový strop v pekárni
additional: Pekáreň je otvorená utorok až piatok od 7:00 do 16:00 a sobotu od 7:00 do 11:30, prípadne do vypredania zásob. Prevádzka zdôrazňuje poctivú remeselnú výrobu a rodinný charakter firmy Trnka Gastronomy. Podujatie je spojené s tradičným pečením chleba, organizované v pekárni Dumas v Hronskom Beňadiku, vhodné pre všetkých záujemcov o pekárske remeslo.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička je tradičný bežecký pretek s bohatou históriou, ktorý sa koná pri príležitosti výročia oslobodenia obce Sovietskou armádou. Tento 32. ročník sa uskutoční 18. apríla 2026 na futbalovom ihrisku v Turčianskej Štiavničke. Trať s dĺžkou približne 10 km vedie prevažne horským terénom a ponúka bežcom náročný, ale krásny zážitok. Súťažiaci sú rozdelení do vekových kategórií, pričom sú vyhodnocované aj detské kategórie a najlepší Štiavničania. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov a tešia sa na ich účasť.
course_highlights: Trať vedie prevažne horským terénom s lesnými cestami a miestnym parkom
Dĺžka trate približne 10 km, známa ako „Štiavnická desiatka“
Štart a cieľ pri kultúrnom dome a futbalovom ihrisku v obci
additional: Online prihláška je otvorená od 1.4.2026 do 16.4.2026. Pretek je rozdelený do mužských vekových kategórií, žien a detských kategórií. Štartové čísla sú tradične šité a potlačené podľa pôvodného vzoru z Ružomberka a používajú sa dodnes. Pred pretekom sa koná slávnostné kladenie venca k pamätníku padlých hrdinov. Preteky začínajú o 10:00 a 13:15, registrácia je možná od 1. do 16. apríla 2026, podujatie má historický význam a je súčasťou miestneho kalendára športových podujatí.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici je bežecké podujatie konané v parku pod pamätníkom SNP v Banskej Bystrici. Ponúka štyri trate rôznych dĺžok vrátane detského behu, ktoré sú vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí do 6 rokov. Trať je rovinatá bez prevýšenia, čo umožňuje príjemný beh pre všetky vekové kategórie. Podujatie podporuje hendikepovaných, keď z každého štartovného putujú 2 € na ich motiváciu k pohybu.
course_highlights: Rovinaté trate bez prevýšenia
Štyri trate: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km a detský beh 500 m
Štart a cieľ v parku pod pamätníkom SNP v Banskej Bystrici
additional: Podpora: 2 € z každého zaplateného vstupného poputuje na podporu hendikepovaných. Detský beh je určený pre deti do 6 rokov (roč. 2020 - 2026) a vyžaduje prítomnosť zákonného zástupcu. Štartovné je platné od 7. apríla 2026. Trať je bez prevýšenia, čo zaručuje ľahký priebeh pretekov. trať je rovinatá, registrácia je online, podujatie podporuje zdravotne znevýhodnených, obsahuje informácie o súhlase s použitím údajov

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run je jedinečné podujatie v behu do schodov, ktoré sa uskutoční 18. apríla 2026 v administratívnej budove Polus Tower 2 v Bratislave. Pretekári zdolávajú výškový rozdiel vlastnými silami na dvoch tratiach - detskej trati s 4 poschodiami a 116 schodmi a hlavnej trati pre dospelých s 19 poschodiami a 416 schodmi. Štartuje sa individuálne v 30-sekundových intervaloch a čas je meraný elektronickým systémom. Podujatie organizuje Športová nadácia KOTRMELEC a je vedené podľa platných pravidiel TWA.
course_highlights: Dospelí: 19 poschodí / 416 schodov, dĺžka 400 m, prevýšenie +80 m
PHZ (policajti, hasiči, záchranári): 416 schodov / 19 poschodí, dĺžka 400 m, prevýšenie +80 m
Deti: 4 poschodia / 116 schodov, dĺžka 200 m, prevýšenie +21 m
additional: Štart pre deti je o 11:00, pre dospelých o 11:30. Vyhodnotenie pretekov je o 13:00. Povrch trate je 100% dlažba. Štartuje sa individuálne v 30-sekundových intervaloch s elektronickým meraním času. Ocenenia sú podľa vekových kategórií pre mužov a ženy. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
location: TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championship along with the 24th Hanácký Half Marathon is a traditional running event organized by the Olomouc Athletic Club. The race takes place in the heart of Olomouc and offers quality organization at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The club boasts a rich history and participation of its athletes in major European and world competitions. The race is suitable for a wide running public, who can enjoy the atmosphere of a championship half marathon in the beautiful environment of Moravia.
course_highlights: Regional Championship of Moravia and Silesia in Half Marathon
24th Hanácký Half Marathon with a traditional venue in Olomouc
Opportunity for runners of all levels to participate in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The races include various runs and events, detailed course information and registration have not yet been published

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč (předem), 200 Kč (na místě) pro dospělé; 30 Kč (předem), 50 Kč (na místě) pro děti; 50 Kč za štafetu
description: The Javorka Run is a traditional spring running race with many years of history, held regularly in April in the beautiful environment of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The main race over 6 km is among the fast races because the course runs on hard park paths and is only slightly hilly. The race is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and offers quality performance experiences for runners of all categories. In addition to the main race, there are also children's categories and team relays.
course_highlights: The 6 km course runs on hard park paths (gravel, paving)
Loop courses from 200 m to 1200 m, marked with flags according to categories
Slightly hilly profile of the track in a beautiful park environment
additional: Registration is possible in advance online or on the day of the race no later than 20 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race facilities are at the outdoor stage (Music Pavilion) next to Javorka Restaurant. Starts: children's categories at 9:30, main race at 11:30, team relays at 12:10. The race takes place in Javorka Park, registration is possible online or on-site, the track is surface-paved with gentle inclines and turns. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers various categories including athletes with disabilities.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovic, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zehrovický Kalspotkros is a cross-country running race covering a distance of 6.2 km with a hilly profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup and offers runners an interesting and challenging course in a natural environment. This race is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the form of hilly terrain. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality race atmosphere and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of 6.2 km
Hilly profile with undulating terrain
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026, with the start scheduled for 10:30 AM and registration from 9:00 to 10:00 AM. More information is available in the regulations on the official website.

name: Listonošův krpál
location: Praha - Jarov (u Zbraslavi), Praha, Czech Republic
description: Listonošův krpál is a hill race in Prague - Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with an elevation gain of 150 meters. This race is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts and uphill runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, providing a dynamic and attractive racing experience.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.88 km
Elevation gain 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026. Registration details are not specified. It is part of the mountain running series in Prague.

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Tolštejn Estate Race Jiřetín pod Jedlovou - Jedlová is a mountain uphill run 6 km long with an elevation gain of 340 meters, aiming to reach the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course with beautiful views. This race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the Lusatian Mountains.
course_highlights: Length of the course 6 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Finish at the summit of Jedlová
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race is open to the general public, registration is possible online, and children can participate for free. The event is combined with opportunities for trips around the area, including visits to the Jedlová lookout tower and the Tolštejn ruins.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB: I Don't Want to Be Last is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering a unique experience of running in an African and walking safari environment. The race is open to the general public and offers three routes: 2 km family run, 5 km, and 10 km race, with the 10 km route being two laps of the 5 km course. The surface of the routes is mainly paved asphalt, with start and finish at the main entrance to the safari park. Included in the registration fee is free entry to the safari park on race day and support for the rescue of bald zebras.
course_highlights: The route passes through African and walking safaris
Mainly paved asphalt surface
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Race bibs are equipped with a chip that remains with the runner. The registration fee includes free entry to the safari park on race day, a registration bag with gifts from partners, a meal voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, light refreshments at the finish line (water, fruit), and accompanying activities for children at the main partner ČSOB's stand. The race is suitable for families and more experienced runners, with online registration available for various dates. The event is combined with activities in the safari park and supports nature conservation.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
description: Spring Run in Dražovka in Hořovice is a traditional trophy race that invites competitors of all ages to an active sporting experience. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Dražovka and offers an opportunity for sports enjoyment and meeting other runners. Registration is possible online at brdskypohar.cz or directly on-site on the day of the race. We look forward to your participation and wish everyone much success and joy in running.
course_highlights: Trophy race in the picturesque environment of Dražovka
Suitable for both large and small competitors
Online registration available as well as on-site
additional: Registration is preferred online at www.brdskypohar.cz, but on-site registration on the race day is also possible. Trail run suitable for all age groups, registration via the website, same-day registration on-site is available.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Husínský cross-country is a traditional spring running race in Tajanov near Klatovy, which was created as a replacement for the canceled Klatovská patnáctka. The race has been held since 2012 and is part of the prestigious Ešus league series. Men run three laps, women and girls two laps, with each lap approximately 3.6 km long and mostly on forest paths with a section on smooth asphalt. In recent years, the course has returned to the original longer variant around the Husín forest. The main referee is running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer.
course_highlights: Circuit approximately 3.6 km with two-thirds on forest paths
One-third of the course runs on smooth asphalt
Course runs around the Husín forest
additional: The race is part of the Ešus league series, which will have its 42nd edition in 2026 and includes 22 races. Men run 10.5 km (3 laps), women and men over 70 run 7 km (2 laps). The start is at the volleyball courts in Tajanov. The organizer is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the prestigious Ešus league series, which has previously been held virtually due to the pandemic. The event attracts a wide participation and has a long tradition in the region.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou, now in its 43rd year. The race takes place on a certified course of 21.097 km, which runs along a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality and includes ascents and descents. The start is at 10:00 AM at the square in Bakov nad Jizerou, and the race offers monetary and material prizes for the best men and women. Registrations are possible in advance with a lower starting fee or on the race day for a higher fee.
course_highlights: Certified course of 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with variable surface quality
Refreshment stations at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:45 AM in a building approximately 150 meters from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. A prize of 2000 CZK is awarded for breaking course records in the absolute categories of men and women. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer or on the race day at the venue. The route runs along a hilly asphalt road with alternating surface quality, there are refreshment stations on the course, and categories are announced by age, with the possibility of winning prizes for records.

name: Ještěd SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd SkyRace® is a traditional trail running race held in the beautiful environment of the Ještěd ridge near Liberec. The race offers several route options, including the premier SkyRace route with a length of 22 km and an elevation gain of 1390 m, as well as shorter trails Trail (13 km) and Easy (6 km). The event is suitable for runners of all levels, including races for children and canicross. The start and finish are located in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd, providing stunning views and challenging terrain. The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Premier SkyRace route: 22 km with 1390 m elevation gain
Other routes: Trail 13 km / 945 m+, Easy 6 km / 300 m+
Start and finish in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd
additional: The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM. The races include children's categories and canicross. Start and finish are in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd. The routes are challenging with significant elevation gain, suitable for mountain running enthusiasts. Distances are 6 km, 13 km, and 22 km; accompanying events, trail camps, merchandising, registration, entertainment, and nutrition are available during the race weekend.

name: Pyšelský kopeček
organizer: parta běžců z Pyšel a Kopeček 2016, z.s.
description: Pyšelský Kopeček is a traditional trail run in the picturesque environment of Pyšel, offering routes for all levels of runners from recreational to ultramarathoners. The course is 90% forest trails and includes loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km. Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are designated as UTMB index races, attracting experienced runners. The start and finish are at the football field in Pyšel, which provides facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The event is suitable for the general public and is accompanied by children's races and canicross.
course_highlights: Course is 90% forest trails
Loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km
Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are UTMB index races
additional: The race has a limit of 250 participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and showers are available at the start and finish area. Parking is available at designated spots outside the start area, respecting residents. For canicross, there are refreshment stations for dogs along the course. Children's races have manual timing, adult categories use electronic timing. Starts are divided into waves from 10:00 to 14:15 with winners announced at 17:00. The ultraPUNKtrail courses of 52 km and 105 km branch off and reconnect with the classic 21 km route. The race includes registration, timing, and facilities at the start and finish; it is also suitable for children and beginners.

name: Run for ProCit
price_range: 550 Kč online, 600 Kč na místě, děti do 10 let zdarma
description: RUN for ProCit is a charitable family run organized by the civic association ProCit in Pilsen, supporting families with children with autism spectrum disorder. The event takes place annually in April on the occasion of World Autism Awareness Day and offers routes for children and adults, including the possibility of Nordic walking. The run is complemented by a rich accompanying program for children and parents and is dog-friendly, so runners with dogs can also participate. The proceeds from registration fees and accompanying activities are donated to support families with children with autism.
course_highlights: 2 children's routes without registration and time measurement
2 km and 5 km routes with time measurement and winners announced
Color zone on the track, which can be run around
additional: On-site registration from 8:30 AM. Children's runs start at 10:00 and 10:10, 2 km run at 10:15, 5 km run at 10:45. Possibility to complete the 2 km route as Nordic walking with an instructor. Every participant who crosses the finish line receives a commemorative medal. The run is dog-friendly. On-site charity raffle and refreshments. Registration from 8:30, starts from 10:00, charity event, opportunity to purchase small gifts and raffle tickets.

name: Dačická 14
location: Dačice, Rybník Peráček, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Sdružení běžců Dačic, Běh Vysočiny z. s.
price_range: 100 Kč - 150 Kč, mládež do 17 let zdarma
description: Dačická 14 is a traditional running race held in Dačice, South Bohemia, on April 18, 2026. It offers various courses and categories, including for adults, youth, and children, with predominantly mixed terrain consisting of fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections. The event is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive enthusiasts, with the opportunity to win valuable prizes and set record times.
course_highlights: Various course lengths including 13.5 km, 9.7 km, 4.3 km, and 1.475 km
Mixed terrain including fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections
Categories for different age groups including youth and children
additional: The race offers multiple distances and categories, registration is possible online and on-site, including for children and youth categories. The course runs through fields, forest paths, and park trails, with opportunities to win prizes for record times and is complemented by refreshments and water during the race.

name: ŘepoRun
description: ŘepoRun is a running race held in Řeporyje, Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race is organized by the enthusiastic group Run Labe Run and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The route runs around Řeporyje, and participants receive a start package and a medal after finishing. Registration is available online with a lower entry fee until April 10, 2026; later, on-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: The route runs around Řeporyje
Children's courses 200 m, 600 m, and 1300 m
Time measured with a chip on the start number
additional: Start packages can be picked up from 9:00 to 11:30 for children and from 10:00 to 11:45 for adults. The time is measured using a chip on the start number, which is not returned. After the race, a baggage storage service is available. Parking is limited; public transport is recommended. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached. Registration is open until April 10, 2026. Race categories include various distances, with starts divided by age groups. The race features chip timing.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a friendly sporting event in Děčín that offers various running disciplines including a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, and children's races. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of the Elbe Valley at Mariánská Louka and is suitable for all age groups and fitness levels. The program also includes Nordic Walking and accompanying activities that ensure fun and sporting experiences for the whole family.
course_highlights: various distances including half marathon and 5 km
friendly environment in nature in the Elbe Valley
accompanying activities for children and adults
additional: The event is family-friendly and offers various sports activities. Registration is possible online. The races are suitable for all age groups and will be held in April 2026.

name: Kotva race
location: T.J. Sokol Maxičky, Děčín, Czech Republic
price_range: 250,- to 800,- CZK podle kategorie a data registrace
description: The Kotva race is an obstacle course race held in Děčín that combines a sporting challenge with the values of the Sokol movement. The race takes place on April 18, 2026, and offers a main race for participants born in 2011 and earlier, as well as children's and canicross categories. Participants can look forward to a demanding terrain with obstacles that will test their strength, endurance, and determination. Registration is possible online and on-site with an increased starting fee, and parental consent is required for competitors under 18.
course_highlights: Obstacle course race in terrain with various challenging obstacles
Course suitable for competitors born in 2011 and earlier
Categories for children and canicross
additional: On-site registration is possible on the day of the race from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children's race with an increased entry fee. For competitors under 18, written parental consent and submission of a signed legal responsibility statement (REVERZ) are required. It is recommended to arrive early to avoid waiting in line. The race includes the main run, canicross, and children's races. Registration must be completed in advance. The race is open to the general public, including people with disabilities and children from 2 years old.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Student Run Bakov is a traditional children's running race held since 2002 in Bakov nad Jizerou. The races take place on the athletic track at the elementary school, where children can run in trainers. Competitions are held in twelve categories from preschoolers to juniors, including relay races. The event is part of the accompanying program of the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and recognition of the best competitors with diplomas, medals, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: Circuits around the athletic track at the elementary school
Circuit length of 313 meters
Running on the sidewalk, possibility to use trainers
additional: Participant registration takes place on the day of the race in the theater hall of the elementary school and ends 30 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race is free of charge. Awards include diplomas, medals, and small sports supplies; relays include sweets and gifts from sponsors. The race has been moved from the square to the athletic track due to reconstruction of the square. The race will be held in April 2026, featuring various distances from 200 m to 1500 m, and is open to the general public. Applications can be submitted via the race's website or Facebook page.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park Rožnov, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: Valasský Trak 2026 is a half marathon held on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in the City Park in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. This race offers a sporting atmosphere in the heart of the city and is ideal for runners who want to experience running in a beautiful environment with a friendly community. The start and finish are located in the park, ensuring convenient access and a pleasant environment for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Half marathon in City Park Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Start and finish in the park with a pleasant sporting atmosphere
Run in the heart of the city with a friendly community
additional: The event also includes cultural activities such as an Easter creative workshop, concerts, and workshops in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm.

name: TIŠNOVSKÉ KOZY 2026
location: Tišnov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 200 Kč for main race, free for children

description: Tišnovské Kozy 2026 is a charity trail run taking place on April 18 in Tišnov. The race offers two options - a relay for pairs over 2x5 km and an individual race over 10 km, guided through the scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections. The event celebrates movement, fun, and community, with accompanying activities for children and adults. All proceeds from registration fees and jersey sales are donated to support the Lokomoce association and the Člověče, hýbej se! initiative.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections
A time limit of 3 hours allows completing the course even on foot
Start and finish at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval, with a climb to Květnice and Klucanina
additional: Children's races are free but require online registration due to timing chips. The start and finish are at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval. The main race has a time limit of 3 hours. An original running jersey with your name is available for order until March 8, 2026. After the race, a raffle with valuable prizes takes place. The accompanying program includes archery, airsoft shooting range, face painting, music and drum shows, and other activities for children and adults. The trail race can be registered online, with proceeds supporting children's initiatives. The event also includes walking, refreshments, and activities for all age groups.

name: Děčín Run Fest 2026
price_range: 399,- Kč to 850,- Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a traditional running event held on April 18th in Děčín at Mariánská louka along the Labská cycle path. It offers a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, children's races, and a relay for pairs, including a Nordic Walking half marathon. The event is complemented by presentations of sports activities and an accompanying program that invites all age groups to active sports and family entertainment. Starts are divided from morning to afternoon with results announced and a charitable focus for the family and children's runs.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 5 km run along the Labská cycle path
Family run and children's races of various lengths
Nordic Walking half marathon and relay for pairs
additional: Registration from 08:30 to 12:55, with the latest registration 20 minutes before the start. Starts are divided into Nordic Walking half marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, family run, and children's races. The family and children's runs have a charitable focus, with registration fees going to charitable causes. The relay for pairs involves a handover at the turnaround point. Categories are based on age and gender. The event includes an accompanying program and sale of sports equipment. It takes place at Mariánská louka and around the Labská cycle path in Děčín.

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín - Jedlová uphill run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, taking place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging route of 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 meters, leading from 434 meters above sea level to the summit of Jedlová Mountain at 774 meters above sea level. The course is a combination of asphalt, gravel, and forest paths. Participants start at 8:00 AM from the sports complex and can look forward to monetary prizes and a running raffle.
course_highlights: Length of the course 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest paths
Start at the sports complex in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, finish at the top of Jedlová Mountain
additional: Categories by age from juniors to seniors, monetary prizes for category winners and for breaking the course record, running raffle with prize draws, race at own risk, basic medical care provided. Terrain: hilly, trail; registration: online or on-site; Memorial of Milan Krupka.

name: Dehtářská 10°
location: RS Kletečná, Kletečná u Humpolce, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Dehtářská 10° is a cross-country race in the Vysočina region intended for the general public and all age groups. It offers courses of 5, 10, and 20 km, with the main race approximately 10 km long and an elevation gain of 85 meters. The race takes place at RS Kletečná near Humpolec and is known for its friendly atmosphere, where everyone who surpasses themselves is a winner. Registration takes place on the race day from 11:00 to 13:30, and the start is at 14:00. Participants can enjoy the beauty of Vysočina and a sporting experience in a pleasant community of runners.
course_highlights: Main course approximately 10 km with an elevation gain of 85 m
Option to choose between courses of 5, 10, and 20 km
Race in the picturesque nature of Vysočina at RS Kletečná
additional: Race registration takes place on the race day from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is suitable for all age and performance categories. Maps of all routes are available for download in SVG format. Contact persons are listed with phone numbers for technical support, marketing, and course/registration. Registration is from 11:00 to 13:30, with the race start at 14:00 at RS Kletečná. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and families.

name: Safari běh ČSOB
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering three courses: a family run of 2 km, a 5 km race, and a 10 km race. The routes mainly lead along paved asphalt paths and include passages through African and walking safaris, providing a unique experience in contact with nature and animals. The start and finish are at the main entrance to the safari park. The race is suitable for the general public, including families, and promotes the protection of bald zebras and other animals in the park.
course_highlights: Routes lead through African and walking safaris
Surface mainly paved asphalt paths
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Start number with an embedded chip that remains with the runner. Entry to the safari park is free on race day. The registration fee includes a registration bag with gifts, a voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, and light refreshments during the race (water, fruit). There is an option to contribute to elephant protection as part of the registration fee. Activities for children are available at the main partner ČSOB's booth. The event has been moved to October 18, 2026, due to animal protection measures against foot-and-mouth disease. The park operates with safety measures; registration is possible with options for transfer or refund of the registration fee. The event is suitable for families and athletes, with beneficent activities supporting animal protection in Africa.

name: Běh O pohár století
location: Zámecký park Pacov, Pacov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Cup of the Century is a cross-country race held in Pacov in the castle park, offering courses on circuits of 1100 and 500 meters long. The race takes place on hilly terrain along park paths and is suitable for trail shoes. Men run a distance of 5.5 km, women 3.3 km. The organizer is TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov, which ensures a quality sports experience in the beautiful Vysočina environment.
course_highlights: Circuits of 1100 and 500 meters in the castle park
Hilly terrain along park paths
Option to use trail shoes
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, the main category begins at 11:40. The organizer is TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov, contact Pavel Zajíc, phone 731 189 985. The race is a cross/trail type cross-country in the castle park in Pacov, Vysočina. The race is part of the local athletics calendar; specific registration details are not provided, but it is suitable for runners of all levels who enjoy trail and cross races.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running race organized by the Municipality of Csepel as part of the Active Csepel series. The race starts at the beautiful Csepel Danube bank, from the György Kolonics Leisure Center, and offers four distances for movement: 3.5 km, 7 km, 400 m children's run, and a special race for people with disabilities. The goal of the race is to share the community experience and the joy of movement for all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Wearing a bib number is mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The race route runs along Kolonics promenade, on the Danube bank
Chip timing and absolute male and female podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances
The children's run route passes under the two-arched bridge, with parental supervision allowed
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are advised to use their own softcup, bottle, or cup. Medals are awarded to the youngest participants, while older runners receive a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish line. Starting with a stroller is only permitted at your own risk. The special race for people with disabilities is a joyful run where walking and strolling are also allowed. Multiple distances require registration, environmentally friendly chip timing, awards, family and special categories, route along the Danube, outdoor event, rain or sunshine.

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged that supports young people living in child protection services. The race starts from the Dome Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic and have a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, dedicating a day to movement, community, and care. The registration fees fund developments and experiences for the supported youth.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic with a solid surface route
Start and finish at the Dome Square, an iconic Szeged location
Secured course with police and volunteers
additional: The race offers distances for various age groups and fitness levels, including children's races and adult distances. A parental consent form is mandatory for children. Bicycle escorts and multiple checkpoints ensure the safety of participants. After the race, special bathing offers await participants, and the official ice cream flavor will be mango-passion fruit. Race participants support the ÁGOTA® Foundation. The event features multiple distances and categories, with the course starting from the Dome Square and running through the city environment. Participation is possible through online registration.

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged that supports young people living in child protection services. The race starts from the Dóm Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic, with a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, either individually or in teams. The event is not only a sports competition but also a community gathering that helps disadvantaged youth with increasing support year after year.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic, flat, paved route
Start and finish at Szeged Cathedral Square
Bicycle escort and police security at intersections
additional: The race offers options for various age groups and distances, including children's races (100 m, 400 m, 800 m), adult distances (3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 21 km), and a 4x3 km relay race. Bicycle escort and police security ensure safety during the event. Registration is available online, with limited on-site registration. Participants under 18 must have parental consent. After the race, special bath offers and gifts await participants. The participation supports child protection youth, with online registration available, multiple running options, and categories.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS Národný beh Devín - Bratislava je najstaršie športové podujatie na Slovensku s viac ako 100-ročnou tradíciou, ktoré sa uskutoční už 78. raz. Bežci absolvujú ikonickú trasu z historického hradu Devín do centra Bratislavy, čo prináša jedinečnú atmosféru a spojenie histórie so športom. Podujatie je vhodné pre hobby športovcov aj náročnejších bežcov a každoročne pritiahne tisíce účastníkov rôzneho veku. Organizátorom je STaRZ mesta Bratislava, ktorý zabezpečuje kompletné organizačné informácie a registráciu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie z hradu Devín do centra Bratislavy
Cestný beh s viac ako 5 000 účastníkmi
Historická a ikonická bežecká tradícia od roku 1921
additional: Online registrácia je možná do 15. apríla 2026 do 20:00 h. Možnosť hromadnej registrácie cez e-mail hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk s fakturačnými údajmi. K dispozícii je limitovaná edícia tričiek za 13 EUR. Štartová listina je dostupná online. Podujatie organizuje STaRZ mesta Bratislava. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne trate v Devíne, registrácia je dostupná online, a je súčasťou bežeckého seriálu Slovenského atletického zväzu. Súčasťou je aj možnosť sledovať výsledky a štatistiky na oficiálnych stránkach.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je určený pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa kategórií a výkonov.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km) v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Prezentácia a registrácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30 hod. Pri rovnosti bodov v súťaži rozhoduje najlepší čas po prepočte koeficientom a potom veľkosť topánky. Súťažiaci môžu získať plusový bod za zlepšenie svojho najlepšieho času v roku. Na konci roka sa z celkových výsledkov vymažú dve najhoršie mesiace (amnestia). Pretek sa koná na verejnej ceste v oblasti Kuchajdy, Bratislava; kategórie zahŕňajú deti, juniory, ženy, mužov a veteránov; registrácia je možná aj na mieste.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: Beh 2 míle v Bratislave pri Kuchajde je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom. Prezentácia a registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00 hod. Závod je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Súťaž je súčasťou putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa výsledné časy prepočítavajú podľa vekových koeficientov a pretekári sú bodovaní podľa účasti a výkonov.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km) v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Prezentácia a štart pri volejbalovom ihrisku
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 pri volejbalovom ihrisku. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa body prideľujú podľa účasti a výkonov s možnosťou amnestie na dve najhoršie účasti v roku. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje vek a najlepší čas v danom roku. Beh sa koná na Areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava, s možnosťou registrácie od 9:30 a štartom o 10:00. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, hodnotenie podľa bodov a časov, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka - 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v obci Sačurov v okrese Vranov nad Topľou. Preteky sa štartujú pred budovou základnej školy v Sačurove a ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny vrátane detí, dorastu a dospelých. Hlavná kategória štartuje o 13:00 hod., deti o 12:00 hod. Organizátormi sú obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ a MŠ Sačurov. Pretek je vhodný pre miestnych bežcov aj začínajúcich športovcov.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú v obci Sačurov pred základnou školou
Kategórie od predškolského veku až po seniorov nad 70 rokov
Vyhodnotenie najlepších bežcov za okres Vranov
additional: Štartovné sa platí výlučne online. Muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov štartovné neplatia. Štart detí je o 12:00 hod., hlavných kategórií o 13:00 hod. Vyhodnotenie najlepších bežcov za okres Vranov je súčasťou podujatia. Pretek je súčasťou podujatia na podporu komunity, s možnosťou online registrácie a rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňanská desiatka - Memoriál Jána Osloviča je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v obci Slovenská Kajňa. Preteky ponúkajú tri disciplíny: dlhý beh na 10 km, krátky beh na 3,66 km a krátky nordic walking na 3,66 km, všetky štartujú súčasne o 13:00. Súťaž je rozdelená do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov a ženy, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôzneho veku a výkonnosti. Organizátorom je spoločnosť MATORE s.r.o., ktorá zabezpečuje kvalitnú organizáciu a meranie časov.
course_highlights: Dlhý beh na 10 km v príjemnom prostredí obce Slovenská Kajňa
Krátky beh a nordic walking na 3,66 km s rovnakým štartom
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov a ženy
additional: Registrácia na mieste je možná od 9:30 v deň pretekov. Limit účastníkov pre dospelých je 130. Všetky disciplíny štartujú súčasne o 13:00. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií a vekových skupín, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štart je naplánovaný na 13:00, a súčasťou sú aj detské preteky a sprievodné aktivity.

description: Kajňanská desiatka - Memoriál Jána Osloviča je bežecké podujatie konané v Slovenskej Kajni pred budovou Obecného úradu. Pretekárov čakajú trate 10 km, 4 km a Nordic Walking bez vekového obmedzenia, ako aj detské kategórie. Štart hlavnej kategórie je o 13:00, detské behy začínajú o 12:00. Organizátormi sú Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné a Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina. Podujatie je súčasťou POWERGRAF bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2026.
course_highlights: Trate 10 km, 4 km a Nordic Walking v obci Slovenská Kajňa
Štart pred budovou Obecného úradu
Súčasť POWERGRAF bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2026
additional: Detské behy štartujú o 12:00. Limit pretekárov je 150. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane Nordic Walking. Organizátori sú Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné a Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina. Podujatie zatiaľ nemá zverejnené podrobnosti o registrácii alebo štartovnom, ide však o významnú bežeckú udalosť v regióne.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke, Likavka, Ružomberok, Slovakia
description: Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Obecným úradom Likavka a ZŠ s MŠ Likavka. Preteky sa konajú na Futbalovom štadióne Obecného športového klubu v Likavke a sú súčasťou Liptovskej bežeckej ligy 2025. Súťažiť môžu deti, žiaci, dorast, ženy a muži v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:05 hod., pre dospelých o 11:40 hod. podľa propozícií. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príležitosť zmerať si sily v peknom prostredí obce Likavka.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na Futbalovom štadióne Obecného športového klubu v Likavke
Súčasť Liptovskej bežeckej ligy 2025
Kategórie pre deti, žiakov, dorast, ženy a mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách
additional: Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:05 hod., pre dospelých o 11:40 hod. podľa propozícií. Kategórie zahŕňajú deti, žiactvo, dorast, ženy a mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách. Organizátorom je Obecný úrad Likavka a ZŠ s MŠ Likavka. Súťaž je súčasťou Liptovskej bežeckej ligy 2025. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom štadióne, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie a je súčasťou regionálnej bežeckej série.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
description: Čadčianska desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Klubom Kysuckého maratónu Čadca, mestom Čadca a Centrom sociálnych služieb Čadca Žarec. Tento 30. ročník sa uskutoční 19. apríla 2026 so štartom o 10. hodine v lokalite Sídlisko Žarec v Čadci. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na kvalitne pripravenú trať a príjemnú atmosféru podujatia, ktoré je obľúbené medzi bežeckou komunitou v regióne. Registrácia je možná online až do 17. apríla 2026, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj v deň preteku za zvýšené štartovné.
course_highlights: Tradičný bežecký pretek s dlhoročnou históriou
Štart a cieľ na Sídlisku Žarec v Čadci
Pretek o pohár primátora mesta Čadca
additional: Registrácia je možná aj v deň preteku s vyšším štartovným 10 €. Organizátori žiadajú prihlásiť sa aj v prípade neistoty účasti, aby sa urýchlil proces prezentácie a minimalizovali chyby pri zápise mien. V prípade neúčasti nebude meno uvedené vo výsledkovej listine. Pretek sa koná 19. apríla 2026 o 10:00, registrácia je možná do 17. apríla 2026, štart a cieľ na sídlisku Žarec, preteky sú súčasťou tradičného športového podujatia s bohatou históriou.

name: 5. Prunéřovský půlmaratón
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The 5th Prunéřov Half Marathon is the first race of the SUMMER RUNNING CUP, held on a cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice. The course is certified, looped, and run on two laps with minimal elevation gain, ensuring a fast and enjoyable run. The race is organized by the Running Club F - C Kadaň, z.s. and is suitable for the general running public. The start is at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy a quality running atmosphere in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Certified looped course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Running on a cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice
additional: The race is part of the SUMMER RUNNING CUP. Shorter races for children are also available: Prep (250 m), Younger pupils (750 m), and Older pupils (1,500 m), all with looped courses. Registration is simple and allows for data adjustments and transfer of registration to another runner. The entry fee is 250 CZK without division into time or price segments. The race is open to the general public, offers various distances, and is part of the running cup, with minimal elevation gain and a flat course.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
location: Hluboká nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run around Hluboká is the regional championship in road running over 25 km, held in the picturesque environment of Hluboká nad Vltavou. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a challenging course with beautiful views and a quality asphalt surface. The race is part of the South Bohemian regional athletics calendar and is suitable for experienced runners seeking a challenge in a longer road distance. The organizer is Atletika Veselí, which ensures a professional race course and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course 25 km long around Hluboká nad Vltavou
Regional championship in road running with official timing
Beautiful views and a quality asphalt surface
additional: Registration for the race often takes place on the day of the event, usually up to 30 minutes before the start. Atletika Veselí also offers the sale of club caps and headbands. Parking is available at the sports complex. Athletics training sessions are held outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, taking place on April 19, 2026, and is suitable for the general running public.

name: Racio běh kolem Dyje
location: Národní hrdinů, Břeclav, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50 Kč běh na 5 km, ostatní kategorie zdarma
description: The Dyje Run Race is a traditional athletic event organized by the Athletic Club TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav, taking place on Sunday, April 19, 2026. The race offers courses for various age categories from the youngest children to adults, with the main 5 km run on a loop around the Dyje River. Youth categories run within the Racia complex, the former sugar factory, and the race is suitable for the general public as well as competitors. The registration office opens at 8:30 at the start location, and changing rooms are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall.
course_highlights: 5 km loop around the Dyje River (3 laps)
Youth courses in the Racia complex (former sugar factory)
Various course lengths adapted to age categories
additional: The race office will be open from 8:30 at the start site. Changing rooms and showers are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall. The youth and junior categories run simultaneously but are evaluated separately. The race takes place in the park at Racia on Národní hrdinů Street. Registration is possible online or on-site. Changing rooms and showers are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall.

name: Bolatická 20

description: The Bolatice Twenty is a traditional event for tourists and runners, held annually in Bolatice. The race offers distances of 20 km and 10 km with routes mainly through forest terrain, alternating cross-country sections with asphalt. There is also a walk of 20 km or a shortened 10 km route in a pleasant forest environment. The event has a long-standing tradition since 1977 and attracts hundreds of participants, including friends from Slovakia. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool, where entertainment is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Routes mainly lead through the forest around Strahovské Ponds and Chuchelnický Forest
Alternation of cross-country sections with asphalt parts
Both walk and run are marked in yellow
additional: Registration for runners on site takes place from 8:00 to 8:55, pre-registered participants only need to report their name and pick up their number. The 3 km run starts at 9:20 and the 500 m run at 9:22. The walk starts from 7:30 to 9:00. The race takes place amidst full road traffic; participants must adhere to traffic rules. After the race, from 12:00, entertainment with the country band CARAVANA is available. Registration is possible on-site; the event will be held on April 19, 2026; routes mainly pass through forested areas.

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Velodrom, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: CRAFT Brno Half Marathon, Ten and Five is a traditional running event of international significance held in Brno with the center at the velodrome. The event is open to the general public, from world-class athletes to recreational runners, and includes children's races. The race offers courses of 21.1 km, 10.5 km, and 5 km, with the possibility to participate in relay races. The organizers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s., who annually prepare this popular sporting event.
course_highlights: Center of the race at the Brno velodrome
Traditional road courses of 21.1 km, 10.5 km, and 5 km
Races for all age categories including children
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, the main category at 11:00. The race is open to the general public, including relay races and children's categories. The organizers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The race is part of the traditional running calendar, offering races for children and adults, and is organized with an emphasis on a friendly atmosphere and promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Chřibská Town Race in the uphill run to Studenec, which takes place in the picturesque environment of the Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for both top competitors and recreational runners and serves as a qualification for the World Youth Championships in uphill running. The course measures 6.1 km with an elevation gain of 397 meters, and the finish line is at the Studenec lookout tower. The start is at 10:00 AM in the Chřibská town square, with registration starting at 8:30 AM at the Chřibská Town Hall.
course_highlights: 6.1 km course in the varied terrain of the Lusatian Mountains
Elevation gain of 397 meters
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 AM at the Chřibská Town Hall. Prizes for the top three in each category and a running raffle. The race is a qualification for the World Youth Championships in uphill running. The race takes place in the Lusatian Mountains area, registration begins at 8:30 AM, the start is at 10:00 AM, the course passes through beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Žatecký půlmaratón a desítka
description: The Žatec Half Marathon and 10K is a popular running race held in Žatec, taking place on April 19, 2026. Participants can choose between the half marathon (21 km) and the 10K (10 km), both courses run on paved paths along the Ohře River towards Vičice and Stroupeč. The event also includes children's races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m. Registration takes place at the football field behind the river, the main races start in the morning, and all finishers receive a participation medal.
course_highlights: Courses run on paved paths along the Ohře River
Half marathon 21 km and 10K 10 km
Accompanying children's races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m
additional: Registration for participants takes place from 8:00 to 10:00 at the football field behind the river. Children's races start at 10:00, the half marathon at 11:00, and the 10K at 11:15. All finishers receive a participation medal. Registration is already ongoing, and the races include the half marathon, 10K, triathlon, and Advent run; the races are suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
location: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: Dětské závody: 80-100 Kč, hlavní závod: 200-250 Kč, štafety: 200 Kč
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants conquer Petřín Hill in three different ways: by interval running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, running uphill with a mass start, and interval running down a slope on an unpaved path and stairs. The overall classification is based on the sum of times from all three segments, with bonuses for the best runners. There are ten age categories for children with routes around Hladová Zed. The race also offers a relay option, where three runners each complete one part of the race.
course_highlights: Running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower with interval start
Uphill run of 1 km with an elevation gain of 118 m with a mass start
Interval running down a slope of 1 km on an unpaved path and stairs
additional: Race office and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after 30 runners for descending from the tower. Children's races have routes of 200 m, 365 m, and 730 m with results announced immediately after finishing. Relays consist of 3 runners, each running one part of the race, starting together with individual runners; relay participants cannot compete in the main race. The schedule runs from 7:45 to 12:35 with main race results announced at 11:30. Terrain includes stairs and unpaved paths; registration is via the Apachi platform; the race is part of the series "Lookouts in Motion"; it offers multiple categories and a relay running option.

name: Charitativní běh NF Křídla dětem
location: Ostrava-Poruba, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: dobrovolné startovné, 150-400 Kč podle věkové skupiny a registrace
description: Charity run of the Křídla dětem Foundation is a traditional annual event held in Ostrava-Poruba to support sick children in pediatric hematology-oncology at the University Hospital. The run is open to all age groups, including children's races and walking routes. The event combines sports activity with a charitable purpose, with proceeds helping to make hospital stays more pleasant for children through necessary gifts. The run takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, and offers the opportunity to contribute even without participating in the run.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ostrava-Poruba at the University Hospital, pediatric hematology-oncology department
Children's races over 550 m and 1000 m, adult routes of 5 km and 10 km (2 laps)
Free parking next to the VŠB Sports Hall with access from Studentská street
additional: Children's races start at 9:30 (up to 6 years old) and 9:45 (7-12 years old). Adult routes are 5 km and 10 km (2 laps). Free parking at VŠB Ostrava Sports Hall. In case of registration errors, contact guras@kridladetem.cz. Entry fee is non-refundable in case of absence. It is possible to donate the entry fee as a gift certificate. The event includes various routes, online and on-site registration, free parking, options to contribute financially or in kind, and is associated with a charity collection and accompanying activities.

name: Šaratický běh

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
description: The 15 Brods of the White Creek is an off-road adventure running race taking place through the beautiful valley of the White Creek around the settlement of Šmelcovna. The longest route measures approximately 22 km and includes 16 fords, which are runnable and most can be bypassed via a footbridge. The race is suitable for hobby runners and moderately trained athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. There are three routes available: 7 km non-competitive, 15 km with 7 fords, and 22 km with an additional loop and elevation gain. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths, is well-marked, and offers beautiful natural scenery.

At the end of the race, there is approximately 1.7 km of steep ascent
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours, with a 50-minute window to split the route into 6.6 km segments. Slower runners are directed to the finish line and evaluated on the shorter route. The course is marked with arrows and ribbons. Water in the fords is above ankle level; the fords are runnable, and most of the heavier fords can be bypassed. There is an option to change the route length even during the race. An off-road race with fords, routes of 7, 15, and 22 km, easy terrain, natural environment, marked trails, and a time limit of 3 hours.
