Štart 10 km behu je o 12:00, 5 km beh o 12:05 a nordic walking o 12:10. Maximálny počet účastníkov na jednotlivých tratiach je 250. Podujatie organizuje Občianske združenie Horný Chríb. Pretek sa koná 9. mája 2026, registrácia je možná do 7. mája 2024, štart je naplánovaný na približne 12:00 hod. na futbalovom ihrisku v areáli OŠK Dolná Krupá.

name: BTK Run Fest
organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 je bežecké podujatie pre všetkých, ktoré sa uskutoční 9. mája v areáli kaštieľa vo Veľkom Bieli. Ponúka rôzne disciplíny vrátane 5 km a 10 km cestných behov, detských behov, štafety rodič + dieťa a adrenalínového prekážkového behu pre deti aj dospelých. Trasy vedú prevažne po asfaltových a spevnených plochách okolo jazera s malebným okolím. Podujatie je vhodné pre rekreačných bežcov, rodiny aj skúsených športovcov, pričom sú pripravené ocenenia a medaily pre najlepších i finišerov.
course_highlights: 85% asfalt a 15% spevnené plochy
Rovinatá trasa okolo jazera so štartom a cieľom v kaštieli
Dve okruhy pre 10 km beh preveria kondíciu bežcov
additional: Detské behy majú trasy 350m, 600m a 1000m. Štafeta rodič + dieťa je na 2x 350m. Prekážkový beh je určený pre deti aj dospelých s dĺžkou 1 km. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo, občerstvenie, fotografie a ocenenia. Na mieste je možná registrácia, ak nie je naplnený limit účastníkov. Časy štartov sú rozdelené podľa disciplín od 09:00 do 13:10 s vyhlasovaním výsledkov medzi behmi. Podujatie sa koná na povrchu s 85% asfaltu a 15% spevnených plôch; registrácia je otvorená s rôznymi termínmi a poplatkami; preteky zahŕňajú rôzne vzdialenosti a kategórie pre dospelých aj deti.

name: Fiľakovský cross
description: Fiľakovský cross je bežecké podujatie organizované OZ FTC Fiľakovo a Komisiou pre šport a telesnú výchovu pri MZ vo Fiľakove. Preteky sa konajú na štadióne FTC vo Fiľakove a ponúkajú rôzne kategórie vrátane detských, hobby a nordic walking. Povrch trate tvorí kombinácia poľných ciest, asfaltu a trávy, čo robí beh zaujímavým a rôznorodým. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 hodine a pre dospelých o 12:30 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú športovú atmosféru.
course_highlights: Povrch trate: poľné cesty, asfalt, tráva
Miesto štartu a cieľa: štadión FTC vo Fiľakove
Rôzne kategórie vrátane detských, hobby a nordic walking
additional: Štart detí o 10:00 hod., dospelí o 12:30 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú detské, hobby a nordic walking. Organizátorom je OZ FTC Fiľakovo a Komisia pre šport a telesnú výchovu pri MZ vo Fiľakove. Kontaktné osoby: Mgr. Attila Visnyai (0915 163 310), Mgr. Gabriel Nagy (0908 948 429). Preteky zahŕňajú rôzne trate s dĺžkami od približne 3 do 14 km, registrácia je možná od 1.4.2024 do 10.5.2024, a podujatie je určené pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí a hobby bežcov.

name: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov
location: Reštaurácia Kúpeľná dvorana, Bardejovské Kúpele, Bardejov, Slovakia
organizer: EPC Pro Health Team a BarRan Team

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online registrácia a úhrada štartovného do 27. 04. 2026 s garanciou všetkých benefitov

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Úhrada štartovného do 05. 05. 2026 bez garancie niektorých benefitov (napr. tričko)

description: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov je horský beh, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Bardejovských Kúpeľov. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z troch tratí: krosový polmaratón s prevýšením viac ako 1000 metrov, sedemkilometrová kúpeľná trať a sprievodné detské a mládežnícke kategórie. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročnejší terén a horské výzvy. Organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvenie na trati, medaily, tričká a ďalšie benefity pre včas registrovaných účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa A: Krosový polmaratón 22 km s prevýšením 1000+ m
Občerstvenie na trase A na 8. km pri Zborovskom hrade a na 15. km na Stebníckej Magure (899 m n.m.)
Trasa B: Kúpeľná sedmička 7 km s prevýšením 180+ m
additional: Registrácia na Trasu C (deti a mládež) prebieha na mieste podujatia, počet štartujúcich je obmedzený na 80. Pretekári na Trase A a B majú zabezpečené bezplatné parkovanie v Bardejovských kúpeľoch, číslo pretekára s čipom, tričko, občerstvenie na trati, medailu, trofeje, ceny, obed a nápoj po pretekoch. Čas na Trase C sa nemeria, všetci účastníci dostanú medailu a sladkú odmenu. Trať vedie horským terénom, možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste, viacero kategórií vrátane detí a mládeže, program na deň pretekov a podrobné pokyny pre účastníkov.

name: Beh pre Labky
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre labky 2026 je charitatívny beh organizovaný Úniou vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP, ktorý sa uskutoční v Košiciach, v lokalite Kavečany pri chate Hrešná. Tento 10. ročník podujatia ponúka bežcom možnosť podporiť dobrú vec a zároveň si užiť príjemný beh v prírode. Trať má dĺžku 5 km a je vhodná pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí a bežcov so psami. Podujatie je otvorené širokej verejnosti a ponúka rôzne kategórie podľa veku a typu účastníka.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie v prírodnom prostredí Kavečian pri chate Hrešná
Dĺžka trate je 5 km s jedným okruhom
Možnosť bežať so psom alebo s psom z útulku
additional: Podujatie je charitatívneho charakteru, organizované Úniou vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP. Kategórie zahŕňajú muži, ženy, chlapci a dievčatá do 15 rokov, ako aj kategórie s psom a psom z útulku. Registrácia prebieha cez web pretekaj.sk s možnosťou vytvorenia účtu pre správu prihlášok. Podujatie je určené na podporu ľudí a psov v núdzi, registrácia je možná online, a výsledky sú dostupné na stránke organizátora.

name: DOBRObeh
organizer: KERIC Čadca, Centrum voľného času Čadca, Terminovka.sk, Červený kríž, Detské oddelenie KNsP Čadca, Mesto Čadca
description: DOBRObeh je charitatívny beh v Čadci, ktorý ponúka päť rôznych tratí vrátane hlavného behu Márie Marcibálovej s dĺžkou 21,5 km a prevýšením 600 m. Trať vedie prevažne lesom, asfaltom a lúkami, pričom je jasne vyznačená a zabezpečená usporiadateľmi. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú podporiť dobrú vec, pričom víťazom je každý, kto si zabehne. Štart je na Palárikovej ulici pri fontáne Rybka v pešej zóne v Čadci. Okrem hlavného behu sú k dispozícii aj kratšie trate vrátane 10 km, 4,5 km a detských behov.
course_highlights: Beh Márie Marcibálovej: 21,5 km s prevýšením +600 m, 70% les, 10% asfalt, 20% lúka
KERICross 10 km: 65% asfalt, 25% lúka, 10% šotolina, prevýšenie +180 m
Beh mestom 4,5 km: 90% asfalt, 10% les, prevýšenie +42 m
additional: Povinná výbava: vlastný pohár na pitie, trailové topánky, mobil s číslom na organizátora, hodinky alebo mobil s trasou, skladacie bežecké alebo turistické paličky. Občerstvovačky na 3,8 km a 13,8 km. Trať je jasne vyznačená šípkami a fáborkami, usporiadatelia navigujú bežcov na nejednoznačných miestach. Vyhodnotenie je o 12:30 hod. Charitatívny beh bez vyhodnotenia víťazov, kde je víťazom každý, kto podporí DOBRO. Charitatívny beh s možnosťou prispieť potravinami alebo finančne, rôzne trate vrátane 21,5 km behu, podujatie podporuje pomoc ľuďom v núdzi.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Mánesova Trail Run is an endurance cross-country and trail race held in Lutín in the Olomouc Region. The course is moderately hilly and mainly runs on district roads, forest and field paths. The race offers two distance options: 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women and men over 60. It is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc with the aim of offering runners an interesting and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on district roads, forest and field paths
Moderately hilly terrain suitable for cross-country and trail running
Two course lengths: 23 km and 16.5 km
additional: The race is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc. The start is at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The course is designed for men, women, and men over 60 with different distances. The race is part of the Czech Running Club. It is suitable for runners seeking a moderately challenging course with diverse terrain, registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Vltava Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Základní startovné 29.700 Kč / 1.215 € včetně DPH pro jeden tým. Předregistrace do 30. 9. 2025.

description: Vltava Run is a relay running race over 375 km long, leading from Šumava to Prague. The route passes through the Šumava National Park, along the Vltava River, through forests, around dams, beautiful valleys, hills, historic towns, and villages of South Bohemia and Central Bohemia regions. The race is designed for teams of 6 to 12 runners of any gender and offers a unique running experience along the most beautiful path to the finish line. The race starts at the Zadov - Churáňov cross-country skiing stadium at dawn and the finish is in Prague in the afternoon.
course_highlights: 375 km long route from Šumava to Prague
Guided along hiking trails, roads of class II and III
Passage through Šumava National Park, around Vltava dams, and historic towns
additional: The race is a relay with fixed transfer points. Teams can have 6 to 12 runners of any gender. The expected time for a runner to complete 10 km in the last year must not exceed 60 minutes. Runners must be at least 18 years old, 15 years old with written parental consent and a parent’s membership in the same team. Registration includes mandatory information and questions regarding race rules, which must be answered correctly for successful registration. The race is divided into multiple control points, with teams of 6-12 runners participating, offering a unique experience of running in nature with the opportunity to explore the beauty of South Bohemia and Central Bohemia regions.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Sjezdovka v Merklíně, Merklín, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Merklín-Plešivec Cross is a mountain running race over 6.5 km, which takes place on forest paths and initially on a ski slope in the Ore Mountains. This race is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners League and offers runners challenging terrain with beautiful natural scenery. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength in a hilly environment.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with elevation in the Ore Mountains
Forest paths and initial section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners League
additional: The course includes mountain terrain, registration details are not specified, the race is suitable for runners seeking an outdoor challenge.

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
description: The Jana Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Blatná, held in Blatná in the area under Sokolovna and the castle park. The races are primarily intended for children and youth, with categories from the youngest children to adults, and take place on asphalt and forest paths. The first race starts at 9:00 AM, and registration is conducted in person no later than 15 minutes before the start of the respective category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and offers technical facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and baggage storage.
course_highlights: Surface of the course: asphalt and forest trail
Start and finish in the area under Sokolovna and the castle park
Categories for children from 3 years old to adults
additional: Registration is conducted in person no later than 15 minutes before the start of the respective category. Toilets, changing rooms, baggage storage, and washrooms are available. The race is supported by grant programs from the South Bohemian Region focused on sports activities for children and youth. The event is part of the local sports tradition, with registration possible in person before the race, and is supported by regional grants.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Náměstí v Novém Jičíně, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace do 31.3.2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace od 1.4.2026 do 30.4. 2026 i jeden člen štafety

description: The Nový Jičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 400 participants over 18 years old, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Nový Jičín. The route runs through scenic countryside along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín through Hodslavice, Mořkov, and Hostašovice back, mostly on asphalt. The race also offers a relay for 2x10.5 km and is suitable for runners seeking a quality half marathon experience with refreshments on the course and at the finish line. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín, with the race starting at 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: The route runs along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path
95% asphalt surface, 5% paving
Refreshments on the course at kilometers 6.5; 11; 17 and at the finish
additional: Race packets are distributed on the day of the race from 07:00 to 08:30. Participants have access to a changing room at the start area. Two pacers are available on the course for times of 2:00 and 1:45 hours. Medical services are provided at the start, refreshment stations, and at the finish. The race takes place in all weather conditions with a maximum time limit of 2:45 hours. The route passes through Nový Jičín, Hodslavice, Mořkov, and Hostašovice; the race is held regardless of weather, with refreshments on the course and after the race, and medals for participants. Registration is open until April 30, 2026.

name: Přísnotický kros
description: Prísnotice Cross Country is a traditional running race held in Prísnotice in the South Moravian Region, which is part of the Zajíc League as its second round. The race offers a wide range of categories for men, women, youth, and children of all ages, with distances from 110 meters for the youngest to 7,500 meters for adult men. Bib numbers are issued from 8:30 AM, and the race is also open to very young children without league scoring, who can register on the spot. Prísnotice Cross Country is suitable for all runners who want to test their strength in a pleasant environment with quality organization.
course_highlights: Various distances from 110 m for the youngest to 7500 m for adult men
Categories for all age groups including veterans
Part of the Zajíc League, second round of the series
additional: Registration and bib distribution start at 8:30 AM, at least 30 minutes before the start of each category. It is possible to register the youngest children and categories of adults and youth on the spot up to 30 minutes after the start of the respective category. The race takes place in Prísnotice, registration costs 50 CZK, the course is mainly forested with pleasant nature and minimal elevation gain.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec u Závady, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: od 01.04.2026 do 12.04.2026 - 1. vlna registrace: 250,- Kč, (startovní číslo se jménem v ceně)

description: Závadská desítka is a cross-country run over 10 km held on forest paths around the Daranec nature reserve. This race is very attractive and has become a traditional part of the Prazsko-Opava Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most attractive short-distance race. The route is secured by event staff, and a refreshment station is prepared at the 6th kilometer. The race is divided into several men's, women's, and youth categories, including categories for local residents and natives of Závada, who compete for a traveling trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on forest paths in the Daranec nature reserve
Refreshment station at the 6th kilometer
Safety secured by event staff
additional: The race is part of the Prazsko-Opava Running League (POBL). In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also children's races over 100 m, 500 m, and 1000 m, as well as a 4 km and 10 km walk. A start number with a name is included in the first wave registration. Terrain: 90% forest path, 10% asphalt; registration in waves, refreshments, start package; race categories based on age and gender.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The 50-mile Iron Mountains Ultramarathon is a race held in the beautiful environment of the Iron Mountains in Heřmanův Městec. The course passes through historic fortresses, castles, hillforts, and oppida, offering a unique opportunity to explore the region up close. The race is open to both individuals and relay teams and is part of the Vládce Mrdic series. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, and welcomes all running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: The course passes through historic fortresses, castles, and oppida in the Iron Mountains
Participants can compete as individuals or relay teams
Part of the Vládce Mrdic series with beautiful trail sections
additional: The race offers a course approximately 81 km long, with the possibility of participation on bicycles or scooters as a secondary category. Registration is recommended in advance.

name: Barvám neutečeš – Olomouc
description: Color Run in Olomouc is a colorful race full of joy, friendship, and fun, taking place on May 9, 2026, at Výstaviště Flora. It offers two routes - 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about shared experience, music, and entertainment for all ages, families, and individuals. The start package includes a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that enhance the colorful experience.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: Online registration ends on May 7, 2026, at 20:00; after this date, registration is only possible on-site until capacity is reached. The start package includes a T-shirt, a sackpack, Holi color, a sheet of limited-edition tattoos, a bubble blower, a start number, and a medal. The event is suitable for individuals and teams (team = 4 or more people). Various registration packages are available, including options for teams, and it is also suitable for children. There is a charitable component and an interactive sports zone.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
description: Vrchlabí - Strážné is a traditional cross-country mountain running race that takes you from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The route is varied and offers challenging climbs, technical descents, and fast flat sections, making it ideal for mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Cup in mountain running and the regional championship of the Hradec Králové Region. The start is at the Střelnice cultural house in Vrchlabí, and the finish is at the parking lot in Strážné. The race is a tribute to Jan "Pída" Herbs, the spiritual father of the event.
course_highlights: The route mainly runs through terrain on forest and meadow paths
Challenging ascent to Jankův hill and technical descent around Jankův grove
The finish features almost 1.5 km of fast flat running and a sprint on asphalt
additional: Transport of competitors from the finish to the start is not provided; it is recommended to use the yellow tourist trail. Refreshments are available at the finish. Recommended footwear includes cross-country or trail shoes. The race is part of the regional championship of the Hradec Králové Region, with refreshments and a friendly atmosphere at the finish.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard
price_range: 300 Kč za jednotlivce, 500 Kč za rodinu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 500 Kč za rodinu (rodiče a děti do 15 let)

description: Charity Run 'To Two Lookouts' with the Bernard Foundation is a sports and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. The race starts in intervals with gaps and passes through two control points - the Bernard Lookout and the castle lookout at Orlík. The route is conducted on both paved and unpaved paths, allowing participants to choose their own strategy and navigation. After the race, refreshments including beer and medals for the first 100 registered participants are provided at the finish line. The event is intended for persons over 15 years old; younger participants must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The route passes through two lookouts - Bernard and Orlík Castle
Participants must pass through two control points marked on the race card
The route is a combination of paved and unpaved paths with free navigation
additional: Start is interval-based with 30-second gaps for racers and 5-minute gaps for groups of up to 15 hikers. At Orlík Castle, water is available for racers. Each participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish line, including alcoholic/non-alcoholic beer. Medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. Participants must have both control points marked on their race card; the time limit is 2 hours from the start. Persons under 15 may participate only accompanied by a guardian or with written consent. The route is approximately 5 km long, with the start scheduled at 12:30, and the race duration is up to 2 hours. Start intervals are 30 seconds and 5 minutes. The event is supported by the Bernard Foundation for Help.

name: FREEDOM RUN
description: FREEDOM RUN is a cross-border mountain run in the Krkonoše Mountains, offering two route options. The shorter Classic route, 9 km long, runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět and the Mýtiny area to Polish Orle, ending in Jakuszyce, a well-known sports center. The longer Mega route, 16 km long, is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and beautiful mountain scenery, ideal for more experienced runners. Both routes start in Harrachov and pass through picturesque mountain nature and forest trails with open plains of the Krkonoše Mountains.
course_highlights: Cross-border route from Czechia to Poland
Beautiful mountain nature and forest trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Finish line in the sports center Jakuszyce
additional: The registration fee includes a start number and a chip for timing. The race features mountain terrains, forest trails, and cross-border sections; registration is required, safety rules and race regulations apply.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
location: Kramolna u hasičské zbrojnice, Kramolna, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Charity run for Emmička takes place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, in Kramolna near the fire station. The event offers two routes - 3 km and 7 km, as well as a children's route of 200 meters. The routes run along paved forest paths, suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. The run is dog-friendly, and dogs must be on a leash or harness at all times. Participants can complete the course by running or walking at their own pace.
course_highlights: Routes run along paved forest paths
Option to complete the course with sports strollers and wheelchairs
Event is DOG friendly, dogs must be on a leash or harness
additional: The routes are suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. The run is dog-friendly, and dogs must be on a leash or harness. The course can be completed by running or walking. The event is traditionally held at the fire station in Kramolna. It is DOG friendly, participants can run or walk, registration is via sport-reg.cz, date May 9, 2026.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
location: Sigma Stadion, Lutín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Mánesova Trail Run is a cross-country race held at Sigma Stadium in Lutín, offering a 23 km course for men and 16.5 km for women. The race is part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region and features challenging terrain suitable for cross-country enthusiasts. Participants can expect beautiful natural scenery and a challenge in the form of a hilly route. The race is suitable for experienced runners seeking a quality sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with a length of 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women
Challenging terrain as part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Start and finish at Sigma Stadium in Lutín
additional: The race takes place on the route 'to Kosíř and back'; registration and further details are not explicitly provided.

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
description: The SzalamandRUN running day is a race offering a variety of distances in Solymár, welcoming runners for 3, 5, 11, 21, and 42 km courses. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to challenge themselves on different distances. The race takes place in a natural environment, providing an enjoyable running experience for participants. The organizers offer professional timing and convenient registration options for entrants.
course_highlights: Natural environment running course around Solymár
Variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21, and 42 km
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided at the race. Registration is available on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment options are also accessible. Bib numbers are produced and safety pins are provided for participants. The race is held in multiple categories and distances, with opportunities for children’s races, and the organizers prioritize the athletes' experience.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: The Overtake the Cogwheel Railway! is a traditional sports event in District XII that will welcome runners, cyclists, and relay teams again in 2026. The goal of the race is for participants to reach the finish line before the Cogwheel Railway, while completing a roughly 4 km course with a 325-meter elevation gain in the Buda Hills. The race challenges athletes of all fitness levels and is also a great community program for families and colleagues. The event is organized by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Ltd. and Városmajor Swimming Pool.
course_highlights: Approximately 4.0 km distance
325 meters elevation gain
Scenic environment of the Buda Hills
additional: Participants can compete in running, cycling, and relay categories. Rules for bib number wearing and chip usage, as well as data management information and general terms and conditions, are available in the official documents. Athletes of all age groups, under and over 18, can participate, and results from previous years are accessible in the archive. The race is known for its extreme challenge, with awards, individual or relay options, and registration details available on the official website.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hajdú-Bihar County, Hungary
description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity running event scheduled for May 9, 2026, in Debrecen, at the Southern Industrial Park. The race aims to promote sports and physical activity, showcase the venue, and support the Foundation for Children with Leukemia, with all registration fees and donations doubled by Krones Hungary being donated. Participants can choose from multiple distances, and each finisher receives a unique medal. The event provides a MIZUNO event t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshment stations, and at the end of the race, Athletes Garden welcomes runners.
course_highlights: 10 km individual race, 4-lap course
Located within the Southern Industrial Park, where Krones Hungary was the first tenant
MIZUNO event t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments at refreshment points
additional: Registration is done via the StafétApp mobile application, which is available for free. The race kit pickup is also through StafétApp. Every runner finishing within the time limit receives a unique medal. At the end of the event, Athletes Garden provides on-site activities. Eco-friendly, Oeko race kits are used, and plastic usage is minimized. All registration fees are donated to charity, with online and on-site registration options available. The participation package includes a MIZUNO t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Pest County, Hungary
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a family-friendly recreational trail running event organized by EDUSPORT Sports Association. The race takes place in Gödöllő, at Erzsébet Park, offering races for all ages, from children's runs to half marathons. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and community experience, with expert support and diverse programs. Participants receive a finishing pack, medal, and refreshments, and the day concludes with a colorful Color Run.
course_highlights: Trail running course in Gödöllő Erzsébet Park
Flat terrain, easy distances to complete
Children's and team runs for families
additional: Number pickup and on-site registration from 07:30, warm-up at 09:00, children's runs from 13:30, Color Run at 15:30. The registration fee includes timing, bib, finisher medal, finishing pack, and refreshments. There are changing rooms, restrooms, and baggage storage available at the event. Children's runs, team runs, Color Run, prize draw, online and on-site registration, detailed routes, refreshment points, commemorative medal, and finishing pack.

name: EDURACE
location: Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a diverse trail running race that will be held in 2026 in Gödöllő, at Erzsébet Park. The race offers multiple distances, from 500-meter kids' runs to half marathons, making it suitable for all ages and running experience. Alongside natural routes and a community atmosphere, participants will receive a unique finisher medal and enjoy a good mood. The event aims to appeal to families and sports enthusiasts alike and promote a healthy, active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Forest routes in Erzsébet Park with varied terrain
Elevation changes from 24 m to 340 m across different distances
Unique finisher medal and family-friendly programs at the finish line
additional: Number pickup on October 31st from 16:00, with free cloakroom and luggage storage provided. On-site registration is available in limited numbers, but advance online registration is recommended. Medical personnel will be available during the race, and participation is at your own risk. The event features various distances, family and children's runs, team competitions, pet-friendly runs, online and on-site registration, and post-race programs.

name: FUT A VÁROS

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: Wings for Life World Run Bratislava je jedinečné podujatie, kde bežci aj účastníci na vozíku štartujú súčasne a pretekajú proti virtuálnemu Catcher Caru, ktorý ich postupne dobieha. Preteky nemajú cieľovú čiaru, bežci bežia tak dlho, kým ich nepredbehne auto. Trať vedie cez Sad Janka Kráľa, jeden z najstarších parkov v Európe, a kombinuje rôzne prostredia. Podujatie podporuje výskum poranení miechy, pričom 100 % registračných poplatkov ide na tento účel. Štart pretekov je presne o 13:00 hodine.

Kombinácia rôznych prostredí na 2 km trati
Virtuálny Catcher Car štartuje 30 minút po štarte a postupne zvyšuje rýchlosť

Virtuálny Catcher Car začína 30 minút po štarte rýchlosťou 14 km/h a postupne zrýchľuje, až kým nepredbehne všetkých súťažiacich. Účasť je možná len cez mobilnú aplikáciu Wings for Life World Run. 100 % všetkých registračných poplatkov putuje na výskum poranení miechy. Registrácia je online, beh je podporovaný aplikáciou Wings for Life World Run, a celý výťažok ide na výskum poranení miechy.

Trať vedie z archeoskanzenu Nižná Myšľa, známeho archeologického náleziska, cez lesné a nespevnené cesty, lúky a obec, s kombináciou asfaltových a prírodných povrchov. Štart pretekov je 10. mája 2026 o 13:00 a všetky registračné poplatky putujú na výskum poranení miechy. Pridajte sa k bežcom po celom svete a prekonajte sami seba v tomto globálnom behu bez cieľovej čiary.
course_highlights: Trať vedie 20 % po asfalte a 80 % po lesných a nespevnených cestách
Štart a cieľ v archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa s kompletným zázemím a občerstvením
Okruh vedie cez archeologické lokality a malebnú prírodu Košickej kotliny a Slanských vrchov
additional: Virtuálny Catcher Car vyráža 30 minút po štarte rýchlosťou 14 km/h a postupne zvyšuje tempo, až kým nepredbehne všetkých bežcov. Nordic walking je vítaný. Parkovanie, šatne a úschovňa sú k dispozícii v Archeoskanzene. 100 % z registračných poplatkov ide na výskum poranení miechy. Trať zahŕňa asfalt, lesné cesty a nespevnené cesty; štart v archeoskanzene, parkovanie na mieste, registrácia cez aplikáciu.

description: Nočný beh Hlohovcom je obľúbený nočný beh, ktorý sa koná 16. mája 2026 v Zámockom parku v Hlohovci. Bežci si užijú atraktívny 6 km okruh vedúci malebným prostredím parku s jazierkom a najväčším platanovým hájom v strednej Európe, popri rieke Váh, cez centrum mesta a okolo hlavných dominánt Hlohovca. Podujatie ponúka kategórie pre deti, hlavný beh a nordic walking, pričom štart je pred amfiteátrom v Zámockej záhrade. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, odporúčajú reflexné doplnky a čelovky, a pre prvých 550 pretekárov sú pripravené účastnícke medaily.
course_highlights: 6 km okruh v Zámockom parku s jazierkom a platanovým hájom
Trasa vedie popri rieke Váh a cez centrum mesta Hlohovec
Štart a cieľ pred amfiteátrom v Zámockej záhrade na asfaltovej ploche
additional: Prezentácia prebehne v deň pretekov 16. 05. 2026 v Zámockej záhrade pred amfiteátrom od 18:00 do 20:15 hod. Prezentácia detí je od 17:30 do 18:30 hod. Behy štartujú v rôznych časoch: detské behy o 19:00, hlavný beh o 21:00 a nordic walking o 21:10. Prvých 550 pretekárov s viditeľným štartovacím číslom dostane účastnícku medailu. Pretekári musia mať reflexné doplnky a odporúča sa čelovka. Podujatie sa koná za vylúčenia dopravy a koordinácie polície. Tombola obsahuje ceny od regionálnych vinárov a sponzorov. Medaily pre prvých 550 finisherov, online registrácia, súťažné kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, podujatie zahŕňa aj prezentáciu a odovzdávanie cien

name: Běh města Nýřany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany City Run is a traditional sporting event organized by Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. and the Education, Sports, and Culture Committee. The main race over 10 km, including a team run of 2x 5 km, offers an active experience for the general public. There are also supplementary races for children from Nýřany and the surrounding area, which are free or for a symbolic fee. The event takes place at the ZŠ Nýřany athletics stadium and concludes with a disco with free entry.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with a team run of 2x 5 km
Supplementary free children's races for local kids
Event concluded with a disco on the asphalt playground
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site with a higher fee. The disco starts at 18:00 with free entry. Starting numbers for children are issued at school facilities or in the white booth next to the gymnasium. The 10 km race, 2x 5 km team runs, children's races, online registration since 2018, results and photos available.

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Máchovo jezero, Liberec region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a hilly cross-country race set amidst the beautiful nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region. It offers courses of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km, with 90% of the route through terrain. The race is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking a more challenging trail run. Come enjoy running in a picturesque environment with a challenge for every runner.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country terrain with 90% natural paths
Courses from 5 km to 160 km ultramarathon
Picturesque nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region
additional: Trail race with multiple distances, taking place in May 2026, unsupported race, single loop course.

name: Lesempolem
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Veselice in the South Moravian Region. It offers three courses - 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km) - mainly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower, which guarantees beautiful views and an experience of running in nature. The race is suitable for all runners from amateurs to experienced athletes, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a rich program, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere are prepared for competitors and spectators.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along forest and field paths (90%), only 10% on asphalt
Surroundings of the Podvrší lookout tower with beautiful views
Three courses: 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: Start and registration are at the cultural house in Veselice, parking approximately 200 meters from the registration. On site, there is abundant refreshments (water, tea, isotonic drinks, fruit, traditional Loštice spread) and the possibility to store your own refreshments. For spectators, there is a cultural program, a beer tent, and children's runs. Accommodation is available in the cultural house for a symbolic fee in personal sleeping bags. The marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The races take place around Veselice, in the Moravian Karst, emphasizing a family atmosphere and social experiences.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: Karlovy Vary, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Karlovy Vary 2026 is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary, offering runners the opportunity to experience the joy of running while discovering the city's UNESCO monuments. The course, certified by World Athletics, runs around iconic hotels Thermal and Pupp and through a unique colonnade. This festival is a traditional gathering of runners with a rich atmosphere and beautiful views of world-famous landmarks.
course_highlights: The course runs around the Thermal and Pupp hotels
Passes through the unique colonnade in Karlovy Vary
Surroundings with UNESCO monuments
additional: Registration is only possible using a registration code. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, with the first wave starting at 14:00. The festival includes various running disciplines including a half marathon and relay half marathon. Registration only via registration code; more race categories including 3x5 km and 6.0975 km; races are held in the beautiful environment of UNESCO monuments and hotels.

name: Zručský májový běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1100 m)

description: The Zruč May Run is a traditional race held annually in May in the picturesque environment of the castle park and the Sázava River in Zruč nad Sázavou. The race offers courses for all age categories from the youngest children to adults, including the main race of 10 km, which is a fast certified course by ČAS. The event also includes children's races, relays, and a popular 3 km run. The goal of the run is to support the athletic club TJ Jiskra Zruč nad Sázavou and promote sports activities in the region, with the proceeds donated to a good cause in the local area.
course_highlights: The main 10 km race is a fast certified ČAS course running around the castle park and the Sázava River
Four color-coded circuits for children and youth from 150 m to 1100 m in the castle park
The popular 3 km run leads through the castle park, cycle path, and square with the finish at Barončina Stezka
additional: Race numbers can be picked up on Friday from 17:00 for the Friday Popular Run and on Saturday from 8:30 for all categories. On-site registration is only possible on Saturday from 8:30 and closes 30 minutes before each race start. Each registered participant in the main race over 35 years automatically participates in the MČR Masters 2026. The course is marked with colorful wooden directional signs at turns. Results and records of the main race are financially rewarded. The races take place in the castle park and surroundings, with on-site and online registration, various race lengths including children's and relay races, and a certified 10 km course.

name: NN Night Run Brno
location: Hněvkovského sportovně-rekreační areál, Brno, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 km

description: NN Night Run Brno is the largest running event in Brno, held at the Hněvkovského sports and recreation area. Each year, more than 2000 runners of all ages participate, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers not only the main 10 km race but also children's races and shorter runs, all in a friendly and lively atmosphere. The program includes accompanying activities, performances, and a rich supporting program for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Sports and recreation area Hněvkovského in Brno
Main race of 10 km with a 90-minute limit
Children's races and runs of 3 km and 5 km with a charitable aspect
additional: The program includes KIDS CUP children's races, FÉNIX RUN 3 km and BELLIS RUN 5 km with a charitable aspect, a 2x5 km relay, accompanying performances and warm-up sessions with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND). There is a baggage storage and changing rooms, testing of MIZUNO running shoes, airbrush tattoos, a photo booth, a raffle, and other supporting activities. Registration is available online and on-site. The entry fee can be discounted by 50% for NN clients, and athletes receive a discount on life insurance through the Fit Sport program. The terrain includes an urban park and recreational area; the event features various race categories and supporting activities.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The race offers three variants: a free children's race of 1 km, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and advanced runners with a mostly flat course, and a half marathon for more experienced runners with a challenging second half full of hills. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Half marathon with an initial flat section and a second half full of hills
10 km race mostly flat with one refreshment station
Three refreshment stations on the half marathon (5, 10, and 15 km) with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
additional: Athletes registered by 1.5.2026 are entitled to a commemorative medal, which is distributed after the results are announced. All participants meet in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. By registering, you confirm participation at your own risk and agree to the use of visual recordings for promotional purposes. The race includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, starting in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle, and features a children's race.

name: Rakovnická 100
description: Rakovnická 100 is a traditional ultralong walk and run in the beautiful landscape of Křivoklátsko, offering a challenging but manageable route approximately 107 kilometers long with 2400 meters of elevation gain. The event is known for its excellent organization and pleasant atmosphere, making it ideal for testing physical capabilities. It starts from Husovo Square in Rakovník, and participants can expect a combination of running and walking with various natural obstacles, including fords and wet sections. Rakovnická 100 is suitable for experienced athletes seeking a challenge in a less extreme but still demanding terrain.
course_highlights: Route approximately 107 km long with 2400 m elevation gain
Beautiful nature of Křivoklátsko with rivers, streams, and fords
Well-organized refreshment stations and support along the route
additional: Start at 4 a.m. from Husovo Square in Rakovník. The route is a combination of running and walking, suitable for testing physical condition after the winter season. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere and quality organization. In the past, the route has been slightly adjusted but still offers a challenge with the possibility of fords and wet sections. The race takes place in May, with the finish at Penzion Šéba, and is part of regional ultramarathons. The route is suitable for experienced runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment.

name: Charitativní Běh Na Špince
location: Tábořiště Špinka, Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Charity Run at Špinka is a sporting event with the motto #KdyžMůžuPomůžu, which combines the joy of movement with helping those in need. The proceeds from the event go to support the NONA 92 Day Care Center in Nové Město nad Metují, which helps people with mental disabilities integrate into society. The race is open to everyone - professional runners, beginners, moms with strollers, and children. The race atmosphere is unique, and 100% of the entry fee goes to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes for all age groups from 100 m for the youngest to 10 km for adults
Children's race starts at 10:00 and 10:15, main routes of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km start at 10:30 and 11:00
Charity run supporting NONA 92 Day Care Center, which offers meaningful daily activities and preparation for independent living
additional: Registration is possible online via SportChallenge.cz or on-site from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The race is part of the Primátor CUP series. Teams can register (minimum 3 members), with the final time averaged. The program includes children's races, main races of 2, 5, and 10 km, a quiz, and a raffle for a scooter. All entry fees go to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors. The charity run supports NONA 92 Day Care Center, is open to all age groups, with 100% of the entry fee donated to charity.

name: Májový běh Slapy
location: Sigma Slapy, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je dobrovolné formou příspěvku v libovolné výši na jednu ze sbírek Blíž domovu

description: The May Run Slapy is a traditional running race organized by the Slapský Cultural Association, held in the picturesque environment of the Slapské forests and hills. The race offers routes for children and adults, emphasizing beautiful nature, forest paths, and interesting elevation changes. The start and facilities are located at the Sigma Slapy area, where participants can change clothes and store belongings. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere with awards for the best and all children.
course_highlights: Forest paths and terrain with minimal elevation change for children
Manageable but hilly profile with an elevation of 225 m for adults
Beautiful view of the dam lake from the middle of the adult race
additional: Children start independently at 9:30, adults start at 10:00 after children finish. Registration is from 9:00 to 9:20 for children and until 9:45 for adults. There is an option to change clothes and store belongings without valuables at the start area. The route is well marked with white arrows on the ground. Children can be accompanied by parents. Children up to 9 years run 1.4 km, older children 2.8 km, adults 7.5 km. Children up to 18 years can run the adult route with parental consent. Start times: children at 9:30, adults at 10:00; race distances: 1.4 km for children up to 9 years, 2.8 km for children 10-18 years, 7.5 km for adults; the race takes place on forest trails with elevation changes.

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městec Králové Ten is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering courses of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1 km, including a run for the youngest. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads with slight elevation changes, and the start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky. The race is known for its records and great atmosphere, with participants able to use refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, runners receive an SMS with their finishing time, and winners receive trophies and material prizes. Organizers emphasize fair play and the safety of all participants.
course_highlights: Course without significant elevation
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish at Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. SMS with the finishing time after the race. On-site registration will not be available. Functional T-shirt NO.6 available for purchase at 490 CZK. The children's run is not timed and is free; registration takes place on race day from 8:30 to 9:20. Children can run with an escort; the use of tricycles and scooters is prohibited. The race includes refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is only possible online, and results are available via SMS and online. The course runs over asphalt, paving, and sandy areas; start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Orlické hory, Czech Republic
description: The 7 Mountains of the Orlické Hory are part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, which takes you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race in the Orlické Hory offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The route passes through viewpoints, Šerlich, the border with Poland, and the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná. Prepare for a challenge with an elevation gain of 920 meters and a length of 24 km, which will test your strength and determination.
course_highlights: The route passes through viewpoints and Šerlich
Across the border with Poland to Masarykova Chata
Climb to the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná (1,115 m)

name: LHUT – Lysohorský Skyrace a Ultratrail, MČR Skyrace a Ultra Sky 2026
location: SKI Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 690 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 790 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Skyrace je 990 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Skyrace je 1090 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Supersky je 590 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Supersky je 690 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a mountain running race in the Lysá hora massif, offering three race routes: Ultra Trail (67 km, +4100 m), Skyrace (31 km, +2100 m), and Supersky (16 km, +875 m). The routes run along marked hiking trails with stunning views of Lysá hora from all sides. The race is organized with the support of Lysá hora hunters, LČR, and CHKO, emphasizing the athlete's ethical code and nature protection. The start and finish are at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice, where refreshments, recovery zones, and other services for competitors are provided. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement and afterparty.
course_highlights: Routes run along marked hiking trails in the Lysá hora massif
Challenging elevation gain up to 4100 m on the Ultra Trail route
Refreshment stations at the top of Lysá hora and at the start/finish area
additional: Registration for competitors will take place on Friday, May 15, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00 at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice. Participants will receive a start package with a chip, bib number, and gifts from partners. The refreshment station offers abundant refreshments, and showers and a recovery zone are available after the race. Accommodation in Hannah tents is available with reservation via roman.tulinsky@rockpoint.cz. Changes of participant are possible for a fee of 200 CZK; route changes are not allowed. The bib number must be visibly worn on clothing. Support is only permitted on Lysá hora within 100 meters of the refreshment station. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, at SKI Malenovice, with different start times depending on the route length, and is supported by local hunters, LČR, and CHKO.

name: Energon běh – Penzion Nový rybník
location: Penzion Nový Rybník, Obořiště, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Energon Run at the Nový Rybník guesthouse in Obořiště is part of the Brdský Running Cup and offers races for adults, juniors, and children. The main adult race and relay are run on four loops with a combination of asphalt and trail surfaces. Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back, with the length adjusted to age. The event is family-friendly and open to runners of all ages, with a traditional start at 12:00 at the Nový Rybník guesthouse.
course_highlights: The course combines asphalt, field, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 loops with asphalt and trail surfaces
Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back, with length according to age
additional: Children's races are free of charge. Registration is possible until May 15, 2026, at 22:00, or on the day of the race on-site. The main race can also be run as a four-member relay. The track surface is a combination of asphalt and trail. Organizers offer neoprene chip bands for 100 CZK for purchase. The event includes various age categories, options for pre-registration and on-site registration, and sports accompanying activities including children's races.

name: Hostivice RUN

price_tiers.distance: dospělé závody (5 km, 10 km, 21 km, CROSS)

description: Hostivice RUN is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Hostivice ponds. In 2026, the thirteenth edition will take place, offering four main courses: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km, and a 4 km cross-country terrain run, complemented by children's races. The race is suitable for all runners who want to experience the joy of sport and challenge themselves in a pleasant atmosphere. Participants will also receive an original metal medal as a symbol of success and determination.
course_highlights: Routes lead around the system of Hostivice ponds with natural scenery
The half marathon consists of two laps of the green course
The cross-country run CROSS offers a more challenging surface and natural obstacles
additional: Children's races start at 9:00, main adult races from 11:00 (10 km and half marathon), cross at 11:10, and 5 km at 11:20. Hostivice RUN T-shirts can be ordered until April 1, 2026, as part of online registration, with a limited number available on-site later. Registration is possible online, in person at the Hostivice Municipal Library, and on race day at the start area. The parent ultramarathon and some children's categories are already at capacity. Multiple race distances, children's races, registration opens December 1, 2025, event held in Hostivice, Czech Republic.

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
description: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice) is a friendly running race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, with the goal in Čeperka, 10 km from each city. The course combines asphalt sections with natural parts, with the Pardubice side offering more nature and the Hradec side more asphalt. The race takes place in all weather conditions and is popular among runners from both cities. More information and registration are available on the race website www.ph7.cz.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Pardubice to Čeperka
Combination of asphalt and natural sections
More nature on the Pardubice side, more asphalt on the Hradec side
additional: The race is run in all weather conditions. More information and registration are available at www.ph7.cz. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available. 10 km course, asphalt and nature, in all weather conditions.

name: Hradubický běh (start Hradec Králové)
location: Lipky – zastávka MHD „Lipky“, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hradubický Run is a friendly running race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, taking place on May 16, 2026. The race has two starts, each in its own city, and a shared finish line at the halfway point. The course is 10 kilometers long from each side, partially paved and partially through nature, and is run in all weather conditions. A new feature is the children's races, which are free for children of registered main race participants. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere and refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course 10 km from each side, precisely measured with a Jones counter
Part of the course runs on asphalt, part through nature with a predominance of natural scenery on the Pardubice side
The route is marked with orange spray or flags
additional: Children's races are free for children of registered main race participants. On-site registration is possible with card payment or QR code. Luggage storage is provided at the finish line, with luggage transportation from both starts by car. Refreshments at the finish include water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweet pastries, and salt; there is a refreshment station with water at the 5 km mark. Starts are in Hradec Králové (Lipky, MHD stop) and Pardubice (Poděbradská Street).

name: Pivoňův běh
location: Louka Na Křižatkách, Písecké hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Pivoňův běh is a traditional running race in the Písecké hory mountains, held on the Na Křižatkách meadow near the White House. It offers routes for beginners and experienced runners in lengths of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, as well as children's races and a charity walk. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, beautiful nature, and the opportunity to support charitable projects. The starting field passes through picturesque ponds, a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer, and forest paths with diverse surfaces. After the race, participants can enjoy a relaxed environment and original Pivoňovo clothing.
course_highlights: Routes pass around ponds with wooden bridges and dams
Running through a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer in Písecké hory nature park
Forest paths with varied surfaces and an elevation gain of up to 465 meters
additional: Children's races have different lengths depending on the age of the children with separate starts. The charity walk with Toyota Dolák donates half of the entry fee to charitable projects. Race numbers and clothing can be picked up on the race day. The routes have time limits: 5 km - 1 hour, 10 km - 2 hours, half marathon - 3.5 hours. The terrain is a combination of forest, paved, and asphalt paths with an elevation gain of up to 465 meters. Registration is possible via bank transfer, the event offers refreshments, an accompanying program, and the option to purchase T-shirts. The routes are suitable for runners of all levels.

name: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice
location: Tatra Kopřivnice, Tatra Trucks, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Kopřivnice is part of a popular running series that offers races for all age groups and performance levels. The program includes courses from children's runs, family and hobby runs, to more demanding half marathons. The race takes place at the Tatra Trucks premises and offers a family atmosphere, quality facilities, and an accompanying program for the whole family. Each participant receives a starter pack and contributes to charity. A guiding team and medical services ensure a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km at the Tatra Trucks premises
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters with a kids' corner
Refreshment stations on courses of 5 km and more, at least twice during the half marathon
additional: Each runner receives an official gymsack with gifts from partners. A starter pack from Lidl is prepared for children. Guides with flags are available on the track to help maintain pace. Emergency services are accessible via a dedicated phone line during the race. Refreshments are available at the finish for shorter runs, and refreshment stations are set up along longer courses. Multiple race distances, family activities, charity support, participant medals, photos, and comprehensive race services.

name: SKYRUN – DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / závod

description: SKYRUN - DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ is a challenging individual race of 22 km with an elevation gain of 820 meters, leading from Kouty nad Desnou to the crown of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant and back. The route combines unpaved paths, roads, and trails, offering participants unique views of Jeseníky and the technical works of the power plant. The race is scheduled at the turn of the winter and summer seasons, which brings a specific atmosphere and challenges, including possible snow on the track. The Kouty nad Desnou area provides complete facilities with restaurants, accommodation, and parking directly at the start and finish.
course_highlights: 22 km route with an elevation gain of 820 m
Passage over the crown of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant at an altitude of 1354 m above sea level
Combination of unpaved roads, roads, and trails with views of Jeseníky
additional: Each participant receives a GPS locator, which must be active during the race. Registration is done by picking up a race packet including a voucher for a cable car ride. The use of trekking poles is permitted on the track; other assistance is prohibited. Support is only allowed in the designated Support zone with a personal bottle. The organizer provides the route in map files and GPX files. The race number must be clearly attached to the front of the body. The race offers trail and road sections, registrations are available, and the event takes place on May 16, 2026. The course includes a technically demanding ascent with support at the summit.

name: Rozběháme Jaroměřice
location: Fotbalové hřiště v Jaroměřicích nad Rokytnou, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: město Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou a FK Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou
description: Run Jaroměřice is a sporting running event scheduled for May 16, 2026, which will take place at the football field in Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou. The event is open to the general public and offers various courses including 11 km, 5 km, children's routes of 3 km, and a short run for the youngest participants. It is organized by the town of Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou in cooperation with FK Jaroměřice nad Rokytnou and promises a day full of fun and activity for the whole family. Registration for the main routes will open in March 2026.
course_highlights: Various course lengths including 11 km, 5 km, and children's routes
Event held at a football field in the peaceful Vysočina environment
Family sports day with entertainment for all age groups
additional: The race day is on May 16, 2026, registration will be available from March 2026, the courses are suitable for runners and families with children

name: Standův českorybenský půlmaraton
location: Hřiště Česká Rybná, Česká Rybná, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: We invite you to the 2nd Standov Českorybenský Half Marathon and Quarter Marathon, which will be run through the beautiful Podorlicko nature. The start and finish are at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná, where there will also be abundant refreshments and a sports day. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to challenge yourself, with the announcement of the fastest runners. The event is part of the ČUS Sportuj s námi project and is suitable for the general public, including youth.
course_highlights: Beautiful Podorlicko nature
Start and finish at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná
Refreshments on the track: water, fruit, sugar, salt with an emphasis on ecology
additional: Registration is also possible on-site from 8:00 AM. Parking is provided at the roundabout and on the meadow above Dvončovými, which will be marked. There is an option to store valuables. The winners will be announced at 1:30 PM. The event is part of a sports day with rich refreshments throughout the day. It is recommended to bring your own water container to minimize plastics. The race takes place at the Česká Rybná sports field, Pardubice Region, and is suitable for recreational and competitive runners. Exact registration details are not provided.

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
description: The Hradubický Run is a friendly race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, taking place on May 16, 2026. The race is unconventional in that it has two starts, each in its own city, with a common finish line at the halfway point. The course is exactly 10 kilometers from each side, partly asphalt and partly natural terrain, and is run in any weather. A new feature is children's races, which are free for children of registered main race participants. After the race, refreshments and baggage storage are provided at the finish line.
course_highlights: Two starts in the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice with one shared finish line
Exact course length of 10 km from each side, measured with a Jones counter
The route partly on asphalt and partly natural terrain, marked with orange spray and flags
additional: Children's races are free for children of registered main race participants. Registration for children takes place from 10:30 to 11:15 at the Čeperka playground. After the race, refreshments including water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweet pastries, and salt are available at the finish. There is baggage storage at the finish, where cars from both start cities are transported. Starts are accessible by public transport, and the organization at the finish line is smooth despite ongoing construction work in the area of the starts. The start in Pardubice will be postponed due to construction; on-site registration is available, with payment via QR code or card. The race is part of the traditional sports meeting between Pardubice and Hradec Králové.

name: Hradubický běh (start Hradec Králové)
location: Hradec Králové-Lipky, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Hradubický Run is a friendly race connecting the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice. The race is unconventional in that it has two starts, each in its own city, with a common finish line at the halfway point. The course measures exactly 10 kilometers from each side and combines asphalt sections with natural parts. The race takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for a wide running public. The start is scheduled for Saturday at 10:00 AM.

Exact course length of 10 km from each side, measured with a Jones counter
Combination of asphalt and natural sections, more nature on the Pardubice side

The deadline for completing the main race is at 11:30, with results announcement and award ceremony at 11:35. Refreshments including water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweet pastries, and salt are available at the finish line. There is a baggage storage at the finish line, where cars from both start cities are transported. Starts are conveniently accessible by public transport from main train stations. The race takes place in all weather conditions. It is suitable for all age groups, offers various race distances, and is accessible for all with barrier-free access.

name: Lomecký běh
description: Lomecký běh is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Lomec in the South Bohemian Region. The race offers two courses of 12 km and 6 km, which combine different surfaces and terrains, providing an interesting experience for runners of all levels. The main category starts at 11:00 AM, organized by Josef Prokeš. The event combines running, nature, and the running community in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two courses: 12 km and 6 km
Mixed terrain with natural and asphalt sections
Picturesque environment of Lomec in the South Bohemian Region
additional: The organizer is Josef Prokeš, contact by phone at 608 854 937. The race is part of the services of the Czech Athletic Federation for runners and running. Connecting running, people, nature, and faith. The race is part of a social and spiritual gathering with accompanying activities, including a family atmosphere and an outdoor mass.

name: Dobřichovický půlmaraton
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: Dobřichovice Half Marathon is the sixth edition of a successful cross-country half marathon held in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice Castle courtyard. The race offers three variants: a 1 km children's race for free, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and advanced runners, and a more challenging half marathon with a hilly second half of the course. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of various experience levels.
course_highlights: Half marathon with the first flat and second hilly half of the course
10 km race mainly flat with one refreshment station
Children's race on 1 km for free for young runners up to 10 years old
additional: Registrants by May 1, 2026, are eligible for a commemorative medal, which is distributed after the results are announced. Participants gather in the castle courtyard of Dobřichovice. There are three refreshment stations along the half marathon route with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. The results for the 10 km race are scheduled to be announced at 12:30. The children's race is free and intended for children up to 10 years old. The races are suitable for all age groups, including the 1 km children's race. Registration is open until May 14, 2026. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of Dobřichovice, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Zkus půlmaraton Kuks
description: The Try Kuks Half Marathon is a running race that starts in the courtyard of the Baroque complex of Kuks Hospital and leads along a scenic educational trail around the unique Braun's Nativity Scene sculpture gallery carved into rocks. The route offers a unique experience of Czech Baroque and the atmosphere of a mystical area hidden in the woods. Runners pass by pilgrimage sites around Kuks, and the race ends with a return across the modern Cross Path of the 21st century, which connects history with contemporary art. In addition to the half marathon, shorter distances of 10 km and 5 km are available, also passing through interesting local sites.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the courtyard of the Baroque complex of Kuks Hospital
Educational trail around Braun's Nativity Scene - a gallery of sculptures carved into rocks
Passage through the modern Cross Path of the 21st century connecting history and contemporary art
additional: The registration fee includes a race bib and chip. It is possible to purchase the registration as a gift voucher with a unique code. Participants under 18 years old can only participate with written consent from a legal guardian. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The route passes through the historic and natural environment of Kuks. Registration is available via myresult.cz. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Prizes are awarded on the race day.

name: Šanovská desítka
description: Šanovská desítka is a running event organized by Sokol Šanov, inviting athletes of all ages to participate in distances from 100 meters up to 10 kilometers. The run takes place on May 16, 2026, at the municipal sports field in Šanov and offers an atmosphere full of excitement and determination. Starts are divided by categories from 9:30 AM, allowing for a smooth race experience for all participants. The event is ideal for runners who want to experience a community sports event in the beautiful environment of South Moravia.
course_highlights: Distance from 100 meters to 10 kilometers
Start at the municipal sports field in Šanov
Categories with staggered starts from 9:30 AM

Distances from 100 m to 10 km, family activities, medals for early registrations, race on an asphalt cycle path, outdoor event.

name: Energon běh - Penzion Nový rybník
location: Dobříš, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Energon Run at Penzion Nový Rybník in Dobříš is part of the Brdský Running Cup and offers races for adults, juniors, and children. The main adult race and relay race are run on four loops with a combination of asphalt and terrain surfaces. Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back, with the length adjusted to age. The event is traditional and friendly, suitable for a wide running public.
course_highlights: The course combines asphalt, field, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 loops with asphalt and terrain surfaces
Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back
additional: Children's races are free and have routes adapted to age. Registration is possible until 15.5.2026 at 22:00, but on-site registration is also available. Organizers allow individual and relay team registrations. Start and finish are at Penzion Nový Rybník. The length of the race is 10 km, with children's races, terrain and asphalt surfaces, registration options.

name: Kryry třikrát jinak
price_range: 80-150 Kč, zdarma pro místní děti a školní mládež
description: The Kryry race three times differently is a unique running event where participants conquer the hill with Schiller Tower in three different ways: a mass start uphill run, an interval downhill run, and an interval run of 127 stairs to the lookout tower. The overall classification is based on the sum of times from all three parts, with the top three places receiving time deductions as bonuses. There are races on circuits under the lookout tower for children. The race is part of the Lookouts in Motion series and also offers a relay race option for teams of three runners.
course_highlights: Uphill run 1.25 km with a mass start
Interval downhill run 750 m
Run of 127 stairs to Schiller Tower
additional: Race office and changing rooms are located in tents at the Czech Army Square in Kryry. Children's races are divided into several age categories with different circuit lengths. The relay race is intended for teams of three runners, each running one part of the race. Material prizes are prepared for the top three in individual age categories and for the top three relay teams. In cooperation with Kryry Elementary School, a competition for parents and children is organized. Registration takes place at the Czech Army Square; the race is part of the Lookouts in Motion series, which promotes active movement in nature and community gatherings.
