description: The Opárno Valley Run is a running race held in the picturesque environment of Opárno near Lovosice. The course runs on asphalt and forest paths with a length of 5.5 km, offering a combination of pleasant terrain and natural scenery. The race starts at 3:00 PM in Lovosice and the finish is at the former pub Oráč in the village square in Opárno, where refreshments and access to the building are provided. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a relaxed atmosphere with the possibility of transporting backpacks to the finish line.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route on asphalt and forest paths
Start in Lovosice, finish in Opárno at the former pub Oráč
Picturesque Opárno Valley with natural scenery
additional: Backpack transport to the finish will be available after the start. Refreshments for runners are provided. The start is in Lovosice (bus stop Lovosice město, intersection of Lovošská and Ústecká streets). Transfer to the start in Lhotka is at 2:00 PM from Lovosice city. The race is scheduled to start at 3:00 PM, with the finish in Opárno. The event is part of a series of sports events in the Central Mountains region.

name: Desítka z Jasének
description: The Jasénky Ten is a traditional running race held in Hlučín, Moravian-Silesian Region. The route runs through the valley of the Jasénky stream and the Opava River, with a length of 8.6 km. The start and finish are at Gras Servis company. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a pleasant run in a natural environment with the possibility of multiple attempts within an individual time trial. Organizers welcome fair play, and race records are sent electronically. Results are published online after the race ends.
course_highlights: Route through the valley of the Jasénky stream and the Opava River
Distance of the route 8.6 km
Start and finish at Gras Servis in Hlučín, Jasénky 29
additional: The race is an individual time trial where participants run with a mobile phone and an app recording their running activity. They can complete the route multiple times but only submit their best record. Recommended apps include mapy.cz, Endomondo, Nike, and others. There is a limited number of parking spaces at the start (approximately 12). Results will be published by April 10, 2026. The event includes a family day with activities, registration is open, race categories include the 8.6 km route, and the race takes place in a natural environment with parking available at Gras Servis.

name: Lysohorský Ultra Trail
location: Hotel KAM, Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a challenging mountain run held in the picturesque surroundings of Lysá hora and its vicinity in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The start and finish are located at the KAM Hotel in Malenovice. The race offers abundant refreshments, a recovery zone, hot meals, and gifts from sponsors as part of the start package. After the race, there will be a ceremonial award ceremony and an unforgettable afterparty. The race is rated by ITRA and electronic timing with chips is provided.
course_highlights: Abundant refreshments at the top of Lysá hora and at the start/finish area
Electronic timing with chips
Recovery zone and hot meals after the race
additional: Changing registration to another participant is possible for a fee of 200 CZK. Changing to a different route is not possible. After the race, showers and baggage storage are available free of charge. In case of valid health insurance in the Czech Republic, free first aid and medical services are provided at the finish. Results are published within 48 hours on the website. The race includes categories Ultra trail, Skyrace, and Supersky, with refreshments, medical support, and an afterparty. The start and finish are at the KAM Hotel in Malenovice, in the vicinity of Lysá hora.

name: Běh na Velký Javorník
location: Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

The race offers a beautiful route with a climb to the summit of Velký Javorník, ideal for mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The start is on Saturday, May 16, 2026, at 10:00 AM in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. Come enjoy a sporting challenge and beautiful views in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain run with a climb to the summit of Velký Javorník
Picturesque environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
Start in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm
additional: The course passes through forest and mountain terrains, and the race is suitable for experienced runners seeking mountain challenges. Registration and detailed information about participation fees are not specified.

name: Dubenský běh pro dobrou věc
description: The Dubenský Run for a Good Cause is a charitable running event held in Dubné in the South Bohemian Region. The race offers routes of 3 km and 5 km and combines a sporting experience with support for the family of a child with disabilities. The proceeds from the event are donated to help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice, specifically for the purchase of a van with a lifting platform and rehabilitation. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and entertainment.
course_highlights: Two routes: 3 km and 5 km
Start at the football field by the Velký hajský pond
Charitable run supporting the family of a child with disabilities
additional: The event is beneficent, with proceeds from the 9th edition donated to help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice. The start is at the football field by the Velký hajský pond in Dubné. Organizers emphasize the connection of sport, good refreshments, and entertainment with charity. The event is connected with the local community; the run is likely charitable, but specific information about the route or registration is not provided.

course_highlights: The running course around Lake Tata with varied terrain
Natural environment, ideal for runners and nature hikers
Traditional mass participation event involving multiple disciplines

description: Vertikál Martinky je štvrtý ročník náročného behu do vrchu, ktorý je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy. Pretekári majú možnosť získať ITRA Score body a porovnať sa s najlepšími na extrémnej trase s prevýšením 944 metrov. Podujatie ponúka výzvu pre profesionálov aj hobby bežcov v krásnom prostredí Martinských holí. Súčasťou sú aj detské kategórie s kratšími trasami a sprevádzaním rodičov. Organizátori zabezpečujú vývoz osobných vecí do cieľa, občerstvenie a bezplatné parkovanie.
course_highlights: Extrémna trasa behu do vrchu s prevýšením 944 metrov
Štart a cieľ v lyžiarskom stredisku Martinské hole
Detské kategórie s prevýšením 76 m a 186 m
additional: Registrácia v deň pretekov od 8:30 do 9:30 na Hrdinov SNP Martin - Stráne, požičovňa FATRA SKI a od 10:15 do 10:45 v reštaurácii Nová Ponorka. Bezplatné parkovanie nad miestom registrácie pre dospelých a na Martinských holiach pre deti. V cene štartovného je vývoz osobných vecí do cieľa, nápoj a jedlo v reštaurácii. Deti môžu štartovať o 11:00, rodič ich môže sprevádzať bezplatne. Pretekári štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť a mladiství do 18 rokov potrebujú písomný súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Trať pozostáva z 20% asfaltu a 80% lesnej cesty, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, súčasťou je preprava osobných vecí, podujatie začína o 10:00 a končí okolo 14:00, je zabezpečené bezplatné parkovanie

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
description: Beh vďaky - Továrne - memoriál Františka Chmeľa je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Továrne v okrese Vranov nad Topľou. Pretek sa koná pred budovou Obecného úradu v Tovarnom a je určený pre širokú kategóriu bežcov podľa veku a pohlavia. Podujatie má tradičný charakter a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách mužov a žien. Organizátori zabezpečujú kompletné informácie a podporu pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Dostupné kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a pohlavia
Dve dĺžky tratí: 5 km a 10 km
Uskutočňuje sa v malebnom prostredí obce Tovarné
additional: Pretek je organizovaný obcou Továrne, kontaktnou osobou je starostka Kvetoslava Mižáková. Informácie o platbe štartovného sú zasielané e-mailom po registrácii, prípadne sú dostupné cez stav úhrady v zozname prihlásených. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, pretek sa koná pred budovou Obecného úradu v Tovarnom. Registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, podujatie je venované pamiatke Františka Chmeľa a je určené pre širokú verejnosť.

name: Orungutan Run
description: Benefičný beh oRUNgutan v ZOO Bratislava je tradičnou športovou udalosťou, ktorá spája bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií s podporou ochrany primátov. Bežci majú možnosť prebehnúť areálom ZOO, vrátane miest, ktoré sú bežne pre verejnosť uzavreté. Výťažok zo štartovného je venovaný na zlepšenie podmienok v Pavilóne primátov, kde žijú orangutany sumatrianske a ďalšie druhy, vrátane nových obyvateľov zoo. Podujatie je vhodné pre rodiny, firmy aj jednotlivcov, ktorí chcú športovať a zároveň pomôcť dobrej veci.
course_highlights: Beh prebieha v areáli ZOO Bratislava s prístupom do bežne uzavretých častí
Trate sú určené pre deti aj dospelých s rôznymi disciplínami
Podpora revitalizácie a zlepšenia životných podmienok primátov, vrátane orangutanov sumatrianskych
additional: Podujatie je benefičné s limitom 800 účastníkov. Bežci môžu bežať v tímoch alebo individuálne. Výťažok je použitý na rekonštrukciu a zlepšenie pavilónu primátov, vrátane inštalácie biopodlahy, nových preliezok a zelene. Beží sa v nedeľu 17. mája 2026 od 10:00 hod. Pre firmy je možnosť zapojiť sa ako team alebo ponúknuť účasť zamestnancom a ich rodinám. Výsledky sú dostupné na vysledkovyservis.sk/orungutan. Trať pravdepodobne vedie cez areál ZOO Bratislava; registrácia je dostupná online; výťažok ide na zlepšenie podmienok pre primáty.

description: Beh Zabudišovou je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 5400 metrov s peknými výhľadmi a prevýšením 133 metrov. Povrch trate je kombináciou asfaltu, štrku a trávnatej cestičky. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské sranda preteky pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Po dobehu čaká účastníkov guláš z diviny, tombola, medaily a ceny pre víťazov. Pretekári štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť a registrácia je možná online s limitom účastníkov, pričom deti štartujú zdarma.
course_highlights: Trať 5400 m s prevýšením 133 m (2 kopčeky)
Povrch: 25% asfalt, 75% štrková alebo trávnatá cestička
Pekné výhľady počas behu

Šatne a sprchy nie sú k dispozícii, sú však dve WC (splachovacie a latrína). Parkovanie je obmedzené priamo pri štarte, po naplnení kapacity je možné parkovať na futbalovom ihrisku 200 m od štartu. Čas merá elektronická časomiera SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. Štartové číslo je povinné a musí byť viditeľné na hrudi. Trať je prevažne prírodná s kopcovitým terénom, preteky sú vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie, registrácia je obmedzená na 100 účastníkov, preteky sa konajú 17. mája 2026.

description: The 68th edition of the Kolín - Velký Osek - Kolín half marathon is a traditional running event that brings together sports enthusiasts from the area and visiting runners. Friendly atmosphere and sporting experience for all levels

description: Brdská 25 is a traditional endurance running race through the central Bohemian Forest (Brdy), designed for the general sports public. The race offers a challenging 25 km course with an elevation gain of over 400 meters, with start and finish located at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field, which provides facilities including changing rooms and refreshments. The program also includes accompanying races such as Nordic Walking Brdy, Cruiser Race Brdy, and children's races. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár (Brdy Running Cup) and offers beautiful running weather and a superb course with safe guidance away from traffic.
course_highlights: 25 km course with an elevation gain of over 400 meters
Start and finish at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field with full facilities
Course runs on the Tok trail, more trail-like, safe away from traffic
additional: Start and finish of the race are at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field, which provides changing rooms and refreshments. Registration begins at 8:00 for children's races, the main race starts at 11:00, the 12 km race, Nordic Walking, and Cruiser Race start at 11:05. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and after the race (water, isotonic drink, cola, banana, salt). Student categories and children start free of charge. The race takes place on May 17, 2026, in Láz u Příbrami, offering various course lengths including 25 km and 12 km. Registration is possible on-site, and the event includes medals, refreshments, and a social program.

name: Běh na Kašperk
location: Kašperské Hory, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Kašperk Run is a traditional and prestigious race as part of the Ešus League series, held in Kašperské Hory. The race, 3.2 km long, starts from the town square at an altitude of 750 meters above sea level and runs on flat terrain as well as challenging ascents to Kašperk Castle, where the finish line is located. The route offers beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and the atmosphere of the castle, making the race a unique experience for runners of all levels. After the race, participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the castle and a jog back to the town.
course_highlights: Start at the town square at an altitude of 750 m above sea level
Flat section along the green trail with views of Křemelná Mountain and surrounding peaks
Final 1.7 km ascent with a 200 m elevation gain to Kašperk Castle
additional: Registration takes place from 9:15 to 9:45 in front of the cinema building in Kašperské Hory. The start and finish may slightly shift, so no record times are set for the course. The event is organized by the town of Kašperské Hory, with contact person Mrs. Renata Hartmanová (tel. 777 848 756). The races include the Ždánov Run (13th edition) and the Kašperk Run (12th edition), a challenging climb to Kašperk (2.9 km), with results and complete information available online.

name: Běh pro kočku
location: Lázně Toušeň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Cat Run is a charity running event held in Lázně Toušeň, which raises awareness about homeless cats and supports a selected cat shelter. The race offers a main run of 8 km along the Elbe River between the Toušeňský and Čelákovický bridges, and a accompanying 4 km route suitable for running and walking. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the run, offers accompanying activities for children and the opportunity to purchase items with cat motifs, with proceeds going to support the shelter. Start and registration take place at the football field area in Lázně Toušeň.
course_highlights: Main 8 km run between the Toušeňský and Čelákovický bridges along the cycle path by the Elbe River
Accompanying 4 km route around Lake Malvíny suitable for running and walking
Start and finish at the football field area in Lázně Toušeň
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race at the venue. The entry fee and proceeds from the sale of items with cat motifs are donated to the cat shelter. The accompanying program includes activities for children and adults, the possibility to sit in a restaurant with a summer terrace and a children's playground. There is also a shorter run or walk of 4 km around Lake Malvíny. Participants agree to the race rules and participate at their own risk. A charity run with proceeds supporting cat shelters and veterinary care, suitable for all age groups, including families with children.

The event offers running courses of 5 km and 10 km and an accompanying program full of fun and activities for all participants. The proceeds support activities promoting the LGBTQ+ community and people living with HIV in the Czech Republic.

The race is not only a physical challenge but also a true adventure and experience, welcoming everyone with open arms.

Nočný beh, registrácia online a na mieste, štart od 17:00 do 20:40, možnosť využiť mestské priestory, zdravotné údaje na štartovnom čísle

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik je náročný horský beh v okolí Kameneca pod Vtáčnikom, ktorý ponúka tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z 50 km trate s 2000 m prevýšenia, 27 km trate s 1000 m prevýšenia alebo 8,4 km trate s 380 m prevýšenia. Každá trať má svoj časový limit a kategórie pre ženy a mužov do a nad 40 rokov. Pretek sa štartuje na farme pod Vtáčnikom a je zabezpečené občerstvenie na viacerých miestach trasy. Organizátor kladie dôraz na povinnú výbavu a bezpečnosť bežcov.
course_highlights: 50 km trať s prevýšením +2000 m a časovým limitom 10 hodín
27 km trať s prevýšením +1000 m a časovým limitom 5 hodín
8,4 km trať s prevýšením +380 m a časovým limitom 2 hodiny
additional: Na trati 50 km sú tri občerstvovačky na 9 km, 27 km a 44 km. Povinná výbava zahŕňa doklady totožnosti, nabitý mobilný telefón, mapu alebo GPX súbor, vlastný skladací pohár alebo fľašu s objemom minimálne 1,5 dl, balík prvej pomoci (izotermická fólia, elastický obväz) a minimálne 0,5 l vody. Štartovné číslo musí byť viditeľne umiestnené na prednej časti tela počas celého preteku. Odporúčaná výbava zahŕňa nepremokavú bundu v prípade dažďa. Traťové dĺžky: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; prevýšenia: +2000 m, +1000 m, +380 m; povinná výbava, občerstvovačky na tratiach, časové limity 10, 5 a 2 hodiny.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 je obľúbený bežecký pretek v Bratislave, ktorý sa koná na Námestí Republiky v Petržalke. Pretek ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detského behu, hlavného behu na 10 km, nordic walking a rodinného behu so psom. Štart detských behov je o 10:00 a hlavného behu o 11:30. Organizátorom je Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v Bratislave-Petržalke, štart a cieľ na Námestí Republiky
Hlavný beh na 10 km s kategóriami pre mužov, ženy a nordic walking
Rodinný beh so psom na 1,8 km a detský beh na 5 km
additional: Deti do 5 rokov a deti z centier pre deti a rodiny (CDR) majú štart bezplatný. Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách, nordic walking na 5 km a rodinný beh so psom na 1,8 km. Viacero kategórií vrátane 5 km, rodinného behu a Nordic walking; štarty o 10:00 a 11:30; online registrácia; miesto konania na Námestí Republiky v Petržalke

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety je bežecký štafetový maratón, ktorý sa koná 23. mája 2026 na trase medzi mestami Salgótarján v Maďarsku a Lučenec na Slovensku. Trať má dĺžku 42,2 km a je rozdelená na štyri úseky, ktoré bežia štyria pretekári v štafete. Preteky sú určené pre mužské, ženské a zmiešané štafety s minimálnym pomerom 50 % žien a 50 % mužov. Na trati sú zabezpečené občerstvovacie stanice a v cieli čaká guláš, športové poháre a finančné odmeny pre najlepšie štafety. Pretekári štartujú o 10:00 a registrácia je možná do 21. mája 2026 online alebo na mieste, ak sú voľné miesta.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce a Lučenec
Štafeta má 4 úseky: 11 km, 10 km, 10,7 km a 10,5 km
Občerstvenie na každom bode odovzdávania štafiet a guláš v cieli
additional: Registrácia je platná po zaplatení štartovného. Kapacita je limitovaná na 20 štafiet. Štafetu tvoria 4 pretekári, odovzdávanie štafiet je možné len na určených bodoch. Limit na celú trať je 4 hodiny. Prísny zákaz doprovodu na trati (auto, bicykel, kolobežka) z dôvodu bezpečnosti. Štart je možný pretekárom od 15 rokov. Beží sa za plnej cestnej premávky po ľavej strane. Pretek je určený pre účastníkov od 15 rokov, s dôrazom na bezpečnosť a dodržiavanie pravidiel. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj sprievodné kultúrne akcie a online registrácia.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: Memoriál Františka Daniša - cezpoľný beh je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Trstín, okr. Trnava, na futbalovom ihrisku. Trať vedie prevažne po poľnej a trávnatej ceste s čiastočným úsekom asfaltového chodníka. Súťažia rôzne vekové kategórie mužov, žien, juniorov a trstínčanov, pričom niektoré kategórie bežia dva okruhy. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi prírodné povrchy a cezpoľný beh v príjemnom prostredí obce Trstín.
course_highlights: Trať je z 3/4 poľná a trávnatá cesta
1/4 trate tvorí asfaltový chodník
Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Trstíne
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, niektoré kategórie bežia dva okruhy, trstínčania majú vlastnú kategóriu. Miestne kontakty: Obec Trstín, tel. 033/558 92 62, e-mail outrstin@slovanet.sk, starosta Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, e-mail starosta@trstin.sk. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií a je súčasťou jarného behu zdravia, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj na mieste. Registrácia je dostupná prostredníctvom kontaktu na organizátorov.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard je extrémny beh jednotlivcov, ktorý sa uskutoční 23. mája 2026 v obci Hlboké nad Váhom. Tento 6. ročník ponúka jeden okruh trate s množstvom adrenalínových prekážok a prudkými kopcami na moto-crossovej trati. Súťažiť sa bude v deviatich kategóriách podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií. Pretekári si užijú čerstvý vzduch, výzvy na trati a po behu ocenenie, občerstvenie a pamätné predmety.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 9 - 10 km s množstvom nových prekážok oproti predchádzajúcim ročníkom
Prudké kopce a adrenalínové prekážky na moto-crossovej trati
Pitná voda na štarte a počas trate, občerstvenie a guláš po behu
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 07:45 hod. v areáli pri futbalovom ihrisku. Štart je postupný, prvý štart detského boyardu a následne štarty po 4-5 pretekároch každých 5 minút. Štartovné zahŕňa medailu, pamätný predmet, lístok na guláš a nápoj, sladkosť, vodu a občerstvenie na trati. Po behu sú k dispozícii sprchy s teplou vodou vo futbalových kabinách. Diváci majú bezplatný vstup na celú trasu. Parkovanie je bezplatné. Pretek sa koná za akéhokoľvek počasia, registrácia je možná predplatením, súčasťou sú medaily a občerstvenie, prebieha od marca do mája 2025

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka je bežecký pretek organizovaný v Jacovciach na futbalovom štadióne. Pretek ponúka dve trate - hlavnú 22 km a hobby beh na 8 km, ktoré vedú po asfaltových a poľných cestách so šotolinou. Štart je naplánovaný na 10:00 pre 22 km a 10:15 pre 8 km. Pretek je vhodný pre rôzne vekové kategórie a pohlavia, pričom organizátorom je ATK Javorina Jacovce. Štartovné je dostupné za prijateľné ceny, čo robí podujatie prístupným pre širokú bežeckú komunitu.
course_highlights: 50 % asfaltové cesty a 50 % poľné cesty so šotolinou
Dve trate: 22 km a 8 km
Štart na futbalovom štadióne v Jacovciach
additional: Kategórie pre 22 km sú rozdelené podľa veku: do 39 rokov, od 40 do 49 rokov, od 50 rokov; pre 8 km sú kategórie muži a ženy. Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny: 10:00 pre 22 km a 10:15 pre 8 km. 50% asfalt a 50% poľné cesty, možnosť registrácie cez email, predaj alebo výmena štartových čísel, pretek sa koná 23. mája 2026

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec je bežecké podujatie organizované run ForRest run o.z., ktoré sa koná na futbalovom štadióne Michala Podolana vo Veľkých Kostoľanoch. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami s dĺžkou 10,90 km a 5,40 km, obe s prevýšením 64 metrov a povrchom kombinujúcim asfalt a lúku. Štart je naplánovaný na 11:00 hod. a súťažiaci sú rozdelení do vekových kategórií s ocenením najrýchlejších Kostolanec a Kostolanka. Podujatie ponúka občerstvovačku a je vhodné pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný beh s miernym prevýšením v peknom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať 10,90 km s prevýšením +64 m
Trať 5,40 km s prevýšením +64 m
Povrch 50% asfalt a 50% lúka
additional: Vyhodnotenie pretekov je o 12:45 hod. Pre zaradenie do kategórií je rozhodujúci rok narodenia. Pre najrýchlejších Kostolancov/Kostolanky je potrebné pri registrácii uviesť obec Veľké Kostoľany. Počet občerstvovačiek na trati: 1. Preteká sa podľa pravidiel cestnej premávky. Účastníci sú zodpovední za vlastné zdravotné poistenie. Trať je prevažne rovinatá, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a je vhodné pre rekreačných aj výkonnostných bežcov.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: Sninský trailový polmaratón je bežecká udalosť v Snine, Slovensko, ktorá ponúka dve trate - hlavnú 21 km trať a kratšiu 7,5 km trať. Pretek je určený pre všetkých milovníkov trailového behu, ktorí si chcú užiť krásy prírody a výzvy terénu. Organizátori vítajú bežcov všetkých úrovní a ponúkajú kvalitnú atmosféru športového podujatia.
course_highlights: Trailový beh v prírodnom prostredí Sniny
Dve možnosti trate: 21 km a 7,5 km
Výzva pre všetky úrovne bežcov
additional: Pretek je vhodný pre všetky úrovne bežcov, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste, a zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane detí a mládeže.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: Beh Soviou Poľanou v Podolínci je lesný bežecký pretek, ktorý ponúka kvalitný tréning a možnosť preveriť si svoje schopnosti v horskom teréne. Pretek je vhodný pre bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť strhujúci deň v prírode a pripraviť sa na dôležité preteky v sezóne. Trasa vedie malebnými lesmi okolo Podolínca a poskytuje výzvu aj pre skúsených bežcov.
course_highlights: Lesné trate v okolí Podolínca
Horský terén s prírodnými prekážkami
Malebné výhľady v oblasti Poľany
additional: Sú k dispozícii detské behy a viacero tratí vrátane 11 km a 18 km varianty. K dispozícii sú mapy, plagáty a propozície na stiahnutie. Registrácia prebieha online cez oficiálnu stránku. Pretek je súčasťou série pretekov s možnosťou online registrácie a rôznymi kategóriami, vrátane detského behu. Podujatie je zamerané na podporu trailového behu v prírode a ponúka atraktívne ceny pre najlepších v kategóriách.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky beh je charitatívny bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 23. mája 2026 na futbalovom štadióne v Belej - Duliciach. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi trasou 5 km alebo 10 km, ktoré vedú mierne členitým terénom po poľnej ceste a šotoline s prevýšením 40 až 80 metrov. Podujatie podporuje dobrú vec, keďže všetky vyzbierané financie poputujú na liečbu 4-ročného chlapca s autizmom a na projekt „deti môjho srdca“. Pre účastníkov sú pripravené darčeky, tombolové lístky, pamiatkové medaily a animácie pre deti, pričom rodičia môžu behať a o deti je postarané. Na mieste je zabezpečené občerstvenie a parkovanie pri štarte a cieli.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie po poľnej ceste a šotoline
Prevýšenie 40 až 80 metrov, mierne členitá
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom štadióne Belá Dulice
additional: Registrácia prebieha v deň preteku od 8:00 do 11:00. Pred štartom dostane každý účastník pitný režim, fit tyčinku a darček od partnerov. Vstupné zahŕňa jeden tombolový lístok s možnosťou dokúpenia ďalších. Po dobehnutí dostane každý pamiatkovú medailu. Pre deti sú pripravené animácie s profesionálnymi animátormi a atrakcie. Parkovanie je zabezpečené pri areáli štartu/cieľa. Na mieste je možnosť zakúpenia občerstvenia a pitného režimu. Pre virtuálnych bežcov sa po skončení podujatia zasiela darček a medaila na adresu. Terén je poľná cesta a asfalt, parkovanie je zabezpečené pri štarte a cieli, k dispozícii sú šatne, sprchy a občerstvenie na mieste. Registrácia je možná online, s možnosťou virtuálnej účasti.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: Mravenčárska míľa je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom štadióne v Plaveckom Štvrtku. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, ako aj pre deti, žiactvo, dorast, juniorské kategórie, Nordic walking a canicross. Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:10 a pre hlavnú kategóriu o 12:00. Organizátorom je Obecný úrad Plavecký Štvrtok, ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom štadióne v Plaveckom Štvrtku
Viacero vekových a špeciálnych kategórií vrátane Nordic walking a canicross
Štart hlavných kategórií o 12:00, žiactvo štartuje o 10:10
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách, deti, žiactvo, dorast, juniorské kategórie, Nordic walking a canicross. Organizátormi sú Milan Zajíček a Soňa Zajíčková s kontaktnými telefónmi 0907 467 595 a 0908 423 975. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, vrátane detí, Nordic walking a canicross; štarty sú naplánované na 10:10 a 12:00; miesto konania je futbalový štadión v Plaveckom Štvrtku

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča je bežecké podujatie v Zeleneči, ktoré organizujú dobrovoľníci z obce spolu s miestnymi spolkami a zdravotníckou službou. Pretek je určený pre mužov, ženy a juniorov do 18 rokov, pričom súťaží sa aj o najrýchlejšieho linčana a linčanku. Štartovné zahŕňa vstup na degustáciu vína počas SvätoUrbanských slávností, čo podujatiu dodáva jedinečnú atmosféru a spája šport s kultúrou. Online registrácia bude spustená od 13. apríla 2026 a pretek sa uskutoční 23. mája 2026.
course_highlights: Pretek v Zeleneči, Vinohrady Zeleneč
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a juniorov do 18 rokov
Vstup na degustáciu vína v cene štartovného
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa vstup na degustáciu vína počas SvätoUrbanských slávností v hodnote 5 €. Registrácia online od 13. apríla 2026, miesto konania: Zeleneč, okr. rnava, čas štartu: 18:30, miesto: Jednotka

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná v krásnej prírode Fatranskej oblasti, v lokalite Tomčany pri Martine. Pretekári si môžu vychutnať beh po lúkach, kopcoch a predmestí Fatry s nádhernými výhľadmi na Lúčanskú, Krivánsku a Veľkú Fatru. Trasa je offroadového charakteru, s prírodnými prekážkami ako blato či spadnuté stromy, čo pridáva na atraktivite a výzve pre bežcov. Podujatie je určené pre rôzne skupiny bežcov, ktorí si môžu vybrať svoj trail podľa schopností a preferencií.
course_highlights: Bežecké preteky fatranskou prírodou, po lúkach a kopcoch
Nádherné výhľady na Lúčanskú, Krivánsku a Veľkú Fatru
Offroad trasa s prírodnými prekážkami ako blato a spadnuté stromy
additional: Povinná výbava: pohárik alebo fľaša minimálne 0.2 l, telefón s číslom na organizátora (0949 465 006). Miesto konania: Tomčany (mestská časť Martin). Podujatie je 1. ročník. Nie sú uvedené konkrétne ceny ani termíny registrácie na stránke. Traťové dĺžky od 4,5 km po maratón, registrácia cez MisoSport.sk, povinná výbava zahŕňa pohárik alebo fľašu a telefón s číslom organizátora, rôzne trasy a aktivity pre deti, štart v 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical - Dúbravský beh na Kobylu je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Pretek sa koná v mestskej časti Dúbravka s štartom pri ulici Pod záhradami (pri Lidli). Súťažiť môžete na 10 km trati AZ-pneu vertical, 5 km Dôverun alebo v detských behoch. Organizátorom je Beh si ty, o.z. spolu s Mestskou časťou Dúbravka. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ v mestskej časti Dúbravka, Bratislava
Trať AZ-pneu vertical má dĺžku 10 km
Okrem hlavnej trate sú aj detské behy a 5 km Dôverun
additional: Poistenci ZP Dôvera majú zľavu 2 Eurá pri online platbe štartovného. Štart detských behov je o 10:20, hlavný beh AZ-pneu vertical 10 km štartuje o 11:00 a Dôverun 5 km o 11:20. Trať vedie mestskými cestami v Dúbravke, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, podujatie je naplánované na 23. mája 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Beh s vlkmi pre život je charitatívny bežecký event organizovaný Nadáciou CHADIM´S CHARITY, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Čierneho na Trojmedzí Slovenska, Česka a Poľska. Ponúka šesť rôznych tratí vrátane polmaratónu, desiatky, päťkilometrového behu, nordic walkingu a detských behov, pričom trate vedú prevažne po asfaltových a lesných cestách s krásnymi horskými výhľadmi. Pretekári môžu očakávať kvalitnú organizáciu s vyznačenými trasami, občerstvovacími stanicami a sprievodným vozidlom s vodou. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje zdravý životný štýl a charitatívne ciele.
course_highlights: Polmaratón s prevýšením +500 m vedúci po horských hrebeňoch s krásnymi výhľadmi
Trasy prevažne po asfaltových a lesných cestách
Vyznačené trate s fáborkami a dobrovoľníkmi na kľúčových križovatkách
additional: Na trati polmaratónu je časový limit 5 hodín, na 10 km behu 2 hodiny. Pretekári musia mať štartovné čísla umiestnené vpredu a prejsť všetkými kontrolnými bodmi. Na trati je jedna občerstvovacia stanica, pitný režim je zabezpečený na štarte aj v cieli. Počas pretekov bude sprievodné vozidlo rozdávať vodu na dostupných miestach. Povinná výbava zahŕňa osobné doklady a odporúča sa poistenie s náhradou liečebných nákladov vzhľadom na prechod cez územia viacerých štátov. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre dospelých aj deti, možnosť registrácie na mieste, sprievodný program a občerstvenie, s dôrazom na podporu charitatívnych aktivít.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma je bežecké podujatie v Novoveskej Hute, ktoré ponúka štart pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Remeselného šenku za Holubnicou a sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií s ocenením pre prvé tri miesta. Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00 hodine, pre dospelých a staršie deti o 13:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych vekových skupín a úrovní.
course_highlights: Preteky v prostredí Novoveskej Huty, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
Viaceré vekové kategórie od detí do dospelých
Štart detí o 10:00, dospelých a starších detí o 13:00
additional: Kategórie pretekov zahŕňajú deti do 6 rokov, deti od 7-9 rokov, deti od 10-14 rokov, mládež a dospelých rozdelených podľa veku s ocenením pre prvé tri miesta v každej kategórii. Pretek sa koná v krásnom prostredí Novoveskej Huty, začiatok pre deti je o 10:00 a pre dospelých o 13:00, súčasťou je aj medaila pre účastníkov a rôzne atrakcie počas podujatia.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100-200 Kč (za jednotlivé závody, dle registrace a délky)
description: Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the sixteenth time in the picturesque landscape on the border of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. It offers routes from 3.6 km up to a marathon, which lead through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains. The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex, where there is also a rich accompanying program including a children's olympiad. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Routes lead through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice
Excellent views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 AM and closes 20 minutes before the start of the respective race. The start and finish are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. There is refreshment available on the course, with one refreshment station at the finish and additional refreshments offered by a local pub known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the complex, and it is recommended to use train or bus connections. After the race, changing rooms and showers are available. Blood and plasma donors are offered a 50% discount on the entry fee upon presentation of the latest donation. The races take place in a natural environment, offering various distances, including children's categories and an accompanying program. Registration is possible online.

name: Vrané – Zvole
location: Vrané nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a traditional and popular circuit where competitors can automatically be included in the overall ranking without the need for additional registration. The races are organized with an emphasis on fairness, safety, and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Uphill run in Prague and Central Bohemia terrain
Challenging ascent and hilly profile of the course
Part of the traditional KOPEC series with scoring and league
additional: Participants are automatically included in the overall KOPEC series ranking by participating in any race. The series standings are determined by the total points from placements in individual races, with a maximum of the 10 best results counting. Runners must adhere to start and conduct rules on the course, including the obligation to run with a bib number and not to use assistance from other persons or animals. In case of health threats, the race director may suspend or terminate the race.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: The Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km course with mixed terrain predominantly on roads. The run is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish line and prizes for the best runners in various categories. The race is run in traffic, with each participant at their own risk.
course_highlights: Length of the course 10 km, mixed terrain with predominance of roads
Refreshments at the finish line and traditional Štramberské uši
Course record men 37:26.6, women 47:26.5
additional: Registration of competitors takes place from 9:15 to 10:40 at the gymnasium of the Štramberk Elementary School. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokolovna in Štramberk. Prizes are awarded in categories based on age and gender, including monetary premiums and material prizes. The race is part of the Ing. Petr Bayer Memorial. Registration from 9:15 to 10:40 at the elementary school gymnasium in Štramberk, refreshments at the finish line, changing rooms and showers at the Sokolovna, the race is run in traffic at your own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
price_range: drahší poplatek na místě, přesná cena není uvedena
description: Berounská desítka is a renewed running race with a tradition, taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three courses: a main race of 10 km for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free children's run of 500 meters. The course runs through forest paths with an elevation gain of 252 meters and features the lookout tower Děd at an altitude of 491 meters above sea level. Participants can look forward to refreshments during and after the race and a friendly atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.
course_highlights: Forest paved and unpaved paths
Highest ascent to the Děd lookout tower (491 m above sea level)
Total elevation gain of 252 meters
additional: Race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 10:00 on race day. Runners in the 10 km race will have refreshments at approximately 6 km, as well as fruit and water after finishing. The children's 500 m race starts at 10:15, and the 4 km and 10 km races start together at 11:00. On-site payment is possible but at a higher fee. The race takes place in all weather conditions; suitable footwear for wet terrain is recommended. Parking is available on Hudlická road; it is advised not to attempt parking directly in the village. The course has an elevation gain of 252 meters, with refreshments before the start, at 6 km, and after finishing. Weather conditions may vary, and the race is held regardless of weather.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
location: Olešnice v Jihomoravském kraji, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Orel Run through the Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by the Christian sports organization Orel in Olešnice, South Moravian Region. The Memorial of Prof. P. Leopold Benáček offers runners the opportunity to compete in the beautiful natural environment of the Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel's broader program, which promotes sports for all in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and contributes to the development of sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: Skalky Forest Park with natural running trails
Beautiful natural environment around Olešnice
Traditional memorial dedicated to Prof. P. Leopold Benáček
additional: The race is part of the OBL 2026 race schedule, offers rules and results, takes place in May 2026

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional trail running race in nature near Plzeň, offering scenic routes of various lengths and difficulty levels. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations of the 750th anniversary of the village. The course passes through Jandova Skála, Čilina, and includes a marathon with a run up to Maršál and Radyně. For children and families, a multigenerational relay is prepared, promoting active movement for all generations.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course through Jandova Skála
21 km route through Čilina
Marathon with a run up to Maršál and Radyně
additional: The race is part of the Running Cup of Plzeň Region. There are school routes and a multigenerational relay for children called "Running for Totem" with parents. The event also celebrates the 750th anniversary of the village of Letkov. It includes various distances, such as 8.5 km, 21 km, and a marathon, with options for family relays and children's categories. Registration opens at the end of 2025, and the races take place in a natural environment with refreshments and medals for participants.

name: Libouchecký UltraMaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 850 Kč. Členové ČAU mají slevu 100 Kč na startovném.

description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchecký Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and its vicinity. The races are mainly run off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails, with clear signage. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Organizers emphasize safety and ecology, for example by limiting plastic cups at refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Routes are mainly off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails
Refreshment stations are located every 15 - 20 km with a diverse selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets, and the possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: Start and finish are behind the football field in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating, and refreshments in a covered tent. Possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available in the Burg area. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a start chip and a charged mobile phone. At refreshment stations, water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, cookies, muesli bars, and salt are available. At the finish, there is soup and a main meal; it is recommended to bring your own dishes and cutlery. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop bag handover are the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children's races, facilities at the football field and in the Libouchecká hall, the possibility of a tent city, ceramic medals, and T-shirts for participants.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Obecnice, CHKO Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč při koupi 8 závodů v rámci jedné objednávky
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail run held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, which are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful nature, technical sections, and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish line is extended to 500 meters, providing an interesting challenge for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international scoring
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - extended 500m finish line with a measured section
additional: In Brdy, competitions are held on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The winner of the Conti Speed Section receives a voucher for tires and a running jersey. The fastest man and woman across all routes will receive a functional Craft running jersey as the GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1 title. The race includes various distances from 4 to 22 km, children's races, accompanying program, and the opportunity for family participation. The event takes place in the natural environment of CHKO Brdy with an emphasis on ecology and community atmosphere.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice
price_range: startovné je darem na podporu hospice
description: Run for the Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event organized to support the St. Stephen Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those whose life journey is coming to an end, thereby contributing to the funding and support of hospice care. The event takes place in a beautiful setting and is complemented by professional timing. The motto of the race is 'Who runs, helps'.
course_highlights: Charity sporting event supporting the hospice
Beautiful environment of Litoměřice
Professional timing
additional: The event is a charity initiative supporting hospice care. The website mentions volunteers and other beneficent activities, but no specific details are provided about start times, waves, capacities, or runner equipment. The event includes various race distances (0.5 km, 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 11 km), offers a virtual run option, and promotes care for the sick.

name: Milada Run
location: Hlavní pláž jezera Milada, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is part of the popular sports series Milada Tour, which takes place in the unique landscape of the former brown coal mine transformed into the natural Milada Lake. The jubilee 10th edition offers a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere with routes for children and adults. The races run along hilly and flat paths with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding nature. The high level and popularity of the race are confirmed by the participants themselves.
course_highlights: Half marathon route with two loops, including a hilly path by the water and views over the lake
10 km route on paved, flat paths suitable for all runners
Children's races 500 m and 1 km near the main beach with parental supervision
additional: The race capacity is limited to 500 participants. All runners will receive a medal, and a start number with their name upon payment by May 16, 2026. An official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt is available for order during registration, and a free children's T-shirt for the first 100 registered children. The accompanying program includes the Olympia children's corner and childcare. The race includes routes around Lake Milada, children's races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle
location: Lesní divadlo, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque environment of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three routes of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes lead through the forest with diverse terrain, including ascents, descents, and beautiful views of spring nature. The race is known for its technical sections and variable profile, which will test runners and experienced trail enthusiasts alike. Starting numbers can be personalized with a name, and participants can use facilities with refreshments and a children's corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with elevation gain of 200 - 360 m depending on the distance
Technical sections with rocky and soft forest paths
Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom
additional: Starting number with a personal name can be ordered by May 17, 2026. The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage, and refreshments at the finish line (Corny bars, bananas, water, Ionilyte sports drink). A children's corner with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for kids. It is recommended to travel by train due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, routes of 10 km and 15 km, start from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

name: NN NIGHT RUN Liberec
location: Vesec, Liberec, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN Liberec is the largest running event in Liberec, held in the Vesec area. Every year, more than 2000 runners of all ages, from beginners to experienced competitors, take part in the start. The event offers an unforgettable experience with a rich accompanying program, including races of various lengths and a charity run against breast cancer. The atmosphere is full of energy, music, and fun, making this race a popular sporting event for the general public.
course_highlights: Night run in Vesec area with atmosphere and musical accompaniment
Races for all age groups including children's and relay runs
Charity run BELLIS RUN against breast cancer on 5 km
additional: Limit of 90 minutes for the main race NN Night Run 10 km. Limit of 75 minutes for BELLIS RUN against breast cancer 5 km (manageable by brisk walking). Rich accompanying program including performances, warm-up sessions with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND), testing MIZUNO running shoes, airbrush tattoos, tombola, and other attractions. Discounts for students with ISIC cards and clients of NN Životní pojišťovna. Option to purchase a functional MIZUNO T-shirt for an additional fee. The event includes various routes, online or on-site registration, accompanying activities, and races focused on families and health.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Horský hotel Čarták, Hutisko-Solanec, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a mountain run suitable for beginners and endurance runners, taking place in the picturesque environment of the Mountain Hotel Čarták in Hutisko-Soláň. The race offers courses of 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km, run along paved ridge paths with stunning views. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of nature and enjoy a sporting challenge. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of mountain terrain in the heart of the Zlín Region.
course_highlights: Run along paved ridge paths
Beautiful views during the course
Various distances from 10 km to 50 km
additional: race distances, mountain terrain, registration details not specified

description: VolšoHEC RUN is a traditional charity relay race held in the beautiful surroundings by the Olšovec pond in the South Moravian Region. The race is run in two relay variants: 4×5.5 km and 2×11 km, with a total distance of a half marathon 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for original running jerseys going directly to the o.p.s. Život dětem. In addition to the main race, there are free children's runs and a non-competitive ride on kick scooters. The race is suitable for teams who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: Relay route around Olšovec pond
Four laps of 5.5 km or two laps of 11 km
Ability to monitor the current race status on a large screen
additional: An original running jersey with your name can be purchased for 500 CZK, order by March 31, 2026. The time limit for completing the entire relay is 3 hours. Relay exchanges take place at the start and finish areas. The non-competitive kick scooter ride starts at 13:13 without a time limit or timing. Children's runs are free and take place from 13:30 to 14:45 with results announced afterward. The main race starts at 15:00, covering four laps with a 3-hour time limit. Registration is possible via an online form. The event also includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony.

description: Running for Children is a sports and entertainment afternoon organized since 2015 that supports children and young people from children's homes. The event offers running races and fun sports activities for all age groups, including a family run and a team relay. The program features accompanying activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, a magic show, and musical performances. In 2026, the event will take place on May 23rd in Na Pankráci Park in Prague 4 and is organized under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 4. Everyone who helps is a winner, and every participant is entered into a raffle for prizes.
course_highlights: Mayor of Prague 4 Cup 5 km run in Na Pankráci Park
Family run of 1 km for 2 to 5 members, all start and finish together
4 x 1 km team relay with at least one adult in the team
additional: Registration is possible online until May 20, 2026, at a reduced price, later on-site at a higher price up to 30 minutes before the start. Each registered participant is entered into a prize draw and receives an electronic certificate. Daily steps are now counted, not only targeted activity. The event features a rich accompanying program including musical performances and fun activities for children. The event is held under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 4. Registration is possible online, supporting children from children's homes, sponsorship opportunities, and community sports support.

name: SeziRun
location: Sezimovo Ústí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závody, 100 Kč za 4 km s kočárkem, 50 Kč pro děti do 16 let, dobrovolný příspěvek pro děti do 12 let
description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí, taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon, 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km courses. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish lines, making it easy for participants to arrive. The race atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with opportunities to share photos and a limited edition headband for participants.
course_highlights: Various courses for adults and children from 200 m to a half marathon
Start and finish in Sezimovo Ústí with accessible parking about 300 meters from the start
Announcement of the top three in all categories except the walking category
additional: Parking is available at designated parking lots in Sezimovo Ústí, ideally as close as possible or directly on K Hájence street, approximately 300 meters from the start. Vehicle entry directly to the forest hut is prohibited. A limited edition headband is being prepared for the 2026 anniversary. A photo gallery is shared for all participants and fans of SeziRun. The race takes place in a natural environment with online registration, refreshments, chip timing, and a raffle with prizes. Temporary changing rooms are available at the haystack, without showers or storage facilities.

name: Zaječický bůr
location: Zaječice u Pyšel, Zaječice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Zaječický běh je tradiční cross-country race with a family atmosphere, offering courses for all age groups from children to adults. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Zaječice near Pyšely and is part of the Ladov Region Cup. It offers material prizes for the top three in each category and prize money for the course record on the longest track. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Five courses from 55 m to 10,555 m for different age categories
Main prize for the overall winner of the MAXI rabbit category on 5555 m
Part of the Ladov Region Cup with prize money for the course record on 10,555 m
additional: Registration is possible online until May 22nd or on-site on the race day. Starts are divided by categories from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and marked from the entrance to Zaječice. The race is scored for the Ladov Region Cup and the Regional Skiing Association of the Central Bohemian Region. The HOLE category is Nordic walking with style control. The race offers medals, material prizes, diplomas, start packages, refreshments for all participants (cookie, juice or tea, soup), and online registration options. The event is suitable for the whole family and includes a children's program.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event organized to support a collection for Šimonka, a boy suffering from the rare metabolic disease Lesch Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun sports day for the whole family in the Skalka area near Nový Jičín. The goal is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation but also to raise awareness about this disease and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to help a good cause.
course_highlights: Run of 13 km combining asphalt and trail routes
Support for children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka with Lesch-Nyhan syndrome
Supporting program, raffle, and collection to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun sports day for the whole family with refreshments. Part of the support includes the sale of T-shirts, with a portion of the proceeds going towards Šimonka's treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheater, registration is possible online, and the proceeds are allocated to rehabilitation, aids, and medical examinations. There are races for children and adults, a program, and a collection.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné při registraci do 30. dubna 2026 (cena není explicitně uvedena)
description: Run for a Smile is a sporting event for the whole family held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for active and non-active families, seniors, and children from 1 year old, and you do not have to run the race, walking is also fine. Half of the entry fee goes to the Julinka Foundation, which fights against childhood obesity. Races for children and parents are scheduled back-to-back, and while waiting for parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are certified
Children's routes without placement evaluation, run for joy and a smile
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov
additional: Distribution of race bibs and athlete registration on race day from 8:30 AM, bibs must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are chip-timed with single-use chips attached to their bibs. The registration fee until April 30, 2026, includes a medal, a name-tagged bib, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A baggage storage service is available for runners. The event hosts are Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with accompanying activities for children and a charitable aspect.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
description: Ivan Belobrada Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses up to 9 km, run on village asphalt roads, forest and field paths with varied surfaces. The event is suitable for the general public, including youth and children, with the possibility of individual starts for the youngest. The race takes place in a pleasant sports area and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Course up to 9 km on asphalt, forest, and field roads
Varied surface: asphalt, paved, and unpaved terrain
Sports area Dlouhoňovice as start and finish
additional: Registration begins from 8:00 - 8:30, the first category starts at 9:00, the main race starts at 11:00. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup series. For the youngest children, a community run with flexible start times is prepared. Online registration is available as well as on-site registration with different entry fees. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series, includes various categories, exact courses are not specified.

name: Přibyslavský kros
location: Přibyslav u Nové Paky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: The Přibyslav Cross is a cross-country and trail run held in the picturesque environment of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two courses of 8 km and 4 km, which run through nature and forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, allowing comfortable participation for the general public and competitive runners. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure high-quality organization of the event.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail course characteristics
Course lengths of 8 km and 4 km in a natural environment
Forest paths and natural terrain
additional: Start of the first category at 10:00, main category start at 11:00. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec (phone 728 334 590). The race includes cross-country and trail courses, with starts scheduled at 10:00 and 11:00; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova Návsi, Poniklá, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Poniklá Rezek uphill run is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. The race starts at Tuláčková Square and leads uphill to Rezek. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy challenges in natural terrain and want to experience an active sports day in a beautiful environment. The organizer is Petr Holec, who ensures the smooth running of the race.
course_highlights: Start at Tuláčková Square in Poniklá
Uphill run with the finish at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views
additional: The race starts at Tuláčková Square, with various distances including 2 km and 9.2 km, and features challenging ascents and a final climb to Rezek. The event is supported by the local community and also offers an evening program.

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Gočár Run is a unique race connecting two regional cities, Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners will face a 33-kilometer route combining road and natural sections with the backdrop of Gočár's buildings, from schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-member relay teams, and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience with an accompanying program and musical performances. The Gočár Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemia region and attracts hundreds of runners and thousands of fans each year.
course_highlights: 33 km route from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
Combination of road and natural sections
Backdrops of Gočár's buildings including Automatic Mills
additional: The start package includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a Hradecký Klenot beer pack, a race number with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, an electronic diploma, and an accompanying program. There are changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and videos, testing of Craft footwear, and taping at a discounted price. The VIP experience includes a personalized T-shirt, diploma, and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The accompanying program features musical performances, children's activities, various race categories, and the opportunity to share the experience with friends.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Skořice, CHKO Brdy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Run Forests Brdy is a trail run held on May 23, 2026, in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Brdy), near Prague and Příbram. The race offers both short and long routes, including a charity race, and is part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can compete in speed sections such as the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which provide additional motivation and rewards. The course runs through beautiful nature of the Brdy and is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races - international point rating of trail races
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - a 500-meter flat finish stretch with timing and rewards
additional: Online registration and registration fee changes are available via SportID. The charity race is part of the event. Results and performance analyses are accessible on the website and in the SportID app. Starting numbers are already sold out for some dates; early registration is recommended. Routes are 12 km and 22 km, featuring charity and UTMB Index point evaluation, speed sections, race speed sections, online registration and results, and GPX format routes available for download.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in a beautiful environment with the opportunity for active participation by club members and the public. Club Jasan is known for its long-standing tradition and active approach to training and competitions in the region.
course_highlights: Terrain includes slopes around Aš
Race date is May 23, 2026
Organizer offers sporting experiences in a natural environment
additional: Registration is open until January 31, 2026; the race course includes slopes and natural terrains around Aš; start and registration information are available on the official website.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: The Puppy Run - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a cross-country race covering 7.2 km, held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers runners an interesting course in natural terrain. The event is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test their strength on a more challenging route with diverse surfaces. The race has a tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in natural terrain
Distance of 7.2 km
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The event is intended for the broad running public and supports the regional running community.
