description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers courses for all age groups from the youngest children to a race over 11 km. Participants have access to abundant refreshments, comfortable facilities including changing rooms and showers. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful nature around Žlutava.
course_highlights: Main route 11.3 km with an elevation gain of 227 m
Surface of the course: asphalt (35%), grass and dirt (30%), cobblestone (35%)
Picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava
additional: Participants have access to chip timing, refreshments (drinks, fruit), a voucher for food and drinks for online registered participants in main races A and B, participant medals for children, and material prizes for the top three in age categories. There are changing rooms and showers available. IZS categories have special conditions and part of the start fee is donated to the Military Solidarity Fund. The course is over 11 km, with refreshments, showers, parking at the football field, online and on-site registration, various age categories, start on 23 May 2026.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Solanec pod Soláněm, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a daily individual running race held along the ridge of the Beskydy mountains in the beautiful environment of forests around Solance under Soláně. The course is off-road, running on marked hiking trails, and offers smoothly undulating terrain with inspiring views. The race is suitable for cross-country and trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the beautiful nature of the Beskydy Mountains.
course_highlights: The course runs along the ridge of the Beskydy mountains off-road with one secured crossing of a road
Marked hiking trails in smoothly undulating terrain
Beautiful forest environment with inspiring views
additional: The organizer is the 3THX sports club, Tomáš Knop-Kostka. The race is a fast-paced individual running event. The race distances are 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km. The course is off-road, with only one secured road crossing. Course lengths: 50 km / 30 km / 20 km / 10 km; terrain trail and cross-country, registration fee varies depending on registration order.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
location: Brno, Pavilon Anthropos, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 2 000 Kč

description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Brno is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Anthropos pavilion and offers timed runs of 6 km, 10.5 km, and a relay of 4 x 2.5 km, as well as untimed family and children's runs. The route runs along the Svratka River with a surface of paved paths and asphalt. Participants contribute through their entry fee to the filming and preservation of witnesses' stories and educational programs.
course_highlights: Route along the Svratka River towards Kamenná Colony and Kamenný Bridge
Surface of paved paths and asphalt
Timed runs of 6 km (1 lap) and 10.5 km (2 laps)
additional: Start and finish at the Anthropos pavilion. Changing rooms, storage, sanitary facilities, water for rinsing, and refreshments to replenish energy are available. Students, individuals under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. On-site registration is possible with a higher registration fee. The event includes not only sports activities but also an accompanying program with music, refreshments, and facilities including changing rooms and water stations. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the sixteenth time in the picturesque landscape on the border of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. The races offer routes from 3.6 km up to a marathon, including relay races and a children's olympiad, starting and ending at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The running courses lead through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains and between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice. The event is complemented by a rich accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes lead through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Start and finish of all runs are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration begins at 7:00 AM and ends 20 minutes before the start of the respective race. There is refreshment on the course, and at the finish line, one refreshment is available included in the entry fee. It is recommended to try the Marathon Soup at the local pub. Parking is available near the complex and on the main road, with ideal options being train and bus connections. The event also includes a children's olympiad and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon presenting proof of their last donation. The course passes through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children's activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krušnej downhill is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque environment of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses - the longer FullHD approximately 14 km long and the shorter HD 7 km, which mainly run through forest paths and paved roads with hilly terrain and technical sections. The start and finish are in Nové Hamry, with the start moved to an earlier hour to ensure the race takes only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners who want to experience a challenging yet attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Circuit course with a length of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest paths, paved forest roads, and asphalt crossings
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry at the Velká sjezdovka, with a circuit course featuring water stations on the track (for FullHD) and at the finish. Transportation to the start is provided without the need for train transfer. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes only the morning part of the day. Course variants: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km), hilly profile, bus departure from the registration site, on-site and online registration, changes in the route and schedule compared to previous years.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a course length of 4.8 km. The race is of a mixed type and includes a hill climb prize, adding to its attractiveness and challenge for runners. The start is at a football field, and the race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer is Sokol Běšiny, ensuring a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: Course length of 4.8 km in Běšiny near Klatovy
Mixed type race with a hill climb prize
Start at a football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather conditions. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. Children start for free. The course passes through a football field, registration is at your own risk, the race is held in all weather conditions, and there is a hill climb prize.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady and Čechovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
price_range: on-line registrace od 400 Kč, na místě od 500 Kč; štafety od 1 500 Kč, na místě od 1 600 Kč; dětské závody od 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 1 500 Kč

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Olomouc is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, in Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks and offers timed runs of 5 km, 10 km, and a 4x2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children's and family runs. The start and finish are near the collection greenhouses in Smetanovy Park. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route runs through Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks on marked circuits
The 5 km race consists of 2 laps, the 10 km race of 4 laps
The relay is composed of 4 segments of 2.5 km each
additional: Students, minors under 18, members of the Post Bellum Friends Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the registration fee. Changing rooms, a storage area, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying program includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are issued during check-in on the race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family and children’s program, and promotes memories of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race offers timed runs of 5 km and 10 km with mass start, which lead along paved paths and asphalt in the forest park and along the cycle path. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of history and the courage of fighters for freedom. Start numbers are issued on the day of the race at the registration site. The event also includes a children's run and the possibility of a symbolic run "Anywhere!" outside the official routes.
course_highlights: Start at the entrance near Sletiště
The route runs through the forest park along the cycle path
Surface of paved paths and asphalt
additional: Students, pupils under 18, members of the Friends of the Nation's Memory Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and pick-up of start numbers take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on the race day. It is recommended to write medications, allergies, and a contact person on the back of the start number for medical emergencies. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on-site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national memory.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Jihlava is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn area with start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose from timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, or untimed children's and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant environment on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The route runs along paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn area
Start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the area
Offers timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, as well as untimed children's and family races
additional: Students, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Hygienic facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and bib pickup take place on the race day at specified times. Results are announced after the runners finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for various race categories.

name: LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a loving community event in Magyarpolány that focuses on the movement and rejuvenation of body and soul. Participants of all ages can take part in the running race, followed by a day filled with delicious foods and meditative programs such as labyrinth walking and gong sound baths. This event is not just a sport activity but a lively, breathing community celebration held in the embrace of nature. The event is organized by the Habitus Foundation and is part of the Polányi Pentecost series of events.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented running race for families and all age groups
Meditative labyrinth walk offering a unique inner experience
Gong sound bath for inner silence and rejuvenation
additional: The event is part of the Polányi Pentecost series. After the running race, participants can enjoy a communal picnic with delicious foods, including chili con carne and vegan salads. The program features a gong sound bath and meditative labyrinth walk, providing a special inner experience. Several special awards are given out, emphasizing the community aspect. The event includes running races, a family picnic, relaxation programs, refreshments, and spring water. Prior registration is required to participate.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon - relay race is a team event between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering a distance of 42.2 km divided into six sections for teams of 4-6 members. The route passes through picturesque towns, and runners complete the full distance by relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment points and goulash served at the finish line, while cultural programs add variety to the day. The race will be held on August 23, 2025, and registration is available online until August 20. After that, registration is only possible on-site if spots remain.
course_highlights: 42.2 km relay race in 6 sections, each 5-7.8 km long
Route passing through Salgótarján, Somoskoujfalu, Radzovce, Rátka, Trebeľovce, Hladký Majer, and Lučenec
Refreshment points approximately every 5 km, with goulash and cultural programs at the finish
additional: Relay teams consist of a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 6 members, with handovers at relay points. Participants can start from age 15. The entire route runs on the left side of the road alongside traffic, and traffic rules must be followed. The first 30 teams will receive medals, and the top three in each category will win cups. The course passes through multiple towns, with refreshment points every 5 km. Online registration is available, with on-site registration possible if spots remain. Cultural programs and concerts are held at the finish line.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometer trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna, including the famous "two spikes," which present a special challenge for runners. This race offers a unique finish line experience in Hungary, provided only by UTH. The event is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the Ultra-Trail Hungary atmosphere and trail running challenges.
course_highlights: 22-kilometer distance around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna
The dreaded elevation of the two spikes
Unique finish line experience in Hungary
additional: Registration was open until May 1, 2026, and submissions and distance changes could be handled on that day. The race is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary series, which offers multiple distances and events. The event is supported by various sponsors and media partners. The race location is Dömös, Szentfa-Kápolna; bus transfer is included in the registration fee; there is no water station at the start location.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail running race that starts from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and leads to the city center of Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging parts of the Visegrád Mountains, traversing varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail running enthusiasts alike. The event is traditionally of high quality and provides well-organized support along the course.
course_highlights: 30 km distance from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád to Szentendre
The most beautiful and difficult-to-traverse parts of the Visegrád Mountains
Varied terrain and natural environment
additional: Registration has closed as the maximum of 1600 participants has been reached. The race center and expo are located in Szentendre, at Áprily Lajos tér 3, in the Ferences Sports Hall. There is a luggage storage at the Reformed High School building. Among the supporters of the race are well-known brands such as Salomon, TUI, Leki, Petzl, Garmin, and Rudy Project. Information about other distances, registration, volunteer opportunities, supporters, and media partners is available.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia je prvý oficiálny slovenský vegánsky beh, ktorý organizuje Slovenská vegánska spoločnosť. Podujatie spája šport, zdravie a súcit a prináša viac než len beh - je to spoločný krok za zdravšie telo, čistejšiu planétu a informovanejšiu spoločnosť. Trasy vedú z ikonického Amfiteátra v Rači cez rozhranie karpatského lesa a vinohradov, ponúkajúce lesnú terapiu, rôznorodý terén a epické výhľady na Bratislavu. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km, 10 km a Canicross disciplínou, ktorá umožňuje bežať so psom.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú cez karpatský les a rozkvitnuté vinohrady s čerstvým vzduchom a tieňom stromov
Panoramatické výhľady na Bratislavu z vinohradníckych chodníčkov
Rôznorodý terén od mäkkých lesných ciest po kľukaté cestičky v Malých Karpatoch
additional: Merač času na všetkých tratiach. Možnosť bežať so psom v disciplíne Canicross. Trasy sú vhodné pre začiatočníkov aj pokročilých bežcov. Výťažok z podujatia podporuje zvieratá v útulku a edukačný program o rastlinnej výžive pre lekárov. Podujatie je charitatívne a podporuje edukačné programy o rastlinnej výžive, pričom výťažok je venovaný zvieracím útulkom a vzdelávaniu lekárov.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros je tradičný bežecký pretek v Bytči, ktorý ponúka štyri trate rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti, vrátane Super Krosu s dĺžkou 21 km a prevýšením 500 m. Trať vedie prevažne terénom, ako sú poľné cesty, lúky a cyklochodníky, s 80 % terénnym povrchom a 20 % spevneným povrchom. Pretekári môžu očakávať tri občerstvovačky na dlhších tratiach a dôkladné značenie trasy. Súťaže sú rozdelené podľa vekových kategórií pre mužov aj ženy, pričom ocenení budú prví traja v každej kategórii.
course_highlights: Super Kros 21 km s prevýšením +500 m
Trať vedie 80 % terénom a 20 % spevneným povrchom
Tri občerstvovačky na dlhších tratiach
additional: Pretekári na trati Super Kros 21 km musia mať stiahnutý GPS súbor mapy trate v telefóne alebo hodinkách a mať pri sebe nabitý a funkčný mobilný telefón. Trať je značená stužkami, šípkami a dobrovoľníkmi. Zmena trate oproti predchádzajúcim ročníkom kvôli cyklochodníku, beží sa po ľavej strane Váhského kanála. Registrácia zahŕňa povinné stiahnutie GPS súboru a pripravenosť na mobilnom telefóne; preteky sa konajú v rôznych terénoch vrátane asfaltu, poľných ciest a cyklistických chodníkov.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and mainly runs on flat terrain with slight inclines between Nemilí and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Cup and offers quality facilities including refreshment stations and a children's race. The start and finish are at the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh, where participants receive a symbolic medal and refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course with predominantly flat profile
Surface: asphalt, with sections of chipseal, cobblestones, and concrete
Four refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Participants with an estimated finish time of 2:30 - 3:00 hours can start as early as 9:30 AM. The race has a time limit of 3 hours. After the race, a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer, draft lemonade) and pasta salad is available for participants. A children's race is organized after the start of the adult race. Lockers are available for 10 CZK. Parking is possible at the swimming pool and nearby, following the instructions of marshals. The course is free of restrictions and construction works. The race will take place on May 24, 2026, registration is open, suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with various categories and team competitions.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
description: The Forest Half Marathon Říčany is a running race held exclusively on beautiful forest roads and trails without asphalt. The surrounding nature in the Říčany area is very picturesque at the end of May, contributing to a pleasant running experience. The race is suitable for lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half marathon distance. Organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage sharing race experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs exclusively on forest roads and trails
Zero asphalt content on the course
Beautiful surroundings with tall old beech trees
additional: Course distances: 5 km, 10.5 km, and 14.5 km; elevation gain approx. 120-350 m; routes run exclusively on forest roads and trails.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
location: Příbram, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Příbram Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Příbram, offering a half marathon course, relay race, fitness run, and children's races. The race is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially during the descent to the square. It attracts a wide running community each year and provides quality facilities including refreshments and parking.
course_highlights: New half marathon route
Descent to the square with a magical atmosphere
Relay race with team spirit
additional: The race offers multiple categories: individual half marathon, relay half marathon, fitness run, and children's races. Online registration in advance is recommended. Refreshments and parking are available near the start. The race takes place on May 24, 2026. Registration is possible through the website. The race is suitable for various age and performance categories.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova pětka is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a course of 5 kilometers. The race is part of the calendar of the Stříbro Endurance Association and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route runs through the city park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, results are announced and refreshments are provided for participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park across Svatováclavská bridge
The race takes place in the evening from 18:00
Friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to run in a group
additional: The race is part of the Tachovsko Runner series. After the race, results are announced and refreshments are provided. The organizer is the Stříbro Endurance Association, z.s., which supports amateur and recreational athletes. Registrations and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The race is part of the local sports calendar; exact distances and categories are not specified.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
description: Run the Unconventional Path is a running race held in Prague 13, offering courses of 13 km and 5 km. The race takes participants through scenic corners of Central Park Stodůlky and the Prokop Valley Nature Park. The start is on Sunday, May 24, 2026, at 13:13:13. Runners can enjoy refreshments on the course and at the finish line. The event is open to everyone and is conducted in the spirit of fair play, emphasizing adherence to the marked route.
course_highlights: The route passes through Central Park Stodůlky and Prokop Valley Nature Park
Refreshments at 8 km and at the finish for the 13 km course, refreshments at the finish for the 5 km course
Start and finish near the refreshment area Kuželkárna
additional: Start of the race is also possible on-site on the race day, May 21, 2026. Awards are given to the top 3 in each category, divided by age, with a minimum of 4 runners in each category. Participants under 18 years old may only start with parental consent. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and rules without prior notice. Photos and videos may be used for promotional purposes without compensation. The race takes place on May 24, 2026, with registration available online and on-site. The event also includes training runs and safety regulations.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, the 6th edition will take place with courses of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km trail, 11 km Nordic Walking, and children's races. The main course passes through the Špulka lookout tower and offers beautiful nature and a challenging route. All courses are measured with chip timing, and each participant will receive a medal. The registration fee partly contributes to the restoration of fruit alleys in the area.
course_highlights: Main trail of 15 km passes through the Špulka lookout tower
Sprint 5 km course across the local pasture with the possibility of meeting cows
Nordic Walking 11 km follows the main trail
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race with the risk that medals may not be available for participants. Most routes are measured with IRONTIME chip timing. Children's races are divided into age categories and include a 650 m obstacle race for children. The registration fee contributes to the purchase of mature fruit trees for the restoration of alleys in the area. Course options: 15 km trail, 5 km run, 1300 m children's course, 10 km Nordic Walking, 650 m children's obstacle run; online registration until May 25, 2023, or May 22, 2025; proceeds go to tree planting and landscape restoration.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is a memorial to Jirka S. and is traditionally run along the cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00 AM with registration from 8:00 AM. The event is open to all runners and offers a friendly atmosphere with the possibility of winning a raffle.
course_highlights: Length of the course 5 km
Race along the cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant registration from 8:00 AM, race start at 9:00 AM, the race is run along the cycle path, possibility of winning in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course lengths and registration information have not yet been published.

name: Suchdol běží
price_range: Kč 0,- to Kč 300,- podle registrace a způsobu platby

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kč 0,- děti při přihlášení online do 24.5.2026 (60 min před startem)

description: Suchdol Run is part of the seventh edition of the running series Run with us 2026, which is intended for the general public. The race takes place on Sunday, May 24, 2026, in Prague 6 - Suchdol, with start and finish in the Community Garden area. The course runs along paved field and forest paths with an elevation gain of 96 meters, offering runners a pleasant run on flat terrain and a downhill into the valley, with return via forest paths. Categories are divided into children and adults according to age groups, with participants under 18 only allowed to start with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved field and forest paths
Downhill into Roztok towards Únětický Stream
Elevation gain of 96 meters for the adult circuit
additional: Start for children at 11:00, for adults at 13:00. Registration no later than 30 minutes before the start. Chip timing, start number with chip is mandatory to wear on the upper front part of the body throughout the race. The race takes place in any weather; the organizer reserves the right to cancel the race in case of extremely adverse conditions. Starts are scheduled at 11:00 for children and 13:00 for adults, online registration is available, parking is provided on Suchdolská Street, and the race course is the same as in previous editions.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh and its vicinity. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and mainly runs on flat terrain with slight inclines between Nemilí and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers quality facilities including refreshment stations and timing with chip technology. The start is at 10:00 AM from the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh, with runners expected to finish in under 2:30 hours able to start at 9:30 AM. After the race, a buffet with refreshments and medals for all participants is available.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course mainly on flat terrain
Surface: asphalt, with sections of gravel, cobblestones, and a concrete cycle path
Four refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: The start is at the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh. Runners with an expected time of 2:30 - 3:00 can start at 9:30 AM. The race has a time limit of 3 hours. On the course, there are 4 refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, bananas, apples, raisins, and salt. At the finish line, there is a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer, draft lemonade) and pasta salad. Lockers are available for 10 CZK. Parking is at the pool above Oborník Street; the race finish is directly in front of the pool, where parking is not possible. A children's race for the youngest participants is also organized. Registration is open until May 21, 2026, with an option to order a running shirt. The course is certified, and the race starts at 10:00 AM.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
description: The Salomon Szentendre Trail is a 54-kilometer trail running race held in Szentendre and its surroundings, with an elevation gain of 1800 meters. Runners cross the Apátkúti stream twelve times and pass through beautiful landscapes, including Visegrád and the Calvary. The finish line is located in Szentendre's main square and on the Duna promenade, where tourists applaud the finishers. This race offers a unique experience by combining nature and urban environment.
course_highlights: 54 km distance, 1800 meters elevation gain
Twelve crossings of the Apátkúti stream
Beautiful views in Visegrád and at the Calvary
additional: 54 km, 1800 meters elevation gain, trail, registration, volunteer opportunities, multiple distances (30k, 42k, 84k, 111k) available

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Szentlászló Trail is an exciting trail running race in Szentendre, offering the steepest ascents of the Visegrád Mountains. The race starts at dawn, and participants run across the misty Sikárosi Meadow, where the cuckoo greets them. Before reaching the finish line, tourists applaud the runners along the promenade and in the Main Square. This challenge provides an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail running enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: The steepest ascents of the Visegrád Mountains
Crossing the misty Sikárosi Meadow
Finish at Szentendre Main Square, where tourists applaud
additional: Registration was open until noon on May 1, 2026, with the number of entries reaching the maximum of 1600. The race begins at dawn, when the bell strikes two. During the race, runners move through natural environments and varied terrain, with the finish expected before 7 PM. Multiple distances (54K, 84K, 30K, 22K, 42K, 111K), diverse terrain, registration options, start at 14:00, multiple sponsors, and categories.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary's most prestigious trail running race, consisting of six separate distances with approximately 1500 trail runners participating. The race takes place on varied terrain through dense and dark forests, challenging participants with significant elevation gains. The longest distance is 111 km with 4200 meters of elevation gain, featuring 9 refreshment points and 2 depot points, and a 20-hour time limit. The event location is Szentendre, with start and finish at Lázár Cár Square. A detailed map and information center are available for runners and their companions to ensure smooth organization.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4200 meters of elevation gain
9 refreshment points and 2 depot points on the longest route
Dense and dark forests, varied terrain
additional: The maximum number of participants is 1600, with up to 300 starters on the longest distance. The race's Google map includes refreshment points, start and finish locations, and the race center. There are secured crossings on the course where companions cannot cheer. The refreshment points at Dömös and Pap-rét are not accessible by car; a 30-minute walk is required. Registration opens on November 2, 2025, with various registration options and related activities.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
location: Baumax, Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň is a regular running race held in Pilsen, offering a course length of 8 km. The race takes place on a cycle path in the Pytel area and is open to all age categories. The start is scheduled for the evening, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and shared time with other running enthusiasts. Organizers emphasize safety and fairness, with the race being measured manually and held in all weather conditions except extreme conditions.
course_highlights: The course runs along a cycle path in Pytel
The race distance is 8 km
The race takes place in the evening from 18:00
additional: The race is measured manually, with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes. Runners must wear a visible bib on their chest. The race is held in all weather conditions; the organizer reserves the right to cancel the race in case of extreme weather. It is open to all age groups; participants under 15 must be accompanied by an adult over 18. The race supports charitable projects. Registration is possible online or on-site. The course is flat and runs alongside the Úslava River.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by the group Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who are dedicated to organizing running races, charity runs, and running trainings. The event takes place in the picturesque location of Pytle in Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of the running community that promotes an active lifestyle and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: Flat profile along the Úslava River
Length of 7.5 km suitable for all levels of runners
Pleasant environment in the center of Plzeň and around the river
additional: The race takes place in Pytle, registration is possible online or on-site, the event is part of the running community in Plzeň.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Around Saint Juliána is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina with a course length of 5600 meters, mainly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration take place at a tourist shelter on the cycle path in K Juliána Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories including juniors, adults, and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking options nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary contribution for some categories.
course_highlights: Course 5600 m, one lap
Mostly forest paths with the first 600 m on asphalt
Minimal elevation gain
additional: Start and registration at a tourist shelter on the cycle path in K Juliána Street, signage from bus stops 161 and 312 (about 5 minutes walk). Parking in adjacent streets, preferably in K padesátníku Street. Categories: Juniors, young women, men and women up to 39 years old, veterans and veteran women in various age groups. The race is suitable for runners and cyclists, offering an opportunity to explore the historic site of Saint Juliána and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.

name: Koutecká vertikála
location: Ski areál Kouty nad Desnou, Kouty nad Desnou, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Koutecká vertikála is an uphill race 2.5 km long with an elevation gain of 510 meters, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race features an interval start and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenging and dynamic uphill run, ideal for mountain running enthusiasts and vertical challenge seekers.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.5 km
Elevation gain of 510 m
Interval start at Kouty nad Desnou ski resort
additional: Uphill race, part of the cross-country race series, opportunity for children to participate, suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country is a running race in Krčský Forest in Prague 4, offering a 7.5 km course for men and a 2.5 km course for women. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners seeking a pleasant cross-country run in a natural environment. The route runs through forest terrain and provides an opportunity to enjoy running in a peaceful part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test their strength in this attractive event.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Krčský Forest
7.5 km course for men and 2.5 km for women
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is very demanding with a total elevation gain of approximately 315 meters for men. The start is at 17:00, registration is possible online, and the race takes place in Krčský Forest near Hotel Nosál.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
location: Peklák, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Hellish Kilometer is a uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and offers a 1 km course with an interval start, leading to the ski slope over grass, snow, and roads depending on the weather. The children's race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging ascent.
course_highlights: Uphill run to the ski slope
Interval start except for the youngest children
Course surface: grass, snow, roads depending on weather
additional: Registrations are possible on-site. Award ceremonies for the youngest categories are held immediately, while for other categories, the top three times are considered, with a ceremonial award after the last race on August 26, 2026. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026, and the overall standings count towards this series. The race takes place on Wednesday evening, the course is short and steep, crossing the ski slope and forest roads, and is designed for a wide age range from children to adults.

description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running race around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, where runners with various ambitions meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing and good spirits after finishing. The event takes place at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda and is the largest sporting running event on a weekday in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.
course_highlights: Short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone
Long loop of 9 km with long flat sections, terrain, and a climb up Kunětická Mountain via stairs
Start and finish at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda under Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. An isotonic drink is available after the race. A start number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 CZK once at the first start of the year. Categories are divided by age and gender. Runners participate at their own risk, and written parental consent is required for minors. Cross-country running, start at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda, race held on May 27, 2026.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO is a traditional 40th edition of a stage running race in Teplice, designed for fitness, recreational, and competitive runners from 15 years old. The race consists of ten best starts during the season, with the better time deciding in case of a tie in points. The measurement limit for judges is 35 minutes, after which the runner's time is recorded as 35+. A separate series for young runners, Young BĚKODO, is prepared for younger participants. The organizer is TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.
course_highlights: Stage race with ten best starts counted towards the overall score
Time measurement limit of 35 minutes with the possibility to finish after the limit
Designed for runners from 15 years old, with a separate series for young runners
additional: Start is only permitted for runners from 15 years old (born in 2011 or earlier). Younger runners can participate in the separate series Young BĚKODO. The race is mainly held on Wednesdays, except for the 3rd round, which takes place on Saturday, April 18th (Memorial Čudla Vorlíček). The race features a multi-phase format with the possibility to track the top 10 performances. Registration is open for runners from 15 years old. The race takes place in a natural environment under Teplická Doubravka.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (6) – květnový
description: Come run on a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník, where personal records are often broken! The race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA, which take place every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Republic Championship. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners is prepared.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified measuring device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Republic Championship at 10 km
additional: The run is timed with a chip timing system, and each runner also has a measured "chip" time. Registration takes place at the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, you can replenish your energy and vitamins at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Restrooms are available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 meters from the start). Bag storage is possible at the organizer’s tent. Cancellation from the race is possible up to 24 hours before the start with a refund of the entry fee. The races include various terrain types, from urban routes to trail sections, and are open to runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and the series offers regular updates on results and schedules.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Cernovír Eight is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Endurance Sports Association in Olomouc-Cernovír. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup, which offers courses of various lengths and is open to all runners regardless of age or performance. The course takes place through the scenic environment of the Olomouc region and is suitable for both beginners and experienced endurance runners. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic environment of the Olomouc region
Part of the Hanácký Running Cup with courses from 5 to 42 km
The race is open to all age categories and performance levels
additional: Registration is conducted via a credit system with a chip card used for electronic timing. The entry fee is paid from preloaded credit on an account at Fio Bank. Runners can top up their credit in cash after the results are announced. The race is part of the year-round Hanácký Running Cup series, where points are awarded based on placement in individual races. The race includes trail/cross running, starts at 18:00, registration via the website, and takes place in Olomouc-Cernovír at the Bulgarian Club.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
location: Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu, Balatonfüred, Veszprém County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultramarathon race held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The race is divided into multiple durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12, and 6-hour races, which are part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can compete in individual and team categories, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race center.
course_highlights: 898-meter loop course with minimal, 1-meter elevation gain
Race center located on the east side of Füred Camping
Central refreshment table with water, hot tea, isotonic drinks, soda, and coffee
additional: The race is divided into multiple durations: the 72H World Cup and 48H European Cup start on 2026-05-28 at 12:00, the 24H European Cup starts on 2026-05-30 at 12:00, the 12H European Cup starts on 2026-05-30 at 08:00, and the 6H European Cup starts on 2026-05-31 at 06:00. The opening ceremony and technical briefing will be held on 2026-05-27 from 17:00 to 18:30. Bib pickup is available at multiple times before and during the race. Accommodation and parking can be reserved from 2026-05-27 12:00 to 2026-05-28 10:00, with vehicle movement restricted during the event. Prizes are awarded in age and gender categories, as well as team competitions. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The race takes place at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred from May 28 to 31, 2026. Participants can choose different distances, and organizers provide the necessary infrastructure and services for runners.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: Beh v raji je tradičný bežecký závod konaný v krásnom prostredí Dobšinskej ľadovej jaskyne a jej okolia. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z viacerých tratí vrátane prológu, polmaratónu, 10 km a 5 km tratí, ktoré vedú prevažne po asfaltových cestách s čiastočnou uzávierkou premávky. Prológ je kopcovitý 1 km beh lesným chodníkom od parkoviska k ľadovej jaskyni. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka aj nordic walking.
course_highlights: Prológ 1 km kopcovitá trať lesným chodníkom k ľadovej jaskyni
Polmaratónska trať vedie po asfaltovej ceste cez obec Stratená a Stratenskú pílu
10 km a 5 km trate sú rovinaté a vedú po asfaltovej ceste s čiastočnou uzávierkou premávky
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je v budove OOCR. Prológ štartuje v piatok 29.5.2026 od 16:00 do 17:15, sobotné preteky 30.5.2026 od 8:00 do 10:40. Pretekári dostanú čelenku z funkčného materiálu s logom Beh v raji (prvých 300 registrovaných) a občerstvenie po dobehnutí do cieľa. Preteky sa konajú za čiastočne uzavretej cestnej premávky s vyhradeným jedným pruhom pre bežcov. Časový limit preteku je 2 hodiny 30 minút. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre mužov a ženy, štart o 17:30, registrácia je možná na webovej stránke, preteky sú podporované Košickým krajom.

name: Ružindolský víchor

price_tiers.distance: Beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km

description: Beh Ružindolský Víchor je 12. ročník cestného behu, ktorý sa koná v športovom areáli Ružindol. Trať vedie po asfaltovom a hlineném povrchu v obci a zahŕňa aj trávnatý okruh na štadióne. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi behom na 7 km a Nordic Walking na 4 km. Štart je naplánovaný na 17:30 a sú pripravené kategórie pre mužov, ženy, domácich bežcov a Nordic Walking. Na účastníkov čaká štartovné číslo, čip na meranie času, občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila.
course_highlights: Trať s asfaltovým a hlineným povrchom v obci
Trávnatý okruh na štadióne
Dve disciplíny: beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km
additional: Štartovný balíček obsahuje štartovné číslo, čip na meranie času (ktorý sa po skončení behu odovzdáva v cieli), občerstvenie na trase a v cieli, účastnícku medailu. K dispozícii sú šatne v priestoroch športového areálu Ružindol. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane kategórií pre domácich bežcov z Ružindola. Trať je kombináciou asfaltu, hliny a trávnatého okruhu; preteky sú určené pre mužov, ženy, domácich a Nordic Walking; registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste; súčasťou sú občerstvenie a medaily pre víťazov.

name: Kamenická 15
location: Kamenice u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (online), 150 Kč (na místě), zdarma pro mládež do 17 let

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line.

description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice near Jihlava, offering adult runners a 15 km large loop on asphalt roads and paths. Youth have access to shorter loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km on asphalt roads within the village. The course passes through scenic parts of the surroundings, including the Brodek settlement, Zátiší Chateau, and Cípy gamekeeper's lodge, with the finish at the start point. The race is suitable for a wide age range from 3 years old and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and prizes for winners and youth.
course_highlights: Large 15 km loop on asphalt roads and paths
Course passing through Brodek settlement, Zátiší Chateau, and Cípy gamekeeper's lodge
Youth loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km within the village
additional: Each participant receives a voucher for refreshments at the U Raimunda restaurant. Monetary rewards for breaking course records: men 1000 CZK, women 500 CZK. Bus transportation from Jihlava and back is provided. Categories for children and youth are divided by age with possible route changes. The main race is 15 km on asphalt roads; shorter loops are available for youth; registration is possible online before 12:00 on race day; the event includes refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Kapličkobraní

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 170 Kč 100% jde na charitu

description: Kapličkobraní is a charitable non-competitive run that takes participants around 13 chapels in the vicinity of Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with a total of 14 stops including the finish line. The route, approximately 10-12 km long, is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even with a stroller. The event has a deeper meaning, and all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants will receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of parish wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní was awarded for the best sports project with a low budget for small organizations.
course_highlights: The route passes around 13 chapels in the vicinity of Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice
The length of the route is 10-12 km, suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, and strollers
Tasting of parish wine at one of the chapels
additional: A commemorative magnet in medal design for the first 200 at the presentation. Light refreshments are available at the finish. There are changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking. The event is charitable, with 100% of the proceeds going to support Jan Rieml's family. There is an option to donate the entry fee to company employees via invoice or donation agreement with free registration codes. The event offers various activities, refreshments, parking, changing rooms, and showers. The route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
location: Zámecký park, Mimoň, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Mimoň Park Run is a race held in the castle park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is divided into loops of 7 kilometers, with options for 7 km and 21 km distances. The event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners, and is organized by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 5:00 PM, with the first category beginning as early as 9:00 AM. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is organized under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved paths
7 km loop along the Ploučnice River
Start in the castle park in Mimoň
additional: Race registration takes place at the swimming pool, with the start at Vranovská Avenue. The race is of a mixed type with 7 km and 21 km courses. The organizer is Lenka Zeťová, who can also be contacted by phone at 777 909 842. The races are held in the picturesque environment of Mimoň Park, with participation options for children and adults, and are part of the running league. Registration and details are available on the official website.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
location: Vysočina Arena, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 2 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place at Vysočina Arena and its surroundings with routes of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, with 5 km being one lap and 10 km two laps. The event offers both timed and untimed runs, including a family and children's race, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students, and seniors with the possibility of a discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at Vysočina Arena stadium, which provides facilities including changing rooms, a storage area, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt, paved, and forest paths at Vysočina Arena and surroundings
The 5 km course consists of one lap, the 10 km course of two laps
Start and finish at Vysočina Arena stadium with complete facilities
additional: Registration and pickup of race numbers take place on the race day from 15:00 to 16:30. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, storage, sanitary facilities, and water are available at the finish. Race distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: road; registration fee: 100-400 CZK; race held at Vysočina Arena.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby, Horné Saliby, Slovakia
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
price_range: 13,-€ online do 31.3.2025, 16,-€ online do 28.5.2025, 10,- € pre seniorov nad 60 rokov, deti a nad 60 rokov štartovné neplatia
description: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka a Hornosalibská trojka sú tradičné bežecké podujatia organizované RoniRun Clubom v obci Horné Saliby. Preteky ponúkajú certifikované trate s dĺžkami 21,1 km, 10 km a 3 km, ktoré vedú malebnou oblasťou s občerstvením a čipovým meraním času. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, pre ktoré sú pripravené špeciálne detské behy. Okrem športového zážitku sa návštevníci môžu tešiť na bohatý sprievodný program s hudbou, ukážkami bojových umení a tombolu.
course_highlights: Certifikované trate 21,1 km, 10 km a 3 km
Občerstvovacie stanice s nealko pivom Zlatý bažant a širokým výberom nápojov
Malebné prostredie obce Horné Saliby s areálom futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
additional: Štartovný balíček obsahuje štartovné číslo, občerstvenie počas preteku a v cieli, čipové meranie času, nealko pivo Zlatý bažant, lístok do tomboly a plastový pohár podujatia. Preteky sú ekologické s papierovými a vratnými pohármi s depozitom 2€. Detské behy sú zdarma a deti dostanú medailu. Počas podujatia je pripravený bohatý sprievodný program vrátane nafukovacích hradov, koní, koňských záprahov, bubeníkov, DJ-a a ukážok bojového umenia a lukostreľby. Podujatie zahŕňa trate na 21 km, 10 km a 3 km, štarty sú naplánované na 10:00, 10:30 a 10:35, s detským behom od 9:15. Súčasťou je aj charitatívny rozmer a ekologické poháre.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12hod a 100km beh v Šamoríne je tradičný ultrabežecký závod, ktorý sa koná 30. mája 2026 v Mestskom parku Pomlé. Ide o 24. ročník 6-hodinového behu a 15. ročník 12-hodinového a 100 km behu, ktorý ponúka kategórie pre jednotlivcov aj štafety. Bežci môžu súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách vrátane veteránov a veteránok nad 50 rokov. Štafety tvoria maximálne traja bežci, ktorí sa môžu striedať v ľubovoľnom poradí, pričom každý člen musí po odovzdaní absolvovať aspoň jeden okruh. Výkon sa meria podľa skutočne zabehnutej vzdialenosti s presnosťou na meter.
course_highlights: Pretek sa koná v Mestskom parku Pomlé v Šamoríne
Trať je okruh, kde sa bežci môžu striedať v štafetách v špeciálne vyznačenom úseku
Časový limit na 100 km beh je 12 hodín
additional: Bežci môžu kedykoľvek urobiť prestávku, ktorú musia nahlásiť zapisovačovi kôl. Po ukončení pretekov je potrebné umiestniť značku na ľavú časť trate a zotrvať v blízkosti, kým sa nezaznamená skutočná zabehnutá vzdialenosť. Z bezpečnostných dôvodov nie je povolené sprevádzanie bežcov na bicykli alebo korčuliach. Traťový lekár má právo kedykoľvek odvolať pretekára z pretekov. Preteky zahŕňajú kategórie 6h, 12h a 100km, s možnosťou štafiet, a majú stanovené pravidlá pre meranie vzdialenosti a správanie počas pretekov. Registrácia je otvorená s uvedenými termínmi a poplatkami.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Športový areál, Veľké Lovce, Nové Zámky, Slovakia
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom je štvrtý ročník bežeckého podujatia, ktoré sa uskutoční 30. mája 2026 v športovom areáli vo Veľkých Lovciach. Preteky vedú ulicami a chotárom obce po asfaltových a poľných cestách. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s rôznou dĺžkou tratí podľa veku, ako aj hlavné behy na 5 km a 10 km. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka ocenenia v kategóriách podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátori kladú dôraz na pohodlnú online registráciu a kvalitné meranie časov pomocou čipov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie ulicami a chotárom Veľkých Loviec
Povrch trate je asfalt a poľná cesta
Detské kategórie s rôznou dĺžkou tratí od 40 m do 1000 m
additional: Limit účastníkov pre 5 km a 10 km beh je 250. Školské kolá majú limit 160 účastníkov. Prihlásení bežci dostanú účastnícke medaily. Registrácia na mieste je možná od 14:00 hod v deň pretekov, ak sa nenaplní limit. Meranie časov je zabezpečené čipmi, okrem škôlkárov. Odporúča sa registrácia s diakritikou a vytvorenie účtu na stránke pre jednoduchšie úpravy prihlášky. Trails include asphalt and dirt roads; registration online and on-site; medals for all finishers; optional T-shirts; health info on race bibs.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.description: Účasť v detských behoch je bezplatná. Štartovné sa neplatí.

description: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka je každoročne organizovaný bežecký pretek na počesť výsadkára a hrdinu Jozefa Gabčíka, významného predstaviteľa protifašistického odboja. Tento 11 km cross run v zmiešanom teréne vedie zo Žiliny - Poluvsie, rodného domu Jozefa Gabčíka, do telovýchovného areálu 5. pluku špeciálneho určenia v Žiline. Podujatie spája civilných a vojenských bežcov a podporuje fyzickú výkonnosť a komunitného ducha. Súčasťou štartovného je pretekársky balíček, občerstvenie, pamätná medaila a meranie času s čipom.
course_highlights: 11 km cross run v zmiešanom teréne
Štart pri rodnom dome Jozefa Gabčíka v Poluvsí
Cieľ v telovýchovnom areáli 5. pluku špeciálneho určenia v Žiline
additional: Kapacita podujatia je 500 pretekárov. Registrácia je platná až po pripísaní platby do 1. apríla 2026, inak bude zrušená. Štartovné zahŕňa administratívu, pretekársky balíček, občerstvenie, ceny pre víťazov, pamätnú medailu a meranie času s čipom HRDOSPORT vrátane online výsledkov. Detské kategórie majú bezplatnú účasť, registrácia prebieha online a na mieste pred štartom. Preteky sa konajú v Žiline - Poluvsie, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo s čipom, občerstvenie, ceny, medaila a meranie času.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
description: Kurimské pobehaňe je bežecké podujatie organizované o.z. Aktívna Kurima, ktoré sa koná v obci Kurima pred kaštieľom. Trať vedie po asfaltových a poľných cestách s povrchom hlina a štrk. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie od školákov až po veteránov, pričom súťažiť môžu muži aj ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Registrácia je možná online s rôznymi cenovými hladinami podľa termínu prihlásenia, pričom je zabezpečený aj školský beh pre deti. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný a komunitný bežecký zážitok v prírode.
course_highlights: Povrch trate: asfalt a poľná cesta s hlinou a štrkom
Miesto štartu: pred kaštieľom v Kurime, okres Bardejov
Viacero vekových kategórií vrátane školského behu
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú žiakov základnej školy, dorastencov do 17 rokov, mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Organizátorom je o.z. Aktívna Kurima. Kontakt na organizátora: Ing. Tomáš Bolišinga, tel.: 0910 902 784. Pretek sa koná v lokalite Kurima pri Pred kaštieľom, s registráciou online alebo na mieste, s detailmi o termínoch a poplatkoch dostupnými na oficiálnej stránke.

name: MEA GRATI Ultramaratón vďačnosti

description: MEA GRATI Ultramaratón vďačnosti 2026 je charitatívny ultramaratón, ktorý vedie bežcov na trase 64 km z Košíc do Tokaja. Tento beh nie je len o fyzickom výkone, ale aj o prejave ľudskosti a podpore ľudí bez domova prostredníctvom organizácie Oáza. Každý kilometer symbolizuje cestu späť k ľudskej dôstojnosti a účasť generuje prostriedky na zlepšenie života ľudí v núdzi. Bežci si môžu užiť špičkovú organizáciu, svetovú atmosféru a víno ako odmenu za svoj výkon.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 64 km z Košíc do Tokaja
Charitatívny beh podporujúci ľudí bez domova
Symbolický význam každého kilometra ako cesta k ľudskej dôstojnosti
additional: Účasť na ultramaratóne zahŕňa špičkovú organizáciu a po výkone je pripravená svetová atmosféra a víno ako odmena. Beh cez Tokaj, registrácia cez oficiálnu stránku, trasa z Košíc do Tokaja, koná sa 30. mája 2026.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
price_range: 18€ - 42€ v závislosti od termínu a kategórie registrácie
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso je tradičný nočný beh v nádhernom prostredí Vysokých Tatier, ktorý sa koná už 14. rok. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou vedúcou okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa, Jazierok lásky a cez Areál bežeckého lyžovania Snow. Podujatie je súčasťou Grand Prix série a ponúka nezameniteľnú atmosféru s výhľadmi na Rysy a nočným dobehom za tmy. Okrem dospelých pretekov sú pripravené aj detské behy a Nordic walking. Telekom Night Run je obľúbenou každoročnou zastávkou bežcov, ktorí si užívajú krásne bežecké zážitky v horskom prostredí.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa a Jazierok lásky
Nočný beh s dobehom za tmy a výhľadmi na Rysy
Prechod cez Areál bežeckého lyžovania Snow
additional: Štart a cieľ na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS a hotelom Patria. Časový limit pre beh je 1,5 hodiny. Účastnícky limit je 1000 bežcov s riadne zaplateným štartovným. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské behy (300 m, 600 m, 800 m) a Nordic walking na 5 km. Registrácia je možná online do 29.05.2026 alebo osobne v deň preteku od 12:00 do 18:00 na Štrbskom Plese, ak nebude naplnený limit. Podujatie je súčasťou série Grand Prix 2026, umožňuje online aj osobnú registráciu, má obmedzený počet účastníkov (1000), a zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane charitatívneho behu, detských pretekov a Nordic walking.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Slovakia
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso je tradičný nočný beh v nádhernom prostredí Vysokých Tatier, ktorý sa koná už 14. krát. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou vedúcou okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa s krásnymi výhľadmi na tatranské štíty. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské behy Turbo TV s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí pre najmenších až po teenagerov, ktoré ponúkajú nezabudnuteľné zážitky a medaily. Atmosféra podujatia je výnimočná, s povzbudzovaním na trati a dobehom do cieľa za tmy, čo robí tento beh obľúbenou zastávkou bežcov počas sezóny.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo Malého a Veľkého Štrbského Plesa s nádhernými výhľadmi na Rysy
Občerstvovacia stanica na 10 km trati a povzbudzovanie na trati
Nočný beh s dobehom do cieľa za tmy a jedinečnou atmosférou Vysokých Tatier
additional: Detské behy Turbo TV majú trate 300 m, 600 m a 800 m s medailou za výkon. Nordic walking 5 km je tiež súčasťou podujatia. #REŠPEKT run je nesúťažná disciplína s dobrovoľným štartovným, výťažok je venovaný detskej onkológii. Časový limit pre hlavné trate je 1,5 hodiny. Účastnícky limit je 1000 bežcov s riadne zaplateným štartovným. Registrácia je možná online do 29.05.2026 alebo osobne v deň pretekov od 12:00 do 18:00 na Štrbskom Plese, ak nebude naplnený limit. Traťové dĺžky od 300 do 800 metrov, kategórie podľa veku, štart na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS a hotelom Patria, registrácia počas prezentácie, občerstvenie a medaila sú súčasťou štartovného.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
price_range: 15 eur (dospelí), 5 eur (deti), +5 eur za jedlo na cieľovej stanici

description: Fatranský Vĺčko je kynologický vytrvalostný šport, ktorý spája turistiku a beh so psom v krásnej prírode Veľkej Fatry. Podujatie sa uskutoční 30. mája 2026 v Turčianskom Jasene a ponúka dve trasy - dlhšiu MID s dĺžkou 44 km a prevýšením +2350 m a kratšiu SHORT s dĺžkou 14 km a prevýšením +500 m. Súťažiť môžete v kategóriách dogtrekking (človek so psom) alebo trail (beh bez psa). Počas celej trasy je pes povinne na vôdzke alebo v postroji, voľný pohyb psov znamená diskvalifikáciu. Organizátori odporúčajú trasu MID pre skúsených a SHORT pre nováčikov alebo menej trénovaných.
course_highlights: Trasa MID: 44 km s prevýšením +2350 m po turisticky značených trasách a vlastnom značení
Trasa SHORT: 14 km s prevýšením +500 m po turisticky značených trasách a vlastnom značení
Krásna príroda Veľkej Fatry s doplnkovým značením (fáborky) a aktuálnymi informáciami o trase
additional: Štartovné zahŕňa štartové číslo, meranie prostredníctvom kódu, účastnícky balíček so sponzorskými pozornosťami, občerstvenie na trase a nápoj v cieli. Možnosť dokúpiť jedlo v cieli (mäsové alebo vegetariánske) za 6 EUR. Účastníci mladší ako 15 rokov musia byť v sprievode dospelej osoby, účastníci od 15 do 18 rokov potrebujú písomný súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Počet účastníkov je limitovaný. Registrácia prebieha prostredníctvom externého odkazu, sú stanovené pravidlá vrátane povinného vodítka pre psy a bezpečnostných opatrení. Podujatie sa koná v oblasti Ovčín - Boulder & Bistro v Turci.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: Lišanská Road Race - Liberation Run is a traditional road running race held on a 7 km course between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race takes place on a lightly trafficked third-class road and is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration and the finish line are located at the U Hřiště restaurant. The race is organized in four men's and two women's categories and offers cash prizes as well as bonuses for breaking course records. The start time is at 11:15 AM, and registrations are accepted on-site on the day of the race.
course_highlights: 7 km course on a lightly trafficked third-class road Lišany - Lužná - Lišany
Start and finish at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonuses for the first approximately 500 meters and the possibility of breaking course records
additional: Registration begins at 9:30 AM at the U Hřiště restaurant (sokolovna) in Lišany. Entries are accepted on-site no later than 30 minutes before the start. The race office is open from 9:30 AM. Results are announced around 12:30 PM. The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners Cup. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and diplomas are given to the top six finishers. Bonuses are also awarded to the winner and for breaking course records. The health status of participants is the responsibility of the sending organization or the participant. The race offers a 7 km category on a lightly trafficked road, with on-site registration possible, and is part of the regional running cup. Exact times and conditions are published on the official website.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
location: Cyklodomu Broumov, Broumov, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to participate in the picturesque environment of Schroll Park near the Broumov Cycling House. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy running in nature with services such as bike rentals, luggage storage, and charging stations for e-bikes. Registration takes place in the morning before the start, which is traditionally at 10:00 AM. Organizers warmly invite all runners to participate in this sporting event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Schroll Park in Broumov
Start and registration at the Broumov Cycling House
Natural environment with bike rental and storage options
additional: Registration for competitors takes place from 8:30 to 9:45 at the Broumov Cycling House. Services available include bike and e-bike rentals, bike and luggage storage, charging stations for e-bikes, and restrooms. The race is scheduled for May 31, 2025, with a start at 10:00 AM at the Broumov Cycling House. Online registration is available until May 28, 2025. A race in 2026 is also planned, including 10 km and 7 km courses.

name: Tuháčkův běh
location: Chrást u Příbramy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Tuháčkův běh is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást near Příbram as part of the Brdský běžecký pohár (Brdy Running Cup). The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and mainly runs on asphalt and gravel cycle paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom children's races are prepared. The start of the main race is at 11:00 in the Valcha area. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to compete with other runners in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: One loop on asphalt cycle paths around Chrást
Mainly asphalt and gravel surface
Main race length 8.2 km
additional: The race takes place in the Valcha area. In addition to the main race, children's races are also organized. The track surface is mainly asphalt and gravel. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár. There is an option to follow training activities via Garmin and Strava apps within the Brdský běžecký pohár group. Road running, asphalt and gravel cycle paths, children's races, online registration, approximately 8.2 km course, race held in the Valcha area.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon that runs through the heart of the historic city center. The start is at the second largest square in the Czech Republic, Přemysl Otakar II Square, and the route offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and special sites. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian metropolis during a sports day. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.
course_highlights: The route runs through the historic center of České Budějovice
Start at Přemysl Otakar II Square, the second largest square in the Czech Republic
Run around a series of historic buildings and unique sites
additional: The race starts at 15:30. The festival also includes other runs such as the Vodafone 5 km run, dm family mile, dm bambini run, relay half marathon, and more. A mobile app from RunCzech is available for better navigation and race information. The race takes place in the city center, offering maps and GPX downloads, with online registration available.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
location: Chlum u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Chlum Race Three Ways is the fourth event in the Tower Movement series, held around Pilsen. Participants conquer the dominant peak of Chlum in three ways: a uphill run with a mass start, an interval hill run, and a stair climb to the lookout tower. The overall classification is based on the sum of times from all three segments, with bonuses for the top three finishers. There are ten age categories for children with circuits around the lookout tower. A relay race is also available, where a team of three runners completes all three disciplines.
course_highlights: Uphill run 1.75 km with an elevation gain of 111 m
Interval hill run 450 m with an elevation gain of 59 m
Climb 121 stairs to the lookout tower with an elevation gain of 22 m
additional: The race office is in a tent at the lookout tower on top of Chlum from 9:00 to 11:00. The uphill run starts at 11:45, the interval hill run at 12:20, and the stair climb at 12:45. Children's races begin at 10:00. Relays consist of 3 runners, each running one discipline, starting together with individual runners. After 20 runners have completed the stair climb, a 2-minute break for descent follows. Items left at the start can be transported by the organizers' car to the finish. Participants must reach the start on their own. The race includes terrain sections, children's categories, family relays, registration, and parking are available.

description: Třanovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Třanovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers courses along loamy-gravel, forest, field, and asphalt roads within the cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice. The event is open to the general public and includes a main race of 10 km, a 5 km race, and a relay. The start and finish are at the municipal office, with the race beginning at 9:00 AM. Registration is possible online and on-site, with the option to pick up race numbers and medals for those registered in time.
course_highlights: The route runs along loamy-gravel, forest, field, and asphalt roads
Cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice
Start and finish at the municipal office no. p. 250
additional: The time limit to complete the 10 km race is 90 minutes, for the 5 km race 60 minutes, and for the relay 90 minutes. Online registration closes on May 27, 2026; after this date, only on-site registration is possible. Race numbers with names are guaranteed only for runners registered by May 25, 2026. The organizer recommends payment by May 27, 2026; otherwise, the entry fee must be paid on-site in cash with a surcharge. Children's races are registered directly on-site. The race takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026. Registration is open, and the event includes various age categories and accompanying activities.

description: The Devil's Challenge 666 km is an 8-day stage running race in the beautiful nature of northern Bohemia, offering a route of 666 km or a shortened version in 4 stages. The race passes through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještěd Ridge, and Český ráj, with the final stage identical to the route of the Devil's Ultra Trail 66.6 km. The race is open to individuals, pairs, and trios with the option to switch during stages and also offers the possibility to choose individual stages. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers to stage starts and GPS navigation. The registration fee includes a pre-race buffet.
course_highlights: 8 stages passing through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještěd Ridge, and Český ráj
Mainly along tourist trails with available GPX files
Final 8th stage identical to the route of the Devil's Ultra Trail 66.6 km
additional: Starts of shorter stages are at 7:00 (stages 2, 3, 5, 7), with a group bus departure at 6:00 to Houska Castle for the 8th stage. The time limit is always until the start of the next stage. Chip timing and GPS trackers with online route tracking are used. It is recommended to have the map.com app with offline maps on your mobile. The registration fee includes a pre-race buffet during registration on Friday, May 29, 2026. Mandatory equipment includes a personal drinking cup, which can be ordered during registration along with a T-shirt or socks. 8 stages, option for shortened routes, GPS tracking, offline maps, start in Hamr na Jezeře, final stage of 66.6 km, pre-race buffet.
