description: The 1/2 Marathon Bělský les is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Bělský Forest in Ostrava-Zábřeh. It offers various courses including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay, and a tourist walk Nachmelená 25 km. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and the general public, and is associated with charitable support. The start and finish are at the Water Area South, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: The route runs through the scenic Bělský Forest with natural landscapes
Various course lengths including half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and relays
Start and finish at the Water Area South in Ostrava-Zábřeh
additional: Race bib and chip pickup takes place at different times depending on the course, from 6:00 to 10:00. It is possible to register up to 9 additional participants under one email, suitable for teams, companies, schools, and families. Charitable support for young fighter Kamil and the option to donate plasma with a financial reward. Relays can be registered as mixed, men's, or women's teams. Individual race starts are sequential from 7:00 to 10:15. Registration is online, the event offers various categories, the option to order a T-shirt, parking nearby, and information about the routes and accompanying program.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
location: Komenského sady, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: on-line registrace od 300 Kč, na místě od 400 Kč
description: Run for the Memory of the Nation in Ostrava is a charitable sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place on May 30, 2026, in Komenského Sady with timed runs of 4 km (1 lap) and 8 km (2 laps). The event is open to all age groups, including children's races, and offers the possibility of a symbolic run anywhere. The start and finish are near the statue of J. A. Komenský, with refreshments and hygienic facilities for participants.
course_highlights: The route runs through the popular Komenského Sady park
The 4 km race is one lap, the 8 km race is two laps
Start and finish at the statue of J. A. Komenský
additional: Students and pupils under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, hygienic facilities, water for rinsing, and refreshments are available. Race numbers are issued upon registration on the race day. It is recommended to write medication and contact details on the back of the race number in case of health complications. The event promotes remembrance of historical figures and the fight for freedom; proceeds support filming and education.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
location: Sedlec u Starého Plzence, Plzeň-město, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Across Three Villages is a modern cross-country race that continues the tradition of the road race organized by Spartak Sedlec. The race is intended for both athletes and runners who want to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. It also caters to the youngest runners for whom running is a lifelong joy. The route passes through three villages: Sedlec, Lhůta, and Tymákov in the vicinity of Starý Plzenec.
course_highlights: Cross-country race across three villages: Sedlec, Lhůta, and Tymákov
Beautiful scenery and natural environment
Traditional race with a history linked to the Spartak Sedlec road race
additional: Registration is possible online or on the day of the race. The race is supported by the town of Starý Plzenec and other local sponsors. Results are regularly published on the website. The race is suitable for children and youth, with categories based on age. It is open to the general public, including children, with the option to register on-site or online. The event usually takes place in May, with the route passing through fields and forests around Sedlec near Starý Plzenec.

name: Ostravské běhny
location: Forum Nová Karolina, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Ostravská běhna 2026 race is a sporting event primarily aimed at women, offering joy, movement, and solidarity in the heart of Ostrava. The race starts at Forum Nová Karolina and continues through a peaceful green oasis on the right bank of the Ostravice River. Participants can choose from running routes of 2.5 km and 5 km, Nordic Walking of 2.5 km, and children's races with shorter distances. After the race, entertainment and refreshments are provided at Nová Karolina, where participants can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and socializing. Winners in each category will receive material prizes, race numbers, results service, and complete facilities for a comfortable run.
course_highlights: Routes lead from Forum Nová Karolina through a peaceful oasis and greenery on the right bank of the Ostravice River
Offering running routes of 2.5 km and 5 km and Nordic Walking of 2.5 km
Children's races with distances of 250 m and 500 m for various age groups
additional: After the race, entertainment and refreshments are prepared at Nová Karolina. Race numbers, results service, and route security are standard. Winners in each category will receive material prizes. The program includes performances by the band Ballistic and warm-up sessions before individual starts. Routes include running, Nordic Walking, children's races, accompanying program, medals, and T-shirts for early registrations.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: The Chlum Race Three Ways offers a run uphill to the prominent Chlum peak near Plzeň, which is tackled in three different ways. The event begins with a mass start run uphill over a distance of 1.75 km. This race is attractive to runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain and wanting to try different ascent variants on the same hill. The event is part of the running community and provides an interesting experience in nature close to Plzeň.
course_highlights: Uphill run to Chlum peak
Distance of 1.75 km with mass start
Three different ways to conquer the peak
additional: The race takes place in Plzeň, including categories for children and adults, with various running segments and the opportunity to compete in several age groups.

name: Běh na Děvín
location: Kostel v Perné, Děvín, Perné, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Děvín Run is a hill running race offering two routes of 4.4 km and 9.1 km. The course mainly runs through terrain with the finish at the top of Děvín, providing beautiful views and a challenging profile. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the natural environment of South Moravia. The start is at the church in Perná and the finish is at the top of Děvín, ensuring a unique mountain running experience.
course_highlights: Two routes: 4.4 km and 9.1 km mainly through terrain
Finish at the top of Děvín with beautiful views
Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup
additional: The race takes place on May 30, 2026, the course is mainly terrain and challenging, start at the church in Perná and finish at the top of Děvín.

description: The AC Praha 1890 Prague - Brandýs running races are traditional race events with a history dating back to 1892. The race takes place in the Arborka forest park in Prague 14 and offers courses for men, women, juniors, and children. The course is an asphalt loop suitable for fast running and walking. The race is part of the men's and women's league and is open to both amateur and club runners. Start numbers and chips are issued at registration, timing is provided by chips and a finish camera.
course_highlights: Asphalt loop in Arborka forest park
Course suitable for walking and running
Start and finish in the pleasant natural environment of Prague 14
additional: Participants registered for the team competition do not pay an entry fee. Start numbers and chips are issued at registration. Timing is provided by chips and a finish camera. Properly registered runners start at their own risk. The race will be held on May 30, 2026, with starts at 11:15 and 12:00, registration and more information are available on the organizer's website.

description: The Devil's Challenge is a unique 8-day stage running race covering 666 km in the beautiful nature of northern Bohemia, offering also shortened variants of 4 stages or individual stages. The route passes through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještěd Ridge, and Český ráj, with the final stage identical to the route of the Devil's Ultra Trail 66.6 km. The race is suitable for individuals, pairs, and trios with the possibility of switching, and is equipped with chip timing and GPS tracking. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with options for group transfers to stage starts. The registration fee includes a pre-race buffet.
course_highlights: 8 stages passing through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, Lužické hory, Ještěd Ridge, and Český ráj
Mainly along tourist trails with accessible GPX files
Final 8th stage identical to the route of the Devil's Ultra Trail 66.6 km
additional: The start of individual shorter stages is at 7:00 AM, bus departure to the start of the 8th stage is at 6:00 AM. The time limit is until the start of the next stage. The registration fee includes a pre-race buffet during registration on May 29, 2026. Mandatory equipment includes a personal drinking cup, with options to order a devil's cup, T-shirt, or socks. The race is staged, with GPX navigation, chip timing, offline maps, starting in Hamr na Jezeře, and various lengths and participant categories.

name: WEBER Jičínská10 (CityRun Jičín)
description: Jičínská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Jičín. The race offers a 10 km course suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, and is complemented by a training run of the course, allowing participants to better prepare. The race atmosphere is friendly and welcomes all runners who want to experience a sporting challenge in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: 10 km long course
Training run of the course before the race
Picturesque town of Jičín as the race backdrop
additional: The 10 km training run takes place on Sunday, May 18th at 17:30. The event also includes other races of 5 km and 21 km, registration is possible online and on-site, race day features timing, refreshments, and prizes.

name: IX. TISZA-TAVI PROHUMAN ÖSSZEFUTÁS
description: The 9th Tisza-tavi Prohuman Run is a friendly and family-oriented running race in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza. The event aims for participants to enjoy the beauty of nature and the joy of sport on a varied, well-marked route. The race is held in the spirit of recreational sport and community experience, open to all ages. Runners can complete the distances in the scenic surroundings of Lake Tisza while becoming part of a supportive sports community.
course_highlights: Tisza-tó lakeside running route
Natural, varied terrain
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
additional: Participation in the race requires registration, the participation fee includes a technical T-shirt, medal, timing, and lunch. The deadline is April 20, 2026.

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: The 5th Tisza Lake Sports Picnic and Mass Sports Weekend will be held on May 30-31, 2026, in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza. This event is a community sports event that offers participants the joy of movement and proximity to nature. The program includes various sports activities and family programs, providing an experience for all ages. The venue is the beautiful surroundings of Lake Tisza, which is ideal for relaxation and active recreation.
course_highlights: Sports event on the shores of Lake Tisza
Community and family programs in nature
Wide range of sports opportunities around the lake
additional: The event takes place on the shores of Lake Tisza in Sarud, where the Experience Village offers a variety of experiences, including cycling and e-bike rentals, sailing, water sports, as well as family and children’s programs. Several accommodation options are available on site, and the event supports the Slow Food movement and showcases local gastronomic experiences. Related to the event, there are multiple accommodation options, local attractions, and family programs awaiting participants around Lake Tisza.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: Running in the Mountains and Valleys is an off-road race held at the picturesque football field of Tardos. Organized by the Sprint Running Club, the event offers participants the proximity to nature and a varied terrain. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and movement, welcoming all enthusiasts of active living. The organizers reserve the right to change the date and program.
course_highlights: Off-road course at Tardos football field
Varied hilly terrain
Close to nature running
additional: The race takes place at the Tardos Football Field, starting at 10:00 AM, and is part of a series organized by the Sprint Running Club.

name: HEGYEN-VÖLGYÖN FUTÁS
price_range: 4500 forint a hosszabb távokra, ingyenes a 200 méteres, kedvezményes 2000 forint a tardosi és klubtagoknak
description: The Mountain-Valley Run is a traditional race organized for sports enthusiasts in Tardos, hosted by the Sprint Running Club. The race offers challenges on three different distances: a 200-meter children's run, as well as 4 and 12 kilometers for more serious runners. The start is from the Tardos sports field, and the race features chip timing to ensure accurate results. The event has a friendly atmosphere and attracts many runners from the surrounding area each year.
course_highlights: Start from the Tardos football field
Three distances: 200 m, 4 km, and 12 km
Chip timing for accurate results
additional: Registration and preparation from 9 AM on-site. The race is organized by the Sprint Running Club. The event, held for the 33rd time, is family-friendly and offers participation opportunities for multiple age groups. The race location is Tardos / Sports Field, with various distances, prizes, medals, cups, gifts, and chip timing.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: Beh Rajeckým rínkom je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný Maratón klubom Rajec, ktorý sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť krásy prírody a okolia Rajca počas májového dňa. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí a neplnoletých, ktorí musia mať súhlas zákonného zástupcu. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť a kvalitnú prípravu pretekárov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie malebným rajeckým rínkom
Štart a cieľ na Námestí SNP v Rajci
Prírodné prostredie s miernym prevýšením
additional: Pre účasť detí a neplnoletých je potrebné priniesť podpísané vyhlásenie zákonného zástupcu. Osobné údaje účastníkov sú spracúvané v súlade s platnou legislatívou o ochrane osobných údajov. Podujatie sa koná v Rajci, registrácia stojí od 3 € pri skorých prihláškach, je pripravené pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane detí, a je súčasťou športového dňa v meste.

name: Beh na Zniev
description: Beh na Zniev je majstrovský beh do vrchu konaný v Kláštore pod Znievom, ktorý ponúka náročnú trať s dĺžkou 5 650 metrov a prevýšením 475 metrov. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od detí až po veteránov, vrátane mužov, žien, juniorov a dorastu. Štart hlavného preteku je o 14:00 hodine v areáli bývalého gymnázia. Organizátormi sú Obecný úrad Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT a Slovenský atletický zväz, pričom pretek je súčasťou Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 5 650 m s prevýšením 475 m
Trať vedie v okolí Kláštora pod Znievom, okr. Martin
Súčasť Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 14:30 hod., mládežníckych kategórií o 15:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane viacerých vekových skupín od najmladších žiakov po veteránov. Organizátori sú Obecný úrad Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT a Slovenský atletický zväz. Pretek je súčasťou slovenských majstrovstiev v behu do vrchu, je určený pre profesionálnych aj rekreačných bežcov, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, Veľký Šariš, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka je bežecké podujatie organizované mestom Veľký Šariš v spolupráci s Pivovarom Šariš a Športovou komisiou pri MsZ vo Veľkom Šariši. Pretek sa koná v areáli TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a nordic walking. Štart je naplánovaný na 15:00 hod. pre beh a 15:05 hod. pre nordic walking. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane dorastu, juniorov, žien a mužov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 7000 metrov vedie cez malebné prostredie Veľkého Šariša
Možnosť zúčastniť sa v rôznych kategóriách vrátane juniorských, dospelých a Nordic walking
Podujatie je súčasťou miestnej športovej tradície a organizuje ho mesto v spolupráci s miestnym pivovarom
additional: Kategórie zahŕňajú dorast, juniorky, ženy a mužov v rôznych vekových skupinách. Štart nordic walking je o 5 minút neskôr ako beh. Organizátorom je mesto Veľký Šariš v spolupráci s Pivovarom Šariš a Športovou komisiou pri MsZ vo Veľkom Šariši. Kontaktná osoba: PhDr. Mária Gáborová, tel.: 051/321 41 24, 051 776 22 33, 0948 593 266. Pretek sa koná na areáli TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, registrácia je možná aj na mieste, a podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane Nordic walking účastníkov.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross Country is a traditional running race held in Nekoř in the Pardubice Region, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses through very hilly terrain along forest roads, meadows, and partially on asphalt, ensuring an interesting and diverse running experience. The start and finish are at the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners including youth and is known for its friendly atmosphere and material prizes for winners in individual categories.
course_highlights: Very hilly terrain
Forest roads, meadows, and partially asphalt
Start and finish at the ice rink in Nekoř
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The top three in each category will receive material prizes and diplomas. The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2026. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 and 2026, offering various age categories including children and veterans. Registration is possible online, the course is technical and demanding on terrain.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: The Run Between Squares is a traditional running race held at Freedom Square in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the opportunity to compete on a course leading to Castle Square and back. There are special races for children with medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants receive not only prizes but also the joy of movement and social gathering.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course from Freedom Square to Castle Square and back
Children's races with record participation and rich prizes including medals and Marlenka
Pleasant atmosphere at Freedom Square with refreshments and prize draws
additional: The children's race starts first, with a record number of children participating (e.g., 252 in 2025). The best runners are awarded medals, Marlenka, and other prizes, which are drawn among all participants. Winners of the main men's and women's race receive traditional prizes, including beer barrels for the overall winners. The main race starts at 11:00 AM, with the mayor of the city traditionally firing the starting pistol. The event takes place on May 31, 2026, registration is required in advance, start lines are at Freedom Square and Castle Square, and the race is open to all age categories.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Chodsko Grand Prix is a race 9.6 km long with an elevation gain of 130 meters, primarily running on roads from the village of Klenčí pod Čerchovem to the Hrádek hill. This race is part of the Chodsko Runner competition and offers runners an interesting route with gentle inclines. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the picturesque environment of the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 9.6 km
Elevation gain of 130 m

The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an adventure in the terrain. After a mass start at 22:00, participants plan their own route between control points within a 30-hour time limit. The race headquarters is at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gymnasium, showers, and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers freedom and space for navigation in the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in the Czech Republic.

Challenging terrain of Wallachia with hills and natural beauty

The race facilities are open from approximately 16:00 on Friday to 12:00 on Sunday and include a gymnasium, showers, dining hall, drinking water, and a luggage storage. Each participant must provide their own route map. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, emphasizing resilience and the ability to handle the demanding terrain in the Wallachia region.

description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where a loop of nearly 7 kilometers is run every hour. The race continues as long as there is only one runner who can complete more laps than the others. This unique format emphasizes not only speed but primarily endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championship in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable and the event is also connected with a charitable project.

The race is connected with charity, where runners contribute 1-10 CZK for each completed kilometer to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with a requirement to use a headlamp during night sections. Registration is mandatory. The event has a charitable dimension and emphasizes community atmosphere and endurance.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run je horský beh v Nízkych Tatrách s dĺžkou trate 23 km a prevýšením 1600 metrov. Trať vedie prevažne po značených turistických chodníkoch, cez krásne južne orientované singláče v lese, skalné mesto a vrchol Poludnice s panoramatickým výhľadom na Liptov a Tatry. Podujatie je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy a Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, pričom slúži aj ako kvalifikačné preteky na majstrovstvá sveta v skyrunningu. Atmosféra je priateľská a trať patrí medzi najťažšie na Slovensku vo svojej kategórii. V roku 2026 sa uskutoční posledný ročník tohto podujatia.
course_highlights: 23 km dlhá trať s prevýšením 1600 m
Trasa vedie po značených turistických chodníkoch, singláčikmi a skalným mestom
Vrchol Poludnice s panoramatickým výhľadom na Liptov, Západné a Vysoké Tatry
additional: Registrácia sa spustí 23. marca 2026. Prezentácia a vyzdvihnutie štartovného čísla je v deň štartu od 07:00 do 08:40 v priestoroch štartu. Hromadný štart je o 09:00. Maximálny počet účastníkov je 200. Na trati je občerstvenie na 19. km. Trať je považovaná za jednu z najťažších na Slovensku vo svojej kategórii. Po vyhlásení výsledkov o 14:00 sa uskutoční tombola s lístkami za 2 €. Podujatie je súčasťou sezónneho hodnotenia a zbierania ITRA bodov, s možnosťou získať body na majstrovstvá sveta. Súčasťou sú aj tombola, teplý obed a bezplatné parkovanie.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou je bežecké podujatie organizované Bežeckým klubom obce Vyšná Myšľa a obcou Vyšná Myšľa. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku vo Vyšnej Myšli a ponúkajú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov, žien a detí. Súčasťou je aj štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km. Štart detských kategórií je o 14:00 a dospelých o 16:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane členov klubu a občanov obce, ktorí majú výhody na štartovnom.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku vo Vyšnej Myšli
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti podľa veku
Štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km
additional: Štart detí o 14:00 hod., dospelých o 16:00 hod. Štartovné neplatia Muži E, Ženy I, členovia BKO Vyšná Myšľa, občania obce Vyšná Myšľa a deti. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre deti, dospelých a štafety, s možnosťou registrácie online aj na mieste, trať je situovaná na futbalovom ihrisku a v okolí obce.

name: Trail Run
description: Trail Run v Družstevnej pri Hornáde je bežecká súťaž, ktorá ponúka trať s prírodným charakterom a rôznorodým povrchom. Pretek sa koná 6. júna 2026 s možnosťou výberu medzi 8 km a 15 km okruhmi, ktoré vedú po asfaltových, betónových, lesných a poľných cestách s prevýšením až 309 metrov. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí, čo robí podujatie vhodným pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov. Štart a cieľ sú situované pri multifunkčnom ihrisku na Okružnej ulici v Družstevnej pri Hornáde.
course_highlights: 8 km okruh s prevýšením 162 m
15 km okruh s prevýšením 309 m
Povrch trate zahŕňa asfalt, betón, lesné a poľné cesty
additional: Registrácia je možná iba online s platbou prevodom alebo kartou, prípadne platba na mieste počas registrácie. Súčasťou programu sú aj detské kategórie s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí a nording walking o 16:00. Registrácia začína o 13:30 a končí o 15:30, deti sa registrujú do 14:30. Podujatie je podporované nadáciou e.SK a je zamerané na propagáciu trailového behu v Slovenskej prírode. Detaily o trase a registrácii budú zverejnené neskôr.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Futbalové ihrisko Kišovce, Hôrka, Poprad, Slovakia
description: Starostovská desiatka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Hôrka okr. Poprad na futbalovom ihrisku Kišovce. Pretek ponúka 10 km trať s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia, ako aj hobby kategóriu na 5 km a preteky pre deti a žiakov. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 16:30, detské kategórie začínajú o 13:00. Organizátormi sú Obecný úrad Hôrka a TJ Baník Hôrka, ktorí vítajú bežcov všetkých vekových skupín a úrovní.
course_highlights: 10 km trať s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia
Hobby kategória na 5 km bez vekového obmedzenia
Preteky detí a žiakov s vlastným štartom
additional: Detské kategórie a žiaci majú štart o 13:00 a sú bez štartovného. Štartovné na mieste je 15 €. Registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štartové časy sú o 13:00 a 16:30, súčasťou štartovného je teplé jedlo a nápoje

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Beh pre dobrú vec je bežecké podujatie v obci Pača, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 4,4 km. Preteky sú určené pre širokú vekovú kategóriu od mladších po starších bežcov, s kategóriami pre mužov a ženy. Ide o komunitný beh, ktorý spája šport a dobrú vec, pričom pretekári môžu súťažiť v rôznych vekových skupinách. Podujatie je súčasťou platformy pretekaj.sk a ponúka jednoduchú online registráciu.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 4,4 km v obci Pača
Jednoduchý okruh s jedným okruhom
Kategórie pre mužov a ženy od 15 rokov a starších
additional: Registrácia prebieha cez platformu pretekaj.sk, kde je potrebné si vytvoriť účet pre správu prihlášok. Partnerské kluby môžu ponúkať vernostné alebo členské karty pre rýchlu registráciu. Podujatie zahŕňa kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti, štartové časy sú naplánované na 9:30 a 10:30, trať je prevažne asfaltová s časťami po štrkovej ceste.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: Beh na vrchol Minčola je tradičný bežecký pretek v Lipanoch, ktorý ponúka náročnú trať s dĺžkou 7 300 metrov a prevýšením 649 metrov. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od najmladších detí až po seniorov a zahŕňa aj súťaž v rámci Vychodniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025. Organizátormi sú Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany. Pretek je vhodný pre všetkých, ktorí majú radi beh do kopca a chcú si zmerať sily v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 7 300 m s prevýšením 649 m
Štart v Lúčke nad obecným úradom v Lipanoch
Súťaž v rámci Vychodniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025
additional: Kategórie pretekárov od prípravky (2017 a ml.) až po seniorov, vrátane kategórií pre Nordic Walking. Organizátorom je mesto Lipany v spolupráci s turistami a priaznivcami behu na Minčol. Štartovné je zvýšené v deň preteku. Súčasťou preteku je Vychodniarska liga behov do kopca 2025. Terén: horský trail, registrácia online alebo na mieste, súčasť pretekov Východniarskej ligy behov do kopca 2025

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, Slovakia
price_range: 15€ online pred 10.9.2025, 20€ online od 11.9.2025 do 26.9.2025, 20€ na mieste
description: Single-Trail run 30 je bežecký pretek v Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, ktorý ponúka tri trate s dĺžkami 25 km, 15 km a 7 km. Preteky sú určené pre mužov a ženy bez vekového obmedzenia a organizuje ich O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Štartovné je dostupné online a na mieste, pričom pretek ponúka možnosť zažiť náročný trailový beh v prírode. Organizátori poskytujú kontaktné informácie pre záujemcov o bližšie informácie.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 25 km, 15 km a 7 km
Preteky v prírodnom prostredí Ruská Nová Ves
Kategórie pre mužov a ženy bez vekového obmedzenia
additional: Preteky organizuje O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Miesto štartu je Hostinec pod zámkom v Ruská Nová Ves pri budove obecného úradu. Kontaktné osoby sú Lukáš Ferenc, Peter Kačmár a Filip Kušnír s uvedenými telefónnymi číslami. Trať vedie náročným terénom, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, štart a cieľ sú pri Hostinci pod zámkom

name: Trutnovská 10
location: Paradráze, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trutnovská 10 is a traditional running race with a 12-year history, offering unforgettable experiences in the beautiful environment of Trutnov's Para forest park. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, and offers a choice of several routes: 5 km loop, 10 km loop, and canicross over 3 km. For children, there is a children's cross with obstacles adapted to age categories and an accompanying program. Trutnovská 10 is suitable for beginners and experienced runners who want to experience the atmosphere of a mass start and connect with nature in the heart of the Krkonoše mountains.
course_highlights: Para forest park with forested paved paths
Routes of 5 km, 10 km, and canicross 3 km loop
Children's cross with obstacles adapted to age
additional: The start and finish of the race are in the Paradráha Trutnov area. The routes are not certified. Children's categories have various lengths from 200 m to 1500 m with obstacles such as climbing, crawling, and slalom. The difficulty of the obstacles is adapted to the age so that everyone can manage them. The race offers different distances, including canicross, and focuses on a community and family atmosphere with accompanying activities such as yoga, a bouncy castle, and refreshments.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
location: Zámecké náměstí, Jeseník, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the opportunity to test your endurance against time. The 60 km route is designed for more experienced participants aged at least 16 years and includes refreshment stations. The event is traditional and popular, with timing measured by chip technology and results announced at the finish. Organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, making the race suitable for both runners and tourists.
course_highlights: Hiking and running event along the ridges of Hrubý Jeseník
Refreshment stations at 6 locations on the 60 km route
Time limits and timing measured by chip technology
additional: On the 60 km route, there are refreshment options at 6 locations, including 5 control points managed by the organizers. The organizers use chip technology for timing and ranking. After the race, results are announced at 20:30 at the finish line. Children up to 12 years old are recommended to complete the 25 km route with adult supervision. In case of withdrawal from the route, it is necessary to inform the organizers to prevent unnecessary search efforts. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, with start and finish at Zámecké náměstí in Jeseník. The routes pass through the ridges of Jeseníky. Registration begins in April.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: 4 etapy z 8 dle vlastního výběru – jednotlivci – 4 666 Kč / osobu

description: The Devil's Ultratrail is an outdoor run through mountains, valleys, castles, and waters in the mysterious nature of Kokořínsko and the Máchovo region. It offers a main route of 66.6 km with beautiful scenery and well-stocked refreshment stations, suitable even for beginner ultramarathoners. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Devil's Challenge 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and participants will enjoy unforgettable experiences in the picturesque terrain.
course_highlights: Trail through mountains, valleys, castles, and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchovo region
Well-stocked refreshment stations along the route
Picturesque nature and family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup for drinks at refreshment stations, with the option to order a devil's running cup, T-shirt, or socks. The race capacity is limited, and registration for the main race on June 6, 2026, is sold out, but spots may become available before the event. The Devil's Challenge 666 km is an 8-day stage race with GPS trackers and online timing. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with the possibility of earning ITRA points. Registrations are sold out, capacity is limited, and the race offers a family atmosphere and bus transportation to the start.

name: Vybarvený běh
description: Color Run in Kroměříž is an unconventional running event where the focus is not on time but on fun and coloring participants during the course. Every runner will enjoy the joy of movement and the colorful atmosphere at the Great Square. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children who must be accompanied by an adult. The Color Run is a great opportunity for families and individuals who want to experience a sports day full of colors and music.
course_highlights: Run at the Great Square in Kroměříž
Applying colors to oneself and others during the course
Music accompaniment and lively atmosphere
additional: Participants do not compete and their time is not measured. Children under 10 must run accompanied by an adult who takes responsibility for them. Parents with strollers can also run with children but should be cautious due to powder paints. Registration is individual via an online form, where it is necessary to confirm agreement with the rules and conditions. The event is suitable for all age groups; registration is possible online and in person. The starter pack includes a T-shirt, a bib number, color, and gifts. The program also includes concerts at the Great Square.

description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of fields, meadows, and forests around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition of the race will take place on June 6, 2026, with the center at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football field. The race offers routes for all age categories from the youngest children to adults, complemented by a rich accompanying program including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All routes are well marked, and volunteers at intersections indicate the correct direction. The organizer is the Skřipov Running Club, z. s.
course_highlights: The route passes through fields, meadows, and forests around Skřipov
Volunteers at intersections and marker flags
Time limits for some races (Eagle 60 min, Ostrich 90 min)
additional: Start numbers are issued on the day of the race from 14:00 at the football field. Registration for individual races has different closing times. There are changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a baggage storage. Parking is arranged in a residential area with the help of volunteers. Refreshments are available at the finish line for participants. Runners must wear their start number visibly on their chest. The race is open to all age groups; persons under 18 participate with the consent of a legal guardian. The event is intended for all age groups, offering various route lengths and an accompanying family-oriented program.

name: Happy run
location: Studenec u Třebíče, Kraji Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Happy Run is a charity run held on June 6, 2026, in Studenec near Třebíč in the Vysočina Region. This run is intended for everyone - athletes and non-athletes, families with children and individuals, who can choose from several routes according to their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with severe health complications, and the proceeds from the run are donated to his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, a rich accompanying program and an evening social party are prepared.
course_highlights: Routes 11 km, 6 km, 1 km children's race, and 1 km family non-competitive
Children's route with time measurement, start number, and chip
Family route identical to the children's, without time measurement
additional: Registered participants will receive a start package with a number and chip. Time is measured on the children's track, and not on the family route. On-site registration is only possible for the family route. Competition for the largest team with a small prize. Accompanying program throughout the day and an evening party. Charitable event, family and children's routes, on-site registration, support for children with health issues.

name: Běh napříč republikou
description: Running across the country is a unique relay event held for the fifth time. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Číhošť, with the pace adjusted for hobby runners and run at a conversational speed. The routes are divided into segments with guides who ensure the correct pace and navigation. The event is not a race but a shared experience that allows discovering new places and meeting other runners.
course_highlights: 4 parallel routes from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany to Číhošť
Total length of 782.9 km divided into 82 segments with a precise schedule
Routes pass through diverse terrains - hills, plains, trails, roads, forests, and towns
additional: Participants run together at a conversational pace with guides on each segment. The pace is adjusted for hobby runners, approximately 6 min/km on flat sections, slower on hills. On selected segments, the pace is slowed to 7 min/km to allow casual runners to join. Refreshments, support vehicles, and transportation options are provided at relay points, subject to capacity. The race is not marked; participants run according to the timetable and with guides. The finish is collective in Číhošť on Sunday at 17:00. Multiple start locations, approximately 867 km total, group runs with guides, no official timing, open participation, various terrains from city streets to trails, relay format with a predetermined schedule.

description: From Hejnice to Hell 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments, medical support, and a starter pack for each participant. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and seniors, who have special registration fee conditions. Organizers emphasize the comfort of runners, including changing rooms, showers, and baggage storage.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations along the long route
Medical support at the start, finish, and along the route
Start and finish at Hejnice Skatepark
additional: The registration fee includes a start number, rental of an electronic chip for timing, changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage, refreshments, a participant medal, an online results list and diploma, a starter pack, email notifications, and special offers from partners. Start numbers are issued on the race day at the registration tent. The registration fee is tied to a specific person, non-refundable, and non-transferable. The race date is June 6, 2026. Registration requires proof of identity and payment confirmation; children under 18 need a signed guardian form.

In 2026, the 5th edition will take place, with four parallel routes from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) heading to the geographical center of the Czech Republic in Číhošť. The run follows a precise schedule with guides on each segment, ensuring pace and route navigation. Participants can choose any number of segments they wish to run and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.
course_highlights: The Northern route starts in Liberec-Machnín and measures 185.7 km with an elevation gain of 2662 m
The run passes through diverse terrain - hills, plains, trails, roads, forests, and towns
Pace is adapted for hobby runners, averaging 6:00 min/km, with some sections slowed to 7:00 min/km
additional: The run is not a race; it is a group run with guides who ensure the pace and route navigation. Organizers with refreshments and start packages are present at relay points. Participants can join or leave the run at any segment of the 'train'. The run concludes with a joint finish in Číhošť on Sunday at 17:00.

It is not a race, but a shared run at conversational pace with guides on individual sections who ensure the pace and route. Participants can choose any number of sections they wish to run and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for hobby runners and offers the opportunity to discover new places and meet like-minded people.
course_highlights: The route runs from Liberec through Výpřež and Rašovka to Číhošť, the geographical center of the Czech Republic
A total of 21 sections with a length of 185.7 km and an elevation gain of 2662 m on the northern route
Running pace is adapted for hobby runners, on average 6:00 min/km, slowed down to 7:00 min/km on selected sections
additional: The run is not a race; it is run together according to a schedule with guides on each section. Organizers are available at relay points with refreshments and start packages. The finish is joint in Číhošť on Sunday at 17:00, when all routes meet.

additional: Štart detí o 10:30, mužov a žien o 13:00. Kategórie pretekov zahŕňajú detské, dorastenecké, 10 km a 5 km trate s rozdelením podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátori: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku, registrácia je online, štarty sú naplánované na 11:00 pre deti a 13:00 pre dospelých.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Námestie pod OD Billa, Trebišov, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: Charity Run v Trebišove je tradičným podujatím, ktoré spája beh, prechádzku, nordic walking a jazdu na bicykli. Tento charitatívny beh ponúka príležitosť spoznať mesto Trebišov a zároveň podporiť dobrú vec. Podujatie organizuje Majcher-Production s.r.o. a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá chce aktívne stráviť čas a prispieť na charitu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie centrom mesta Trebišov, námestím pod OD Billa
Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne formy pohybu: beh, prechádzku, nordic walking a jazdu na bicykli
Charitatívny charakter podujatia spája šport s podporou komunity
additional: Podujatie zahŕňa aj aktivity ako cyklistika, prechádzky a behy v maskách, s možnosťou registrácie na rôzne vzdialenosti a úrovne. Súčasťou je aj sprievodný program, občerstvenie a koncerty.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 eur (len kategórie dospelých, deti štartovné neplatia)

description: Šamorínska bežecká liga (ŠBL) je séria bežeckých pretekov organizovaných 3klubom Šamorín, určená pre širokú verejnosť bez vekových a výkonnostných limitov. Pretekári sú hodnotení v kategóriách muži, ženy, chlapci a dievčatá, pričom detské behy majú kratšie vzdialenosti. Liga prebieha počas celého roka a zahŕňa aj tradičnú akciu Pomlé Run. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie a vyhodnocovanie ligy. V poslednom kole prebehne oficiálne vyhodnotenie celkovej ligy s ocenením najlepších pretekárov.
course_highlights: Lesopark Pomlé v Šamoríne ako štart a cieľ
Rôzne kategórie s kratšími a dlhšími vzdialenosťami (100 m až 5 km)
Bežecké trate v prírodnom prostredí s občerstvením v cieli
additional: Štart detských kategórií je postupný od 10:00 (predškoláci 100 m, mladší žiaci 700 m, starší žiaci 700 m) a dospelí štartujú o 10:30. Prezentácia prebieha od 9:00 do 30 minút pred štartom kategórie na lúke v lesoparku Pomlé. K dispozícii sú WC a šatňa v priestoroch Amfiteátra. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie v cieli a tombolu. Škôlkari dostanú medailu po dobehnutí, ale nebudú vyhodnocovaní. Podujatie je súčasťou série, ktorá prebieha od marca do októbra 2026, s rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny, lokalita Lesopark Pomlé.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Nevického chatu, Vyšná Šebastová, Prešov, Slovakia
price_range: 12,- € online pred 27.5.2025; 20,- € na mieste; 4 km zadarmo
description: Šebešská pätnástka sú bežecké preteky organizované klubom MTC Vyšná Šebastová v spolupráci s obecným úradom Vyšná Šebastová a športovými združeniami. Hlavná trať meria 15,5 km s výbehom na Nevického chatu, doplnená je o rekreačnú 3 km trať a detské disciplíny pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Preteky sa konajú každoročne v nedeľu prvého júnového víkendu s dopoludňajším štartom a bohatým kultúrno-spoločenským programom, ktorý priláka stovky návštevníkov. Podujatie je súčasťou viacerých bežeckých súťaží a ligy, pričom organizátori kladú dôraz na rozvoj športu a budovanie mena obce. Šebešská pätnástka získala ocenenie Bežecký diamant v rokoch 2011 a 2012.
course_highlights: Hlavná trať 15,5 km s výbehom na Nevického chatu
Rekreačná trať 3 km vhodná pre širokú verejnosť
Detské disciplíny pre predškolákov až juniorov
additional: Preteky sú sprevádzané bohatým kultúrno-spoločenským programom, tombolou a vystúpeniami hudobných skupín. Súčasťou je aj zaradenie do oblastných bežeckých súťaží a Východoslovenskej veľkej ceny vytrvalcov (VVCV). Riaditeľ pretekov Ján Tomčo je aktívny bežec a zakladateľ klubu MTC Vyšná Šebastová, ktorý vnáša do podujatia ducha fairplay a bojovnosti. Trať zahŕňa výstup na Nevického chatu, súčasťou sú aj detské disciplíny a bohatý kultúrny program, ocenenia a uznania.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Mnichovo Hradiště, Czech Republic
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a slightly hilly turnaround course of 15 km, held in Mnichovo Hradiště at T.G. Masaryk Square. The course is well-paved with marked kilometers, allowing runners to plan their pace effectively. The race is organized as a memorial to Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00 AM, and the organizer is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners seeking a quality road race with tradition.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly turnaround road
High-quality asphalt surface
Marked kilometers on the course
additional: The race is a memorial to Ing. Josef Hron. The organizer is Vladimír Koudelka, contact by phone at 606 432 483. The course is a turnaround with marked kilometers. The race is dedicated to the memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers two course lengths (15 km and 25 km). The start is at 10:00 AM, and registration is possible online and on-site.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, which creates a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, contributing to a pleasant running experience. This race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners who want to test their speed over a short distance.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km)
Race in the picturesque Smetanovy Sady park in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race is part of a broader sports calendar and is suitable for runners of all levels, with no specific fees or registration conditions published yet.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Red Hill Run is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque environment of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners from hobby athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and provides quality facilities for both participants and spectators. Registration is available online and on-site on the race day, which takes place on June 7, 2026.
course_highlights: Technically interesting course with a hilly profile
Numerous turns on paved roads
Picturesque natural environment of Dolní Čermná
additional: The race is part of the Iscarex Cup series, offers races for children and adults, registration until 11:30 AM, the race takes place in June 2026.

name: Chotucká šlapka
location: Zámecký park, Křinec, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Chotucká šlapka is a traditional running race in Křinec, which was established in 2012 as a duathlon and has been held as a pure trail run since 2020. The race offers two courses - a main 11 km route and a half-distance 5.5 km route, mainly along trail paths with a small portion of asphalt. The start and finish are in the castle park, and the course runs through scenic countryside with several hills and refreshment stations. The race is open to the general public with a limited capacity of 100 runners and offers personalized bib numbers, refreshments, and wooden medals for all participants.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 5.5 km loop with 80% trail and 20% asphalt
The main race runs two loops (11 km), the half-distance one loop (5.5 km)
The route passes through the castle park, Bažantnice, cemetery, Chotuc, and other natural areas
additional: The race capacity is limited to 100 runners. The bib number is personalized with the runner's name upon registration by 30.05.2026. There are men's and women's changing rooms, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, and wooden medals for all participants. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. Children's races start at 11:00 with staggered starts from 12:00. The race takes place on June 7, 2026, and includes children's races. It is part of the Postřižinská Running League.

The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes community atmosphere and the joy of movement in nature. name: Skalecký kros
location: Skalka, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Skalecký cross-country is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque area of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers courses of 10 km, 5 km, and children's races, which run through forest paths and asphalt. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and youth. The organizer is SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: The Červenkovská ten is a road race over 10 km held in July near Olomouc. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and the Great Prize of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners. The course is a loop, starting from Červenka, passing through Dětřichov to Renot and back, mostly on the road. Participants are divided into age categories, and winners in each category will receive material prizes. The results will be announced at the venue at the Hostinec u Nádraží and will be published on the website hanackybeh.cz.
course_highlights: Loop course from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renot and back
Course runs on the road
Start and finish at Hostinec U Nádraží in July

The race is run according to road running rules, each at their own risk. The race is at participants' own risk, registration is with a chip card and credit conditions, and participants can look forward to small material prizes for category winners.

name: Milada Run
location: Milada Lake, Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of the former lignite mine, which has been transformed into a beautiful natural environment of Lake Milada. The race offers various routes including a half marathon, 10 km, and children's races, which run along hilly and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere of the race is family-friendly and welcoming, suitable for all ages and running levels. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which is appreciated by participants for its high quality and popularity.

10 km route on paved paths with a flat profile suitable for all runners
Children's races 500 m and 1 km near the main beach with parental supervision

Family and friendly atmosphere. Series point scoring for the main adult routes. name: Konopišťská desítka

This race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the opportunity to compete in the main race, relay races, and children's categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy running in picturesque nature with quality organization. The jubilee 30th edition will take place on June 7, 2026.

10 km race with relay and children's categories available

The race takes place on June 7, 2026, with online registration available. The event includes various age categories and relay races.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities agency in Chudenice, Plzeň Region. The race is part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' series and offers an unconventional format where participants cover the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own children's categories. Organizers emphasize the sporting experience in beautiful nature and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Three different ways to complete the course within one race
Beautiful nature and terrain around Chudenice
Categories for children with attractive children's routes

Material prizes are prepared for the top three in individual categories and relays. Kindergarten and elementary school students from Kryry and residents of Kryry have free start. The race includes three runs with uphill sections, stairs, and forest trail; registration is possible online or on-site; the event is part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' series.

description: The Mnichovice Run is an amateur running race set in the beautiful Central Bohemian landscape, featuring a challenging course approximately 7-8 km long with an elevation gain of around 200 meters. The race offers varied terrain including paved roads, forest, meadows, and pastures, where you may be accompanied by domestic and wild animals. The start and finish are newly located at the Šibeniční vrch sports complex on the Podhorky playground. All participants will receive a commemorative medal and diploma, category winners will be awarded cups and a small surprise. The Mnichovice Run is part of the series of running races for the Ladov Region Cup, and everyone who completes the race healthy and safe is a winner.

Terrain includes paved roads, forest, meadows, and pastures
Challenging sections with steep ascents and descents

Registration and pick-up of start numbers are from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshment stations with drinking water are available on the course, with additional refreshments at the Šibeniční vrch restaurant. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The race capacity is a maximum of 100 runners. Parking is available on Bezručova Street near the elementary school. The race is intended for adults aged 15 and over. Registration is from 9:00 to 9:45, with refreshments included in the entry fee and medals for all participants. Parking is accessible at ZŠ Bezručova and at the Podhorky playground. Entry with dogs on the course is not permitted.
