4x (400 m run + beer) - an unconventional combination of sport and entertainment
Surroundings of the training football field
additional: The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, which supports sports activities in the region. The event is open to all interested in sport and fun in Heřmanův Městec. The race takes place on the athletics track in Bažantnice, includes multiple heats, and results are published. The event is part of the local running cup.

name: Běh pro Zuzanku
location: Milíčovský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Run for Zuzanka is a traditional race in Prague held in Milíčov Forest. This race is not a charity event, but a race for the joy of Zuzanka Nováková and all participants. The course is approximately 6.2 km long and the race has a long-standing tradition, this year marking its 11th edition. The race is supported by the Prague 4 Municipal District - Újezd.
course_highlights: The course runs through Milíčov Forest
The race length is 6.2 km
The race has a long-standing tradition, this year the 11th edition
additional: Electronic registrations for the 2026 edition are closed, registration is only possible in person at the start. The course is 6.2 km long, with the possibility of pre-registration or registering on-site, the event is suitable for both trail and road running, appropriate for all age groups including children.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: The SABZO Open Cross Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race offers amateurs the opportunity to test their strength in cross country running in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The SABZO Club is known for its long-standing history and regular organization of running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the broader running event calendar of the club, which promotes an active lifestyle and a community of runners.
course_highlights: Cross country course in the environment of Prague 4
Opportunity for runners of all levels
Organized by the SABZO club
additional: The race is part of the running calendar and offers the opportunity to follow results and other activities of the running community in Prague.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 299 Kč Z toho 200 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 149 Kč Z toho 100 Kč jde na podporu našich hrdinů

description: Advent Runner Ostrava 2026 is a charity running race held on June 10th in Komenského Gardens. The race offers two main categories - adults over 6.45 km and children elves on tracks from 0.2 to 1 km. The route runs on asphalt and paved paths, with a recommendation for road shoes. The entry fee largely supports heroes who have a hard time in life, and participants receive a race bib, diploma, gingerbread, and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable, and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: The route runs on asphalt and paved paths in Komenského Gardens
Adult distance 6.45 km, children's tracks 0.2 - 1 km
Recommended road shoes
additional: Race bib with the option to print the name when paying by May 25th, diploma with time sent after the race, sports prizes for winners in categories, Advent gingerbread, baggage storage and a children's corner with supervision, hydration with Mattoni water at the finish line, temporary tattoos for children, a small surprise for adults. Registration includes a race bib, diploma, prizes, refreshments, and a children's corner; virtual run option.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami of YOUR LEAGUE is an amateur trail run held in Prague, offering runners experiences of running in nature with diverse terrain and interesting views. The races are part of YOUR LEAGUE, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the opportunity to compete with runners of all ages. The races are regularly announced and decorated with medals for the best in categories up to 40 years and 40+.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain with views in Prague's nature
Running in the environment of Modřanských roklí and Zbraslavská pila
Races with the atmosphere of an amateur league and community running
additional: In each race, the top three fastest in categories up to 40 years and 40+ are announced and decorated with medals from Garka. The prize value for the best and regular runners is 44,000 CZK. Starting number and gunshot provide runners with an unforgettable experience. The race is focused on trail runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment and wanting to enjoy beautiful views and technical sections on the course.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami 2026 is a running race in Prague offering two routes of 7 and 14 km. The race takes participants along a scenic trail from Dívčí Hrad to Děvín and Prokopské údolí, including well-known spots such as Foglar's stairs and a hidden pond. Participants will enjoy beautiful panoramic views of Prague and a friendly race atmosphere. The start is easily accessible by metro at Radlická station, and the registration fee includes refreshments, a medal, and results service.
course_highlights: The route passes through Dívčí Hrad, Děvín, and Prokopské údolí
Includes Foglar's stairs and a hidden pond
Panoramic views of Prague
additional: Registration begins at 17:00 at the blue tent near the Převalský horse enclosure at Dívčí Hrad. The race fee includes an isotonic drink, light refreshments, a medal, and prizes for the top finishers in categories 40- and 40+. There is a baggage storage service at the organizer's tent. Recommended public transport: metro Radlická, tram Zlíchov or Lihovar, train Praha-Žvahov, and bus Dívčí Hrad. Parking is available nearby. Trail race in Prague-Zlíchov, part of a series of running events with various distances.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: June's Beautiful Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. This race is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, open to all age categories and running levels. The race offers the opportunity to experience the picturesque Haná landscape and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.
course_highlights: Running race in the scenic Haná landscape of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Hanácký Running Cup with courses from 5 to 42 km
Traditional running event with open start for all age categories
additional: Registration is conducted via a credit system with a chip card used for electronic timing. The entry fee is paid from preloaded credit on the STMSVS bank account. The race is part of the year-round Hanácký Running Cup series, where participants earn points based on their placement in individual races. The race takes place on June 11, 2026, with on-site registration available, and results are published online.

name: Yellow Ribbon Run
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Czechia Yellow Ribbon Run (Gabriela Slováková a podporující organizace)
description: Yellow Ribbon Run is a running event held on June 11, 2026, at the Star Park in Prague 6, symbolizing a second chance and supporting the integration of people with a criminal past. The run combines sport, solidarity, and the courage to help those who want to start a new life and become valuable members of society. The event offers various race categories including the main relay, easy relay, and children's run, and also contributes to awareness and reducing recidivism. Join the largest community in the Czech Republic that breaks stereotypes and supports second chances.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful environment of Star Park in Prague 6
Various race categories: main relay 5 km, easy relay 2.5 km, children's run
Symbolism of a second chance and support for the reintegration of people with a criminal past
additional: The event includes the main relay 5 km, easy relay 2.5 km, Connecting Hearts Race for Children, and VOL FANWALK. The project promotes awareness about people with a criminal past and offers institutions and companies the opportunity to participate in the run as a CSR project. Organizers welcome volunteers to assist with the preparation and execution of the event. The event aims to increase awareness of the issues related to the reintegration of ex-offenders and support their social inclusion. Registration is available through Stopnito.cz.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok je nočný bežecký závod na 5 kilometrov, ktorý sa koná v Areáli zdravia Rozálka v Pezinku. Bežci si môžu užiť rýchly a dynamický beh po trase vedúcej cez Malokarpatskú oblasť s umelým osvetlením, čo vytvára jedinečnú atmosféru. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých od 15 rokov a je rozdelené do štartových koridorov podľa výkonnosti. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, preto je zakázané používať slúchadlá a odporúčajú reflexné prvky či čelovky. Registrácia je možná online a je viazaná na meno pretekára, pričom je možné vykonať preregistráciu do 9. júna 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km nočný beh s umelým osvetlením
Trasa vedie cez Areál zdravia Rozálka, Malokarpatskú oblasť a Radničné námestie
Štartovné koridory podľa zadaného času z predchádzajúcich pretekov
additional: Minimálny vek účastníka je 15 rokov dosiahnutých v kalendárnom roku 2025. Preregistrácia lístka na inú osobu je možná do 9. júna 2026 za poplatok 10 eur. Používanie slúchadiel počas behu je prísne zakázané. Odporúčané sú reflexné prvky a čelovky kvôli nočnému behu. Štartovné je neprenosné a viazané na meno pretekára. Trať vedie z Areálu zdravia Rozálka cez Malokarpatkú, Majakovského most, Okružnú ulicu, most SNP, Kupeckého, Holubyho a končí na Radničnom námestí. Prihlásiť sa je možné len online, preregistrácia je nutná, a štartovné je viazané na meno účastníka.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 je národný štafetový beh naprieč Slovenskom, ktorý prebieha počas troch dní. Bežci spoločne prekonávajú viac ako 530 km z Košíc do Bratislavy, prechádzajúc krásnymi prírodnými scenériami, historickými pamiatkami a malebnými mestami. Podujatie ponúka jedinečnú športovú atmosféru, tímovú spoluprácu a množstvo nezabudnuteľných zážitkov. Trasa vedie cez významné miesta ako Spišský hrad, Vysoké Tatry, Oravský hrad či Malé Karpaty, pričom bežci zažijú aj bohatý sprievodný program.
course_highlights: Trasa dlhá 530 km z Košíc do Bratislavy
Prechod cez významné prírodné a historické pamiatky ako Spišský hrad, Vysoké Tatry, Oravský hrad
Celkové stúpanie 7308 m a klesanie 7376 m
additional: Celkový počet štartujúcich tímov je limitovaný na 100 tímov. Registrácia prebieha cez webovú aplikáciu, ktorá umožňuje sledovanie bežcov v reálnom čase, aktuálne výsledky, navigáciu a notifikácie od organizačného tímu. Pretek je určený pre tímových bežcov, s možnosťou sledovania výsledkov v reálnom čase, registrácia je otvorená, sú k dispozícii rôzne propagačné predmety a mobilná aplikácia na sledovanie výkonov.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Over three dams, the Opatov traditional running race takes place in Opatov on the Vysočina region, and is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup series. The race offers various courses, including the main route of 8.8 km for men and veterans up to 69 years old, and shorter distances for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course mainly runs along field and forest paths, including passing through three dams of local ponds, which gives the race a unique character. The event is open to a wide age range and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the running community in the region.
course_highlights: The course passes over three dams of ponds around Opatov
Various distances from 210 m to 8.8 km for different age categories
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup series
additional: The main loop course is 4.4 km with field and forest paths (30% asphalt), races for children from 210 m to 1.5 km, the event is focused on a wide age range and veterans.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry je prvý ročník horského bežeckého podujatia, ktoré vedie hrebeňom Nízkych Tatier od západu na východ. Trať má dĺžku 49,7 km s prevýšením 2650 metrov a vedie po turistických značkách z Donovalov na Srdiečko. Podujatie je súčasťou kalendára Slovenskej Skyrunningovej asociácie a zároveň slúži ako Memoriál Milana Styka, významného bežca a horolezca, ktorý tragicky zahynul v roku 2025. Štart je plánovaný na 13. júna 2026 o 7:00 hodine v Donovaloch pri Donovalskom pivovare.
course_highlights: 49,7 km dlhá trasa s 2650 m prevýšením
Hrebeň Nízkych Tatier od Donovalov po Srdiečko
Trasa vedie po červenej, zelenej a žltej turistickej značke cez chatu M.R. Štefánika a Kosodrevinu
additional: Registrácia je možná online od 20.12.2025 od 0:00 hod. a tiež na mieste štartu v Donovalskom pivovare 13.6.2026 od 16:00 do 21:00 hod. a ráno pred štartom od 6:00 do 6:45. Predbežný stop čas na Chopku po 37 km je o 15:00 hod (8 hodín po štarte). Organizátor si vyhradzuje právo zmeniť trasu podľa počasia a stanoviť časové limity. Trať prechádza horským terénom, súčasťou sú informácie o registrácii, pamätný charakter podujatia, možné zmeny trasy kvôli počasiu, časové limity podľa podmienok

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa je horský ultramaratón a diaľkový pochod okolo Strečna, ktorý sa uskutoční 13. júna 2026. Pretek ponúka dve trasy - náročnú 50 km trasu s prevýšením približne 2985 metrov a kratšiu 25 km trasu, ktorá je vhodná aj pre bežcov so psom. Trasy vedú po turisticky značených chodníkoch cez obe časti Malej Fatry a časťou národného parku, pričom štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku Radinové v Strečne. Organizátori zabezpečujú štartovné balíčky, ceny pre najlepších a kvalitné podmienky pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: 50 km trasa s prevýšením približne 2985 m cez Malú Fatru
Trasy vedú po turisticky značených chodníkoch a cez územie národného parku
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku Radinové v Strečne
additional: Limit účastníkov: 300 pre 50 km, 300 pre 25 km, 50 pre 25 km so psom. Štartovné číslo a čip sú pridelené organizátorom. Povinná výbava zahŕňa lekárničku, platný doklad totožnosti, poistenie na zásah Horskej záchrannej služby, nabitý mobil, vlastnú nádobu na pitie, píšťalku alebo rolničky (odporúčané pre 50 km trasu), mapu alebo GPS trasu, slnečné okuliare a opaľovací krém. Možnosť prespať v šatniach alebo stanoch na futbalovom ihrisku. Ubytovanie dostupné aj v Pizzeria Alžbetka a SIP ŽSR Strečno. Preteky ponúkajú certifikované trasy, registrácia sa otvára 1. marca 2026, súčasťou je aj Slovenská Ultratrailová Liga, a trať vedie cez národný park Malá Fatra.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom je bežecký pretek v Trnave pri Laborci, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane veľkého krosáku na 10 km, malého krosáku na 5 km, behu zdravia a nordic walkingu. Trať vedie po poľných a lesných cestách s asfaltovým povrchom, pričom veľký krosák pozostáva z dvoch päťkilometrových okruhov. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance a je vhodný pre širokú škálu bežcov od juniorov až po veteránov. Štart pretekov je na Obecnom úrade v Trnave pri Laborci, pričom detské kategórie začínajú o 9:00 a hlavný pretek o 11:00.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po poľnej a lesnej ceste s asfaltovým povrchom
Veľký krosák je 10 km (2 x 5 km okruh)
Pretek sa koná v malebnom prostredí Trnavy pri Laborci
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 8:00 hod. na Obecnom úrade, detské kategórie od 7:30 hod. Nové registrácie v deň pretekov sú možné len do vypredania voľných štartových čísel. Platba na mieste je 25 €. Podujatie sa koná 13. júna 2026, s štartmi o 09:00 a 11:00, a zahŕňa kategórie na 10 km, 5 km a Nordic Walking, s dôrazom na charitatívne účely a komunitnú účasť.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: Kysucký maratón je druhým najstarším maratónom na Slovensku a významnou športovou a spoločenskou udalosťou regiónu Kysúc. Trať vedie malebnou kysuckou dolinou pozdĺž rieky Kysuca, s bezpečnejšou a atraktívnejšou trasou po bežeckej cyklotrase od roku 2025. Súčasťou podujatia sú okrem maratónu aj polmaratón, maratónska štafeta a minimaratón pre deti. Štart a cieľ sú na Matičnom námestí v Čadci pred Domom kultúry. Preteká sa v rôznych vekových kategóriách a účastníci majú k dispozícii občerstvovacie stanice a zázemie vrátane šatní a wellness služieb.
course_highlights: Trať vedie malebnou kysuckou dolinou údolím rieky Kysuca
Bezpečná a atraktívna trasa po bežeckej cyklotrase (Bystrická cyklomagistrála)
Otočka maratónu na námestí pri Slovenskom orloji v Starej Bystrici
additional: Štart a cieľ pretekov sú na Matičnom námestí v Čadci pred Domom kultúry. Na trati je 8 občerstvovacích staníc. Po preteku je zabezpečené občerstvenie. Účastníkom sú k dispozícii šatne, bazén a sauna na miestnej plavárni. Limit na maratón je 5 hodín na 40 km, po prekročení tohto času nie je zaradenie do výsledkovej listiny garantované. Trať na certifikovaných tratiach, občerstvovacie stanice na trati, šatne, bazén, sauna, občerstvenie po preteku, registrácia online do 1.6.2026, bez poistenia organizátorov

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: Beh Hodkovským parkom je bežecké podujatie v areáli Kaštieľa Hodkovce v Žehre, ktoré ponúka trať prevažne poľnými a lesnými cestami s asfaltovým povrchom. Pretek je rozdelený do kategórií na 8 km súťažný beh pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, ako aj nesúťažné kategórie Beh pre zdravie a Nordic walking na 4 km bez vekového obmedzenia. Organizátorom je DOMOVINA n.o., ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov. Štartovné je dostupné online za zvýhodnenú cenu, čo podporuje včasnú registráciu.
course_highlights: Trať vedie prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách s asfaltovým úsekom
Pretek sa koná v areáli Kaštieľa Hodkovce v Žehre
Kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a nesúťažné varianty behu a Nordic walking
additional: Štartovné je 7 € pri online registrácii do 12.6.2025, na mieste 9 €. Trať je vhodná pre rôzne vekové kategórie a zahŕňa aj nesúťažné varianty behu a Nordic walking. Miesto štartu a cieľa je v areáli DSS DOMOVINA no. v Žehre, časť Hodkovce. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny, registrácia je možná do 12. júna 2025, trať zahŕňa les, poľné cesty a asfaltové úseky.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Beh Kalváriou je charitatívny bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v krásnom prostredí Kalvárie v Považskej Bystrici. Podujatie ponúka trate pre dospelých aj deti, pričom povrch trate tvoria lesné cesty. Tento štvrtý ročník preteku je príležitosťou zažiť spoločenstvo, pohyb a radosť, pričom výťažok z behu je venovaný deťom v núdzi. Organizátori kladú dôraz na kvalitnú organizáciu a podporu charitatívnych cieľov.
course_highlights: Lesné cesty v prostredí Kalvárie
Trate pre dospelých aj deti
Krásne členitá trať s pekným počasím
additional: Registrácia je možná len online cez vysledkovyservis.sk. Na mieste a v deň behu sa už registrácia neuskutoční. Po zaplatení štartovného sa meno účastníka zobrazí v zozname prihlásených a príde potvrdenie emailom. Možnosť dobrovoľného príspevku pri registrácii na podporu Hugovi a Simonke. Účastnícky limit je 500 dospelých a 250 detí. Podujatie sa riadi pravidlami Slovenského atletického zväzu. Registrácia je dostupná len online; podujatie má charitatívny účel; účastnícky limit je 500 dospelých a 250 detí; starty sú naplánované na 10:00 pre deti a 12:15 pre dospelých.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo je bežecké podujatie konané v Lemešanoch na lúke nad obcou. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií a nordic walking. Štart pre hlavné kategórie je o 17:00 hod., detské kategórie štartujú o 17:10 hod. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru letného bežeckého kola.
course_highlights: Rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny vrátane detí a dospelých
Online registrácia s nízkym štartovným
Detské behy na lúke zadarmo
additional: Kategórie: Muži A (18-39 rokov), Muži B (40 a viac rokov), Ženy F (18-39 rokov), Ženy G (40 a viac rokov), Dievčatá/Chlapci 1 (12-14 rokov), Dievčatá/Chlapci 2 (15-17 rokov), Deti do 12 rokov (len v sprievode dospelej osoby), Nordic Walking muži/ženy. Detské behy na lúke zdarma, online registrácia do 12. júna 2026, štartovné doplatok 2 € na štartové číslo, štart o 17:00 a 17:10

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: Beh na Chatu pri Zelenom plese je horský beh určený pre nadšencov športu a prírody, vhodný pre amatérskych aj profesionálnych športovcov. Podujatie sa koná pravidelne od roku 2005 počas druhého júnového víkendu a nesie spomienku na Karla Jakeša, významného československého horolezca. Trať vedie náročným horským terénom s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí beh výzvou pre všetkých účastníkov. Cieľom je spojiť rôzne športové skupiny a ponúknuť im jedinečný zážitok v krásnom prostredí Vysokých Tatier.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 7,7 km
Celkové stúpanie 651 m
Celkové klesanie 18 m
additional: Podujatie je realizované s finančnou podporou Ministerstva cestovného ruchu a športu SR. Beh spája atlétov, bežcov, alpinistov, lyžiarov, horolezcov, cyklistov a skialpinistov v jednu športovú osobnosť. Registrácia na 20. ročník bola ukončená. Pretek sa koná v júni 2026, registrácia je dostupná na oficiálnej stránke, trať začína pri autobusovej zastávke Biela voda a končí pri Chate pri Zelenom plese, vhodný pre bežcov všetkých úrovní s láskou k horským výkonom.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beautiful historic center of Olomouc. The start and finish are at Horní náměstí, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with a unique astronomical clock. During the race, you will enjoy the city's atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers accompanying programs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Horní náměstí with sights such as the Holy Trinity Column and astronomical clock
The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc with beautiful parks
City atmosphere and rich history during the race
additional: The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival with accompanying runs such as the Šantovka 5 km run, dm family mile, dm bambini run, and relay half marathon. Starts are divided into several time waves from 15:00 to 19:00. A mobile app, RunCzech, provides all race information and a virtual package. The race course includes historic streets, parks, and city roads; the route is certified and fully closed to traffic; the event offers technical support, refreshment stations, and medical services.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is an interval running race 9.2 km long, taking place on meadows and field roads around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners a pleasant terrain with a natural atmosphere. It starts in intervals, which provides an interesting racing format. This race is suitable for runners seeking a combination of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: The course is 9.2 km long on meadows and field roads
Interval start of the race
Natural environment around Postřekov in Chospíl
additional: The race takes place on June 13, 2026, results and participant lists are available on the website. Exact registration information is not provided.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event scheduled for June 13, 2026, in Sokolov, Karlovy Vary Region. The course primarily passes through scenic parts of the city and surrounding nature, with a race distance of approximately 10.5 km. The event is suitable for recreational runners as well as those who want to experience the race atmosphere in a beautiful environment. Organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for all participants.
course_highlights: Scenic course passing through Sokolov and surrounding natural scenery
Approximate length of 10.5 km suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Relaxed and friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Color Run Sokolov, registration and details are not specified, the race is suitable for the general public.

name: Barevný běh Sokolov
description: Color Run You Can't Escape is a colorful run and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends. There are two routes to choose from: 5 km with five colorful zones and 1.5 km with three colorful zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences full of colors, music, and laughter. The run takes place in Sokolov on June 13, 2026, and is part of a year-round colorful tour across several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colorful zones
1.5 km route with 3 colorful zones and Urban Challenge zone
Colorful zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event is a full-day entertainment from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM with music, themed zones, photo booths, and 360° video. The starter pack includes a T-shirt, start number, medal, and other accessories. The event is also suitable for children, who can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. No timing is measured; the focus is on joy and shared experience. Registrations are already open. The event will be held on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov. The routes pass through Sokolov Island and the surrounding area, focusing on fun and community.

name: Run Labe Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 17 000 Kč za tým.

description: Run Labe Run is a relay race for runners consisting of up to 12 team members, taking place from June 13 to June 14, 2026. The race route runs from Špindlerův Mlýn to Děčín along the Elbe River, covering a total of 380 km divided into 36 segments of varying difficulty. The race starts in 8 waves from 5:00 AM to 11:00 AM and offers categories including mixed teams of 10-12 runners, mixed teams of 6-9 runners, women's teams, and veterans. Teams compete for prizes in several categories, and registration is open until March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: Route length of 380 km divided into 36 segments with difficulty levels from 1 to 5
Start in Špindlerův Mlýn, finish in Děčín near the castle
Race held in 8 start waves from 5:00 to 11:00
additional: Maximum number of runners per team is 12. The captain's meeting will be held online on May 24, 2026, at 7:00 PM. Teams from previous editions have priority registration from June 26, 2025. The race starts in 8 waves from 5:00 to 11:00. Teams are not considered registered until payment is credited to the account. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, with the deadline on March 31, 2026, or until capacity is filled. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of the Krkonoše Mountains and along the Elbe River.

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND
location: Skokanský areál u Ski Ještěd, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Summer Running Weekend is a trail running weekend race held in the beautiful environment of the Ski Jumping Area at Ski Ještěd in the Liberec Region. It offers various running disciplines including a 24-hour run, marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from experienced ultramarathoners to families with children. The routes lead through picturesque mountain terrain with significant elevation changes and stunning views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Picturesque mountain routes on the Ještěd Ridge
Significant elevation gain up to 1390 m on longer distances
Various race lengths including 24-hour run, marathon, and shorter runs
additional: The race offers various running disciplines including a 24-hour run, marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The routes are challenging with significant elevation changes and lead through mountain terrain. The event includes facilities with refreshments and accommodation options. There are children's races on shorter distances for kids. The races take place on terrain around the ski jumping hills, with registration and detailed route information available on the website. The event also features trail camps, merchandising, partner zones, and ecological measures.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné na charitativní účely, přesná částka není uvedena
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk 'In the Footsteps of Silver A', organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the registration fee is donated to charitable causes. The run offers two routes - a shorter five-kilometer and a longer ten-kilometer, and there is also a children's race approximately one kilometer long. Additionally, there is a guided city walk to places associated with the Silver A landing, starting from the Zámeček Memorial.
course_highlights: Two running routes: 5 km and 10 km
Children's race approx. 1 km
Guided city walk following the Silver A landing
additional: Registration begins at 2:00 PM, with the event expected to end at 6:00 PM. The registration fee includes a public transport ticket. Online registration is available until June 11, after which registration can be done on-site on the day of the event. The proceeds from the registration fee are allocated to charitable purposes, specifically for the purchase of a stroller for four-year-old Viktorka, who has an autism spectrum disorder. Routes include 5 km, 10 km, and a children's race, with a guided city walk starting from the Zámeček Memorial. The registration fee includes a public transport ticket, supports local charity, and promotes historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh
location: Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Hradecký koloběh is a mixed pairs race held in the beautiful environment of the city forests with the starting point at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling, with one team member running and the other cycling, and exchanges between competitors are allowed at any time during the race, adding strategy and dynamism. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of movement and offers OPEN and FAMILY categories. The race is supported by the city of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organizational service.
course_highlights: Beautiful environment of city forests
Combination of running and cycling with free exchanges between competitors
Start at Biřička in Nový Hradec Králové
additional: The start package includes a race number, organizational support, baggage storage, toilets, event staff, refreshments at the finish line, and photographs (not guaranteed for everyone). Facilities include toilets, storage, catering, and parking. It is recommended to park in the parking lot on Partyzánská Street; parking is prohibited on Mužíkova Street, where the situation is monitored by the municipal police. Prizes are awarded for 1st to 3rd place in categories. Terrain: 90% forest paths, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain of 108 meters. Categories OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký cross-country is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging route approximately 5.7 km long with an elevation gain of around 178 meters. The start and finish are located at the football field near Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for competitors including parking, changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows, includes running over a wooden bridge, asphalt roads, and a climb to Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The route crosses a wooden bridge over Ohrazenický Stream
Challenging ascent to Vystrkov Hill with an elevation gain of about 30 m
Surface of the course combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows
additional: Facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a refreshment stand. Registration is possible until June 13, 2026, at 17:00, or on-site on the race day. Children's races are part of the program. The course has an elevation gain of +178m and -187m, with start and finish at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. The course is approximately 5.7 km long, terrain: asphalt, forest paths, meadows; children's races; start at the football field near Biokoupaliště.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the picturesque streets of the city, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and provides a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy quality facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban environment with cultural monuments
Part of the RunCzech running league with professional organization
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo, and accompanying activities. Registration is done via the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Jindřichohradecký half marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of the running race, offering a unique experience combining the picturesque historic city center, water-side sections, and natural passages with significant elevation changes. The race is open to individuals for 21.1 km, as well as teams in relay races, families, and schools in shorter runs. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans, music, and organizational support including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also prepared, focusing on team cooperation rather than time. The race starts on June 13, 2026, and participants will receive an original medal and can win material prizes.
course_highlights: Beautiful combination of city and nature - historic streets and peaceful countryside around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along water and natural passages with notable elevation changes
Unforgettable atmosphere with fans, music, and encouragement on the track
additional: The race program includes the Rebel Run start at 15:00, Family Run at 16:00, and the main half marathon and relay race at 17:00. There are refreshment stations, showers, baggage storage, professional photos and videos from the track and finish line. The Rebel Run is a special team race for elementary schools, where the focus is on teamwork and participation rather than time. The course passes through the historic center and natural passages, with various races including relays, family, and school runs, as well as refreshments, showers, facilities, medals, and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
description: LEKI Ještěd Summer - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountainous terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are designed for a wide range of runners from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances from 200 meters up to 42 km. The event takes place in a picturesque setting near the ski jumps on Ještěd and offers a unique outdoor running experience with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by accompanying programs, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation nearby the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with elevation gain up to 1390 m
Routes of various lengths from children's races to 42 km ultramarathon
Scenic environment of Ještěd Ridge with views and technical sections
additional: The winners' announcement takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the area near the ski jumps on Ještěd. There are children's races, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Accommodation and volunteer support are available. The routes are technically demanding with significant elevation gain. The race emphasizes ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities during the weekend.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs are a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. This race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a pleasant park environment with a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the broader Běžce Podblanicka race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and community gathering of athletes in the region.
course_highlights: Run in Castle Park Neveklov
Natural and peaceful park environment
Traditional regional running event
additional: The races are part of the Běžec Podblanicka cup, with various courses from 50 m to 5 km, offering a sporting experience in nature for the general public.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
location: Dolní Morava, Jeseníky, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jeseníky Race 2026 is a technical trail run in the beautiful nature under the Kralický Sněžník, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The courses are prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and mainly lead through natural terrain. Participants will enjoy professionally marked trails, chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts who want to experience epic views and an atmosphere that cannot be found elsewhere.
course_highlights: Main route 23.5 km with an elevation gain of 830 m
Alternative route 11.3 km with an elevation gain of 410 m
Kari Traa RUN 7 km with an elevation gain of 230 m
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the rescue app. The registration fee includes a start number, chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish, and access to facilities at the start and finish areas. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The race offers registration, timing, medals, and other amenities. The courses are set in mountain environments with technical trail sections and are suitable for both experienced and beginner trail runners. The race is held in June 2026.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhelský Run is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Českolipsko, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a natural environment with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhelský Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Okrouhlá
Picturesque views and peaceful environment
Part of the District Running League of Českolipsko
additional: Part of a series of regional races including cross-country and half marathons, exact race distances are not specified

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
location: Vojtanov, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost tip of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometer route with an elevation gain of 2,174 meters. The course passes over five peaks of Egerland and combines asphalt roads, cycling trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sports challenge and stunning panoramas. Organizers emphasize precise timing and runner safety. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Vojtanov and also offers relay and duathlon pairs options.
course_highlights: 91 km route with an elevation gain of 2174 m
Five peaks of Egerland: Kapellenberg, Háj Aš, Zelená hora Bismarck, Dyleň, Lesný
Combination of asphalt roads, cycling trails, and forest terrain
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Vojtanov. Timing is provided by passive or active chips with high accuracy. Participants receive a functional T-shirt with the logo and a finisher medal. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish line. The relay race is for teams of 3 to 6 runners with at least one woman in the team. The duathlon pairs event combines a runner and a cyclist in a fixed order of segments. The race is authorized by the Forests of the Czech Republic and the Slavkov Forest Protected Landscape Area. Registration requires a team with at least one woman, the time limit is 18 hours, the entry fee is 2400 CZK paid in cash on site. Accommodation is not provided.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: The Pajrek Run is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, in the area below the ski slope in Nýrsko. The race offers a course of 8.6 km (2 laps) for men and 4.2 km (1 lap) for women, with an elevation gain of 152 meters per lap. The finish line is located at the same place as the start. The event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Ešus League, with refreshments provided on site. Organizers warn of possible route changes due to construction modifications and provide material prizes for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Course for men 8.6 km (2 laps), for women 4.2 km (1 lap)
Elevation gain of 152 m per lap, course includes uphill and downhill sections
Finish at the same location as the start in the area below the ski slope
additional: Registration on-site from 12:00 to 13:45. Payment to account with note including name, surname, year of birth. All participants run at their own risk. Refreshments available on site. Material prizes for the top three in each category. The organizer reserves the right to change the route due to construction work. The race takes place at Pajrek, registration is possible on-site, and the event is part of a series of local running races, with registration from 12:00 to 13:45 on the race day.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: The Brutálfutás 15.0 is a light obstacle course race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can complete a 2, 3, or 7-kilometer course that combines a military training ground and obstacle race. The race is not about performance but about good mood and unforgettable experiences, with mud and water guaranteed. Participants are greeted with a unique finisher medal and lots of mud, and can also register as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of settlements across the country and is a truly entertaining, family-friendly event.
course_highlights: A mix of military training ground and obstacle race
Lots of mud and water, unforgettable obstacles
Unique finisher medal and party atmosphere
additional: Registration is only possible online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. The race takes place at the Nyáregyháza MotoCross track, easily accessible from the M5 motorway. Student discounts are available upon presentation of a school attendance certificate and student ID for school-aged students. Classic running gear is not required for the race; good mood and a sense of adventure are most important. Cross-country running, online and on-site registration, unique finisher medal, challenging obstacles, and a mud-filled course.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is a charming evening running race scheduled for June 13, 2026, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Strand and Thermal Bath. During the race, runners will pass by the riding hall as well as the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park. The race starts at sunset with special atmospheric lighting, and participants can choose from three distances, including a relay half marathon. Runners receive a premium start package with BioTechUSA refreshments, and everyone finishing within the time limit will receive a unique finisher medal.
course_highlights: The running course passes by the riding hall
Crosses the Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park area
Evening start at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting
additional: BioTechUSA refreshments are provided at refreshment points during the race. Start packages include an optional ECO or premium package, with the premium package containing a Mizuno event T-shirt. At the finish line in the Athletes Garden, finishers are greeted with a unique finisher medal. The race starts in the evening at sunset, making summer heat less of an issue. There are time limits for the 5.25 km, 10.5 km, and half marathon distances; there are no time limits for the preschool and family runs. The race office is located in Budapest, on Tüzér Street, with opening hours and a phone contact. The event takes place in an environmentally friendly and family-friendly atmosphere, with the opportunity to purchase discounted bath entry after the race.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Edelény Castle Island Evening Circuits is a charming running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg castle. The race offers options for runners at multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the special atmosphere of the castle park and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timing and a convenient registration platform.
course_highlights: Running in the park of L'Huillier-Coburg castle
Evening atmosphere and unique environment
Multiple distances: 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km
additional: Registration is available at korido.hu, where chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided. Participants can choose from several distances, and the organizers will automatically send confirmation of registration and payment. Race bibs are provided, along with safety pins, and payment can also be made via SimplePay card. The race takes place over various terrains, including forest and asphalt sections, with RFID timing. Registration is done through korido.hu.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sports Festival is a traditional community sports event in Kecskemét, around the Benkó Hill. The aim of the event is to promote leisure physical activity and sports, welcoming participants in a friendly atmosphere with various running programs. In addition to running, charity events and community programs are also held, linking sports and social responsibility. Organizers warmly invite runners to enjoy the joy of movement and the proximity of nature together.
course_highlights: Running track around Benkó Hill in a pleasant natural environment
Community, family-friendly running events
Charity running programs and additional sports events
additional: The event also includes charity activities where proceeds support local foundations. There is usually a raffle among runners, and organizers provide refreshments and meals for participants. The event features ultramarathons, light runs, and other sports activities that encourage active participation of the location and community.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra distance that winds through the picturesque vineyards and hills of the Tokaj-Hegyalja region. The race offers three different distances, catering to both beginners and experienced runners seeking their ideal challenge. The event is not just a race but an experience set in one of Hungary's most beautiful wine regions. Starts are mass start, and participants receive refreshments along the route and at the finish line.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra distance through vineyards and hills
Legendary route of Tokaj-Hegyalja
Refreshments on the route and at the finish line
additional: The race includes individual and team categories, with teams of 2-4 members. Starts are mass start, with the latest start times for teams announced by June 5, 2026. Registration fees can be paid by credit card or bank transfer. Participants receive a downloadable electronic certificate, and related programs and discounts are available. The time limits are: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Age restrictions vary by distance, between 12 and 18 years. Three different distances are available; registration details are not provided. The race takes place around the Festival Theatre area.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: The Brutálfutás is a light obstacle course race in Nyáregyháza, offering unforgettable muddy and watery experiences on 2.3 and 7 kilometer distances. The race is a mix of military training ground and obstacle race, where fun and community experience are at the forefront. Participants, coming from hundreds of towns across the country, are greeted with a unique finisher medal and lots of mud. The event is not about seriousness but about entertainment and challenge, so anyone can find a suitable distance for themselves.
course_highlights: A mix of military training ground and obstacle race
Mud and water courses of 2.3 and 7 kilometers
Unique finisher medal and lots of mud
additional: Registration is only possible online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment can be made by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account registration is required for registration. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and lots of mud. The event welcomes participants with online registration, charity elements, and a festival atmosphere. The race offers both challenges and community experience.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros LETO je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave-Rači, ktoré ponúka tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením. Hlavná trať má 16 km s prevýšením 503 m, ďalšia trať 9,5 km s prevýšením 335 m a sú pripravené aj detské behy. Trate vedú prevažne lesným terénom s asfaltovými úsekmi a sú dobre značené tromi spôsobmi. Podujatie je vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a ponúka ocenenia pre najlepších v kategóriách. Štart je v Knižkovej doline a časový limit je 3 hodiny pre hlavnú trať.
course_highlights: Trať 16 km s prevýšením +503 m, časový limit 3 hodiny
Trať 9,5 km s prevýšením +335 m, časový limit 2 hodiny
Povrch: 80% les, 20% asfalt, značenie ružovými stuhami, bielymi šípkami a zalaminovanými šípkami na stromoch
additional: Trať je značená tromi spôsobmi: ružovými stuhami s potlačou preteku na stromoch, bielymi múčnymi šípkami na zemi a zalaminovanými šípkami na stromoch (modré, ružové, oranžové). Počet občerstvovačiek: 2 na 16 km trati, 1 na 9,5 km trati. Povinná výbava je štartové číslo upevnené na hrudi viditeľne. Vyhodnotenie pretekárov je krátko po dobehu. Trať je prevažne lesná s asfaltom; registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste; súčasťou sú detské behy s medailami a cenami; podujatie je súčasťou série Račiansky kros s viacerými edíciami počas roka.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v meste Vranov nad Topľou, ktorý ponúka trate na 10 km a 5 km. Pretek je organizovaný Mestom Vranov nad Topľou, Mestským športovým klubom a Mestským domom kultúry. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom sú vyhodnocovaní aj najlepší traja bežci z Vranova. Štart a cieľ sú pri Dome kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, od rekreačných bežcov po súťažiacich.
course_highlights: Trate na 10 km a 5 km v meste Vranov nad Topľou
Kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia vrátane vyhodnotenia najlepších Vranovčanov
Štart a cieľ pri Dome kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou
additional: Kategórie pretekov sú rozdelené na 10 km (muži a ženy podľa vekových skupín) a 5 km (muži a ženy bez kategórií). Štartovné je 15 € pri online registrácii a 20 € pri registrácii na mieste. Organizátormi sú Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub a Mestský dom kultúry. Kontaktnou osobou je Eva Fedorňáková s telefónnym číslom 0917 127 502. Pretek ponúka kategórie na 10 km a 5 km, štartuje sa v priestoroch Domu kultúry, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: Čeľovská sedmička je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom. Pretek je určený pre rôzne kategórie vrátane mužov, žien, rodín a detí, pričom ponúka letnú prechádzku a súťaž pre najmenších bežcov. Podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej komunity Beh.sk a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v príjemnom prostredí obce.
course_highlights: Udalosť sa koná pred Kultúrnym domom v Čeľovciach
Podujatie je určené pre rôzne vekové kategórie a rodiny
Dátum konania je 14. jún 2026
additional: Miesto štartu je pred Kultúrnym domom v Čeľovciach. Kategórie zahŕňajú mužov, ženy, rodiny a deti, vrátane najmenších bežcov a letnej prechádzky. Pretek je súčasťou miestnych aktivít a je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny, vrátane detí a rodín.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 je bežecký pretek organizovaný Obecným úradom Mlynčeky a športovými nadšencami z Mlynčekov. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku v Mlynčekoch a ponúka príležitosť pre bežcov zažiť atmosféru športového podujatia v krásnom prostredí. Štartovné je dostupné za zvýhodnenú cenu pri včasnej registrácii, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj v deň pretekov. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov a športových nadšencov na tomto tradičnom podujatí.
course_highlights: 15 km trať v malebnej prírode Mlynčekov
Súčasť OCR pretekov vrátane Barbarian a Spartan
Priaznivé ceny štartovného, 10 € pri prihlásení do 21.6.2024
additional: Štartovné sa platí pri prezentácii v deň pretekov. Organizátorom je Obecný úrad Mlynčeky a športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov. Miesto štartu je futbalové ihrisko v Mlynčekoch. Startovne: 10€ pri prihlásení do 21.6.2024, 12€ pri prihlásení v deň pretekov; miesto konania: Futbalové ihrisko, Mlynčeky

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Castle Park Run in Kravaře is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský Running Club Kravaře, held in the picturesque castle park in Kravaře. The race offers a main course of 8.7 km for adults and shorter distances for children according to age categories. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course is run over three loops within the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with pleasant facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through three loops in the castle park
Surface made of gravel paths
Main course length of 8.7 km for adults
additional: Registration for children is from 8:30 to 9:10, children start at 9:15. Children's categories are divided by age with course lengths from 150 m to 1800 m. Refreshments for adults include cake and drinks, children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. Trail run on gravel paths in the castle park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments, and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Half Marathon around Prague 4 is a unique individual running race that offers a meditative running experience on a varied profile city trail. The course measures approximately 21 kilometers and runs around the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, allowing participants to get to know the local geography and their own running form. The race takes place without a mass start; runners start individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, which eliminates stress and crowding at the start and on the course. After a successful premiere, this half marathon is held for the second time and is suitable for everyone who wants to combine athletic performance with a pleasant experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: City trail with a varied profile
Circuit approximately 21 km around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00 without mass gathering
additional: The race is individual with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00; participants can run alone or in groups, using a map on their mobile or on paper. The race is held without crowds at the start, on the course, or at the finish, ensuring a relaxed experience. The course is marked, with a start between 9:00 and 10:00, and the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series. Running is at your own risk; extra caution is advised when crossing roads.

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country running at the Chábory health area is a traditional race organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Chábory, held in the picturesque health area near Dobruška. The race offers a main run of 10,000 meters and additional categories on a 3,330-meter circuit, designed for men, women, juniors, and the general public from 4 to 90 years old. The event is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix in running and is suitable for all generations with the motto "BE FIT!". Participants can look forward to diplomas, material prizes, and a raffle, with the overall winner of the main race receiving a traveling trophy.
course_highlights: Circuit of 3,330 meters on field and forest paths
Main race of 10,000 meters
Categories for everyone from 4 to 90 years old
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:30, with an entry fee of 50 CZK paid during registration as a contribution to administration and refreshments. Results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Runners participate at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race will be held on June 14, 2026, with registration possible until June 13, 2026, 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000-meter race, shorter distances are available. Awards include diplomas, prizes, and a trophy for the overall winner.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Chaloupecký cross country is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and is suitable for the general public without children's categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Course lengths: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Children's races are not part of this event. The course surface is a combination of asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Distances: 8 km and 4 km, start at 10:00 AM, no children's races, different lengths for various categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Border Runner is a traditional and prestigious uphill running race held in the picturesque environment near the forest theater at Úhlava in Nýrsko. The 5 km course with an elevation gain of 380 meters passes through the ruins of Pajrek Castle and ends at the top of Hraničář with a stunning view of Ostrý Hill. The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own.
course_highlights: Start at the forest theater near Úhlava
Elevation gain of 380 meters over 5 km course
Finish at the top of Hraničář with a view of Ostrý Hill
additional: The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own. The race includes a main category of 5 km and children's runs; registration takes place on-site from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mainly trail with a hilly profile and an ascent to the top of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Climbing Dívčí Hrad is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 meters, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. This race is part of the Hill Running series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race attractive to mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts. The race is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength in a hilly environment.
course_highlights: Length of the course 2 km with an elevation gain of 135 m
Challenging uphill run in Prague's Hlubočepy
Part of the Hill Running series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race is part of the cycling segment - duathlon, with the possibility of participating in various categories and results recorded by over 78 runners in the past.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 mountain running race will be held in the picturesque surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild parts of the Sopron Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km, and 25.9 km, with the Alpokalja Trail King series also included. The race features a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the best male and female runners will receive a prize. The race headquarters is located at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, which has restrooms and showers available.
course_highlights: Wildly scenic terrain in the Sopron Mountains
Timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances
Refreshment points on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances, environmentally friendly with no cups
additional: The start and finish are at Brennbergbánya main square. The award ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish line. Showers and restrooms/WC are available at the race headquarters. Due to environmental reasons, no cups will be provided at the refreshment points; participants are advised to bring their own water bottles or cups. Registration is done online via the E-registration system, with the deadline on June 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM. The race offers special prizes for the challenging uphill sections. The organizers implement eco-friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: The Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race between the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views and challenging ascents. The race takes place in a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet each other year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but registration without a medal is also possible. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards. The start/finish area is located at the Lussonium Romkert, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views between Paks-Dunakömlőd hills
Challenging ascents and varied terrain
Exciting start/finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and a maximum of 400 entries, including up to 100 preschool and elementary school children. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. The finisher medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at Lussonium Romkert in Dunakömlőd, offering sports opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a diverse trail running event offering various distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near the Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race is held over four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), mid-distance (13.5 km), and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km warm-up lap in the castle park. The courses traverse varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refresh at aid stations. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and organizers pay special attention to participants' safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on mini, 595 m+ on mountain half marathon
Two refreshment stations on the course, three on the mountain half marathon, use of personal soft-cup recommended
additional: The race starts twice: at 9:00 for the Mountain Half Marathon, and at 9:30 for the Mini, Short, and Mid-distance races. Use of a personal "soft-cup" is mandatory at aid stations during the mountain half marathon. The race is timed electronically, with rescue systems provided by off-road vehicles and medical personnel. Registration is available on SPORTNAPTAR.HU, with pre-registration from December 6, 2025. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The event features multiple distances, refreshment stations, medical services, parking, and an auto-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and an impressive start/finish location. The race takes place in a friendly, family-like atmosphere, where participants of all ages can test their strength over various distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, with an option for a cheaper registration without a medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, and on-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and first aid are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging ascents on the trail
Impressive start and finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and accepts up to 400 registrations, including a maximum of 100 preschool and elementary school children. On-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are provided. Finish medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Multiple distances, family and children categories, hilly terrain, medals, and refreshments are available for participants.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
location: Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: UniCredit Prague Relay is a team running race held on June 16, 2026, in Prague, offering a relay run in four segments of 5 km each. The race starts at 6:00 PM in Stromovka Park, directly in front of Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The race is designed for teams and is suitable for corporate team building, school events, or other groups seeking a sporting atmosphere and shared fun. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering for participants and their fans is available.
course_highlights: Team relay run 4 x 5 km
Start and finish in Stromovka Park, Prague
Easy tram access to Výstaviště Holešovice station
additional: Team Box offers a fully equipped tent with catering, alcohol and non-alcoholic drinks, electrical connection, and branding for 50 visitors. Only runners with bib numbers ending in "A" will be allowed at the start. It is strictly forbidden to use skates, bikes, strollers, run with dogs, or bring children onto the track. The race takes place in Stromovka Park with options for team registration, refreshments, and an accompanying program including an evening party. The start and finish are at Výstaviště Praha Holešovice.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Otakara Pachmanna Cross is a race 4.4 km long, run through terrain in the beautiful environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4. This race is part of the SABZO series and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy natural terrain and forest atmosphere. It is suitable for everyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a sporting challenge in a peaceful forest setting.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 4.4 km
Trail running in Krč Forest
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, offering various course lengths including 6 km, 3 km, 12 km, and activities for families with children in Krč Forest.

name: 401. Malá cena Monaka
location: Restaurace Monako, Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Little Monaco Run is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This race is part of the long-standing history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on interesting courses. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience the atmosphere of a quality sporting event in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place around the Monaco restaurant in Slatiňany
A traditional running event with a long history in the Pardubice Region
Friendly atmosphere and quality organization by the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race date is set for June 17, 2026. Precise information about the course length and registration is not currently available.

name: Běh olympijského dne
description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee, taking place as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín. This run connects different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, with the race complemented by sports and educational activities. The registration fee supports children's sports through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to experience the joy of movement and support a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes for adults and children of various age groups
Time measurement with chip timing
Start and registration on the meadow near the sports complex Komec, Brno - Komárov
additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not possible. The first 150 adults and 70 children registered by March 31 will receive a free T-shirt (registration with T-shirt and size selection required). The route is not wheelchair or handbike accessible. Facilities include a changing room, storage, and toilets. Time measurement is provided by chip timing. Registration begins on June 19, 2026; the event takes place in Zlín as part of Olympic Day; focused on promoting friendship and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Zlín
location: Stadion mládeže, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Zlín is a traditional sporting event held at the Youth Stadium. The race offers a classic five-kilometer course on a tartan track for adults and several children's races over shorter distances. The event supports sports participation for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the registration fee donated to the Czech Olympic Committee. Registrations are conducted online, and the race starts at 6:00 PM, broadcast live on Czech Radio.
course_highlights: 5 km course on a tartan track at the Youth Stadium in Zlín
Children's races over 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 1500 m
The course is accessible for wheelchair users and handbikes
additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not possible. Children's participation on the adult course is not permitted in Zlín. The course is measured with chip timing. Facilities include toilets, a storage area, and changing rooms. Parking is available on Hradská Street and at the public parking lot in front of the Department Store. The race capacity is 300 adults and 200 children. The race will be started live on Czech Radio. Multiple runners can be added to one shopping cart during registration. The races include distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 5 km, with participation allowed for disabled persons and children with parental consent. The event features chip timing and parking nearby the stadium.

The race is open to adults and children, with children's races on 500 and 1000 meter distances. The main adult race over 5 km starts at 6:00 PM and is held under the auspices of Czech Radio. Participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation through their registration fee. Online registration is available until June 5, 2026; registration on-site will not be possible.
course_highlights: Flat course along a country road and meadow around the Jizera River
Finish on an inline track
Children's races on 500 m and 1000 m
additional: Registration is only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration will not be possible. The main race will be started via the Czech Radio broadcast. Timing is not chip-based. Parking is available near the venue, and toilets and showers are provided. Children born in 2011 or later can participate with parental consent. Children on the adult course are allowed to start at this location. The organizer reserves the right to adjust children's categories based on the number of registrants. Races for children and adults are held, with part of the proceeds going to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Parking, toilets, and facilities are available at the venue.

name: Olympijský běh - Bedřichov
location: Bedřichov v Jizerských horách, Liberecký, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Bedřichov is the largest domestic running event, marking the start of the Olympic Day celebrations at over 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of the Jizerské Mountains with a course length of 5 km. The main category starts at 6:00 PM at the stadium in Bedřichov. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the sporting spirit and Olympic values.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the Jizerské Mountains
Start and finish at the stadium in Bedřichov
Mixed race type suitable for various runners
additional: The race is part of the Olympic Day celebrations at over 90 locations in the Czech Republic. Organized by a team under the Czech Athletic Federation. Start and finish are at the stadium in Bedřichov in the Jizerské Mountains. The course is intended for participants born in 2010 and older; children born in 2011 and younger may participate with parental consent. Capacity is 200 adult and 200 children's runners. description: The Olympic Run in Brno is a popular regional running race taking place on June 17, 2026. The race is open to a wide age range from children to seniors and offers courses for both adults and children categories. The adult course measures 5 km and runs through the picturesque village along a stream with a turnaround at an oak tree. Children's races are held on a track around a football field. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

Children's races on a track around a football field
The course is not wheelchair or handbike accessible

Children's categories are for children born in 2011 and earlier; children can also run on the adult course with parental consent. The main race starts at 18:00, with packet pick-up from 16:00. The event is supported by the Czech Olympic Foundation.

The event is combined with the celebration of Olympic Day during a sports program, with the main race starting at 6:00 PM and broadcast live on Czech Radio. Registration is only available online until June 5, 2026, and the entry fee contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Participants are provided with chip timing, changing rooms, a storage area, and toilets.

Children's races of 400 m and 800 m by age categories
Main race start at 6:00 PM with broadcast from Czech Radio

name: Olympijský běh - Budyně nad Ohří
location: T.J. Sokol Budyně nad Ohří, Budyně nad Ohří, Czech Republic
description: Olympic run in Budyně nad Ohří is a traditional sporting event held at the tennis courts of T.J. Sokol Budyně nad Ohří. The main race over 5.8 km takes participants through fields, a small forest, and a gentle hill, with a surface combining asphalt, field, and forest paths. There are races for children over 400 m and 1000 m, which take place in a safe environment around the tennis courts. The event is part of Olympic Day, promoting sporting values and friendship, and also contributes to the Czech Olympic Committee Foundation to support children's sports.

The track surface is a combination of asphalt, field, and forest paths
Children's races take place on circuits around the tennis courts
