During the race, participants will enjoy greenery, mature trees, and peaceful parts of the park without significant elevation changes. The event is both a sports and social gathering with an accompanying program, refreshments, and the opportunity to cheer along the track. The registration fee contributes to the Czech Olympic Fund, supporting children's sports.

The course is clear, safe, and without significant elevation changes

description: The Olympic Run in Čelákovice is a traditional running race with its fifth edition in 2026. The race offers two routes for adults, 5 km and 10 km, which run along flat terrain along the Elbe River with beautiful views and interesting sites such as the railway bridge, St. Wenceslas Chapel, and the courtyard of the Municipal Museum. For children, shorter distances from 200 m to 1500 m are prepared, which also pass through the municipal museum. The start and finish are at the athletic track of the municipal stadium in Čelákovice. Registration is available online until June 5, 2026, and the main race starts at 6:00 PM.
course_highlights: Routes run upstream along the Elbe River with views of the river
The ten-kilometer route includes meadows, forest paths, and the historic site of the Municipal Museum
The entire route is flat with minimal elevation gain
additional: Registrations are only accepted online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration will not be possible. The start of the main race will be broadcast from Czech Radio. Included in the registration fee is a functional ALPINE PRO T-shirt, from which 20 CZK is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Children born in 2011 or later can run the adult route only with parental consent. It is possible to register multiple runners at once in one shopping cart. If you fill in a nickname by May 7, it will be printed on the start number. The route is flat, registration only online until June 5, 2026, the main race starts at 6:00 PM, with the possibility to try the OCR park, food trucks for refreshments, accompanying program, parking on U Kapličky and Na Nábřeží streets.

name: Olympijský běh - Červená Lhota
location: Červená Lhota, Jindřichův Hradec, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Červená Lhota is a traditional race that starts at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle. Participants will run along the blue tourist trail through the villages of Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of the Kardaš pond, mainly on field and forest paths. The start is ceremoniously initiated with a shot from a historical firearm, and by participating, you support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is open to adults over 15 years old and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere with refreshments provided by volunteer firefighters.
course_highlights: Start at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle
The route follows the blue tourist trail through Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of Kardaš pond
Mainly on field and forest paths
additional: The start and finish are at different locations: start at Červená Lhota Castle, finish in Kardašova Řečice at the cider house. Participants are transported by bus from the registration site (Kardašova Řečice cider house) to the start. There are changing rooms, a storage area, and toilets available; showers are not provided. Refreshments are arranged by volunteer firefighters. The race is started with a shot from a historical firearm by the castle steward. Registration is only available online; on-site registration is not possible. The race is for runners over 15 years old; younger participants are not permitted at this location. Timing is measured with a chip timing system. Terrain: field and forest paths. Registration deadline: June 7, 2026. Start time: at Červená Lhota Castle at 18:00. Race distance: 9.2 km. Age requirement: from 15 years old. No participation for disabled or under 15. Transportation: bus from Kardašova Řečice. Facilities: changing rooms, storage, toilets; no showers. The program includes the start, refreshments, and award ceremony.

description: Olympic run in Červené Pečky is a new location in the Kolín region, offering a course suitable even for beginners. The main race for adults measures 4.5 km and mostly runs through easy terrain around a football field and a local forest, with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Shorter courses adapted to children's age and performance are prepared for kids. The event is part of the Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation, with part of the entry fee donated to promote sports among children.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course for adults with predominantly easy terrain and a local forest
Children's races of 200 m, 500 m, and 1500 m adapted to their age
Start and registration at the football field with accessible parking
additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not possible. Children's start on the adult course is permitted at this location, but the course is not wheelchair or handbike accessible. Timing is not chip-based. There are changing rooms, a storage area, toilets, and showers available. Parking is available directly on-site. The program begins with the distribution of start packages at 15:00, children's races start at 16:00, the main adult race starts at 18:00, and the results ceremony is scheduled for 19:00. Registration is possible online until June 5, 2026. The main race starts at 18:00. Parking is available on-site. Timing is not chip-based.

By participating, you contribute to the account of the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children's sports.

Parking is possible at the Crystal Cultural House approximately 150 meters from the stadium. The race capacity is 200 adult participants. The main race will be started via the Czech Radio broadcast. A portion of each registration fee goes to support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The terrain includes the city stadium and a trail along the river; registration only online until June 5, 2026; proceeds support the Czech Olympic Foundation.

description: The Olympic Run in České Budějovice is a traditional race for enthusiasts of challenging terrain. The 7 km route passes through the ford at U Špačků, along the right bank of the Malše River to Roudné and back to the boatyard. The race is open to adults and children, with children's races having their own 1.5 km route. Participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation through their registration fee. The main race starts at 6:00 PM at Hanace boatyard in České Budějovice.

additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026, and on-site registration is not possible. The route is not adapted for wheelchairs or handbikes. Timing is not chip-based. There are changing rooms, a storage area, and toilets available. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, or by public transport (bus No. 10). Parking is available at the boatyard or near the footbridge over the Malše River. The race capacity is 120 adults and 60 children. Children are not allowed to start on the adult route. The course includes crossing the Malše River ford. Registration online until June 5, 2026. Start at 6:00 PM. The race is supported by the Czech Olympic Foundation. It is intended for adults and children up to 15 years old. Location: Hanace boatyard, České Budějovice.

The run has a symbolic character with obstacles and promotes education and integration of children with disabilities.

name: Radimovický koňák
location: Radimovice u Želče, Jindřichův Hradec District, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Radimovický koňák is a traditional cross-country race held in the village of Radimovice near Želč, which attracts runners of all ages every year. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of South Bohemia and offers the opportunity to test strength from the youngest children to adult men, who form the largest category. The event has a long-standing tradition and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the natural environment of Radimovice near Želč
Categories from the youngest children to adult men
Traditional event with a long history
additional: The event is part of the local calendar of sports events, offers local specialties and symbolic prizes, and the races are open to all age groups.

description: Run Forests Team Race is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of Vysočina, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different circuits with a total length of approximately 27.5 km, which each participant must complete during the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and difficulty. In addition to the race, a rich accompanying program is prepared, including sports activities, cultural events, and workshops. The event is supported by a comfortable camp with sanitary facilities and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three circuits with a total length of about 27.5 km and elevation gain of 100 to 300 m
Night run with headlamp as part of the relay race
Forest trails in the heart of Vysočina with varying difficulty levels of the circuits
additional: Start number includes a timing chip and gifts from partners. The team captain must enter the order of runners into the SportID system by June 17, 2026. On-site registration is not possible. A camp with the option to pitch tents and park motorhomes is available, along with sanitary facilities with showers and hot water, refreshments at the PENNY tent, and an accompanying program including sports activities, concerts, and workshops. Disposable cups are not provided at refreshment stations; participants need to bring their own container (Speedcup). The race includes various categories of teams and individual runs, with options for overnight participation and as part of the Run Forests series, including ultramarathons and charity runs.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 14 - Večerní běh
location: Kejřov park, Praha 14, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Metropolitan Race of Prague 14 - Evening Run is part of the series of public running races BĚH METROPOLE, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and the community involvement of Prague residents with their city district. The race takes place in Kejřov Park and offers a pleasant evening running atmosphere with the opportunity to represent your city district. The start is scheduled for the evening, contributing to a unique urban running experience. Organizers emphasize competitiveness and community spirit among participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Evening run in Kejřov Park, Prague 14
Run in an urban environment with a cycle path
Atmosphere supporting a healthy lifestyle and community
additional: Race registration is from 18:45 to 19:15, with the race start at 19:30. The race takes place on the cycle path in Kejřov Park (GPS 50.10139790903832, 14.527847215343387). Organizers prepare special medals for individual categories as a memento of the race. The race is part of the Běhmetropole series and is suitable for the general public, offering an opportunity for an active evening in nature.

name: Okolo Rudného
location: Zborná u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Around Rudný is a running race in the Vysočina region, offering two courses: 8.2 km for men and 4.2 km for women. The race takes place on forest unpaved roads and trails, ensuring a pleasant running experience in nature. This race is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup and is suitable for runners seeking trail running with a moderate profile. Around Rudný is a traditional race that attracts runners from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Forest unpaved roads and trails
Two courses: 8.2 km for men and 4.2 km for women
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup
additional: The race is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup; specific registration information is not provided.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
price_range: 25,- € online, 35,- € na mieste (Skyrun); 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste (Skyshort)
description: Skyrun Kubínska je horský beh v krásnej prírode Oravy, ktorý ponúka trať s dĺžkou 24 km a 11 km. Pretek je venovaný pamiatke Barnabáša Üvegeša a pretekári si môžu vychutnať náročný terén s výhľadmi na okolitú prírodu. Bežci zažijú kombináciu horských chodníkov a prírodných scenérií, ktoré robia z tohto podujatia výnimočný zážitok.
course_highlights: Horské trasy v prírode Oravy
Dve varianty trate: 24 km a 11 km
Náročný terén s krásnymi výhľadmi
additional: Trail race s horským terénom, súčasťou je pamiatka na Barnabáša Uvegeša, pretek sa koná v júni 2026.

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
price_range: 5 € pre dospelých, zadarmo pre deti a mládež
description: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou je bežecké podujatie organizované v Ludrovskej doline pri futbalovom štadióne v Ludrovej. Preteky ponúkajú štart pre detské kategórie na tráve a pre dospelých kategórie na lesnej ceste a asfalte. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov od detí až po seniorov, s kategóriami rozdelenými podľa veku. Organizátormi sú Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová a Ružomberskie Strely o.z., ktorí zabezpečujú príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.
course_highlights: Detské kategórie bežia po tráve
Ostatné kategórie vedú po lesnej ceste a asfalte
Miesto štartu a cieľa je futbalový štadión v Ludrovskej doline
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 9:30 hod., hlavných kategórií o 10:30 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane dorastu a viacerých vekových skupín dospelých. Organizátori sú Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová a Ružomberskie Strely o.z. Kontakt na organizátora: Peter Laco, tel. 0905 284 430. Trať zahŕňa trávu, lesné cesty a asfalt; štartové časy o 9:30 a 10:30; registrácia je možná na mieste; kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny; dĺžky tratí od 60 m po 10 km

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo, známy ako Šariš Run, je bežecká udalosť konaná na brehu Rybníkov vo Veľkom Šariši pod historickým hradom Šariš. Táto lokalita je novinkou v sérii a získala si veľkú obľubu medzi bežcami. Podujatie je plné športového ducha, komunity a lásky k prírode, pričom ponúka aj bohatý sprievodný program vrátane hudobných vystúpení, zdravotných stánkov, relaxačnej zóny a aktivít pre deti. Atmosféra je priateľská a rodinná, čo robí z behu nezabudnuteľný zážitok pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie na brehu Rybníkov Veľký Šariš pod hradom Šariš
Nová lokalita v srdci Šariša s veľkým úspechom u bežcov
Prírodné prostredie s komunitnou a rodinnou atmosférou
additional: Podujatie ponúka bohatý sprievodný program vrátane hudobného vystúpenia skupiny Hrdza, stánkov so zdravotnými službami a kĺbovou výživou, relaxačnú zónu, stredoveké kostýmy s fotostenou a kráľovským trónom, aktivity pre deti a tombolu. Trať 10 km, detské behy, sprievodný program s hudbou, stánkami, aktivitami a tombolou, lokalita pod hradom Šariš

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
price_range: 20€ on-line, 21€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ on-line, 4€ na mieste pre deti
description: Beh cez Zalužické poľa je druhý ročník bežeckého podujatia, ktoré sa uskutoční 20. júna 2026 v lokalite Zalužice. Tento beh ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť prírodu a krásy Zemplína v letnom období. Podujatie je súčasťou série Zemplínsky extrém, ktorá prináša rôzne bežecké výzvy v regióne.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez prírodné polia v okolí Zalužíc
Lokalita v malebnom prostredí Michalovského okresu
Súčasť série Zemplínsky extrém s viacerými bežeckými podujatiami
additional: Pretek sa koná na asfaltových, poľných a trávnatých cestách; registrácia je dostupná online aj na mieste, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny

name: toRunská vrtuľa
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa je charitatívny bežecký a komunitný deň v krásnom prostredí vodnej nádrže Dubník v Starej Turej. Podujatie je zamerané na pohyb a pomoc, pričom všetky vyzbierané prostriedky zo štartovného sú venované na rehabilitácie dievčatka Simonky Zigovej. Bežecké dvojice majú 8 hodín na to, aby zabehli čo najviac okruhov okolo Dubníka, pričom atmosféra je priateľská a podporujúca. Organizátorky a dobrovoľníci zabezpečujú podujatie bez nároku na honorár, čím zdôrazňujú komunitný a charitatívny rozmer akcie.
course_highlights: Okruh okolo vodnej nádrže Dubník s dĺžkou cca 2,4 km
Bežecké dvojice majú 8 hodín na zabehnutie čo najväčšieho počtu okruhov
Príjemné prírodné prostredie a komunitná atmosféra
additional: Registrácia je možná ako dvojica alebo sólo bežec. Deti do 14,99 rokov sa registrujú na mieste za symbolické štartovné minimálne 5 € a prvých 100 detí dostane štartovací balíček. Prvých 170 prihlásených a zaplatených bežcov získa štartovací balíček a medailu. Počas behu je zabezpečený pitný režim a zdravé občerstvenie. Bežci si po každom okruhu musia nahlásiť prejdený okruh v check-line stane, kde im bude zapísaný bod. Podujatie končí vyhlásením výsledkov okolo 18:00. Podujatie je zamerané na pomoc mladému dievčatku Simonke Zigovej, organizuje ho bežecký klub toRun Stará Tura, je to charitatívny, komunitný a fundraisingový event s registráciou dostupnou online.

Pretekári sa musia popasovať s náročnými prekážkami a zdolať trasu vedúcu na vrchol druhej najvyššej vyhliadkovej veže na Slovensku s výškou 40 metrov, odkiaľ sú krásne výhľady. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými chodníkmi, lúkami a potokom s minimom asfaltu a obsahuje strmé stúpania a zbehy. Okrem športového zážitku je pripravený aj sprievodný program plný zábavy pre všetky vekové kategórie. Organizátorom je M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., riaditeľom pretekov Marek Janoštiak.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej, Chorvátsky Grob, Slovakia
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest je dvojdňový športový festival v Chorvátskom Grobe, ktorý spája profesionálnych športovcov aj rekreačných nadšencov všetkých vekových kategórií. Ponúka bežecké trate rôznych dĺžok, detské behy, cyklistické preteky a bohatý kultúrno-zábavný program vrátane food zóny a hudobných vystúpení. Podujatie podporuje komunitu a zdravý životný štýl v príjemnom prostredí s rôznorodými aktivitami pre všetkých návštevníkov.
course_highlights: 5 km WeLive beh po asfaltovej rovine
12 km Beh o pohár obce s 30% asfaltu a 70% terénu, prevažne rovina
Detské behy a cyklistické preteky rozdelené podľa vekových kategórií
additional: Prezentácia na mieste 5 km: 16:00 - 17:45, vyhlásenie výsledkov 19:15. Prezentácia na mieste 12 km: sobota 16:00 - 18:00, nedeľa 10:00 - 11:15, vyhlásenie výsledkov nedeľa 13:00. Povrch tratí je prevažne asfalt a terén s rovinatým profilom. Súčasťou festivalu sú aj florbalový turnaj, futbalový cup, cyklo zóna, food zóna a recovery zóna. Program zahŕňa aj hudobné vystúpenia a prezentácie miestnych organizácií. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero športových aktivít, koncerty, detské zóny, občerstvovacie stanice, zónu na regeneráciu a súťažné podujatia pre všetky vekové skupiny.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
location: Veliše, Podblanicko, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is an off-road race designed for capable runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque landscape of Podblanicko. The race offers two routes of 10 km and 5.2 km, mainly along field and forest paths, ensuring a pleasant running experience in nature. This race is ideal for everyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment and test their strength against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.
course_highlights: Routes mainly along field and forest paths
Picturesque landscape of Podblanicko
Two race options: 10 km and 5.2 km
additional: Children's races from 50 to 1000 meters, timed with stopwatches; the race is suitable for runners of various levels and offers a friendly atmosphere in nature.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic

description: Prague Park Race - Divoká Šárka is a running race held on June 20, 2026, in the beautiful nature of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views that participants can enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometers. The courses run on paved and unpaved paths, meadows, and trails, partly also on asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments on the track and at the finish line. Registration and check-in take place at the SK ARITMA complex in Prague - Vokovicích, which is easily accessible by public transport and car.
course_highlights: Routes run on paved and unpaved paths, meadows, and trails
Distances approximately 8 and 14 km with kilometer markers
The route includes a castle passage, two sections with stairs, and narrow trails
additional: Registration and check-in are from 9:00 to 10:45, children's races start at 10:00. On the 14 km route, there is a refreshment station around the 8th km, and refreshments are available for all at the finish. The race capacity is limited; registration is also possible on-site if capacity has not been reached. Recommended public transport to Nádraží Veleslavín station (700 m from the venue), parking at Džbán water reservoir (300 m). The race takes place in a natural environment, registrations are available on the website, and the event includes scenic trail routes of various lengths and difficulties.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Sportovní areál Jalovčí, Chudenice, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chudenice Žďár Run is a young cross-country race established in 2016, held in the picturesque autumn environment of Žďár hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run without asphalt sections, with a slightly hilly profile and an attractive climb of forest stairs to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located in the area of the local physical education unit. The main race measures 6.2 km and offers runners a challenge as well as beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Course without asphalt sections
Slightly hilly profile with a climb of forest stairs to Bolfánek
Start and finish in the area of the local physical education unit
additional: The race is part of the traditional and prestigious off-road running series in the Klatovy district called Ešus League. In previous years, the Ešus League races featured original prizes such as running caps, bottles with drinks, fairground pies, or Šumava cheeses. The course is known for measuring exactly 6.2 km if you do not get lost. The course is approximately 6.2 km long, suitable for all age categories, without asphalt sections, with a climb to Bolfánek. The race will take place in June 2026, on June 20th.

description: Run4Help 2026 is a charity run taking place on June 20, 2026, in Prague at Letenské sady Natural Park. The event offers races for adults over 4 km and 8 km, children's runs in various categories from birth to 14 years old, and a non-competitive run for people with disabilities over 1 km. The entry fee is donated to the non-profit organization No Foot No Stress, and each participant will receive a commemorative medal at the finish line. The race is suitable for both professional and amateur runners who want to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The route runs along wide paths in Letenské sady Natural Park
Charity run supporting the non-profit organization No Foot No Stress
Categories for children from birth to 14 years old and a special run for people with disabilities
additional: Registration on-site is possible without a package. The entry fee is free for people with disabilities and their companions. The program includes children's races, a non-competitive run for people with disabilities, and races of 4 km and 8 km. The charity run with proceeds supporting NO FOOT NO STRESS features various distances and accompanying activities.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout Troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is intended for both athletes and amateurs, who can choose the distance according to their abilities. It offers hobby category at 4.6 km, sport category at 9.2 km, and relay races consisting of 4 members (2 men + 2 women), with each running a 2.3 km loop. There are also children's races at various distances. The race atmosphere is friendly and supports a broad running community in the region.
course_highlights: Hobby category - 4.6 km (2 laps)
Sport category - 9.2 km (4 laps)
4-member relays (2 men + 2 women), each running a 2.3 km lap
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. The start of categories is staggered: first the sport category, after 2 minutes the hobby category, and after another 2 minutes the relays. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, and offers various distances based on age and performance. It is intended for different age groups, including children and relays, and takes place in the historic center of Příbor. Details about registration and the exact terrain are not specified.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Praha
location: Park u Čeňku, Sokolský ostrov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Color Run Neutečeš is a colorful run and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends. There are two routes to choose from: 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences filled with music, laughter, and colorful explosions. The run takes place in Prague in the Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island and is part of a year-round colorful tour across several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and Urban Challenge zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event is a full-day program from 8:00 to 17:00 in Prague, including music, themed zones, photo booths, 360° videos, and accompanying activities. The run is not about timing; children can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. It also includes a charitable project Color Run Heroes for children with disabilities. The festival features various color zones, music, activities, and is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place in Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island, emphasizing fun and community experiences.

name: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka
description: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka is a traditional running race held in Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the region. Participants can also order an original functional POHO50 T-shirt, which they can pick up on the race day. Registration is simple and allows for relay team registration with member management after paying the start fee.
course_highlights: Course approximately 50 km long around Karviná and Karvinská Lake
Shorter distances of 21 km, 10 km, and 6 km are also available
Natural scenery and diverse terrain around Karvinská Lake
additional: Option to order an original functional POHO50 T-shirt for 390 CZK, which participants will pick up on race day along with their bib number and race packet. Relay team registration allows for member management after paying the start fee. Participants consent to the processing of personal data and the creation of photo/video recordings for promotional purposes by the organizer. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, offers various race distances including an ultramarathon, and is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
location: Lhota nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Run Along the Footsteps of Jan Opletal and the Jiří Vace Memorial is a traditional running event organized by Jan Opletal Gymnasium in Litovel. This race commemorates significant personalities and the history of the school and the town. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Litovel and is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical undertone.
course_highlights: Start at the birthplace of Jan Opletal in Lhota nad Moravou
Race length of 8 km or 10 km depending on the year
Races include school teams and regional runs
additional: The races are held in June, often with the participation of school teams and as part of regional running series.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
location: Černín u Zdic, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Vraní Skála Run is a traditional running race held in Černín u Zdic, offering a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines steep road ascents, forest paths, and narrow trails leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling and mostly descending section with a steep downhill to the finish. The start is at the square in Černín u Zdic, and the main race begins at 10:30 AM. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and terrain with significant elevation changes.
course_highlights: Steep road ascent at the beginning up to 1 km
Moderate ascent along forest paths and narrow trails to the summit around Vraní Skála
Rolling mostly descending section and steep road downhill to the finish
additional: The registration fee is 200 CZK on-site, including a sausage. The course runs on both road and terrain. The race does not have children's races during the main event. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organizer is Instalatérství Ivan Raboch. The course is 9 km, start at 10:30 AM, no children's races, registration on-site, with a sausage included. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series with various distances and categories throughout May and June.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
location: Kozlovský kopec, Česká Třebová, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kozlovský Hill Run is a traditional Czech-Třebová road race uphill, taking place on June 20, 2026. The race starts at 10:00 AM from Habrmanova Street in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, with the finish line at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský Hill. The 5.2 km course with an elevation gain of 230 meters runs on asphalt surface and is considered one of the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Uphill Running Cup. Race facilities are located in the school building, where registration, changing rooms, and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted in advance online at a discounted fee or on the race day.
course_highlights: 5.2 km course with a 230 m elevation gain
Road uphill run with finish at Max Švabinský Cottage
The entire course runs on asphalt surface
additional: Race facilities are located in the building of the Gustava Habrmana Secondary Technical and Transport School, where athlete registration takes place and changing rooms and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted in advance online at a discounted fee or on race day. The race is part of regional cups, registration is possible online, start is on Habrmanova Street, and the finish is at Max Švabinský Cottage.

name: Běh Memoriálu Petry Hézlové - MPH 2026 Louny
location: Masarykovy sady, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 380 Kč (dospělí), 100 Kč (děti), 230 Kč (studenti/senioři), hromadná registrace 150 Kč/člen

tiers.description: Běh děti: registrace 100 Kč, děti do 2 let zdarma.

tiers.description: Hromadná registrace členů běžeckých klubů za zvýhodněnou cenu (150 kč/člen, minimální počet běžců klubu je 5)

description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charitable sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main race includes 5 km and 10 km courses for men, women, and students, measured with chip timing. The event is part of a sports afternoon for the whole family and features a rich accompanying program. All participants receive a commemorative wooden medal, and there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO brand running belt. The Memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.
course_highlights: Adult courses of 5 km and 10 km in Masaryk Gardens in Louny
Chip timing measurement
Children's races of 100 m, 400 m, and 1000 m according to age
additional: The start and finish are in Masaryk Gardens in Louny. Registration and bib distribution take place from 13:00 to 13:45. Children's races start after the main race at 15:45. All runners receive a commemorative wooden medal. In the evening, there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO running belt. The adult courses are available for download in GPX format. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration for running clubs is possible via email. The race includes children's races, family activities, chip timing, and a competition for a running belt; registration is available online and on-site; start and finish in Masaryk Gardens in Louny.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometer trail run held in Vrchlabí, which is part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course runs through mountain terrain with an elevation gain of approximately 903 meters and offers challenging conditions suitable for experienced runners. The event takes place annually in June and attracts participants from all over the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of mountain running.
course_highlights: Mountain terrains with an elevation gain of over 900 meters
Picturesque views of the Krkonoše Mountains and Vrchlabí
Part of the Krakonošova stovka series with a long tradition
additional: Start: June 16, 2026 at 11:00 AM, registration on-site at DDM Vrchlabí, the course includes the peak Žalý and other mountain locations

name: Jirkovský crossmarathon a půlmarathon
description: Jirkov Cross Marathon is a mountain marathon run through the Ore Mountains around the town of Jirkov, offering a personal approach to competitors. The race is designed for runners, cyclists, scooter riders, and hiking tourists, and includes a marathon, half marathon, and a shorter nine-kilometer route. The courses pass through beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains and are suitable for various athletic performances and recreational participation. The start and finish are at the 2nd Elementary School Jirkov, and the event takes place on June 20, 2026.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain of the Ore Mountains
Routes for running, cycling, scooter riding, and hiking
Picturesque views and natural scenery
additional: Registration and start for hiking tourists is from 7:00 to 8:30, start for cyclists and scooter riders at 9:00, runners at 9:05. The start and finish are at 2nd Elementary School Jirkov, Vinařická housing estate, Studentská street. The routes are updated and will be supplemented with refreshment and control points. The race also offers the possibility to walk the route on foot. Mountain terrain, routes for running, cycling, and scooter riding, half marathon since 2018, race in June 2026.

name: FarmaRun
location: Cyklostezka Varhany, Česká Lípa, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sports event organized by the Libchavští Chlupáči rescue farm in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main run of 5 km along a pleasantly shaded flat cycle path suitable for runners and walkers. For children, a short 300 m run is prepared, along with an exhibition race for the youngest under 4 years old right in the farm area. After the race, participants will receive commemorative medals, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for the whole family.
course_highlights: 5 km course runs along a shaded flat cycle path
Start in Česká Lípa, finish at the Libchavští Chlupáči rescue farm
Children's races over 300 m and an exhibition race for the youngest in the farm area
additional: At the finish line, each runner receives a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. The race for children under 4 years old is an exhibition fun race supervised by referees directly in the farm area. The event is focused on families and supporting the rescue farm. The races take place on the Varhany cycle path in Česká Lípa, registration via naZávody.cz, with an accompanying program throughout the day.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšský cross-country is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí Region. The race is open to all age categories and offers various distances, from children's runs to the men's category at 7,800 meters. The Lucky Náprstkov Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. Organized by the Czech Union of Sport, which supports the general public in active movement and sports.
course_highlights: Various distances for children and adults
Cross-country run in natural terrain in Louny
Lucky Náprstkov Memorial as part of the race
additional: The race is open to all categories, children run 100 m with parents, children from the preparation category run 500 m, men run 7800 m. Registrations and the schedule are available at www.askelna.cz. The Lucky Náprstkov Memorial commemorates a tragic event from 2002 in the High Tatras. The event is part of a broader series of sports events in the Czech Republic aimed at promoting active movement and sports participation among the general public.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The I. Midsummer Flash Run is a night running festival in Balatonszárszó, at the Lakeside Park, held on Midsummer Night. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes runners, families, and community sports enthusiasts. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers points collection opportunities for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night run along Lake Balaton
400m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
5.25 km course with refreshment points around 2.6 km
additional: Number pickup at 10:00 AM in Lakeside Park. The relay exchange takes place at the finish gate with a chip timing bib, and it is recommended to use a bib holder. The registration fee includes refreshments (grape sugar, biscuits, salty pretzels, mineral water, syrup, gummy candies). Residents of Balatonszárszó receive a 30% discount, and seasonal discounts are also available based on previous participation. Technical shirts can be purchased separately for 8,500 HUF. The event supports the Ötpróba program, offering discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running opportunities and awards for participants.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Saint László Trail Run is a traditional trail running race in the Gerecse Mountains near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint László, the patron saint of soldiers and infantry, and has been held regularly since 2010, with the exception of 2013 when it was canceled due to flooding. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly areas. The event is a lively, community-oriented occasion, suitable for those interested in outdoor activities and sports.
course_highlights: Varied terrain of the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
Nature-oriented, challenging running course
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which operates several sections including athletics, triathlon, orienteering, outdoor activities, sport shooting, and other sports. The event traditionally takes place in June, and the 2026 race will be the XVI. edition. Maps and previous results are available on the organizers' website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories, detailed information not provided.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný 2 míľový beh organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00 hod. Súčasťou je aj súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa bežci bodujú podľa výkonov a účasti v jednotlivých kolách.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 2 míle (3,218 km), deti cca 200 m
Trať vedie v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave
Prezentácia a registrácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 hod. Štart je o 10:00 hod. Kategórie: deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky, veteráni. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu s bodovaním podľa účasti a výkonov. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje najlepší čas po prepočte koeficientom a veľkosť topánky. Preteky sa konajú na Kuchajde, možnosť registrácie priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku; kategórie zahŕňajú deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov; pretek je súčasťou série 12 pretekov v roku 2025.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava je najväčší slovenský prekážkový pretek, ktorý sa koná v areáli Divoká Voda v Čunove. Pretekári prekonávajú viac ako 20 prekážok na trati približne 5 km, pričom môžu súťažiť v rôznych režimoch vrátane nesúťažného fitness režimu alebo časového merania. Po preteku si účastníci môžu oddýchnuť pri bazéne, vychutnať si občerstvenie a sledovať silové súťaže. Pretek je vhodný aj pre deti od 8 do 14 rokov a ponúka medailu, fotky a video z preteku ako spomienku na zážitok.
course_highlights: Trať cca 5 km s viac ako 20 prekážkami
Prekážky prispôsobené aj pre deti od 8 rokov
Pretek sa koná v areáli Divoká Voda, Čunovo s možnosťou oddychu pri bazéne
additional: Možnosť ísť Tvrďák 5+ km solo alebo v tíme (minimálne 3 osoby, zmiešaný tím možný). Režim Fitness (nesúťažne, bez merania času, bez trestných cvikov, prekážky možno vynechať) a režim Na čas (meranie času, trestné cviky pri nezdolaní prekážky). Po preteku oddych pri bazéne, občerstvenie, možnosť vyskúšať vodné športy a sledovať silové súťaže od 14:00. Štartovné sa nevracia, možnosť prevodu štartovného na inú osobu alebo na ďalší rok za poplatok. Podujatie zahŕňa aj detský pretek, tímové alebo individuálne štarty, a po preteku sú pripravené vodné aktivity a zábava pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
price_range: 15 € pre hlavnú trať, 3 € pre juniorov, 15 € pre Nordic Walking, zľavy pre seniorov
description: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Občianskym združením Bežci VK, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detí, hobby bežcov a Nordic Walking. Preteky sa konajú v meste Veľký Krtíš a zahŕňajú trate od 3 000 m až po hlavný pretek 11 000 m. Štart je rozdelený na deti o 09:45 a hlavnú kategóriu spolu s Nordic Walking o 11:00. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka zľavy pre seniorov nad 60 rokov.
course_highlights: Hlavný pretek 11 000 m mestskými ulicami
Hobby pretek 3 000 m
Nordic Walking trať 6 000 m
additional: Zľava 50 % na štartovnom pre vekovú kategóriu 60 rokov a viac. Registrácia na mieste je možná minimálne 30 minút pred štartom hlavného preteku za zvýšené štartovné 17 €. Trať zahŕňa mestské ulice a asfaltové cesty; registrácia online do 14. júna 2025; podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Hlavné námestie, Moldava nad Bodvou, Košice, Slovakia
description: Moldavský pohár Bodvy je medzinárodný cestný beh, cyklistika a inline preteky, ktoré sa konajú v Moldave nad Bodvou. Preteky ponúkajú rôzne kategórie pre bežcov, cyklistov a kolieskové korčule, s trasami vedúcimi cez okolitú prírodu a obce. Podujatie je známe svojou tradíciou a kvalitnou organizáciou, pričom štart a cieľ sú na Hlavnom námestí v Moldave nad Bodvou. Súčasťou je aj masový beh pre zdravie, ktorý umožňuje účasť širokej verejnosti.
course_highlights: Beh vedie cestou medzi Moldavou nad Bodvou a Jasovom a späť
Cyklistická trasa prechádza viacerými obcami vrátane Budulova, Janíka a Turnianskej Novej Vsi
Inline trasa má dĺžku 17,5 km a je súčasťou Slovenského inline pohára
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 7:00 do 8:30 hod. Vyhlasovanie víťazov prebieha pred budovou Strednej odbornej školy agrotechnickej. Finančné odmeny sú určené pre prvých troch pretekárov v mužských a ženských kategóriách, ostatní dostávajú medaily. Všetky súťažné kategórie sú vekovo ohraničené a pretekári sa môžu registrovať len do kategórie zodpovedajúcej ich veku. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií, online registráciu a podporu sponzorov.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main course of 7 km along forest paths and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and promotes active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families seeking a shared sporting activity. The race takes place on the last Saturday of June, with options to participate in other shorter routes and children's categories.
course_highlights: Course run along forest paths and local roads
Suitable for all age groups and families
Part of the Primátor Cup series with various lengths and categories
additional: Suitable for children, in all weather conditions, sports event, race in May and June, canceled in 2020

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
location: Plzeň, centrum města Plzně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Pilsen is a family running race with an atmosphere of joy and relaxation, suitable for both amateurs and elite runners. It offers various courses from children's runs through 3, 5, 10 km to a half marathon. The race takes place in the city center of Pilsen and is part of a series of races across the Czech Republic. Participants will enjoy not only running but also an accompanying program for the whole family and quality service from start to finish.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km in the center of Pilsen
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters with a children's corner and babysitting
Refreshment stations on the course and a start package for every runner
additional: The race offers a guiding team, medical services, and a special emergency phone line during the race. Each participant receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. For children, a start package from Lidl and entertainment in the children's zone are prepared. There are at least two refreshment stations on the half marathon course. The event offers family activities, charitable support, start packages, facilities with refreshments, showers, and the possibility of professional photographs.

name: Dobratický běh

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: při online registraci a zaplacení do 20.6.2025

description: Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and joy of movement.
course_highlights: Main race route 8.8 km with 90% asphalt surface
Community run over 3.1 km without age restrictions
Scenic environment of Dobratice village and surrounding nature
additional: The race capacity is 500 participants including children and adults. Registration on site is possible only if capacity is not full. Short runs for children are scheduled to start at 9:30 AM. Medals, refreshments, and drinks are provided for all participants. Financial prizes are awarded to the top three men and women overall in both the main and community runs. Gift vouchers are awarded to the top three in each category. There is also a raffle for all starters. Race routes, orientation map, parking, various categories, themed annual editions, and prize money for main categories are included.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
location: Hamelika, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
price_range: 80,- Kč Děti při přihlášení předem 150,- Kč Dospělí při přihlášení předem
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Hamelika near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the series 'Lookouts in Motion' and the 'Plzeň Region Running Cup,' offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and levels, emphasizing a pleasant environment and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long-standing tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to participants in 2026.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque nature of Mariánské Lázně
Part of the series 'Lookouts in Motion'
Suitable for all age groups
additional: Children's races start at 10:00 AM, adults start at 11:45 AM. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and the 'Lookouts in Motion' series. Terrain: around the lookout tower, registration in advance, part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' running series.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
location: Olympia Brno, Modřice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon will take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 AM to allow runners to experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equally long loops, which run partly in nature and partly through shaded sections. Organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and experience a unique dawn running event.
course_highlights: Flat course with five equally long loops
Start and finish at Olympia Shopping Mall Brno, Modřice
Part of the course runs in nature and shaded sections
additional: Electronic timing with chip. The course is marked with directional signs and organizers are present at important locations. Bag storage is available until 10:00 AM. Weather at the start is usually pleasant, 14 - 16 °C, it is recommended to adjust hydration and clothing accordingly. The start is early in the morning, with bus transportation available from Brno, refreshment stations, medical services, and the option to purchase race merchandise.

name: Hradecký kros
description: The Hradecký Cross is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience of natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, suitable for the general public and recreational runners. The event is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia in running and attracts competitors of all levels every year. The course runs through two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain, highlighting the beauty and challenge of the race.
course_highlights: The course runs through forest paths around Biřička
Two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain
Suitable for the general public and recreational runners
additional: Forest paths, minimal asphalt sections; registration on-site or online; race takes place on June 21, 2026, start at 10:00 AM; race length 10 km

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is an uphill race 3.4 km long with an elevation gain of 240 meters, which is part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers runners a challenging yet attractive course in the beautiful natural environment of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Length of the course 3.4 km with an elevation gain of 240 m
Challenging uphill run in the natural environment of Beroun
Part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Registration is possible at the Na Černém vršku pub in Beroun, early arrival is recommended due to limited parking.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Cross Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemia, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The longer route measures 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m, the medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m, and the hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m. All routes are exclusively through nature, ensuring beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque environment.
course_highlights: Longer route 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m
Medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m
Hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m
additional: routes 15.5 km, 10 km, 5 km; scenic trail along Sázava River and forest paths; scenic and technical sections

name: Chuchelský kros

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Závodníci do Přeboru Prahy – 100,-Kč – bude fakturováno oddílům

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ostatní: přípravky až starší žactvo – 100,- Kč

price_tiers.distance: nejmenší děvčata a chlapci (ročníky 2021 a mladší)

description: The Chuchelský Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by the athletic club SC Radotín, held directly on the Velká Chuchle racetrack. The race offers various categories for all age groups from young children to adults, including the Prague Championship in cross-country running. The course mainly runs on grass and occasionally on gravel, ensuring an interesting and challenging terrain. The race is complemented by refreshments and easy access by public transport and car. Start numbers and chips are issued on-site on the day of the race.
course_highlights: The course runs on grass and occasionally on gravel at the Velká Chuchle racetrack
The race is part of the Prague Championship in cross-country running
Accessible by bus number 244 and train to the Praha - Velká Chuchle station
additional: Start numbers are issued from 8:55 in the grandstand; each runner receives a chip, which is returned after finishing. The assembly point is opposite the jump over the outer racetrack. Refreshments are provided during the race. The main entrance for visitors is the main entrance from the bus turnaround. Runners start in several blocks according to categories from 9:30 to approximately 13:30. The race offers various categories and distances, with online registration or on-site registration available. The event takes place on the racetrack with facilities including changing rooms, showers, and parking.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
location: U Kempinku, Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come run on a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník, where personal records are often broken! The race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA, which takes place every month. The course is measured by a certified measurer, and it is possible to run the limit for the Czech Championships (MČR) on the 10 km. After the race, you can evaluate your performance and recharge energy at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward the best runners and loyal participants.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured by a certified measurer
Opportunity to run the limit for the Czech Championships (MČR) on 10 km
additional: Registration from 18:00 at the blue tent by the cycle path U Kempinku 2, Prague. Start of 10 km at 19:00, start of 5 km at 19:05. After the race, electrolyte drink, and the possibility of refreshments (food and beer) at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage in the organizer’s tent. Toilets available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). Cancellation possible until 23.06.2026 19:00 with a refund of the entry fee. Recommended parking P+R at Nádraží Braník or in surrounding streets. The course is measured by a certified measurer, online registration or on-site registration available, race chip timing, refreshments on site, parking at Nádraží Braník, cancellation possible up to 24 hours before the race.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vidrholcem Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. This race is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is organized under the auspices of the Czech Running and the Czech Athletic Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of movement in nature.
course_highlights: Picturesque course in the natural environment of Prague 9-Klánovice
Organized by Czech Running and the Czech Athletic Federation
Open to runners of all levels
additional: The race is held regularly and offers various course lengths, including approximately 3.5 km routes, with results and statistics available on the website.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
description: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu 2026 je prestižní mezinárodní závod veteránů v horském běhu, který se koná v malebném prostředí Janské Lázně. Závody nabízejí několik náročných tratí s výrazným převýšením, které prověří vytrvalost a sílu závodníků z více než 30 zemí. Pořadatelem je TJ Maratonstav Úpice pod patronací měst Janské Lázně a Úpice. Registrace je otevřena do 24. května 2026 a závodníci se mohou těšit na profesionální organizaci a podporu sponzorů.
course_highlights: Uphill race: 7,79 km s převýšením 851 m
Long Distance race: 22,17 km s převýšením 1332 m
Up/Downhill race: 8,95 km s převýšením 594 m
additional: Registrace je otevřena do 24.5.2026. Závodníci musí být členy Sdružení veteránů Českého atletického svazu, jinak nebudou vpuštěni na start. Startovní listiny se aktualizují 1-2x týdně. Po registraci a platbě startovného přijde potvrzující e-mail. Pořadatelé jsou TJ Maratonstav Úpice, pod patronací měst Janské Lázně a Úpice. Závod je určen pro veterány, registrace a přesné detaily tratě nejsou specifikovány.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
location: Duchcov Castle, Duchcov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Castle Duchcov is an obstacle race held from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic surroundings of Duchcov Castle and its vicinity. Participants will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and will face a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the Bílina Mine. The race features modern and certified obstacles on professional aluminum structures, emphasizing safety and quality. The atmosphere is complemented by a knightly theme, connecting physical challenge with values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A rich program and facilities including refreshments and service are prepared for both competitors and fans.
course_highlights: The course runs along the castle staircase and adjacent meadows with views of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands
Modern obstacles on aluminum structures with TÜV certification and regular inspections
Atmosphere inspired by the legend of Giacomo Casanova and knightly stories
additional: Start package, electronic timing chip, online results, photos and videos from the race, fresh fruit and refreshing drinks on the course and at the finish line, rescue and event services, facilities for competitors and their families at the race center, fan zones and entertainment activities for children and adults, the opportunity to watch the race from attractive locations. The race takes place at Duchcov Castle, offering various routes from 6 to 12 km with obstacles and scenic surroundings. Registration and details about prices are available on the official website.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2026 World Veterans Mountain Running Championship in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international veterans' mountain running race attracting athletes from over 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners' endurance and strength. Organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and the race offers several course variants with different lengths and elevation gains.
course_highlights: Uphill race: 7.79 km with an elevation gain of 851 m
Long Distance race: 22.17 km with an elevation gain of 1332 m
Up/Downhill race: 8.95 km with an elevation gain of 594 m
additional: Start lists are updated 1-2 times per week. Competitors must be members of the Veterans' Association of the Czech Athletic Federation; otherwise, they will not be allowed to start. Registration requires agreement with WMRA rules and anti-doping regulations. The organizers are TJ Maratonstav Úpice, WMRA, ČAS, and ČABDV under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. The event takes place in Janské Lázně on June 28, 2026, with the possibility for veterans' categories to participate. The race focuses on mountain running with demanding ascents and beautiful Krkonoše nature.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malofatranská stovka je horský ultramaratón v pohorí Malej Fatry, ktorý ponúka náročné trasy s výraznými stúpaniami a klesaniami. Pretek je určený pre skúsených bežcov s výbornou fyzickou kondíciou a prechádza celým pohorím vrátane Krivánskej a Lúčanskej Fatry. Podujatie je registrovaným členom ITRA a slúži ako kvalifikačný pretek pre ďalšie prestížne ultratraily. Organizátorom je Slovak Ultra Trail v spolupráci s dobrovoľníkmi a partnermi.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez celé pohorie Malá Fatra (Krivánska a Lúčanská Fatra)
Výrazné stúpania a klesania s exponovanými miestami
Dostupné trasy: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: Súčasťou povinnej výbavy je poistenie na zásah Horskej záchrannej služby, ktoré je možné objednať priamo pri registrácii. K dispozícii je funkčné a bavlnené tričko s originálnou potlačou. Zľavy na štartovné sú možné na základe ITRA Performance Index. Prezentácia a štart prebiehajú v Terchovej. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v rekreačnom stredisku Domaša Dobrá. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami - krátkou 5 km a dlhou 13 km, ktoré vedú prevažne lesnými cestami a trailmi s rôznorodým prevýšením. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvovacie stanice, šatne, toalety a zdravotnú službu. Atmosféra je priateľská a športovo súťažná, s hodnotnými vecnými cenami pre víťazov.
course_highlights: Dlhá trať 13 km s prevýšením približne 356 m nahor a 314 m nadol
Krátka trať 5 km vedúca lesnou cestou s prevýšením 70 m
Občerstvovacie stanice na 5 km, 10 km a v cieli dlhej trate, občerstvenie v cieli krátkej trate
additional: Detský beh je bez štartovného. Šatňa, toalety a úschovňa sú v prístave pri Lodi Bohémia. Každý pretekár musí mať viditeľne pripevnené štartové číslo na hrudi. Zdravotnú službu zabezpečuje organizátor. Štartovné sa vráti v plnej výške pri odhlásení do 8. júna. Preteká sa podľa pravidiel atletických súťaží a propozícií podujatia. Trať 13 km a 5 km, detský beh, kategórie pre mužov a ženy rôznych vekových skupín, štart od 09:45 do 10:15, parkovisko pri Bogárke, rekreačné stredisko Domaša Dobra

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: BYS3T PARK, Záhorská Bystrica, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Beh za zdravie v Záhorskej Bystrici je charitatívne bežecké podujatie, ktoré spája šport s podporou zdravia a komunity. Uskutoční sa 27. júna 2026 v BYS3T PARKu a ponúka príležitosť zažiť skvelú atmosféru a inšpiratívne príbehy, pričom každý účastník prispieva na dobrú vec. Podujatie je otvorené všetkým vekovým kategóriám a kondičným úrovniam, pričom podporuje zdravý životný štýl a pomoc znevýhodneným osobám. Beh za zdravie vznikol v roku 2023 a každoročne podporuje vybrané osoby alebo nadácie prostredníctvom pohybu.
course_highlights: Prebieha v BYS3T PARKu v Záhorskej Bystrici
Podujatie spája beh a podporu komunity
Otvorené pre všetky vekové kategórie a kondície
additional: Podujatie je charitatívne a podporuje znevýhodnené osoby a organizácie. Zúčastniť sa môžu deti, dospelí aj starší, behom, pomalým tempom alebo prechádzkou. Organizátori ponúkajú možnosť stať sa dobrovoľníkom a pomôcť tak pri organizácii podujatia. Podujatie sa koná na teréne parku a ulíc v Záhorskej Bystrici, s možnosťou zapojiť sa ako bežec, prechádzajúci alebo dobrovoľník. Súčasťou je aj virtuálna možnosť účasti.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run v Košiciach je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa uskutoční 27. júna 2026 pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici. Pretekárky si môžu vybrať z disciplín 5 km, 10 km a Velvet Nordic Walking na 5 km. Podujatie je určené výhradne pre ženy a ponúka hodnotné vecné ceny pre víťazky v rôznych kategóriách. Organizátori zabezpečujú meranie časov pomocou systému MyLaps a výsledky budú zverejnené na oficiálnych stránkach.
course_highlights: Trate Velvet Run 5 km a 10 km v centre Košíc pri Urbanovej veži
Disciplína Velvet Nordic Walking na 5 km
Prezentácia a štart na Hlavnej ulici
additional: Registrácia prebieha online do 23. júna 2026 alebo do naplnenia limitu. Možnosť registrácie aj na mieste od 14:00 za predpokladu, že neboli naplnené technicko-bezpečnostné limity. Vyhlasovanie víťaziek začína o 18:00, záver podujatia o 19:00. Súťaže dvojíc "Mama a dcéra" a "Sestry" v behu na 5 km a 10 km. Meranie časov zabezpečuje ChampionChip systém MyLaps. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, s časovým meraním pomocou systému ChampionChip; registrácia je možná aj na mieste.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský umirak je horský beh v dĺžke približne 30 km s prevýšením okolo 1000 metrov, určený pre trénovaných bežcov. Pretek sa koná v rekreačnom stredisku Drienica, s možnosťou občerstvenia a doplnkových aktivít pre rodiny. Trať vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom a pretekári sú povinní mať štartovné číslo viditeľne pripevnené na hrudi. Bezpečnosť na trati zabezpečuje Horská služba Čergov, pričom každý účastník štartuje na vlastné riziko. Po dobehnutí posledných pretekárov je pripravené vyhodnotenie a odovzdávanie cien pre najlepších mužov a ženy.
course_highlights: Horský beh s dĺžkou cca 30 km a prevýšením cca 1000 m
Značený turistický chodník v oblasti Čergov
Štart a cieľ pri Chate Ride pub v Drienici
additional: Povinná výbava: nabitý mobilný telefón, min. 0,5 l fľaša na vodu, alufólia v prípade nepriaznivého počasia. Spoločný brífing o 8:30 hod. na Chate Ride pub s oboznámením s traťou a orientáciou. Občerstvenie zabezpečené. Štartovné číslo je neprenosné a musí byť viditeľne pripevnené na hrudi. Počas preteku je zabezpečená bezpečnosť Horskou službou Čergov. Trať je turisticky značená, odporúčajú sa trailové topánky. Pre registráciu je možné kontaktovať organizátorov telefonicky alebo emailom.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: Hámornický polmaratón je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný bežeckým klubom Spartak Medzev v rámci osláv dní mesta Medzev. Podujatie zahŕňa polmaratón, sprievodný beh Hámornícka desiatka a detské kategórie Hámorníček, ktoré sú súčasťou detskej bežeckej ligy. Štart je symbolicky odštartovaný úderom kladiva na kovadlinu, čo dodáva podujatiu jedinečnú atmosféru. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na pekné funkčné tričká, medaile s moderným dizajnom a občerstvenie počas pretekov. Trať vedie krásnym hlbokým údolím s prírodnými krásami a historickou atmosférou mestečka Medzev.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie krásnym hlbokým údolím s prírodnými prameňmi a spevom vtákov
Symbolický štart úderom kladiva na kovadlinu
Sprievodné behy vrátane Hámorníckej desiatky a detských kategórií Hámorníček
additional: Účastníci dostávajú pekné funkčné tričká a medaile s moderným dizajnom. Deti majú bezplatnú účasť v 14 kategóriách s balíčkom sladkostí a džusom v cieli. Podujatie je podporované mestom Medzev a obcou Štós, pričom organizátori oceňujú pomoc z 2% daní. Trať zahŕňa aj futbalový štadión; registrácia online aj na mieste; kategórie pre mužov, ženy a seniorov

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky - Memoriál Františka Hečka je bežecký pretek v Horných Orešanoch, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 300 metrov s prevýšením 100 metrov. Povrch trate je kombináciou asfaltu a terénu v pomere 50:50, čo robí pretek zaujímavým a náročným. Pretek je otvorený pre všetky vekové kategórie, od detí od 1 roka až po seniorov, vrátane kategórií mužov, žien, juniorov a domácich bežcov. Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Viktoria spolu s Obecným úradom v Horných Orešanoch. Štart pre žiakov je o 15:35 a pre ostatných o 17:00 hod.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 10 300 m s prevýšením 100 m
Povrch trate 50 % asfalt, 50 % terén
Trať vedie cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky s krásnymi výhľadmi
additional: Štart pre žiakov je o 15:35 hod., pre ostatných o 17:00 hod. Kategórie zahŕňajú všetky vekové skupiny od detí od 1 roka, juniorov, mužov a žien rôznych vekových kategórií, vrátane domácej kategórie trojčlenných družstiev. Trať má približne 10,3 km, rozdelená na 50% asfalt a 50% terén, možnosť registrácie online alebo na mieste, štartové časy o 15:35 a 17:00

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava je rodinný bežecký festival, ktorý ponúka trate pre všetky vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z tratí 3, 5 a 10 km, ako aj z detských behov na 500 a 1000 metrov. Podujatie sa koná v dvoch lokalitách a ponúka štartovací balíček so všetkým potrebným pre bežcov. Okrem samotného behu je pripravený bohatý sprievodný program, občerstvenie na trati aj v cieli, zdravotnícky a vodičský servis, a zázemie s možnosťou prezliekania a úschovne. Celý deň je ladený ako zážitok pre bežcov aj ich rodiny s tombolou a možnosťou rytia osobných údajov do medailí.
course_highlights: Trate na 3, 5 a 10 km pre hobíkov aj elitných bežcov
Detské behy na 500 a 1000 metrov
Občerstvovacie stanice na trati a v cieli, zdravotnícky a vodičský servis
additional: Bežci majú k dispozícii vodičov s vlajočkami, ktorí pomáhajú udržať tempo. Po behu je možné si nechať vyryť osobný čas a meno do medaily. K dispozícii sú sprchy, úschovňa a bohatý sprievodný program vrátane detskej zóny a tomboly s hodnotnými cenami. Trať na 3, 5 a 10 km, detské behy na 500 a 1000 m, občerstvenie, sprchy, úschovňa, medaily, fotografie, tombola, rodinná atmosféra

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je trailový beh v nádhernej prírode Vysokých Tatier, ktorý ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok z behu na mäkkom povrchu s čerstvým horským vzduchom. Trasa vedie cez Chodník korunami stromov, Monkova dolina a hrebeň Spišskej Magury, pričom štart je zabezpečený lanovkou. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi, ktorá spája športový výkon s podporou miestnych rodín a charitatívnych príbehov. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je výzvou pre skúsených bežcov aj nováčikov, ktorí chcú zažiť horskú prírodu a nezabudnuteľné výhľady.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez Chodník korunami stromov
Výhľady na Vysoké Tatry a hrebeň Spišskej Magury
Štart lanovkou v Bachledovej doline
additional: Preteky sú zaradené pod UTMB Index Races s medzinárodným bodovým hodnotením. Na trati je rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s možnosťou vyhrať voucher na pneumatiky a bežecký dres. Možnosť preregistrácie a zmeny štartovného poplatku online cez profil SportID alebo na mieste pretekov. Súťaž zahŕňa ekologické poháre, vodné stanice, rôzne kategórie pretekov vrátane detských, a ponúka zľavy pri registrácii viacerých účastníkov.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
location: Týniště nad Orlicí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 15 let, ostatní ceny nejsou uvedeny

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Závodníci do 18 let včetně mají závod bez poplatku

description: The Týniště Forest Run is a charity running race held in the beautiful nature of Týniště nad Orlicí, offering courses for various performance levels and age categories. The race takes place in a forest predominantly on paved forest paths and occasionally on asphalt. It includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10, and 21 km. The event combines sport, family fun, and supporting a good cause, promoting the non-profit organization RENEDA, which helps children with neurological challenges.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest paths with some asphalt sections
Beautiful nature of Týniště nad Orlicí bordered by forests
Courses for different performance levels including a family run
additional: Start number with name upon registration by June 7th, baggage storage, refreshments on the course and at the finish line (water, bananas, oranges, pastries), time limits: 3 km - 30 minutes, 6 km - 1 hour, 10 km - 1 hour 30 minutes, 21 km - 3 hours. Running on paved forest paths, the event has a charitable character, registration opens from May 1, 2026, supports the local community and charitable projects.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
location: Janské Lázně, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: World Veterans Championship in Long Mountain Running will take place on June 27, 2026, in the picturesque environment of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is designed for veterans and offers a challenging long mountain run that tests the endurance and strength of runners in beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend following the official organization’s website.
course_highlights: Long mountain run in the mountainous terrain of Janské Lázně
Challenging profile with elevation changes
Picturesque views and natural scenery of the Hradec Králové Region
additional: Participants must be members of the Czech veteran athletics section and run in the national team uniform; the event also includes local races such as the Long Záhony Run.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
location: Česká Skalice, Česká Skalice, Czech Republic
description: The Rozkoš Half Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, running along a new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir. The race offers a main run of 21.1 km and a supporting run of 2 km designed for children and mothers with strollers. The event is complemented by entertainment, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation in a camp, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants and companions. The start of the main category is at 12:30, the first category starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir
Supporting 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers
Possibility of camping accommodation and refreshments on site
additional: Start of the first category at 10:00, start of the main category at 12:30. The race takes place on the cycle path near the Autocamp Rozkoš in Česká Skalice. The supporting run is intended for children and mothers with strollers. There is entertainment, refreshments, and camping accommodation available. Terrain: road, Registration: not specified, Additional notes: entertainment, refreshments, camping accommodation

name: Záblatská osmička
description: Záblatská osmička is a running race in Bohumín-Záblatí that offers a local atmosphere and a friendly pace. The race route passes through various terrains, including asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths, engaging runners from start to finish. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running and a great atmosphere. Registration is open until June 24, 2026, and the start is at 10:00 AM at the football field in Záblatí.
course_highlights: The route passes through asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths
Local atmosphere and friendly pace
Refreshments at the 4th kilometer and at the finish
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Results announcement and raffle are scheduled for 11:30. Toilets are available at the event site, but it is not possible to securely store belongings at the start and finish areas. The race is held on June 27, 2026, with the start planned for 10:00 AM, and registration closes on June 24, 2026. The event includes refreshments at the 4 km mark and at the finish. The route is similar to that of 2025 and includes categories for men and women, including local runners from Bohumín.
