Charity run supporting the Stop Violence program
additional: Start packages can be picked up on race day at the registration tent, labeled according to gender and T-shirt size. There is a baggage storage, changing rooms, refreshments during and after the race, and free massages before and after the run. Starting numbers and chips are non-transferable and must be visibly placed on the chest. The race is charitable and supports the Stop Violence program. The program includes children's races, the main 5 km race, accompanying activities in the children's corner, relaxation techniques, and massages. The event promotes therapeutic programs and violence prevention.

name: Big Bear's Ultra
location: Žilina, Považské múzeum, Budatínski hrad, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Big Bear's Ultra je náročný ultra trailový pretek okolo mesta Žilina, ktorý ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v prírode s krásnymi výhľadmi na okolitú krajinu. Preteky sa konajú v blízkosti Považského múzea a Budatínskeho hradu a zahŕňajú rôzne vzdialenosti, ktoré preveria vytrvalosť a odhodlanie bežcov. Trať vedie cez kopce a horské oblasti s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí z tohto podujatia výzvu pre skúsených bežcov. Organizátori kladú dôraz na ekologický prístup a bezpečnosť účastníkov.
course_highlights: BBU 100+ má dĺžku 118 km s prevýšením 6300 m, vedie cez Budatínsky hrad, Straník, Lysicu, Veľký Kriváň a ďalšie horské sedlá
BBU 60+ má dĺžku 62 km s prevýšením 3500 m, štartuje v Strečne a končí v Budatíne, vedie po časti trasy BBU 100+
Trať prechádza cez historické a prírodné pamiatky ako Považské múzeum, Budatínsky hrad a Hričovský hrad
additional: Registrácia pre 4. ročník pretekov začala 17. decembra 2025 o 20:00. Trať je rozdelená na viaceré kontrolné body s občerstvovacími stanicami. Pretek je súčasťou Europe Trail Cup. Organizátori zdôrazňujú ekologický kódex a povinné vybavenie pre bežcov. Registrácia sa otvára 17. decembra 2025; preteky sa konajú v Žiline, v blízkosti Považského múzea a Budatínskeho hradu; podujatie je známe svojou komunitou a rôznorodosťou trás.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
price_range: 30,00€ to 60,00€ depending on category and registration date
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon je certifikovaný polmaratón s medzinárodným statusom World Athletics, ktorý sa koná v historickom centre Nitry na Svätoplukovom námestí. Podujatie spája šport, komunitu a charitu a ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok v atmosfére Oktoberfestu. Okrem polmaratónu sú súčasťou festivalu aj štafety, rodinné a seniorské behy, charitatívne behy a detské kategórie. Organizátori kladú dôraz na zdravý životný štýl, inklúziu a komunitnú spoluprácu v regióne.
course_highlights: Certifikovaná trať polmaratónu s dĺžkou 21,0975 km podľa štandardov World Athletics
Štart a cieľ na Svätoplukovom námestí v centre Nitry
Možnosť zapojiť sa do štafety, rodinných a charitatívnych behov
additional: Registrácia online končí 17.9.2026 o 23:59 alebo pri naplnení limitu. Možnosť registrácie na mieste v deň pretekov od 08:00 do 09:30, ak nebude limit naplnený. Podujatie je súčasťou Európskeho týždňa mobility a dopĺňa ho kultúrny program v štýle Nitrianskeho rínku s lokálnym streetfoodom a programom pre rodiny. Podujatie má status svetového rebríčka, ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detských a rodinných behov, a je súčasťou festivalovej atmosféry s miestnou kuchyňou a zábavou.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Mestský úrad v Myjave, Myjava, Slovakia
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: on-line prihlásenie do 18. 9. 2025 do 15.00 h, (platba na mieste)

description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka je bežecký pretek v Myjave, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 km pre mužov a ženy, s kratšími variantmi pre ženy a kategóriu Buď - fit. Preteky sa konajú pred Mestským úradom v Myjave a sú organizované TJ Spartak Myjava Atletickým oddielom a mestom Myjava. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00 hod., zatiaľ čo žiaci a žiačky základných škôl štartujú o 10:00 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov, vrátane kategórií podľa veku a špeciálnych skupín Buď fit a detí.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 10 km pre hlavný pretek
Ženská trať 6,6 km a Buď - fit 3,3 km
Štart pred Mestským úradom v Myjave
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane kategórií muži A-D, ženy E-G, Buď fit ženy a muži, a kategórie pre žiakov a predškolákov. Pretek je organizovaný TJ Spartak Myjava Atletickým oddielom a mestom Myjava. Kontaktná osoba: Pavol Michalčík, tel.: 0908 532 753. Preteky zahŕňajú rôzne dĺžky tratí od 200 m po 10 km, súčasťou sú detské kategórie, občerstvenie, medaily, tombola a sprievodný program s vystúpeniami.

name: Memoriál vdp. Jána Laktiša
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Sklabiná, Veľký Krtíš, Slovakia
organizer: Občianske združenie Telovýchovná Jednota družstevník Sklabiná v spolupráci s OZ Bežci VK
description: Memoriál vdp. Jána Laktiša je tradičný cestný beh, ktorý sa koná v obci Sklabiná v okrese Veľký Krtíš. Tento bežecký závod má dlhoročnú históriu a je organizovaný farským úradom Sklabiná. Pretekári sa stretávajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Sklabinej, kde sa koná štart aj cieľ. Podujatie je známe svojou komunitnou atmosférou a úctou k starším bežcom.
course_highlights: Cestný beh v obci Sklabiná
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku
Tradičný bežecký závod s dlhoročnou históriou
additional: 19. ročník sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku, nie pred farou. Usporiadateľom je Farský úrad Sklabiná. V minulosti sa pretekov zúčastnili bežci rôzneho veku, od najmladších po najstarších. Výsledkové listiny a fotky z pretekov sú pravidelne zverejňované na stránke. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku, registrácia je dostupná online, a sú k dispozícii výsledky a informácie o kategóriách na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
price_range: 16 eur – do 18.9.2025 online, 21 eur – v deň pretekov (hotovosť)
description: Dobšinská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný občianskym združením ŠK Dobšiná, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Lányiho Huty v Dobšinej. Preteky ponúkajú členitú trať s kombináciou lesných ciest a asfaltu, vhodnú pre bežcov rôznych kategórií vrátane nordic walking. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj sprievodné akcie ako autogramiáda slovenských olympionikov a rodinné aktivity, ktoré vytvárajú príjemnú atmosféru pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať pozostáva zo 4/5 lesnej cesty a 1/5 asfaltu
Profil trate je členitý s rôznymi prevýšeniami
Štart a cieľ sú v lokalite Lányiho Huta, Dobšiná
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov prebieha od 9:00 do 10:45 v Horskej chate Stará Horáreň. Štart je hromadný pre všetky hlavné kategórie. V štartovnom je zahrnutý doplnok z funkčného materiálu s logom preteku, produkt zdravej výživy, štartovné číslo slúžiace ako tombola, občerstvenie na trati aj po dobehnutí, vrátane nápoja a jedla. Po pretekoch nasleduje detská a rodičovská štafeta. Prví traja v každej kategórii získajú finančné alebo vecné ceny, a je vyplatená finančná odmena za prekonanie traťového rekordu. Trať je prevažne lesná s 4/5 lesných ciest a 1/5 asfaltu; registrácia je možná online aj osobne na mieste; súčasťou podujatia sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a štafety.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
price_range: online  ,- €; on-site  ,- € (if participant limit not reached)
description: Kapušianska 5-ka je bežecký pretek konaný v Kapušanskom parku v obci Kapušany. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane juniorov, dospelých a veteránov. Ide o príjemnú športovú udalosť, ktorá podporuje aktívny životný štýl a komunitné športovanie. Organizátorom je obec Kapušany, ktorá zabezpečuje aj kontaktnú podporu pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie Kapušanským parkom
Preteky sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií
Príjemné prostredie vhodné pre rekreačných aj súťažných bežcov
additional: Štartovné sa platí online alebo na mieste len v prípade nenaplnenia účastníckeho limitu. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane zlúčených kategórií juniorov a veteránov. Pretek sa koná v areáli Kapušanského parku, je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Vstupný areál USS Košice, Košice, Košice, Slovakia
description: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U. S. Steel Košice sú tradičným podujatím, ktoré sa koná už 34 rokov a prináša zamestnancom možnosť súťažiť v rôznych športových disciplínach. Hry zahŕňajú atletiku, bedminton, bowling, tenis, futbal, stolný tenis, plážový volejbal, cyklistiku, šach a šípky. Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov U. S. Steel Košice a podporuje športového ducha a kolektívnu súťaživosť v príjemnom prostredí areálu USS Košice Šaca. Okrem súťaží sa organizujú aj golfové turnaje a ďalšie športové aktivity.
course_highlights: Viacero športových disciplín vrátane atletiky, cyklistiky a futbalu
Súťaže pre zamestnancov v areáli USS Košice Šaca
Golfový turnaj v Golfovom areáli Malá Ida
additional: Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov U. S. Steel Košice s viacerými športovými disciplínami vrátane novinky šípok. V prípade nepriaznivého počasia sa niektoré disciplíny dohrávajú v náhradných termínoch. Organizátori poskytujú kontakty na organizáciu a elektronickú registráciu. Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov spoločnosti, s možnosťou registrácie cez platformu The X App Košice. Súčasťou sú aj výsledky, fotografie a golfový turnaj naplánovaný na 21. septembra 2025.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
location: Humenné, námestie pri MsKS, Humenné, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Generali Trail Hubkovou je bežecký pretek v Humennom, ktorý organizuje Bežecký klub Humenné s podporou mesta a miestnych sponzorov. Pretek sa koná na námestí pri MsKS a ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, juniorov a deti. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00. Účastníci si môžu vybrať z viacerých štartovných balíčkov, ktoré zahŕňajú medailu, reklamný balíček, tombolu, občerstvenie a funkčné tričko. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s občerstvením na trati.
course_highlights: Trať vedie cez náročný horský terén
Rôzne kategórie pre dospelých a deti
Preteky s možnosťou výberu vzdialenosti a časov štartu
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 11:00. Po dátume 16.9.2025 je štartovné pre všetky balíčky online aj na mieste vyššie o 5 €. Balíčky obsahujú rôzne kombinácie medaily, reklamného balíčka, tombolových lístkov, občerstvenia na trati, obeda a funkčného trička. Trailové prostredie, rôzne kategórie, registrácia od 4 do 25 eur, štarty o 11:00 a 13:00

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children's courses along forest paths and courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain predominantly asphalt with some forest and field roads. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services of the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy a pleasant landscape around the local ponds with views of the surrounding mountains.
course_highlights: Children's courses run along forest paths
Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds in Červený Kostelec with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina
additional: Online registration is possible until September 19, 2026, at 6:00 AM, with on-site registration available for a higher entry fee. The first 300 registered participants will receive a small gift. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská street, about a 10-minute walk from the race location. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series with fair-play rules and no accompaniment (dog, bike, scooter, etc.). All proceeds are dedicated to supporting Hospice Anežky České.

name: Zátopkova 10
location: Lomená alej, Stará Boleslav, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená alley in Staré Boleslav, which takes place on two five-kilometer loops through forest paths. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a main race of 10 km, a two-person relay, and children's races over 500 and 1000 meters. The course is mostly flat, and the start is interval-based, with a continuous refreshment station. Runners receive a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and race photos.
course_highlights: Two loops of 5 km through forest paths
Course runs almost flat
Continuous refreshment station with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Start is interval-based. The capacity of the main race is 500 runners, children's races 100 runners. Included in the registration fee are a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, SMS results, an electronic certificate, photos from the course or finish line, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish. Trail terrain, forest paths, registration online and on-site, race categories include main race, relay, and children’s races.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registruji dítě na dětský závod 250 Kč

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a main race of 108 km with over 2000 meters of elevation change around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to explore the unknown landscape of Lipno, its history, and stories during a challenging ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by an accompanying program from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is community-oriented and friendly, organized by runners for runners with respect for nature and local culture.
course_highlights: 108 km long trail with over 2000 meters of elevation gain
The route runs along narrow forest trails around the largest water surface in the Czech Republic - Lipno
The route is divided into 8 sections (8 - 14 km), all transfer points are easily accessible by car
additional: Start and finish of the race are in front of the Stodola restaurant in Lipno nad Vltavou. There are changing rooms, showers, and parking available at the start. The route is divided into 8 sections with transfer points accessible by car. Included in the registration fee is a dropbag for solo runners, refreshments at transfer points (water, isotonic drinks, fruit), timing and results service. The accompanying program runs from Friday to Sunday, including lectures, music, and group activities. The registration fee is non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be at least 18 years old, or 15+ with parental consent. Children under 6 years old only with accompaniment. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying program, accommodation options, involvement of local gastronomy and history.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast and flat course that runs along the Elbe River and past the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the "Ferrari among races" due to its speed and frequently broken records. During the race, runners will enjoy beautiful views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running disciplines including the half marathon, relay half marathon, 10 km run, and family runs.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course along the Elbe River
Passage through the local chemical plant
Views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle
additional: Possibility to authorize another person to pick up the start number. Start times for different races during the day: half marathon at 09:00, other runs at 11:00, 14:30, and 14:45. The 16th edition, approximately 3500 runners participated. The race is part of running series and offers the RunCzech mobile app for participants. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes various races, an expo with official merchandise, and registration options. The course passes through city landmarks and industrial areas, suitable for all age groups.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Young Běchovice is a traditional running race intended for children from 1 to 18 years old, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of various lengths from 50 to 1300 meters to accommodate a wide age range of participants. Approximately 800 children participate each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the 61st edition of this popular race will take place.
course_highlights: Courses from 50 to 1300 meters suitable for children from 1 to 18 years old
The race takes place on a grass field
Approximately 800 participants annually
additional: The race is suitable for children, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The organizer is the association Mladé Běchovice, z.s. Contact is also possible by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and youth, taking place in September 2026, with approximately 800 participants. The event focuses on promoting sports and a healthy lifestyle among youth.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Moravian Karst Run is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition since 1976. This race offers runners from the Blansko area and surroundings the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural environment of the Moravian Karst. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of an annual competition that promotes running sports in the region. The organizers strive to ensure quality service and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality running facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst, and is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic Fourteen is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both fitness and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its friendly atmosphere is emphasized by its name, which refers to the non-alcoholic nature of the event.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic surroundings of Litovel and its vicinity
Mostly asphalt and paved surface suitable for fast running
Part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in Olomouc and the surrounding area, with offerings for organizers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
location: Zámecký park, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The autumn run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional race held in the beautiful castle park. It offers two main routes of 5 km and 10 km (two laps) as well as children's races at the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy a pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the castle park of Heřmanův Městec
Two race options: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children's races at the start and finish area
additional: The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league, which includes a series of races and public measured training sessions throughout the year. The race takes place on September 19, 2026. Registration is available on the official website. The course profiles are not specified exactly but run through the natural surroundings of Heřmanův Městec.

name: Hořovický cvoček
price_range: 150 CZK v předprodeji, 200 CZK na místě
description: The Hořovice Nail is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The race runs through forest paths and asphalt and starts from Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec. The main race begins at 10:00 AM and is intended for adult runners without children's categories. The registration fee is 150 CZK in advance and 200 CZK on the spot. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and has a long history with available results and statistics.
course_highlights: Course approximately 12 km long, a mix of forest paths and asphalt
Start in Hořovice, Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with history and results since 2014
additional: The race does not have children's categories. The start and finish are on Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec. Results are available in the system and in PDF format. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup with other runs in the season. The race includes various terrains, offers pre-registration and on-site registration options, and is part of the series of races in the Brdský Running Cup.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kačina Castle and its extensive castle park, which is part of the series RUN CASTLES OF CENTRAL BOHEMIA. The race offers routes for children up to 800 meters and for adults 5 and 10 km long, mainly along gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for all lovers of movement and nature and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments on the track and at the finish. The start and facilities are located at the back of Kačina Castle, where registration and results announcement also take place.
course_highlights: Routes lead around Kačina Castle and through the extensive castle park
70% gravel path, 30% forest path
Refreshments on the track and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 for children's races and at 12:30 for adult races in the back part of Kačina Castle grounds. Children immediately receive a participation medal after finishing. Parents can run with children in categories 2-3 and 4-5 years old. The race takes place in any weather; safety and fair play rules must be observed. A one-time start number with clips, which must be attached to the chest. Parking is available according to the parking map, with a warning not to park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in the castle park of Kačina.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event of the season with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes lead over soft sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles, ensuring a pleasant running experience in a natural environment. The race offers various distances from children's races up to 21 km, including categories for running, canicross, walking/running, and dogtrek. The race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, contributing to the comfort of all participants.
course_highlights: Soft routes with sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles
Location in Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Registration from 8:00, baggage storage, changing rooms, Leskros kindergarten for children (10:30 - 14:00), massages and taping for competitors, canine physiotherapy advice, rental of canicross equipment by arrangement, parking and toilets near the start. The race includes charitable activities, children's races, equipment rental options, refreshments, and an accompanying program in the natural environment of Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event held on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of various lengths from 6 km to 67 km, including competitive and tourist variants. Participants can choose routes through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a T-shirt with a print. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and offers routes adapted for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km including competitive and tourist variants
Routes pass through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is only possible online. During registration, you can order a cotton T-shirt with a print for 390 CZK (children's 350 CZK). Re-registration to another participant is possible until September 11, 2026, at 20:00 via email redakce@bezvabeh.cz or on-site. The finish in Štramberk will close at 21:00. The event offers various route lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts, and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race approximately 5.2 km long, primarily along cycle paths and sidewalks along the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. This race is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or consider a half marathon too demanding. The start is from Havlíčkovo náměstí, and part of the registration fee is dedicated to supporting sports equipment for youth. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner Running Cup and offers refreshments at the start and finish lines.
course_highlights: The course runs on public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
Elevation gain without significant ascent (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start and finish areas. Starting numbers for paid registrations before September 1, 2026, include the runner's name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the track and after the race, facilities with changing rooms, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, musical accompaniment, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. 15% of each registration fee is allocated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. The course includes asphalt roads, trails, and paving; registration is possible online or on-site; the race supports youth sports activities and offers various supplementary events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Emila Zátopka Running Race through his native land is a traditional event dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympian Emil Zátopek, held regularly on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice at the Emil Zátopek statue and finishes at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and older and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial award ceremony takes place with the participation of prominent guests.
course_highlights: Course length of 22.3 km from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Surface asphalt and gravel in forest sections
Elevation gain of 375 m, undulating and hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one hydration station along the route. The race takes place with full road traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cut-off at 1:20 hours in Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural House in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov. Belongings are transported by bus to the finish line. The organizer provides bus transportation from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation at the Stadion Hotel in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is available at the runner's expense. Participants under 18 require parental consent. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths, registration is required, team and relay races are available, transportation and accommodation are arranged, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: Cross-country race Kocelovice - Hornosín - Kocelovice is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route leading from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and those active in the scenic tourist and cycling terrain. The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice, where the race organization also takes place. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque South Bohemian countryside with ideal tourist and cycling terrain
Start and finish at the building of the former school in Kocelovice
Cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice. Organized by the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn, with the last edition in September 2023, and the next planned for September 2026. The length of the course is approximately 18 km, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton

description: The Havlíčkobrod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, which will celebrate its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, passing through Havlíčkův Brod Square. In addition to the main race, the event includes children's races, relays, and the shorter Havlíček Five race, allowing broad public participation across various age groups and performance levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: The course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
A 5.2 km loop is run four times (half marathon)
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The registration fee includes a race bib (with the runner's name for registrations paid by September 1, 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free entry to the Vysočina amusement park, facilities (changing room, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, seating), musical accompaniment, event moderation, professional electronic chip timing, online results display, medical services, and race organization. The half marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each registration fee is donated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. Children's and Havlíček Five results count towards the Vysočina Runner running cup. The event traditionally takes place in September and offers a diverse program for all age groups and levels, including relays and children's races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Run for the Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children's courses along forest paths and courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain predominantly asphalt with some forest and field roads. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, and the winners of the main race will be announced at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: Children's courses run along forest paths
Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery of the Kostelec ponds with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina
additional: Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is prepared for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series with fair-play rules and no accompaniment of dogs, scooters, or bicycles. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Červený Kostelec, supports hospice services, with registration and details available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is an uphill running race with a total elevation gain of 569 meters, held in the picturesque environment of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. This race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course of 9.5 km. The start is at the square in Jilemnice, and the race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which ensures professional organization and support for competitors.
course_highlights: Course length of 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 569 m
Uphill run in the scenic environment of Jilemnice
Start at the square in Jilemnice
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., contact person Roman Koucký, phone 602 265 857. Race regulations are available for download on the official website. The race takes place on a mountain trail; registration details are not specified. Results are announced at the finish line. The event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

description: The Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held since 2017 around the village of Soběchleby. The main course measures approximately 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 meters and is 90% on field and forest paved paths. Starting in 2024, the race also includes a fitness run over 6 km, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, where facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments are available. The accompanying program includes children's races for various age groups.
course_highlights: Main course 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 m
The route is 90% on field and forest paved paths
Fitness run 6 km with an elevation gain of 137 m suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for children's races is always on-site on race day. For the main race and fitness run, registration is available online or on-site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers, and toilets. Refreshments (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks) are provided after the race. Parking is available nearby the venue. The route runs on field and forest paths, with start and finish at the football field, including refreshments, showers, and parking close by.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for various age groups from young children to adults. The race takes place on a field at the end of Husova Street and includes short courses for children, a family relay, and longer distances for adult runners. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to join comfortably. The event is suitable for families and competitors seeking a sporting challenge in a pleasant city environment.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 and younger
Family relay 3 x 900 m
Longer courses 3 km and 10 km for adults and older youth
additional: Registration begins at 13:00 and ends 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40. The course is cross-country type, running on asphalt and unpaved paths; participants run at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

The race is family-friendly and suitable for beginners and advanced runners alike, with multiple distances: 2.3 km, 5.25 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and a half marathon relay. The race kit includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a uniquely designed finisher medal at the finish line, and environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshments. The running route mostly runs along the water, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.

Views of the opposite Tihany panorama
Environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshment stations along the course

Refreshments at the stations include dm products, and participants can refresh multiple times on longer distances. Using a personal soft cup or water bottle is required, but soft cups can be rented at the race center for a deposit. Various distances and categories are available for runners, with online registration, timing services, and medals provided during the race.

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
location: Tárkány és Ászár, Veszprém megye, Hungary
description: The Bakonyalja Running is a traditional trail running race held around Tárkány and Ászár. The event is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club, which supports running and orienteering sports through various sections. Runners can test their strength on diverse terrains in a natural environment, enjoying the scenic landscapes of Bakonyalja. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all age groups.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around Tárkány and Ászár
Varied trail running routes
Scenic Bakonyalja landscapes
additional: Participants can choose from multiple distances; details are available on the registration page. The event is supported by the local community.

name: DOMB42X (2.)
location: Benkó Domb, Kecskemét, Bács-Kiskun County, Hungary
description: The DOMB42X is a special running race held at the highest point of Kecskemét, on Benkó Hill, where participants run up and down the nearly 50-meter-high hill multiple times. The course length of one lap is 1.0047 km, which must be completed 3 to 42 times depending on the distance, ranging from a half marathon to an ultramarathon. The race is notable for its significant elevation gain, which exceeds 2000 meters over the marathon distance. The event is family-friendly, with free entry for spectators, and offers numerous programs and sports activities in the leisure park.
course_highlights: Multiple ascents of the nearly 50-meter-high Benkó Hill
One lap length of 1.0047 km with significant elevation gain
Over 2000 meters of elevation gain in the marathon distance
additional: A display shows the number of laps completed each round, so runners do not need to count mentally. The event is family-friendly, with free entry for spectators, and the leisure park features a playground, beach volleyball, beach soccer, basketball court, hiking trails, lakes, fishing opportunities, a snack bar, and a restaurant. There are age and participant limits for different distances, and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers of each gender. The race includes trail running, multiple distances, family-friendly programs, sustainability efforts, kids' races, elevation gain, and multiple-loop courses.

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI

description: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI je bežecké podujatie organizované občianskym združením MAPENZI by Generation of love a obcou Bešeňov. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Bešeňove a ponúkajú kategórie na 10 km, 5 km, detské behy a rekreačný beh 2 km. Štart detských behov je o 15:00 a hlavného behu o 16:00. Podujatie má charitatívny charakter a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rôznych vekových kategórií.

Detské behy so štartom o 15:00 hod.
Rekreačný beh na 2 km
additional: Štart detských behov o 15:00 hod., štart hlavného behu o 16:00 hod. Organizátori poskytujú kontakty na štyroch zodpovedných osôb s telefónnymi číslami. Podujatie je charitatívne a organizované v spolupráci s obcou Bešeňov. Podujatie zahŕňa charitatívny beh na podporu MAPENZI, registrácia je dostupná online aj na mieste, a trať vedie cez futbalové ihrisko v Bešeňove.

Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 16,8 km a 9,7 km, pričom štart je pred Obecným úradom. Súťažiť môžu muži, ženy aj deti v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Organizátormi sú obec Ruskov a Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov v spolupráci s okolitými obcami. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, vrátane seniorov a detí, ktorí majú štartovné zdarma.
course_highlights: Dve trate: 16,8 km a 9,7 km
Štart pred Obecným úradom v Ruskov
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti podľa veku

name: Trail Český ráj
location: Branžež, Český ráj, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular terrain half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves, and sandstone cliffs. This race is a continuation of the eleventh edition of the popular ELEVEN HALF MARATHON ČESKÝ RÁJ and offers probably the most beautiful trail of a terrain half marathon in the Czech Republic. The start is at Komárovský Pond and the finish line is a reward for every runner. The race is complemented by rich services for competitors including refreshments, changing rooms, and medical services.
course_highlights: The route passes through the courtyard of Kost Castle
Surroundings of pine groves and sandstone cliffs
Terrain half marathon with beautiful natural scenery of Český ráj
additional: Start and registration take place at the race center near Komárovský Pond. There are changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, and parking available near the race center. Participants will receive an original medal, a start package, an electronic chip for timing, and can use medical services. Photos and diplomas can be downloaded after the race, and the accompanying program and prizes for the top three in categories are provided. The event offers medals, start packages, refreshments, medical support, and parking. Registration is possible online with late registration options. There are also obstacle races and special categories for dogs and children.

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Velká Bíteš, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held every September after the local festivities. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, with shorter distances available for children. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, including categories for children and youth. The route is approximately one-third on asphalt and two-thirds on unpaved paths, run in full road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: Main course 9 km
Approximately 1/3 asphalt, 2/3 unpaved paths
Race run in full road traffic
additional: Children start according to categories from 11:00, first the youngest, then younger and older pupils. The children's race starts immediately after the main race begins. For children, there is a bouncy castle, face painting, and a small prize for everyone. A raffle for a voucher for an extended PoHodová Devítka running weekend is drawn from start numbers. Registration includes the chance to participate in the raffle for a weekend running package. The race is connected with local festivities and offers various age categories and courses.

The race is held in the picturesque location of Capartice near Plzeň and is part of the Chodsko Runner series. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in a natural environment with a more challenging course profile. It is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional race.
course_highlights: Length of the course 9 km
Mostly forest paths
One longer ascent
additional: The race is part of the 'Best Chodsko Runner' competition, offers various age categories, and detailed results from previous editions. The event takes place on September 20, 2026.

name: 6. Liget élményfutás 7 / 3.5
description: The 6th Liget Adventure Run is a special running event in Budapest's City Park, where families and friends can enjoy the pleasures of sport and over 20 exciting obstacles on 3.5 and 7 kilometer courses. The run is not about competition, but about experience, where smiles and shared adventures are the most important. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and a finisher pack, ensuring an unforgettable day. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to participate in a fun, community experience in the enchanting environment of City Park.
course_highlights: Over 20 special obstacles in the heart of City Park
7 km course starting with a water pipe, climbing, crawling, carrying, and pushing
Family-friendly, community run with smiles and a unique finisher medal
additional: Registration is only possible online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. The registration office opens at 9:30 on race day. The number of participants is limited; registration will close once capacity is reached. The run is not a competition but an experience where smiles and community are the most important. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and a finisher pack. obstacles, family programs, community experience, child-friendly courses

name: FESTÉK BÁZIS JÁNOSHÁZAI FÉLMARATON

The race takes place on safe, traffic-free routes, and every finisher receives a finisher medal and a surprise finishing pack. The event features precise timing, refreshment stations every 5 km, and an online photo gallery. At the end of the race, organizers serve homemade goulash, ensuring a communal experience after the run.
course_highlights: Safe, traffic-free route
21.1 km two-loop half marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances
Refreshments every 5 km and at the finish
additional: Registration and on-site sign-up are available from 08:00 to 12:20. Start times: 21.1 km at 09:30, 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:30. Every finisher receives a medal and a surprise finishing pack. Free online photo gallery. Secure changing facilities and medical supervision are provided. Category-based and overall prizes are awarded. The race offers online and on-site registration, timing, refreshments, medals and photos, changing rooms, and medical support. There is also a relay option between distances, and the event aims to promote sports and a healthy lifestyle.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka

The race offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test strength on an interesting course in a beautiful environment. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a long history
Course runs around Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region
Organized by the KRB Chrudim club with a rich running tradition

tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Campus Run is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice area. The race features a 5.6 km loop, which is completed by both men and women in a single category. The program also includes a children's race for kids of any age with a loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering an opportunity to explore interesting places in Brno.
course_highlights: 5.6 km loop in the University Campus area in Bohunice
Start and finish on Netroufalky Street with public transport access (bus lines 50, 60, 61, 69 and trolleybuses 25, 37)
Friendly atmosphere with a children's race and refreshments after the run
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 16:15. The children's race starts at 16:45, the main race at 17:00. After the race, water and a storage tent are available. Participants run at their own risk. Parking is available in adjacent streets. The course is 5.6 km long, registration is before the race, start in Bohunice, refreshments after the race, public transport access, facilities at the event site.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
location: Areál pivovaru VOLT, Jablonec nad Nisou, Czech Republic
price_range: 250 Kč pro dospělé, 100 Kč pro mládež
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a night race over 5 km held in the late afternoon rhythm at the VOLT brewery premises in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route passes around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women, and youth aged 16 and older, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere with chip timing and valuable gifts for the first registered participants. The start and finish are located within the brewery premises, where race numbers can also be picked up.
course_highlights: The route passes around three reservoirs
Night race over 5 km
Start and finish at the VOLT brewery premises
additional: The first 50 registered participants will receive a sports headband with a special race design. The first 200 registered participants will receive a valuable gift from Dr. Oetker. Race numbers can be picked up at the start area from 18:00 to 19:30. Chip timing is provided by Datacontrol.cz. The race takes place around three lakes, registration is possible online and on-site, and prizes are prepared for the best and early registered participants.

description: The Březina Run in Polná is a traditional running race organized by the Polná Running Team and Běžec Vysočiny z.s., held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for various age groups, from young children to veterans, with the main race covering 9.5 km through fields and forest paths along the Šlapanka River valley. The start is at 17:00, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the best in each category. The race has a long-standing tradition with over 39 editions since 1992.
course_highlights: Main course of 9.5 km runs through fields and forest paths along the Šlapanka River valley
Approximately 30% of the course is on asphalt
The loop includes passing through the village of Věžnice and returning via forest and field paths
additional: Online registration until 12:00 on race day, possibility to use a season ticket worth 1000 CZK for start fees, runners from 3 years old can participate, prizes for the top three in each category according to the organizer's capabilities, refreshments available at the clubhouse buffet at the stadium. The race takes place on September 25, 2026, with start and facilities in Polná near Jihlava. The routes include various lengths and terrains, including the main race of 10.75 km and shorter categories.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, Rožňava District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom je bežecké podujatie v obci Pača, ktoré ponúka dva hlavné trate - náročnejší hlavný beh s dĺžkou 13,5 km a prevýšením 492 m a kratší hobby beh s dĺžkou 6,3 km a prevýšením 203 m. Trasy vedú kombináciou asfaltových a lesných ciest s krásnymi výhľadmi a občerstvovačkami na trati. Pretekári štartujú a cieľia pred kultúrnym domom v Pači, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú navigáciu a označenie trasy. Podujatie je vhodné pre pokročilých aj rekreačných bežcov a ponúka športovú atmosféru s občerstvením a tombolou.
course_highlights: Hlavný beh 13,5 km s prevýšením 492 m, 40% asfalt, 60% lesná cesta
Hobby beh 6,3 km s prevýšením 203 m, kombinácia asfaltu a lesnej cesty
Občerstvovačky na trati a panoramatické výhľady na Pačanský chotár
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 8:30 do 9:45 pred kultúrnym domom v Pači. Detské preteky sú zdarma s medailou pre každého účastníka a vecnými cenami pre prvých troch v kategóriách. Štartový balíček obsahuje štartové číslo s čipom, pamiatkový darček - čelenku, medailu, výživové doplnky a účasť v tombole. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie vrátane guláša, piva alebo kofoly. Trať 13.5 km a 6.3 km, scenic forest and mountain terrain, registration online, prizes for top finishers, scenic views, mountain trail, mountain race

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Futbalový štadión, Rybník, Rybník, Levice, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom štadióne v obci Rybník, okres Levice. Preteká sa na dvoch vzdialenostiach - 5 km a 10 km, pričom súťažia rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien. Štart pre deti je o 9:00 hod., pre dospelých o 11:00 hod. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane stredoškolákov a seniorov, ktorí majú zľavnené štartovné. Organizátori zabezpečujú príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitné zázemie pre bežcov.
course_highlights: Trať vedie okolo futbalového štadióna v Rybníku
Dve vzdialenosti: 5 km a 10 km
Kategórie pre deti, ženy a mužov rôznych vekových skupín
additional: Štart detí o 9:00 hod., dospelých o 11:00 hod. Zľavnené štartovné 10 € pre stredoškolákov do 18 rokov a seniorov nad 65 rokov. Pretek je určený pre všetky vekové kategórie, vrátane detí, s možnosťou registrácie online alebo na mieste. Súčasťou podujatia je aj športové vyžitie v prostredí futbalového štadióna.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín sú jedinečné trailové preteky pri Bratislave, ktoré ponúkajú beh po trase s výhľadom na sútok Dunaja a Moravy a Devínsku Kobylu. Trasy vedú historickou Jantárovou cestou a rozkvitnutými alejami medvedieho cesnaku, čo robí beh nezabudnuteľným zážitkom. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené pod UTMB Index Races, čo zaručuje medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie. Súťažiť môžete na krátkej 12 km trase alebo polmaratóne 22 km, pričom na oboch trasách je vyznačený rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou výhrou.
course_highlights: Trasa s výhľadom na sútok Dunaja a Moravy a Devínsku Kobylu
Historická obchodná Jantárová cesta a aleje medvedieho cesnaku
Conti Speed Section - rýchlostný úsek s vyznačenými 150 metrami
additional: Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi, trasy sú značené a na trati sú rozmiestnené občerstvovacie stanice. Súťaž Conti Speed Section ponúka možnosť vyhrať voucher na nákup pneumatík a bežecký dres. Preteky sú hodnotené v rámci UTMB Index Races, čo umožňuje získanie medzinárodného bodového hodnotenia. Trať vedie cez lesnaté oblasti a historickú Jantárovú cestu, sú k dispozícii medaily, darčeky pre účastníkov, fotografie a zdravotné služby.

name: S Ankou za život
description: Beh S Ankou za život je charitatívne podujatie, ktoré sa koná v Košiciach pri Dóme sv. Alžbety. Štartovné je dobrovoľný príspevok a celý výťažok zo štartovného je venovaný zariadeniu Oáza - nádej pre nový život. Organizátorom je Pastoračné centrum Anky Kolesárovej z Vysokej nad Uhom. Bežci tak môžu spojiť športový výkon s podporou dobrého cieľa.
course_highlights: Charitatívny charakter s výťažkom na podporu sociálnych projektov
Bežecká štafeta v Košiciach a okolí
Udalosť spájajúca komunitu a podporu života
additional: Štartovné je dobrovoľný príspevok, celý výťažok je venovaný charitatívnemu zariadeniu Oáza - nádej pre nový život. Podujatie je určené na podporu života a charity, registrácia je možná formou dobrovoľného príspevku.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, 0 € pre deti 8-17 rokov a niektoré vekové skupiny
description: Beh Srdcom i telom v Nižnej Hutke je každoročné bežecké podujatie, ktoré ponúka trať pre skúsených bežcov na 5 km a zábavnú trasu pre najmenších na 500 m. Okrem športového zážitku je súčasťou programu duchovné zamyslenie, občerstvenie, panelová diskusia a hudobný program. Podujatie vytvára príjemnú komunitnú atmosféru a podporuje súťaživosť i radosť z behu.
course_highlights: 5 km trať pre skúsených bežcov
500 m zábavná trasa pre deti
Občerstvenie gulášom pre bežcov
additional: Registrácia je možná online aj osobne, pričom osobná registrácia je spoplatnená vyšším poplatkom. Štartové čísla, spinky a zoznam účastníkov budú pripravené. Po behu je vyhodnotenie, poďakovanie, tombola a koncert skupiny Kalap. Podujatie zahŕňa duchovné aktivity, občerstvenie, zábavu a kategórie podľa veku, s rôznymi štartovnými poplatkami.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
location: Mělník, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering courses of 10 km and 21 km. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, with the route passing through historical and natural attractions around the town. After finishing, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a rich raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The organizer is the association Run the World, which promotes running as a community and friendly activity.
course_highlights: The course passes through Mělník Castle and vineyards with a view of the Vltava River
The loop includes crossing a lock chamber and passing through Hořín Park
Refreshment stations along the route, including a turnaround point at Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes on race day are not possible. Bib pickup is only available until 9:30. After finishing, each participant receives a commemorative glass and can participate in a wine tasting. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. After the winners are announced, a rich raffle will take place. The race capacity is 500 runners for both the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children's races are free. The registration fee varies depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes to help people with cystic fibrosis. The race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the opportunity to test their strength in the pleasant environment of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a specialized club for fitness and performance running, organizing a number of endurance races in the Olomouc region. The race is part of their running calendar and attracts runners of various age groups and performance levels. The club also supports runners in training and race preparation, ensuring a quality sporting experience.
course_highlights: Road course in a beautiful sports complex by the Bečva River
Opportunity for both fitness and performance runners
Part of the Great Olomouc Region Endurance Race Cup
additional: The race takes place on September 26, 2026, the course is adapted for different performance levels, exact registration information is not provided.

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 CZK pro dospělé, 20 CZK pro děti
description: The Bohutín Run is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football field. The race offers courses for men of 8 km and for women of 4 km, with a surface combining asphalt and forest paths. The event also includes children's races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 1:00 PM, and the atmosphere is friendly and sports-oriented.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest paths
Men run 8 km, women 4 km
Start and finish at Litavan football field
additional: Children's races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 4.88 km, according to the regulations men run 8 km and women 4 km. Results are regularly published in the system and in PDF format. The organizer offers neoprene chip bands for purchase at 100 CZK. The start is at Litavan football field at 1:00 PM, the event includes children's races and runs in a natural environment with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations of Zlín Region Day, which takes place on September 26, 2026, in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run but also a cultural program, regional gastronomy, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a rich day full of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sports and local traditions.
course_highlights: The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit in the Baťovský area
The day also includes a children's run and other sports activities
The program includes regional gastronomy, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional gastronomy, run, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
description: The Velká skála Run is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering courses of 11 km and 6.5 km in forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are prepared. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by beautiful nature and rock formations in the surroundings. The race is already in its 56th year and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
Courses of 11 km and 6.5 km
Start and finish at ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is possible online at www.nazavody.cz with a deadline of September 23, 2026, at midnight. Payment of the entry fee must be made in advance for the lower price; on-site payment is possible at a higher price. The race office is open for late registration no later than 30 minutes before the start of the category. The course is in forest and urban terrain, registration via www.nazavody.cz, children's races and relay races are available, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: Pilsen Cardioběh is the largest cross-country run in Pilsen with courses of 5.8 km and 10 km. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Pilsen Region and also the Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with many years of experience in organizing sports events in Pilsen and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sports experience in the natural environment of Pilsen-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Pilsen-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes, there are children's races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is handled through the company Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful nature of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths and features a combination of natural scenery and historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. It welcomes runners of all levels who want to experience a sports challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths in the nature of Konopiště
Combination of natural scenery and historic sites
Friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization
additional: Participants can choose between an 8 km or 14 km course with the option to change the course before the race. The longer course features a refreshment station approximately at the 8th km, with refreshments also available at the finish line. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series with pre-race runs. Registration is available through irontime.cz, and payment must be made within three days of registration. The event includes a children's race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test rides and KEEN running shoe presentations.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views, and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks and long descents. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with an elevation gain of 1,230 meters on the main 23 km route
Routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks
Beautiful views and atmosphere in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and a commemorative medal. The races are held at Ski Area Severák in Trojanovice, and registration includes a start number, chip timing, medal, refreshments, and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city running race held in the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition of the race will offer routes for the general public including the main race over 10 km, a 3.33 km race, relay races for three-member teams, and children's races of various lengths. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle, community cohesion, and commemorates the cultural heritage of the city. For 2026, a rich accompanying program is prepared, including group warm-ups and musical entertainment on the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through the historic center of Šumperk, a city monument zone, pedestrian zones, and parks
The main race is 10 km long, consisting of three laps of 3.33 km with a total elevation gain of approximately 60 meters
Children's races are held in Sady 1. máje park with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration begins on June 1, 2026. Children's races have free entry. A joint warm-up with professional instructors will take place before the start of children (10:30) and adults (14:00). There will be musical accompaniment on the course by a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svoboda Square near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. The capacity of the main race is 350 runners, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams, and 100 children in each category. The race is aimed at the general public, offers various categories, and results are available online. The event is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
description: K3 - Krčmaňský běh přes tři vrcholy is a race with a length of 11.3 km and an elevation gain of approximately 350 meters. The route takes runners through beautiful scenery over three peaks, mostly on paved paths and partially on grass with a predominantly hard surface. This race offers athletes a pleasant experience in nature and a challenge in the form of uphill running and trail running.
course_highlights: Race length 11.3 km
Elevation gain approx. 350 m
Route passes over three peaks mostly on paved paths
additional: The race is mainly on paved paths and grass, suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding landscape.
