description: The Masterprint Tihany Cross trail run and freestyle Nordic walking race takes place on the picturesque Tihany Peninsula, with various distances of 5, 10, 20, and 30 km. The race route passes through beautiful autumn lavender fields and hilly forest trails marked with red ribbons. The event is family-friendly, featuring children's races and relay races. The race headquarters is located by the Inner Lake, where refreshment points and the finish area are well equipped. Participants can also order a professional technical running shirt.
course_highlights: 5 km fun run on the hilly terrain of Tihany
10 km cross course with four autumn lavender fields
Refreshment points with water, energy drinks, fruit, and salty pretzels
additional: Children's races in preschool and elementary school categories, registration on site. Relay race for two- and three-person teams, with shared start packs and ankle chips for baton exchange. The technical race shirt is available for order, made of microfiber polyester and elastane, with a silver-gray design. Refreshment points at multiple locations, <i:am> fueling hypotonized drink. On-site registration for all distances costs 10,000 HUF, and finisher medals are not provided for on-site registration. Terrain: forest roads, trails; registration: on-site and online options; event atmosphere: family-friendly, sporty, close to nature.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, looped running race held at Dióskert. Participants can complete the half marathon distance by running four laps, but running fewer laps is also an option. The registration fee is voluntary, 500 HUF per lap, supporting the race costs. Every participant will receive an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and the top three male and female finishers will receive a special medal. The award ceremony will take place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, on a loop track
The half marathon consists of four laps, but fewer laps can be chosen
Friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot drinks, and mulled wine at the finish line
additional: Registration is possible on-site, with a recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, with the top three male and female finishers receiving a unique medal. The award ceremony is at 12:00. Runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Participants have the option to run fewer laps. On-site registration, refreshments, commemorative medals, and the award ceremony at 12:00 are provided.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec je tradičný bežecký závod v krásnej prírode Malých Karpát, ktorý ponúka rôzne disciplíny pre hobby bežcov aj výkonnostných pretekárov. Podujatie sa koná v obci Marianka s rodinnou atmosférou a vrcholí prekrásnym západom slnka. Súťažiť môžete v kategóriách na 6 km, 10 km, 15 km, v trojčlenných tímoch na 3×6 km, alebo v detských behoch Beh Záhoráčik. Štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku, pričom preteky sa riadia pravidlami Slovenského atletického zväzu.
course_highlights: Trate vedú Malými Karpatmi s krásnou prírodou
Rodinná atmosféra s detskými behmi Beh Záhoráčik
Prekrásny západ slnka ako vrchol podujatia
additional: Prezentácia a vyzdvihnutie štartových čísiel je možná v pobočke TUI v nákupnom centre BORY MALL. Počet dospelých účastníkov je limitovaný na 500, detí na 400. Počet tímov nie je obmedzený. Časové limity sú 1 hodina pre 6 km, 1:30 hodiny pre 10 km, 2 hodiny pre 15 km a 1,5 hodiny pre tímovú súťaž 3×6 km. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero tratí, kategórie pre dospelých, deti a štafety, registrácia online aj na mieste, časomiera s čipmi, občerstvenie a medaily, limit účastníkov je 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová je bežecký závod, ktorý spája históriu, prírodu a dobrú náladu v malebnom prostredí srdca Slovenska. Preteká sa na troch tratiach: 4,3 km hobby trať pre začiatočníkov a mladých od 13 rokov, 10 km hlavný beh pre výkonnostných aj hobby bežcov a detské behy na 850 m pre deti od 6 do 12 rokov. Trať ponúka stúpania, krásne výhľady na Nízke Tatry a pretekári môžu súťažiť o finančné odmeny a hodnotné ceny. Po dobehu čaká na účastníkov tradičný granadír a originálna medaila patriaca do Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4,3 km hobby trať s pekným okruhom a stúpaním
10 km trať s výhľadmi na Nízke Tatry a banský chodník
Detské behy v centre Ľubietovej na 850 m
additional: Detské behy štartujú od 9:30 podľa vekových kategórií, hobby trať štartuje o 10:40 a hlavný beh o 10:30. Každý účastník dostane originálnu medailu do Marathon Tour. V cieli je pripravený granadír. Najrýchlejší bežci získajú poukazy a trofej, absolútni víťazi 10 km aj finančné ceny. Všetci dobehnutí sú zaradení do žrebovania o zážitkové ceny ako zoskok s padákom alebo vyhliadkový let. Trail running, registrácia, rodinné podujatie, historické témy, krásne výhľady

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run je tradičný bežecký pretek v malebnom prostredí Kvačianskej doliny a Liptovskej Sielnice, ktorý ponúka trate rôznych dĺžok pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky vedú po žltej turistickej značke a hrádzi, s cieľom v Kolibe Gréta, kde pretekárov čaká občerstvenie a kultúrny program. Súčasťou podujatia je aj bohatý sprievodný program pre rodiny a deti. Organizátorom je Olympijský klub Liptova, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitné technické a zdravotné služby.
course_highlights: 7,4 km trať z Kvačianskej doliny po žltej značke do Koliby Gréta
15 km trať z Koliby Gréta cez Kvačiansku dolinu a Prosiecku dolinu späť do Koliby Gréta
3 km trať po hrádzi k Liptovskej Sielnici a späť
additional: Prvých 200 registrovaných účastníkov dostane štartový balíček s gulášom, špagetami, tričkom a medailou. Prevoz bežcov na štart 7,4 km zabezpečený autobusom o 15:30. Po pretekoch guláš a vyhlásenie výsledkov v Stodole Gréta, následne koncert. Šatne a toalety k dispozícii v Kolibe Gréta. Organizátor nezodpovedá za osobné veci a batožinu. Možnosť zvýhodneného ubytovania priamo na mieste. Traťové úseky vedú z Kvačianskej doliny a Koliby Gréta, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, súčasťou štartovného je guláš, medaila, občerstvenie a ďalšie služby. Preteky ponúkajú viacero kategórií vrátane detských a veteránskych, s vyhodnotením a cenami pre víťazov.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 6,00 € (len kategória dospelí pri platbe online)

description: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 - 5. kolo je bežecké podujatie organizované 3klubom Šamorín v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Lesoparku Pomlé v Šamoríne a sú určené pre rôzne vekové kategórie od predškolákov až po dospelých. Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00 hod., hlavný beh začína o 10:30 hod. Podujatie ponúka možnosť zapojiť sa do ligy a zažiť športovú atmosféru v komunitnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Preteky v prírodnom prostredí Lesoparku Pomlé
Kategórie pre deti aj dospelých
Štart detí o 10:00, hlavný beh o 10:30
additional: Kategórie: Predškoláci (0 - 6 rokov), Mladší žiaci (7 - 10 rokov), Starší žiaci (11 - 15 rokov), Dospelí (ženy, muži). Organizátorom je 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín. Kontakt na organizátora: Juraj Nagy, tel.: 0905 984 190. trasy na asfaltových a lesných chodníkoch, kategórie od predškolákov po dospelých, bez výkonnostného a vekového limitu

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice - Prague is a legendary road race over 10 km with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech national championship in road running and offers a challenging course of 10,031 meters, which will test every runner. The race atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying program and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course measures 10,031 meters, 31 meters longer than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech national championship in 10 km road running with 26 categories
additional: Start numbers are issued at the Masaryk Railway Station hall in Prague on the days before the race and on race day in Běchovice. The race offers a functional Joma T-shirt and a commemorative medal included in the registration fee. The relay race starts simultaneously with the 3rd wave of the race at 11:50, consisting of 4 members with predetermined segments. The race capacity is 3,333 runners. Photos and personalized videos from the race are free of charge. The race is part of the celebrations and tradition of running sports in Prague, offering online registration and start in Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Metropole Run is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and community belonging among residents. The race is open to all age categories, from children to seniors and people with disabilities, who represent their city district. Each start provides points for the competition for the most athletic district of Prague. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with unique medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city center
Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups including people with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents their city district based on permanent residence and contributes to the point evaluation of the districts. The project emphasizes competition among Prague districts for the title of the most athletic district. Participants receive original medals and running magnets for their race bibs as souvenirs. The races feature various distances, are part of a series with medals and updates on the event locations; registration is available online and on-site.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
location: Kis-Duna sétány, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a diverse-distance running race that takes place in the historic districts of Esztergom, including Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside bike path. Participants can choose from several distances, including individual and relay categories, and there are shorter races organized specifically for children. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and also serves as a point collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. The race is supported by prominent figures such as the mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, enhancing its prestige.
course_highlights: The running course features mixed surfaces, including cobblestones and asphalt sections
The route passes through Esztergom Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside bike path areas
Relay distances consist of three laps, each approximately 7 km long
additional: Children's races are free of charge, registration required. The first runner in the relay can also participate in the individual half marathon. The race is a point collection station for the Ötpróba program, with points earned by completing distances. The relay start/finish zone is located in front of the Basilica. Distances include: half marathon, 14 km, 7 km, relay, and children's races; terrain: mixed surfaces; registration available online and on-site; the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: HÍRÖS FÉLMARATON
description: The Hírös Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Kecskemét, scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026, at the Benkó Center. The race offers multiple distances, including 0.3 km, 1 km, 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 42 km, catering to all age groups and runners. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide a community sports experience. Participants receive a unique finisher medal, and trained first aid providers will be available during the race. Bib pickup is possible on race day and beforehand.
course_highlights: Distances: from 0.3 km to 42 km, individual and relay categories
Time limits: 2 hours 45 minutes for 21 km, 5 hours 45 minutes for 42 km
Start times: 9:00 for the marathon, 10:45 for the 300 m distance
additional: Bib pickup on race day and beforehand on September 27 from 15:00 to 17:00. The registration fee includes participation in the course run and a pasta party. The bib must be worn visibly; exchange is not allowed. Trained first aid providers will be on standby during the race. Participants will have the opportunity to collect their race pack, enjoy the pasta party, receive finisher medals, and visit local sights.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
location: Eszterházi park, Kapuvár, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 running race will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, at Eszterházi Park. The race takes place on a completely flat, urban street course and attracts an increasing number of domestic and international runners each year. The event aims to share a community experience and the joy of movement, with good atmosphere and camaraderie at the center. The experience continues after the finish line with awards and a large event tent where supporters can comfortably cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: Completely flat, urban street course
Race center with a large event tent and start-finish arch
Community experience and mass sport event atmosphere
additional: The race center will be located in a large event tent on the grassy area in front of the local government building, where the start-finish arch is also situated. The course is partially closed to traffic and includes refreshment stations. Participants will receive unique iron medals and certificates, and personalized finish line ribbons can be ordered for the marathon, half marathon, and ultramarathon distances. The race uses disposable chip timing, except for the BabyRace distance. Multiple distances, an urban course, community event, online registration available, location at Eszterházi Park.

name: Ivančická hodinovka
location: Městský stadion Ivančice, Ivančice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ivančice Hour Race is a traditional athletic event organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club, held at the Ivančice Municipal Stadium. The race takes place at the stadium near Malovaný mlýn and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant city environment with a rich history. The start is scheduled for the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the race and other activities in Ivančice. The event is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Race at Ivančice Municipal Stadium
Pleasant sporting environment in a historic town
Start at 10:30 AM
additional: The race is organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club at the FC Ivančice field on Malovansko. The venue is Ivančice Municipal Stadium, U Malovaného mlýna no. 1515, 664 91 Ivančice. The race offers chip timing, online and on-site registration options, and is part of the local sports tradition.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The Svatováclavský Run in Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque environment of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, which mainly follow natural paths and forest sections. The event also includes fun runs and children's races ranging from 50 to 1100 meters, making the race attractive to the general public and families with children. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the routes
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Fun runs and children's races from 50 to 1100 meters
additional: The race starts at the football field in Blažovice. The main category begins at 12:45 PM. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run - Vévoda association, contact person František Kubínek, phone 739 150 283. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation. It is part of the local running tradition and offers various race lengths including children's categories, making the event suitable for the whole family.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumannová Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity for outdoor sports activity and is complemented by children's runs. Registered participants in advance benefit from a lower entry fee. The event has a long-standing tradition and is regularly held in the fall.
course_highlights: Picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť
Traditional running race with children's runs
Natural terrain suitable for running
additional: The race includes children's runs. Pre-registered participants have a cheaper entry fee. Results and statistics are regularly published on the website. Trail maps are available in a photo album. The start is scheduled for September 28, 2026, at 10:00 AM. Exact registration details are not provided. The event is suitable for the general running public.

name: MilešovKa(p)
location: Teplice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional running race from Teplice to Milešovka, covering a distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 meters. The course runs on asphalt, hiking trails, field and forest paths and is marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the best in categories, mountain climbers, and age record holders. It is organized by the SPONA Teplice association, which supports amateur sports in the region. The results are announced together with other running events in November.
course_highlights: Distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 m
Surface: asphalt, hiking trail, field and forest paths
Course marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club
additional: Awards for the top five in each category, medals and diplomas, trophies for winners and teams, bonuses for mountain climbers and the fastest Václav, plaques for five and ten consecutive participations. The course is marked by the Czech Tourist Club. Results are announced in November together with BĚKODO. Registration is open until August 31, 2025. Participants will receive a T-shirt and a race medal. The race is part of a series of local runs in Teplice.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
location: Kamenicko Šenov-Prácheň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The run around Panská Skála is a popular trail race held on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers routes of 3 km and 6 km, which lead through hilly terrain around Panská Skála, and is part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced competitors, providing a unique outdoor running experience with beautiful views.
course_highlights: Trail routes through hilly terrain with views of Panská Skála
Two distances: 3 km and 6 km suitable for various levels of runners
Included in the District Running League of Česká Lípa
additional: The race is supported by local organizations, results and regulations are regularly published, the event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area as well as from across the country.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
location: Krčský les, Praha 4-Krč, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Autumn runners' project "From pub to pub" is a traditional running event held in the picturesque environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. This race is popular among runners and has been organized for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to participate in this popular course, which offers a pleasant experience in nature. Registrations are accepted on the day of the race approximately one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Krč Forest
A traditional running course popular among local runners
Pleasant natural environment in Prague 4-Krč
additional: Registrations for the race are accepted on the day of the event about 1 hour before the start. Running course in Krč Forest, event for design enthusiasts and runners

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského

description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering routes for various age groups from young children to adults. The course runs through the Budoucnost park and past significant sites such as the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a combination of asphalt and unpaved paths with gentle elevation. The start and finish are at the elementary school V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are available.
course_highlights: Circuit route through Budoucnost park
Passes by the memorial to the victims of World War I and II and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský
Highest point of the course at Calvary with three crosses
additional: Start and finish at elementary school V Sadech 560. Showers and toilets available at the school building. Parking is available in several nearby locations, some with a fee, others free. Runners from 3 years old and above can participate. Youth up to 17 years old start for free. The event includes various age categories, with online and on-site registration options, parking nearby. Races are held at the Elementary School Havlíčkův Brod and around the park.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: Jarabský polmaratón je jedinečný horský trailový pretek v Nízkych Tatrách s dĺžkou 22,1 km, ktorý ponúka náročnú trasu plnú stúpaní, klesaní a technického terénu. Pretek je určený pre milovníkov trailového behu a aktívneho oddychu, ktorí si môžu vychutnať krásne výhľady a atmosféru komunity bežcov od profesionálov po rekreačných športovcov. Podujatie má tradíciu od roku 2015 a nesie v sebe ducha priateľského bežeckého stretnutia „Choď ako môžeš okolo Jarabej“. V roku 2025 je zaradený do Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy, čo podčiarkuje jeho kvalitu a výzvu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez čistú prírodu, lesy a horské chodníky
Náročný trailový terén s výstupmi a zostupmi
Krásne výhľady na centrálny hrebeň Nízkych Tatier
additional: Trať má prvky pravého Sky Race-u a je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy od roku 2025. Pretek je určený pre širokú komunitu bežcov od profíkov po rekreačných športovcov. V minulosti bola trať niekoľkokrát upravovaná podľa počasia, aktuálna dĺžka je 22,1 km. Podujatie má priateľskú atmosféru a vychádza z neformálneho bežeckého stretnutia bez časomiery. Náročný horský trail s prevýšením 1240 m, registrácia cez web, občerstvovacie stanice, značenie, zdravotná služba, technológie na zlepšenie skúseností.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run je najväčší bežecký trailový festival v Malých Karpatoch, ktorý ponúka trasy rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti pre bežcov aj turistov. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prírodnom prostredí s dôrazom na ochranu prírody a zdravý životný štýl. Trasy vedú prevažne lesnými zvážnicami a trailmi s minimálnym asfaltovým povrchom, vhodné pre mierne pokročilých až pokročilých bežcov. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Hojta, ktoré podporuje športovanie a ekologické hodnoty.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú 65 % lesnou zvážnicou a 33-35 % lesným trailom
Prevýšenie od 80 m do 876 m podľa dĺžky trate
Občerstvenie na trati na viacerých miestach podľa dĺžky trate
additional: Štart je 700 m od Malokarptského námestia v Lamači s presunom 20 min pred štartom. Časový limit nie je stanovený pre väčšinu tratí, okrem najdlhších, kde je limit 5 alebo 7 hodín. Na trati sú občerstvovacie stanice podľa dĺžky trate. Možnosť zakúpiť občerstvenie na Bielom Kríži. Preteky sa konajú 3. októbra 2026, registrácia je možná prostredníctvom oficiálnej stránky, pretekárske kategórie zahŕňajú rôzne vekové skupiny, preteky sú bez časového limitu pre väčšinu vzdialeností.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: U. S. Steel Family Run - Minimaratón je bežecké podujatie v Košiciach, ktoré je súčasťou tradičného Medzinárodného maratónu mieru. Bežci všetkých vekových kategórií sú vítaní bez vekového obmedzenia. Podujatie sa riadi pravidlami World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a organizáciu. Štart a cieľ sú situované na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach, čo umožňuje atraktívny mestský beh.
course_highlights: Trať vedie centrom mesta Košice po Hlavnej ulici
Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie bez vekového limitu
Organizované podľa pravidiel World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu
additional: Presun štartu na nasledujúci ročník nie je možný. Presun štartu na nového účastníka je možný za určitých podmienok. Registrácia a platba štartovného sa kontroluje online cez účet pretekára. Registrácia je otvorená pre všetkých záujemcov, pričom účastníci môžu očakávať priateľskú atmosféru a možnosť zúčastniť sa na krátkom, ale dynamickom behu v srdci Košíc.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km are races set in the unique natural environment of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly on asphalt cycle paths and forest roads, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in a beautiful and peaceful setting. The race starts at the Renaissance square in Třeboň and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO World Heritage status. The ideal date in October offers pleasant running weather and an inspiring atmosphere with professional pacemakers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course runs on asphalt cycle paths and quality forest roads
Start at the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a UNESCO candidate nature reserve
additional: Registration allows for a refund of the entry fee until September 8, 2026, with an administrative fee of 150 CZK, transfer of the registration to another year until September 30, 2026, and after the race, the possibility to receive a voucher for running shoes worth 777 CZK. The race is limited in participant numbers and registration transfer to another runner is not possible. Included in the registration is a free 12-month subscription to the magazine Svět běhu. Routes are available for download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, supported by regional authorities, with the option to purchase gift vouchers. The event takes place in October 2026.

name: Run Berounka Run
location: Újezd u Svatého Kříže, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 3,300 Kč za tým; 800 Kč pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 3 300 Kč za tým.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra je startovné 800 Kč.

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, running along the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 sections with a total elevation gain of over 3100 meters, mostly on forest and field paths. The race starts on October 3, 2026, at 5:00 AM in several waves, with the Ultra category starting on the evening of October 2. The race is intended for teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category, with winners announced in several categories and refreshments provided at the finish line.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River divided into 6 sections
Total elevation gain of 3182 m, mainly on forest and field paths
Start in Újezd u Svatého Kříže, finish in Prague Radotín at the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Start takes place in waves from 5:00 AM, the Ultra category starts on October 2 at 8:00 PM and at midnight. The time limit for completing one section for teams is 4 hours. Each team receives a starter pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip, and gifts from sponsors. Mobile toilets are available at relay points. Refreshments are provided at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80, with up to 6 runners per team, and in the Ultra category, a maximum of 55 individuals. The race begins in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and ends in Prague Radotín, with registration open from November 1, 2025, to September 20, 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route mainly runs on forest and field paths with a total elevation gain of 3182 meters.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / účastník

description: The 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique environment of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, leading from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky and combines daytime and nighttime running with sunrise and sunset. The route is demanding, with an elevation gain of 820 meters and 90% trail surface, suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou area provides comfortable facilities including restaurants, accommodation, and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with an elevation gain of 820 m
90% trail surface
Views from the upper reservoir of Dlouhé Stráně at an altitude of 1354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from May 1, 2026, to August 30, 2026, or until capacity is reached. Each participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The start package includes a voucher for a cable car ride to view the route. Participants can switch in pairs at will. It is mandatory to follow the rules and have a functioning mobile phone on the route. The organizer provides map materials and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow flags. At the finish line, it is necessary to submit the chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, offers nearby accommodation options, and is associated with supporting the MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hejtman Run is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday of October. The main race is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, taking place on local roads and dikes of ponds in a picturesque environment. The race is open to the public and takes place amidst regular road traffic with an emphasis on safety and adherence to rules. Shorter races are prepared for children and youth up to 15 years old, with presentations directly on site on the day of the race. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The route of the main race passes over the dike of Hejtman Pond and Staňkovský Pond dike
The race takes place on local roads with scenic views of Třeboňsko
Start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on the day of the race from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and chips for the 10 km main race are issued. Participants run at their own risk and must follow traffic rules. For younger competitors up to 18 years old, accompaniment by a legal guardian or a declaration is required. The race is conducted on local roads and a shale track, with registration possible on-site and online. The start is within the stadium area. The races are open to all age groups with different distance options.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: CEZ RunTour Prague is a family running race offering courses for hobby runners and elites in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series of eight unique locations. Organizers emphasize perfect service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and has the opportunity to contribute to charity through their participation.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km in Ladronka Park
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters
Perfect service including guides and medical team
additional: On the course, there are guides, a medical team, and refreshment stations (1 at 5 and 10 km, at least 2 at the half marathon). Each runner receives a gymsack with gifts, children receive a start package from Lidl. There is a children's zone, warm-up sessions for children, and an accompanying program for families. A special emergency phone line is available for the race. More courses, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, refreshments, and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. At the finish line, each participant is rewarded with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: Precisely measured asphalt track of 3.2 km (2 miles)
The course mostly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years old. Time is recorded for each runner, and the top three places in men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, running for all age groups, children's course 800 m, with options to arrive by bike, car, or trolleybus no. 11.

name: Běh na Čerťák
location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

price_tiers.distance: všechny kategorie mimo děti do 14 let

description: The Čerťák Run is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmichovi Garden area in Rýmařov. The race offers routes for various age categories from preschoolers to seniors, with the main trail passing through forest paths and the summit of Kamenná Hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area, and the course includes running on field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. After the race, refreshments and results announcements are provided at the SKI area. The race is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region, and winners in categories receive material prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area
Run over the summit of Kamenná Hora (799 m above sea level) with Čerťák's swinging bridge
Forest and field roads with beautiful views
additional: Registration at the SKI area facilities in Flemdě from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D, E, and all women run a shortened course. After the race, refreshments: beer, soft drinks, coffee, tea. Results are announced at the SKI area after all competitors have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows, online registration until October 3, 2025, start at the SKI area in Flemdě. The race takes place on October 3, 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, which has been held for over half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main race covering 8,000 meters through picturesque countryside around the village and on the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and facilities are located in the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes and light refreshments are prepared for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Main course of 8,000 m mainly runs through meadows, field and forest paths of varying quality
Children's courses run on asphalt within the area
Surroundings of the village and slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), pupils (400 - 1200 m), youth, women, men, veterans (courses of 2,250 m and 8,000 m). The top three finishers in each category will receive material prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Various courses from 50 m to 8 km, family event, refreshments, material prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race held for the 32nd time in the picturesque environment of Nový Rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories including the main 10 km race, relays, and children's runs, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals who want to enjoy a sports day with a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are adjusted for each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and organized.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race in the natural environment of Nový Rybník
Categories for children, adults, family and student relays
Traditional race with over thirty years of history
additional: Registration from 8:00 to 10:30 for children, from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The school category starts at 9:00, the main 10 km race and relays start at 11:30. Conditions for family relays require a familial relationship, student relays must be composed of students from elementary, secondary, or university schools with possible status verification at registration. Start from 8:00, the main 10 km race begins at 11:30, registration from 8:00 to 10:30, various categories including relays and children.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is an outdoor race that offers runners the chance to escape the city hustle and enjoy running through forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains. The race is the final event of the season and takes place through the woods, around the dam, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength in beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains
Running around the dam
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. There are two routes available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. It is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth edition with approximately 2000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails, and the race offers various categories. Registration is possible via a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. Family races are also part of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race for all age groups and running levels, whether running for fun, aiming to improve personal bests, or just enjoying a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps (3.2 km) and children under 12 running one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Pancake Cup, which encourages regular participation and performance reflection.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km)
After the race, a warm cinnamon pancake for all participants
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times measured for each participant and results published online. Adjusted times based on age coefficient count towards the Pancake Cup. The 3.2 km course starts in Stromovka Park, with pre-registration available and on-site registration. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

description: SILESIA cross 1/2 marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice with the center at the U Chovatelů area. The race offers courses of 21 km and 13 km, which pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava. The course is challenging and partially runs on roads with full traffic, requiring participants to follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Timing is measured electronically without chips, and the results are announced at the finish area. The race is canceled for 2026, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava
The race takes place on roads with full traffic, with electronic timing without chips
Course adjustments due to fenced private land; the 21 km course does not lead to Radun Castle
additional: Participant registration takes place at the race center on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the playground behind the elementary school in Raduň, with the finish at the U Chovatelů area in Opava-Kylešovice. The race occurs on roads with full traffic; participants run at their own risk. Timing is electronic without chips. Due to a small number of participants in the short courses, the 750 m, 1500 m, 3 km, and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional portable signage and course officials. Entry fees increase from October 1, 2025, to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km, and 150 CZK for shorter distances. If the fee is paid by September 26, participants can have a start number with their name. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various courses and is known for its specific cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes occurred due to private land.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Castle Park Run is a running race held in the picturesque environment of Vlašim Castle Park. The course, 8.4 km long, combines trail and asphalt sections, offering runners a diverse experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is suitable for runners who want to experience running in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs through Vlašim Castle Park
Combination of trail and asphalt sections
Course length of 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including trail and asphalt sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-filled orienteering-beer running-walking-crawling race in teams, held in the picturesque terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on their back, complete mini-games at stations, and drink beer at the stations. The race combines physical challenge with team cooperation and fun, with the route passing through varied terrain with ascents and descents. The winning team receives a traveling trophy and gift packages. The event is intended for adults over 18 years old and emphasizes safety and participant responsibility.
course_highlights: The route passes through varied terrain with ascents and descents
Completing the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on the back
Five control stations with mini-games and beer consumption
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet), a pump, a barrel harness, a trash bag, and a headlamp. Recommended equipment is a basic first aid kit, water, and nutritious food. Beer may only be consumed at control stations, where it is served from a single competition container with a maximum of 0.5 liters. The start of barrel distribution is from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is intended for participants over 18 years old who sign a declaration of personal responsibility. The use of transportation devices other than trekking poles is prohibited. The event is part of the ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race held on forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to all enthusiasts of healthy movement, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite competitors and spectators to participate and support sports in the region.
course_highlights: Forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera
Uneven terrain with potential puddles and mud
Cross-country character with runs uphill and downhill
additional: The course is not closed, participants must follow the organizers' instructions. The race takes place regardless of weather, only extreme conditions may cause postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 years must be accompanied by a person over 18 years old, participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. A bib number is mandatory and must be visibly worn on the chest. The use of skates, bikes, trekking poles, and shortening the course is prohibited. The race is open to all age groups, offering a rich program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the town of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in the Prague district of Košíře, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. This race is part of a series of local running events and is suitable for both recreational runners and those looking to improve their performance in a natural environment. The course runs through forest paths and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels, emphasizing the joy of movement in nature.
course_highlights: Course approximately 4.5 km long with forest paths and trails
Natural environment around the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Opportunity to participate as a recreational or competitive runner
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the bus stop 'U lesíka'.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run offers participants the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery with vineyards and wine cellars, which are characteristic of this South Moravian region. The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic and is part of the village's rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon of October 3, 2026, at Sóla near the cultural house.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque wine-growing landscapes of Bořetice and Kraví Hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish at the cultural house in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic. The race starts at Sóla near the cultural house. Bořetice offers a rich cultural and sports program, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race includes running on asphalt, registration begins at 13:20, there is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race, participants can taste burčák and local specialties.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszarui Running Festival is a leisure running event held in Jászfényszarú, at Szentcsalád Square. The race offers distances for multiple age groups, from preschoolers to adults, with asphalted and short dirt sections. The quarter marathon features chip timing, refreshment stations, and medals for participants, and the event is free for all distances. The aim of the event is to promote community sports and running, in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: Mostly asphalted route with short dirt sections
Multiple distances suitable for preschoolers to adults, tailored to age groups
Refreshment stations and chip timing for the quarter marathon
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00, closing 15 minutes before the start of the races. Finish packs and medals are provided for quarter marathon runners. The top 1-3 finishers in each age group and gender receive medals. The bib number must be worn visibly at the front. Each participant can only compete in one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers various distances, with races on asphalt and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. Organizers ensure medical supervision and refreshment stations.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running event held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a variety of distances for beginners to advanced runners. The race's special features include the beautiful panorama of the Balaton Uplands and the challenging, diverse terrain that touches the most scenic parts of the peninsula. Many choose the half marathon distance as their first, as the course layout and spectacular sections provide an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants, and all finishers receive a medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.
course_highlights: The half marathon course passes through Tihany's most beautiful, varied panoramic sections, including the Balaton shoreline and the northern tip of the peninsula
The 12 km 'Tihany Circle' offers a challenge with elevation changes and diverse terrain
The 3 km and 5 km distances are on asphalt, easy-to-complete routes, ideal for beginners and those restarting their running journey
additional: All distances include a finisher medal and a running shirt. The 3K race starts at 11:00, while the 5K, 12K, and 21K races start at 12:00, with the 21K having a staggered start. The 400-meter baby run takes place at the race center, with refreshments at the finish line. There are age group awards, and participants under 18 require parental consent. The field is limited to 1500 participants, excluding the baby run. The race takes place on paved roads of the Tihany Peninsula, featuring varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km, 21 km; the event will be held on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: Medzinárodný maratón mieru v Košiciach je tradičný bežecký sviatok, ktorý sa koná 4. októbra 2026 na Hlavnej ulici. Organizovaný Maratónskym klubom Košice, ponúka maratónsku trať, polmaratón a ďalšie disciplíny, pričom štart a cieľ sú situované v centre mesta. Podujatie je známe svojou dlhou históriou a kvalitnou organizáciou, vrátane Majstrovstiev Slovenska v polmaratóne. Bežci môžu očakávať profesionálnu časomieru a bohatý sprievodný program.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ na Hlavnej ulici medzi DoubleTree by Hilton a obchodným domom Dargov
Majstrovstvá Slovenska v polmaratóne sú súčasťou podujatia
Trať je certifikovaná podľa pravidiel World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu
additional: Štart a cieľ sú na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach. Organizátor zabezpečuje profesionálnu časomieru. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj Majstrovstvá Slovenska v polmaratóne. K dispozícii sú vekové kategórie a špeciálne kategórie pre štafety a handbike. Registrácia je možná online a platba je možná kartou, Google Pay, Apple Pay a registračným kódom. Podujatie zahŕňa rôzne kategórie vrátane maratónu, polmaratónu, štafety a inline disciplín, s možnosťou online registrácie a zmeny štartu či disciplíny v stanovených termínoch.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
location: Malšovický stadion, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: OLFINCAR Hradecký Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia, held since 2013. The race offers certified routes including a marathon, half marathon, relay race, 10 km run, and children's races. The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most beautiful city routes. In 2026, the race will also host the Czech Republic Veteran Half Marathon Championship and the Czech Republic Rescue and Security Forces Half Marathon Championship. The facilities of the new football arena in the city center provide comfortable services for participants.
course_highlights: Certified routes with a fast profile
Course among the fastest in the Czech Republic
Facilities of the new football arena in the center of Hradec Králové
additional: Start times: 11:15 AM (marathon), 12:30 PM (half marathon and 10 km), 12:40 PM (charity run). Facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, parking, and clothing sales. The starter pack includes an original medal, a gift, a start number, and an electronic chip for timing. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish line. Photos and diplomas are available for download (not guaranteed for everyone). There is an accompanying program and prizes for 1st-3rd place in categories. Races include half marathon, marathon, 10 km run, and children's races, with a limit of 3,500 runners, chip timing, and certified routes.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
location: Stará Ves u Rýmařova, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run - Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race mainly run on forest paths, covering a distance of 13.6 km with an elevation gain of 430 meters. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. It offers a challenging route in the beautiful nature of the Moravian-Silesian Region, which will delight mountain running and endurance discipline enthusiasts. The race takes place in Stará Ves u Rýmařova and is suitable for experienced runners seeking a terrain challenge.
course_highlights: Distance of 13.6 km mainly on forest paths
Elevation gain of 430 m
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race is part of running series and cups, scheduled for October 4, 2026.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Panorama Run is a traditional cross-country race in the challenging mountain terrain around the Jáchymov football stadium. This race is open to all age groups and has been held for the 33rd time. The event is organized by the Jáchymov Physical Education Union and offers sporting activity in the beautiful environment of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain around TJ Jáchymov football stadium
Traditional cross-country race with a long history (33rd edition)
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race starts at the TJ Jáchymov football field. The event is open to the general public and all age categories. The race takes place in the demanding mountain terrain of the Ore Mountains around Jáchymov. The event is suitable for all age groups; registration details are not explicitly provided. The course runs through mountain terrain around Jáchymov.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
location: Klášterec nad Orlicí, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: nejmladší, mladší, starší žactvo a dorost 50 Kč

description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering courses through meadows and local roads with hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary awards. The start and finish are located at the football field near the school, with the main race beginning in the morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses through meadows and local roads
3 km loop with 60 m elevation gain
Combination of flat and hilly sections with grassy and field paths
additional: Registrations on site from 8:30 AM. The main race starts at 11:15 AM. Prizes for winners include diplomas, medals, material prizes, and monetary awards for the best in the 6 km and 9 km races. The 9 km course is run in three loops of 3 km each, the 6 km course in two loops. The 3 km loop has an elevation gain of 60 m. Hilly terrain, trail/cross-country, various race lengths, on-site registration, refreshments, and a raffle of start numbers.

name: Slatinský kros
location: Park Terénky, Dědická, Brno-Slatina, Brno, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinský cross-country race is a traditional cross-country running event held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and offers a grassy course with a hilly profile, challenging runners in a pleasant natural environment. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can expect cups, medals, and valuable material prizes.
course_highlights: Grassy course with a hilly profile
Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina
Cross-country run in a natural environment
additional: Prizes include cups, medals, and valuable material prizes. Online registration will be launched in summer 2026. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District. The race offers cups, medals, and material prizes; registration is possible online, and the course runs through Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competition primarily with oneself. The event takes place in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Distance of 2 miles (3.2 km) with a children's category over 600 m
Event location in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain
Races by the river on U Dětského domova street in June and August
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM on race day. The top three places are announced in each category. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated within the cup competition from September 2025 to August 2026. The course runs on asphalt paths in Smetanovy sady; registration is voluntary, the race is held on October 4, 2026; a children's race over 600 m is also part of the event.

name: Roštejnské stráně
location: Ranč u Lipek, Telč, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country run organized by Orel Telč, which is part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful environment near Ranch u Lipek in Telč and offers runners various categories including family relays and a popular run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sporting values. Medals, diplomas, and material prizes are prepared for winners, including special awards for the youngest and oldest runners.
course_highlights: Start at Ranch u Lipek in Telč
Cross-country run in natural terrain
Part of the Orel Running League
additional: Categories include children's runs, family relays (3 members with one child up to 12 years old), and a popular run for beginners over 18 years old. Start times are approximate between 12:30 and 13:20, and it is recommended to arrive at least half an hour before the start. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. The race is part of the Orel Running League, with start times between 12:30 and 13:20, and emphasizes fair play and sporting values.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
location: TJ Lokomotiva stadion, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers a unique opportunity for runners of all ages to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has been dedicated to athletics and running races for a long time, emphasizing quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners and children.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Lužnice with beautiful natural scenery
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí
Friendly atmosphere and support from the Atletika Veselí athletics club
additional: Athletics training sessions are held outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. Parking is available in the TJ Lokomotiva sports complex. The club also offers the sale of club caps and headbands. Payments and registration are conducted electronically through club membership. The race is open to all age groups, with registration available via the website. The start is at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium, and participants can choose between the 8.09 km and 5.67 km routes.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huti, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held annually on the first Sunday of October in Huta near Jablonec nad Nisou. This race, with a history dating back to 1972, offers a main race of 10 km and shorter variants for different age categories. The course runs through picturesque scenery with a grassy field serving as the start and finish area. The race is suitable for all running enthusiasts, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race of 10 km through scenic nature
Traditional date on the first Sunday of October
Start and finish on the grassy field at the fire station in Huta
additional: Registrations and bib numbers are submitted directly on site at the start. Youth categories register from 08:10 to 09:00, other categories from 08:10 until 15 minutes before the start. The program begins with a collective assembly at 09:10 AM. Categories include preschool children, youth, unregistered men and women, and the main 10 km race. The race takes place on the first Sunday of October on a grassy field near the fire station in Huta, with the possibility of online registration. The course is quite hilly, mainly forest and meadow paths, suitable for trail runners.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
location: Hospůdka u Plotice, Tetín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka - Tetín Running Series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route goes over hills and offers beautiful views of the Czech Karst and the surrounding landscape, including a climb to the lookout over Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that motivate runners of all levels to stay active in nature with a friendly atmosphere and support from local pubs. Refreshments, baggage storage, and awards for the best in categories are provided on site.
course_highlights: The route passes over Damil hill with views of Tetín and the Czech Karst
The highest point is near Na Koledníku village, then mostly downhill
Picturesque lookout over Beroun and the surrounding landscape before the final descent to the finish
additional: The route is marked with red-white and yellow reflective signs and red ground arrows. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The top three places in each category will receive a diploma and medal. The trail race features a marked route, starting at Hospůdka u Plotice, includes hilly terrain and beautiful views, registration via voucher, with refreshments and baggage storage on site. Bringing a headlamp is advised.

name: Mrdická mašina
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Mrdická Machine is a fast run of 2.0 km across Mrdické meadows in Heřmanův Městec. This race is part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league, which includes ten athletic and cycling events in the vicinity of Mrdice fortress. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun and sporting challenge for all runners. Organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, which supports running and sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: 2.0 km run across Mrdické meadows
Part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league with 10 races
Surroundings of the historic Mrdice fortress
additional: The race is intended for all running enthusiasts, registration is available in the regulations, and the course runs through meadows and forest paths around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Roštejn Forest Run is a friendly race for the general public held in the picturesque surroundings of the forests near Růžená in the Vysočina region. The course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old, with distances ranging from 300 meters to 8,900 meters. The event is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature with the opportunity to observe local wildlife. Organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., the race is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Course lengths from 300 m to 8,900 m suitable for all age groups
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on October 9, 2026, around Růžená. The main race length is 7.3 km, the course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Prague Celts is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the opportunity to experience beautiful nature and Celtic hillforts with a total elevation gain of 2500 meters. The route leads through wooded hilly terrain of Prague, including historical sites such as Šance hillfort, Butovice, Závist, Vyšehrad, and others, providing stunning views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and ends at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds and is intended for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban environment. The race capacity is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km route with 2500 m elevation gain in wooded hilly Prague
Connection of three Celtic hillforts and historical sites of Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické rocks, and other locations
additional: Start and finish are at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds. The race capacity is 120 people. Bus transportation is available via bus 193 from Kačerov station to Kunratice School (12 minutes). Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (chapter 3.3). The route for the new edition is sent via email to registered participants. Refreshment stations are part of the race and highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2500 m elevation gain, includes refreshment stations, the option for a relay race, a diploma and medal, registration until September 30, 2026, capacity of 120 persons.

name: Javornícka stovka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 79 EUR.

description: Javornícka stovka je horský ultramaratón a diaľkový pochod, ktorý sa koná v oblasti Javorníkov. Bežci prechádzajú náročným horským terénom s viacerými kontrolnými bodmi a časovými limitmi. Podujatie je určené pre skúsených bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v krásnej prírode. Štart aj prezentácia prebiehajú v Čadci, cieľ je v Lysej pod Makytou. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, povinnú výbavu a zdravotnú pomoc počas celej trasy.
course_highlights: Horský terén Javorníkov s viacerými kontrolnými bodmi
Cieľ v Lysej pod Makytou
Dlhý časový limit 27 hodín s viacerými etapovými časovými limitmi
additional: Prezentácia účastníkov prebieha v Dome kultúry v Čadci na Matičnom námestí v piatok večer a v sobotu ráno. Štart je spoločný z Čadce o 07:00. Organizátori zabezpečujú prevoz batožiny a dropbagy pre kontrolný bod K4. Počas podujatia je zabezpečená zdravotná pomoc a bezpečnosť. Ubytovanie je možné v Čadci, v telocvični základnej školy je nočný kľud pre účastníkov. Trať zahŕňa 80% lesných ciest, 5% asfaltu a 15% lúk; povinné vybavenie zahŕňa čelovku, reflexné prvky, hydratáciu a prvú pomoc; registrácia bola uzavretá 26. septembra 2025.

description: GARMIN Beh Súľovskými skalami je tradičný bežecký závod v krásnom prostredí Súľovských skál, ktorý ponúka tri trate rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti. Bežci prechádzajú malebnou prírodou s výhľadmi na skalné útvary a hrebeňové chodníky, pričom súčasťou trate sú aj občerstvovacie stanice. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, ktoré majú samostatné kategórie a štarty. Organizátorom je Slovenský cykloklub CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitnú prípravu a servis pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez malebné Súľovské skaly s výhľadmi na skalné útvary a hrebeňové chodníky
Prevýšenie až 850 metrov na najdlhšej 17 km trati
Tri občerstvovacie stanice na trati a samostatné detské kategórie s vlastnými štartmi
additional: Limit účasti je 1200 bežcov na veľký beh a 350 detí na detský beh. Detský beh je bezplatný. Registrácia je platná až po úhrade štartovného. Možnosť osobnej registrácie a platby v deň pred štartom, ak nie je naplnený limit účasti. Štarty detských kategórií sú medzi štartmi veľkého behu. Trať zahŕňa lesné chodníky a krátke asfaltové úseky; registrácia je možná cez oficiálne stránky; podujatie je známe svojou krásnou prírodou a atmosférou

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor je tradičný krosový beh v krásnej prírode, ktorý sa koná v obci Cabaj-Čápor so štartom pri Salaši Cabaj. Bežci si môžu vybrať z viacerých tratí vrátane 10 km, 3 km a detských behov na 600 m a 1000 m. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých, ktorí chcú zažiť atmosféru športu v prírode, či už pre súťaž alebo pre radosť z pohybu. Registrácia je otvorená a počet účastníkov je limitovaný, preto je vhodné sa prihlásiť včas.
course_highlights: Krosový beh v prírode Cabaj-Čápor
Trate 10 km, 3 km a detské behy 600 m a 1000 m
Štart pri Salaši Cabaj
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 9:00 hod. Počet účastníkov je limitovaný. Účastníci hlavného a hobby behu získavajú účastnícke ocenenie. Podujatie sa koná 10. októbra 2026, registrácia je dostupná online, a pretek je vhodný pre všetky vekové skupiny a úrovne výkonnosti.

name: Jesenný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce a Atletický klub Michalovce

description: Jesenný beh Michalovčanov je tradičný bežecký závod v Michalovciach, ktorý ponúka príležitosť pretekárom rôznych vekových kategórií. Preteky sa konajú v areáli 2. ZŠ na J. Švermu 6 a pozostávajú z detského behu na 400 metrov a hlavného behu na 3 kilometre. Podujatie je vhodné pre rodiny a bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť jesennú atmosféru a športové vyžitie v príjemnom prostredí. Organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvenie a pamätné predmety pre účastníkov.
course_highlights: Detský beh na 400 m pre deti do 9 rokov
Hlavný beh na 3 km pozostávajúci z 3 kôl po 900 m
Štart a cieľ v areáli 2. ZŠ, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce
additional: Pretekári obdržia pamätné predmety a zabezpečené je občerstvenie. Prezentácia pretekárov je od 08:00 do 09:15. Vyhlásenie výsledkov a ocenenie medailistov je o 10:30. Detský beh (500 m) začína o 9:30, hlavný beh (3 km) o 9:45; registrácia na mieste; kategórie pre dospelých, deti a seniorov; podujatie je súčasťou jesenného športového kalendára.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou je bežecké podujatie organizované Bežeckým klubom obce Vyšná Myšľa a obcou Vyšná Myšľa. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v obci Vyšná Myšľa v okrese Košice okolie. Štart detských kategórií je o 14:00 a dospelých o 16:00. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, vrátane štafety dvojíc na 2 x 3 km. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru bežeckého športu v obci.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v obci Vyšná Myšľa
Štafeta dvojíc na 2 x 3 km
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov a ženy
additional: Štartovné neplatia Muži E, Ženy I, členovia BKO Vyšná Myšľa, občania obce Vyšná Myšľa a deti. Štart detí o 14:00, dospelých o 16:00. Pretek má rôzne dĺžky tratí od 350 m po 8 km, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, a podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie.

organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.

description: The Metuje Race is a traditional 10 km road run held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also features races for youth in various age categories. The course runs along an asphalt road through the valley of the Metuje River to Peklo and back, providing a pleasant yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can collect points within the series. The winners are announced both in children's categories and in the main race, with monetary and material prizes.
course_highlights: Road course over 10 km through the valley of the Metuje River
The route goes to Peklo and back along an asphalt road
Youth races with various distances from 100 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration is only available online at sportchallenge.cz, including on the race day until 8:00 AM. The race office is open on race day from 8:00 AM at the Sokolovna in Nové Město nad Metují. SK Nové Město nad Metují members have free entry. Children can earn points within the PRIMÁTOR CUP series and receive rewards for participation. Children's races are divided into categories from 9:00 to 10:30, with the main race starting at 10:45. Winners are announced at 10:45 (children's categories) and at 12:00 (main race). The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2025 series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia, including various age categories and offering prizes and certificates.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
price_range: early bird ceny do konce roku 2025, přesné ceny nejsou specifikovány
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around Brno Dam, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, which is approximately one-third of a marathon. The route is slightly hilly, mostly asphalt with a section of rocky terrain, and offers beautiful views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in relay teams, four-member teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 14.1 km course around Brno Dam
Slightly hilly profile with 85% asphalt and 15% rocky surface
Views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn Podkomorské forests
additional: The main race starts in waves, timing is measured with chip technology integrated into the race bib, and the time limit for completion is 2.5 hours. There is a sports EXPO, accompanying program for adults and children, changing rooms, mobile toilets, baggage storage, refreshments, and rescue services on the course and at the start and finish areas. Gift vouchers are sent electronically in PDF format. The race offers various categories, the option to purchase official race merchandise, and an eco-friendly solution with electronic vouchers.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň with a history dating back to 1970. The race is suitable for both beginner hobby runners and experienced athletes of all ages. It offers excitement at the starting line, the tension of the competitive atmosphere, and joy at the finish. Organizers ensure a friendly environment for runners and provide local refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: Race takes place in Borský Park in Plzeň
