Traditional autumn running event with a history since 1970
Friendly atmosphere for hobby and competitive runners of all ages
additional: Registration is possible in advance until October 10, 2024, with discounted entry fees at web nazavody.cz. On race day, registration is available at the start area from 8:30 to 9:45 on October 12, 2024. Organizers provide local refreshments for runners. Race in Borský Park, registration at https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/565-beh-borskym-parkem, start from 8:30 to 9:45.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
location: Lednice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run the Forests Lednice is part of a popular running series that offers races in the most beautiful natural locations in the Czech Republic. The race in Lednice takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice area, where runners pass through the castle park, around ponds, and past iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple. The routes are suitable for runners of various levels and include a short route Nova 14 km and a longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The race is complemented by speed competitions and an attractive finish straight, providing additional motivation for participants.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Lednice-Valtice area with landmarks like the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple
150-meter Conti Speed Section marked with Continental flags
500-meter Generali Investments Finish straight with measured section
additional: The race includes the Conti Speed Section - a 150m speed segment marked with Continental flags and the Generali Investments Finish - a 500m measured finish straight. The fastest man and woman will receive a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. It is recommended to pick up race numbers at least 90 minutes before the start. The event features various distances from 3 to 50 km, is suitable for families and children, includes a charity run, and partners with major companies such as Continental and ČSOB.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
location: Hradčany u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hradčanské vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main routes: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race emphasizes movement in terrain with a predominance of forest and field paths, ensuring an attractive and challenging run. The event also includes children's categories with various distances. Participants are provided with refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners from children to experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Main route 10.4 km with an elevation gain of approximately 260 m, 5% asphalt, 25% field roads, 70% forest paths and trails
Half marathon 21.1 km with an elevation gain of approximately 505 m, a combination of asphalt, field, and stony paths, second half in terrain
Short route 5.6 km with an elevation gain of approximately 155 m, fast and technical blue trail
additional: Registration for children's races begins at 8:30, main races start at 9:45. The half marathon starts at 11:00 from the excursion area, the main route 10.4 km and the short route 5.6 km start from the square. Included in the registration fee are race organization, facilities, showers, food, beer/soft drinks, chip timing, start number, on-trail refreshments, and post-race refreshments. Parking is organized by volunteers with an emphasis on obeying traffic regulations and consideration for Hradčany residents. The race offers various categories, including children's, and is complemented by a rich accompanying program and a raffle.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Police Sports Club Olymp Prague, taking place in the picturesque environment of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. Organizers welcome all interested participants and provide support during registration and the race.
course_highlights: Run in Stromovka Park, Prague 7
Picturesque urban environment with natural scenery
Traditional autumn running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run takes place in the Stromovka area, registration is possible online via results.bezeckenadeje.cz

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
location: Podmošně, Benešov u Semil, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and Pojizeří Ten is a traditional running race in the picturesque environment of the village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers a half marathon and a 10-kilometer route through the beautiful nature of Pojizeří with varied terrain. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for competitors and spectators. The race is suitable for the broad running public and is part of the community's sports activities.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the scenic nature of Pojizeří with forest and field paths
The half marathon course features elevation and views of the Benešov hills
The 10 km offers a faster run on partly asphalt and forest paths
additional: The race facilities are located in the sports complex in Upper Benešov. Registrations and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. Light refreshments are available for competitors and spectators. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil z.s. with the support of the municipality of Benešov u Semil. The races include the half marathon, the 10 km, and a non-competitive 10 km route, scheduled for October 2026, with the start in Podmošně.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Bukov Run is an annual sporting running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place exclusively on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners a pleasant experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age categories, from young children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farm Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forest roads, and trails in Bukov and Plískov
Various distances for children and adults, from 100 m to 8250 m
Start and finish at the playground near the swimming pool in Plískov
additional: Participant registration takes place on the terrace of the inn in Plískov from 9:00 to 10:50. The race starts gradually according to categories from 10:05 (youngest children) to 11:21 (women, juniors, veterans). Winners are announced continuously for children's categories and after the race for others. Please observe Covid precautions; disinfectant is available at the start. Participants without health restrictions run at their own risk. The race is held in October, with a primarily forest and meadow course, and offers online registration and various race distances throughout the year.

name: Kašavský kros
price_range: 400 CZK dospělí, 200 CZK junioři, 50 CZK děti
description: Kašava Cross is a traditional cross-country running race in the vicinity of Kašava, offering two main routes for competitors aged 16 and above, as well as children's races. The race takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its proven course with hills and a pleasant atmosphere. The organizer is the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association, which collaborates with the local municipality and school. Children's races are held after the main races and are divided into several age categories with different distances.
course_highlights: Main course 16.6 km with an elevation gain of 679 m
Short course 8 km with an elevation gain of 254 m
Children's races with distances from 100 to 1300 m
additional: Registration for children is only possible on-site on race day. Check-in begins at 10:30 AM, the deadline for check-in for the long course is at 11:30 AM, the start of the long course is at 12:00 PM, the start of the short course is at 12:30 PM. Children's races start at 2:30 PM. The organizer provides a limit of 200 adult participants. After the race, winners are announced and a raffle is held. Terrain: trail, registration: online and on-site, includes children's races and main adult courses.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
location: Mikulov, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surroundings. This race is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenging course in beautiful nature with marked tourist trails. Organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and quality organizational support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 years old who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to your participation in the next edition on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Extreme ultra trail in the Ore Mountains
Tourist-marked trails in the nature of Mikulov
Challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners
additional: The race is only for persons over 18 years old. Participants must be physically and mentally capable and are obliged to follow race rules and safety measures. The organizer is not responsible for the condition of the courses or any health complications. Runners agree to audiovisual recording of their performance for race presentation purposes. Trail race with over 50 km and 16 km courses, suitable for both experienced and recreational runners, supporting sports performance in nature.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybský trhák is a road running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race covers a distance of 7 km with an elevation gain of 135 meters and is intended for various age categories of men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field, and runners can use secured changing rooms and showers. Refreshments and material prizes are prepared at the finish line for the best runners in each category, including a prize for the oldest participant and the best runner from the village of Rybí.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7 km
Elevation gain 135 m
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field
additional: Changing rooms and showers are provided. Refreshments and treats are available at the finish. Material prizes for the top three runners in each category, a prize for the oldest participant, and the best runner from the village of Rybí. The race takes place on October 10, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration is at the football field in Rybí. Participants can expect refreshments and material prizes for category winners.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
location: Lázeňský park Aurora, Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kleofáš Run is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from children's short runs to a 12-kilometer run around Lake Svět. For less experienced runners, a pleasant 4-kilometer route is available, as well as a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a rich accompanying program for children and is part of the Hospice Week.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural route around Lake Svět
Pleasant 4-kilometer route for other runners
Relay race over 4 km for two or four runners
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 AM, with the possibility to register on-site on the day of the event. Children's races are divided by age with distances of 200 m, 450 m, and 1 km. Results are announced gradually after the children's races, as well as the 4 km and 12 km races. The event is part of Hospice Week. The routes include various lengths from 200 m to 12 km, with surfaces of forest paths, asphalt, and trail, with slight or flat elevation. Registration is via an online form or on-site, with the start in the Aurora Spa Park.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad ve Špindlerově Mlýně, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Small Prize of Špindlerův Mlýn is the traditional 34th uphill run held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and offers a challenging route of 14 km with an elevation gain of 901 meters. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their strength in the beautiful mountain environment of the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 14 km
Elevation gain of 901 m
Start at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup running series. Organizers call for the protection of the Krkonoše nature. The race offers various categories for men and women, registration is through www.jktiming.cz, and it is known for its difficulty and the beauty of the surrounding Krkonoše nature.

name: Červený okruh
location: Termit, Doksy, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Red Circuit in Doksy is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on an interesting course in the natural environment of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. Organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Termit area, Doksy
Part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa
Traditional autumn running race with history
additional: The race takes place in the Termit area in Doksy, the course runs through forest terrain, registration on-site or via email, suitable for various age groups.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Baška reservoir in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and promoting sports activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in beautiful nature. Registration and participation are welcome from both experienced runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a route around the Baška reservoir
Picturesque natural environment of the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event organized by the athletics club Slezan Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race takes place on a road circuit around the Baška reservoir, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The event is suitable for all age groups and also offers races for children.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
price_range: libovolná cena (dobrovolný příspěvek od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč pro první desítku registrujících)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: libovolná částka od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč
tiers.description: Startovné je libovolné v rozmezí 250 až 1000 Kč, výtěžek jde na charitu

description: St. Wenceslas Run Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10th in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports multiple sclerosis patients through proceeds from registration fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while helping a good cause. The first ten registered participants will receive a reward in the form of a discount on tire purchases at Tyreto.
course_highlights: Traditional running race in Děčín
Courses for all age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km
Charitable aspect supporting the St. Joseph's Home
additional: The first ten registered participants who pay an entry fee ranging from 250 to 1000 CZK will receive a voucher for a discount equal to the paid amount on tire purchases at Tyreto. Routes for 5, 12, and 21 km, races in Děčín, charity support, musical and accompanying program.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a weekend-long running event held in Budapest on October 11. Participants can register for distances ranging from 5 km to 42.195 km, ensuring there is a challenge suitable for everyone. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience for runners of all levels, from beginners to seasoned marathoners. Supported by prominent patrons and sponsors, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners through iconic locations in Budapest.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km)
Route passing through Budapest's iconic sites
Weekend-long running festival with programs
additional: The race takes place over multiple distances, with races on Saturday and Sunday, including relay, 30 km, 14 km, 10 km, mini marathon, team relay, and school relay. The registration office is accessible, offering various registration options (guest registration, school registration, corporate registration). The event's main patrons are Budapest's mayor and the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Throughout the weekend, active programs, prize draws, and health consultations await runners. Registration is open for distances between 5 km and 42.195 km; registration for the marathon individual race is currently open, with other categories to follow soon.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event scheduled to take place in Budapest on October 10-11, 2026. Participants will have the opportunity to run along Budapest's most beautiful UNESCO World Heritage sites, enjoying panoramic views of the city and enthusiastic cheering. The festival celebrates running, offering a suitable distance for everyone from 5 km to the marathon. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and running shirt, and the event features numerous accompanying programs and musical experiences to make the weekend unforgettable.
course_highlights: Route along UNESCO World Heritage sites
Budapest's most beautiful panoramas and districts
Numerous bands and spectators creating a lively atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from 18 different distances, from 5 km to the marathon, and can also register in pairs or relay teams. The event includes various accompanying programs, musical experiences, and a vibrant spectator atmosphere. Finishers receive a unique medal and running shirt. Registration office contact details and options for modifying registration are provided. Distances include: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay, walking, family run, city tour, and equality run; schedule, start list, results, online registration, team and school registration, and awards.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Beh za zdravie - Kuchajda je charitatívne bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná 11. októbra 2026 v Bratislave na Kuchajde. Tento beh spája šport s podporou zdravia a komunity, pričom jeho cieľom je pomáhať znevýhodneným osobám a organizáciám prostredníctvom pohybu. Účastníci môžu bežať, pomalým tempom alebo prechádzkou, pričom sa vytvára skvelá atmosféra plná inšpiratívnych príbehov a solidarity. Beh za zdravie je otvorený pre všetky vekové kategórie a kondície, a zároveň podporuje charitatívne projekty s reálnym dopadom.
course_highlights: Bežecké podujatie na Kuchajde v Bratislave
Podpora zdravia a komunity prostredníctvom športu
Príležitosť zúčastniť sa bez ohľadu na vek a kondíciu
additional: Podujatie je charitatívne a podporuje znevýhodnené osoby a organizácie. Zúčastniť sa môžu deti, dospelí aj starší, behom, pomalým tempom alebo prechádzkou. Organizátori ponúkajú možnosť stať sa dobrovoľníkom a prispieť tak k úspechu podujatia. Podujatie sa koná na Kuchajde v Bratislave, podporuje zdravie a sociálne znevýhodnené skupiny, registrácia podrobne nie je špecifikovaná.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 5,- € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad  60 rokov

description: Beh ulicami Krompách je tradičný bežecký pretek v meste Krompachy, ktorý ponúka kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov, mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Preteky sa konajú pred budovou mestského úradu a sú organizované Mestom Krompachy a Komisiou kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch. Štart je rozdelený na detské kategórie a dorast o 9:30 a dospelých o 11:00. Štartovné je symbolické, 5 € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad 60 rokov. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje športový život v regióne.
course_highlights: Preteky vedú ulicami mesta Krompachy
Štart a cieľ pred budovou mestského úradu
Kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny od detí po seniorov
additional: Štart je rozdelený na 9:30 pre detské kategórie a dorast a 11:00 pre dospelých. Kategórie sú detailne rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane viacerých vekových skupín mužov a žien. Organizátorom je Mesto Krompachy a Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch. Podujatie sa koná v októbri, s rôznymi kategóriami a začiatkami od 9:00, registrácia je možná prostredníctvom kontaktu s organizátorom. Trať je pravdepodobne mestská a ulicná.

name: Borský kros
location: Doleček, Machov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Borský Cross is a traditional running race organized by the Borský Ski Club Machov in the picturesque cross-country area Doleček in the Hradec Králové Region. The course offers various difficulties, from gentle long climbs suitable for families with children to challenging hilly and steep profiles for experienced runners. The race is part of the club's diverse sports activities and takes place in a beautiful natural environment with quality facilities. The organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a high-quality sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country area Doleček with different types of trails from gentle to very hilly and steep profiles
Picturesque natural environment around Machov in the Hradec Králové Region
Quality facilities and long-standing tradition of the organizer, Borský Ski Club Machov
additional: The Doleček cross-country area offers trails suitable for families with children as well as for demanding runners. The Machov area also features the Hůrka ski jump area with certified summer jumps. The club has new facilities after reconstruction of the building under the ski jumps thanks to a subsidy from the SZIF program. The race takes place in Doleček, around the ski area, with results available online. Registration details are not specified.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
location: Koupaliště Nové Město na Moravě, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Autumn Cross Country Run - Jiří Bláha Memorial is a traditional race held since 1986, this year marking its 39th edition. The race takes place at the swimming pool area in Nové Město na Moravě, where registration begins at 8:30 AM. The longest course is approximately 6 km for men, women run 2 km, and youth courses range from 300 m to 1500 m. The race is run on a grassy surface, spikes are recommended. Category starts are staggered to allow everyone to have Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men's category finishes.
course_highlights: Running on a grassy surface at the swimming pool area
Longest course approximately 6 km for men, 2 km for women
Staggered category starts with minimal delays
additional: Registration begins at 8:30 AM at the swimming pool. Categories start sequentially with minimal delays to ensure everyone can have Sunday lunch. Spikes suitable for grassy surfaces are recommended. The race is open to the general public, starting at 9:30 AM, with registration from 8:30 AM at the swimming pool. Courses are suitable for all age groups.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: The Forest Run Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, offering courses suitable for all age groups from children to veterans. The race takes place in the beautiful natural environment of the Central Bohemian Region and includes various distances, including 11 km and 5.7 km for adults, with challenging forest paths and steep ascents. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy running on shorter routes adapted to the age of the participants. Organizer Bežecký klub Říčany invites everyone to active outdoor activity and participation in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with natural paths and steep ascents
Accessible courses for all age groups, from children to veterans
Course lengths of 11 km and 5.7 km for adults
additional: The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje, offers various course lengths, and is suitable for families with children. The date is set for October 11, 2026.

name: Běh na Strandu
location: Stránská skála, Brno-Slatině, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Strand Run is a specific uphill running race held at Stránská skála in Brno-Slatině. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing focused effort on a 450-meter course with an elevation gain of 47 meters. The route goes along a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, it is necessary to return the bib number, and the results are announced after the last runner finishes. Registration takes place on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00, with the start at 10:01.
course_highlights: Length of the course 450 m with an elevation gain of 47 m
Course along a rocky and grassy path
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
additional: Registration takes place on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The bib number corresponds to the start time (e.g., number 1 starts at 10:01). After finishing, it is necessary to return the bib number. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. The race is held in October, with start times from 9:00 to 10:00, registration from 9:00, and an entry fee of 50 CZK. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Hrabenovský kros
location: Hrabenov u Šumperka, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Hrabenov Cross is a forest cross-country race over 7.47 km with an elevation gain of 200 meters, held in the picturesque environment of Hrabenov near Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers challenging cross-country courses around Šumperk. This race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in natural terrain with significant elevation changes. The route runs through the forest and offers beautiful natural scenery and technically interesting terrain.
course_highlights: Forest course 7.47 km long
Elevation gain of 200 meters
Part of the Chlapácký běh series in Šumperk and surroundings
additional: The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in natural terrain with a technically interesting profile, taking place in October 2026.

name: Slavkovský lesík
location: Fotbalové hřiště TJ Sokol Slavkov, Slavkov u Opavy, Opava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country race Slavkovský lesík is a traditional event organized by TJ Opava, held in the picturesque forest environment near Slavkov u Opavy. The race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in nature with varied terrain and a sporty, relaxed atmosphere. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field, with the start traditionally at 10 a.m. The organizers invite all runners to participate and promise a pleasant sporting experience.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with diverse surface
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field
Traditional autumn date in October
additional: Registration begins at 8:30 a.m. at the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field. The race is open to the general public, and the organizers invite participants to run for joy and good spirits. The race is open to everyone, with registration via the ORIS system. The course runs through forest paths and is suitable for beginners and advanced runners.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Running Klenčí is a traditional running race in the picturesque environment of Klenčí pod Čerchovem in the Plzeň Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and levels to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beautiful nature of the region. Results and rankings are carefully monitored, and the race is part of the broader Běžec Chodska series. Organizers welcome all runners to participate and provide quality organizational support.
course_highlights: Different course lengths including 5 km and 10 km
Run in the scenic environment of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Races for various age groups and levels
additional: The event is part of the Běžec Chodska 2024 series, includes various distances and terrains, and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
description: From Dobřichovice to Šraňk is an uphill race 3.7 km long with an elevation gain of 280 meters, which is part of the Hill Running series in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenging course with significant ascents, ideal for mountain running enthusiasts and those seeking outdoor challenges. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Dobřichovice and is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and push yourself beyond limits at this traditional event.
course_highlights: Length of the course 3.7 km
Elevation gain 280 m
Part of the Hill Running series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The course follows the ascent along the blue trail to the ridge, the race is low-budget, without changing rooms, only baggage supervision, the registration fee is 20 CZK, the race offers opportunities for slower runners to be admired and for photography on the website.

name: Běh na Kraví horu
location: Kraví hora, Teplice nad Metují, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kraví Hora Run is a public uphill running race with a mass start, held in the picturesque environment of Kraví Hora in Teplice nad Metují. This race is part of the running hill series and offers athletes a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent and beautiful views. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular among runners who want to test their strength in mountain terrain. Organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, it ensures quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Challenging uphill run with a mass start
Picturesque environment of Kraví Hora in Teplice nad Metují
Part of the running hill series and hill climbing league
additional: The race takes place on urban and hill terrain, registration and results are managed using professional chip timing, parking and transportation information are available on the website.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane je bežecký pretek organizovaný na atletickom štadióne Prešovskej univerzity v Prešove. Súťaž je určená pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien a ponúka jedinečnú príležitosť otestovať svoju vytrvalosť a rýchlosť na tartanovej dráhe. Organizátormi sú BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov a AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. Pretek je vhodný pre bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť kvalitnú atletickú atmosféru a súťažiť v príjemnom prostredí univerzitného štadióna.
course_highlights: Pretek sa koná na tartanovej dráhe atletického štadióna Prešovskej univerzity
Kategórie rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia (Muži A, Muži B, Ženy F, Ženy G)
Štart a cieľ na kvalitnom atletickom povrchu v Prešove
additional: Podujatie zahŕňa aj možnosti online registrácie, koná sa 15. októbra 2026, na atletickom štadióne univerzity v Prešove.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Heulose Run - Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race organized in the Heulos forest park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth, and children, with color-coded circuits along paths and trails in the forest park. The event has a long-standing tradition since 1977 and is part of the Vysočina Runners series. The start is in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, with routes suitable for a wide range of runners from the youngest to veterans.
course_highlights: Color-coded circuits along paths and trails in Heulos forest park
Various distances from 300 m for the youngest to 9 km for men and veterans
Start and finish at Na Stoupách athletics stadium in Jihlava
additional: Categories include men, women, veterans, juniors, youth, and children with different race distances. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and youth receive medals and material prizes. This is the 49th edition of the race, supported by the statutory city of Jihlava and the Czech Sports Office. The race is open to the general public, offers trail routes in nature, and is part of the Vysočina Running Cup. The date is set for October 16, 2026.

name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: The Panorama Trail is a special trail marathon in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The 45-kilometer route passes through varied, technical forest trails where nature and history meet. The race is not about time results but about experience and challenge, which can be completed individually or in teams of three. The event welcomes runners in October with premium organization and environmentally conscious approach, during ideal running weather.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer route passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points at Mogyoróskánál, Regéc, Telkibányánál, and Hollóházánál
additional: Race bib pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzer race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for luggage transport from start to finish. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km, three castles, forest and rocky sections, 1800m+ elevation gain, limit of 400 participants, online registration, team and individual categories.

name: Psotkov memoriál
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: Psotkov memoriál je tradičný horský bežecký pretek v Tatrách, ktorý sa koná v Štrbskom Plese. Pretek ponúka dve náročné trasy - BASIC s dĺžkou 25,3 km a prevýšením +1540 m a EXTREME s dĺžkou 37,9 km a prevýšením +2490 m. Trasy vedú cez krásne horské scenérie, vrátane okolia Kriváňa, Jamského plesa a Furkotskej doliny, a sú určené pre skúsených bežcov s dobrou kondíciou. Pretek je súčasťou Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia 2026 a je limitovaný na 400 účastníkov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie ponad Štrbské pleso a pod vrchol Kriváňa
Občerstvovacie stanice na Tri studničkách a pri spodnej stanici sedačkovej lanovky
Krásne horské chodníky popri Jamskom plese a Furkotskej doline
additional: Registrácia je limitovaná na 400 účastníkov (200 na BASIC a 200 na EXTREME). Členovia Slovenského horolezeckého spolku James majú zľavu na štartovné. Trasa EXTREME sa beží formou časoviek. Časový limit pre BASIC je 6 hodín, pre EXTREME 8 hodín. Štart a cieľ sú v areáli bežeckého lyžovania SNOW - Štrba, Štrbské Pleso. Registrácia otvorená od 1.6. do 30.9.2025; limit 400 účastníkov; súčasťou štartovného je občerstvenie, pamätný odznak a zabezpečenie trate; traťové parametre a poistenie do hôr.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter), Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Slovakia
description: Podvihorlatský kros je bežecké podujatie konané v Porube pod Vihorlatom na futbalovom ihrisku (amfiteáter). Preteky ponúkajú štart pre detské kategórie aj hlavnú kategóriu, pričom trať vedie prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách s 30 % asfaltového povrchu. Organizátorom je Mgr. Ján Podstavský s podporou obce Poruba pod Vihorlatom. Podujatie je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a nordic walking.
course_highlights: 70 % poľná a lesná cesta, 30 % asfalt
Trať vedie cez prírodné prostredie Vihorlatu
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku (amfiteáter) v Porube pod Vihorlatom
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 9:00, hlavná kategória štartuje o 11:00. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia vrátane nordic walking. Podujatie je podporované obcou Poruba pod Vihorlatom a je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025. Trať: lesné a asfaltové cesty, registrácia online do 16.10.2025, štartové časy o 9:00 a 11:00, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a úrovne výkonnosti, registrácia zahŕňa aj charitatívny príspevok

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica je horský maratón vedený malebnou prírodou Kysúc, prevažne po horských hrebeňoch s krásnymi výhľadmi na Veľkú Raču. Trať dlhá 42 kilometrov s prevýšením takmer 1700 metrov preverí vytrvalosť, silu a lásku k horám. Podujatie nie je pretek, ale zážitkový beh, ktorý zdôrazňuje radosť z pohybu, priateľstvo a vôľu. Organizátori ponúkajú kompletný servis vrátane občerstvenia, trička a spoločného posedenia po behu.
course_highlights: 42 km trať s prevýšením takmer 1700 m
Prevažne horské hrebeňe s výhľadmi na Veľkú Raču (1236 m.n.m.)
Občerstvovacie stanice približne každých 8 km
additional: Prezentácia bežcov je 17.10.2026 od 06:30 do 08:30 v Kultúrnom dome Oščadnica. Časový limit maratónu je 7 hodín, s časovým limitom 5 hodín na dobehnutie na Veľkú Raču, po ktorom organizátor negarantuje občerstvenie. Registrácia je možná len online, prípadne na mieste ak nie je naplnená štartovná listina. Po naplnení limitu 200 účastníkov sa registrácia uzatvára. Súčasťou štartovného je tričko, úschovňa, sprchy, občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, medaila a after párty. Registrácia je možná online, počet účastníkov je obmedzený na 200, súčasťou štartovného je tričko, občerstvenie, medaila a after-party.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
price_range: 15 € online pred 9.10.2025, 20 € po tejto dátume a na mieste
description: Rozhanovská dvanástka je bežecký pretek konaný v areáli amfiteátra v Rozhanovciach. Ponúka dve hlavné kategórie - krátku trať na 6 km a dlhú trať na 12 km, ktoré sú určené pre mužov aj ženy. Pretek je organizovaný obcou Rozhanovce a občianskym združením KŠK Rozhanovce a je vhodný pre bežcov rôznych úrovní. Štart pretekov je naplánovaný na 17. októbra 2026, pričom detské preteky začínajú o 10:45 a hlavné trate o 11:00 hodine.
course_highlights: Trať vedie v areáli amfiteátra Rozhanovce
Dve kategórie: krátka trať 6 km a dlhá trať 12 km
Preteky pre mužov a ženy s možnosťou detských pretekov
additional: Detské preteky štartujú o 10:45 hod. Štartovné je možné zaplatiť online alebo na mieste. Organizátormi sú Obec Rozhanovce a Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce. Kontaktnou osobou je Ing. Matúš Adamčík, tel.: +421 908 909 779. Preteky zahŕňajú aj detský beh, štart je o 10:45, a trať je pravdepodobne vonkajšia v okolí Rozhanoviec

name: Půlmaraton Český les
location: Nemanice, Český les, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 500 Kč předem / 600 Kč na místě (21 km), 300 Kč předem / 400 Kč na místě (7 km)
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail run held in the picturesque nature of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The race offers two routes, 21 km with an elevation gain of 520 m and 7 km with an elevation gain of 80 m, which lead through beautiful scenery with the option to download a GPX route. The longer course declares absolute winners and categories by age, while the shorter course awards the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are located directly in Nemanice with parking available at the start area.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 520 m elevation gain in the Český les nature
7 km course with 80 m elevation gain suitable for fast runners
Start and finish directly in Nemanice with parking at the race site
additional: Parking is available directly at the start and finish. On the 21 km course, absolute winners and 10 age categories for men and women are announced. On the 7 km course, the top 3 men and women are awarded. GPX race routes are available for download. Trail race with accessible GPX routes, registration and categories for men and women, the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: The 5 km and 10 km races of YOUR LEAGUE are regular running events in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare their performance with others and with their previous results. The course is certified, and on the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Championships on 10 km
additional: Registration from 18:00, start of 10 km at 19:00, start of 5 km at 19:05. After the race, refreshments and the announcement of the best runners. Possibility to store luggage in the organizer’s tent. Recommended parking at P+R Nádraží Braník, public transport by tram and bus. After the race, free isotonic drink. The race is part of a league with rewards for the best and most loyal runners, including medals and prizes from partners. Registration is via the website, winners and regular runners have the chance to win prizes. The race is part of a series of runs in Prague.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
location: Lesní park Amerika, Písek, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around America is the oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic and the third oldest race overall, held since 1925 in the America Forest Park in Písek. This terrain race has a tradition of over 100 editions and offers a challenging course of 10.4 km, which has evolved over the years. The race is popular among runners and local residents and is known for its history and atmosphere in a natural environment. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s., and is internationally recognized through cooperation with partner cities in England and Germany.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in America Nature Park
A 10.4 km course with historical significance
A traditional race with over 100 years of history
additional: The race takes place in America Nature Park in Písek and is the oldest terrain race in the Czech Republic. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s. The race has a rich history with several categories and is internationally recognized. The 100th anniversary will be celebrated in 2026. In the past, the race was interrupted several times (1942, 2020). The oldest forest run in the Czech Republic, terrain course, 100th anniversary in 2026.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family running race offering seven different runs for all age groups and skill levels. The courses range from 500 meters for the youngest to a half marathon, providing a challenge for everyone. The race takes place at the Velké pardubické racecourse and, besides the sporting experience, offers a rich accompanying program for the whole family. Participants receive a start package and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and supportive of both amateurs and elite runners.
course_highlights: The course includes distances of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, children's runs of 500 and 1000 m
Start and finish at the Velké pardubické racecourse with a unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations on the course, at the half marathon at least twice
additional: The race offers a special emergency service phone line during the event. Each runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. For children, a start package from Lidl and a supervised children's corner are prepared. There are pacemakers on the course to help runners achieve their target times. At the finish line, refreshments are available for children's runs and longer distances have refreshment stations. The event includes multiple courses, medals for participants, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support, and post-race photography.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
location: Pramen Halštrova, Aš, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The run along Halštrov is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Aš Ski Club, held in October at the source of Halštrov. The race offers a running experience in the beautiful nature of Aš and its surroundings, suitable for active athletes and runners seeking a challenge. The Jasan Aš Club is known for its long-standing tradition and support of running activities in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs along the source of Halštrov in a natural environment
Beautiful views and forest terrain around Aš
The race is part of the autumn running calendar of the Jasan Aš club
additional: The event is associated with the end of the running season, offers refreshments at the finish line, and is open to the general public including children.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: From Town Hall to Town Hall is a traditional children's running race organized by the District Association of the Czech Union of Sport Náchod. In 2026, the 7th edition of this event will take place, offering several categories based on children's ages with distances from 150 to 1200 meters. The race is primarily intended for young runners and promotes sports activity among children in the Náchod region. The starts are sequentially from 9:00 AM according to age categories. The event is part of the broader sports program of the Czech Union of Sport in the region.
course_highlights: Categories from the youngest children (born in 2021 and later) to older pupils (2011-2012)
Distances from 150 m to 1200 m tailored to age
Starts divided by categories on a schedule from 9:00 to 10:25
additional: The race is divided into categories based on birth years with a precise start schedule. Results from previous editions are available online. The event is part of the broader sports program of the Czech Union of Sport in the Náchod region. The event takes place within the regional sports calendar, registration is through sportchallenge.cz, and it is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
description: The Hronov-Náchod Road Race is a traditional running event with a long-standing history, connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod. The race starts at the town hall in Hronov and finishes at the town hall in Náchod. It offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy a beautiful route in a picturesque setting. The event is popular among locals and visitors and creates a friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Start and finish at the town halls of both towns
Picturesque environment in Eastern Bohemia
additional: Start at 11:00 AM, the route includes asphalt and cobblestone roads, the race is open to the general public

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: The Small Křivoklát Forest Run is a traditional forest race with a long history dating back to 1973, held in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream beneath Křivoklát Castle. The main race covers 6,000 meters and is run on two loops with slight elevation changes and a combination of forest paths, asphalt roads, and a ford across the stream. A course for children is available, measuring 600 meters with a flat profile at the Kolečko sports ground. The race facilities are located at Kolečko sports ground, which belongs to the Sokol Křivoklát unit, the event organizer.
course_highlights: Forest run in the valley of Rakovnický Stream beneath Křivoklát Castle
Main course 6000 m on two loops with elevation and ford across the stream
Children's course 600 m flat at Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and start/finish are at Kolečko sports ground. The main race starts in a mass start, with the course passing over footbridges and a ford across Rakovnický Stream. The children's course is a loop at Kolečko measuring 600 m, run 1-3 laps depending on age. The course is measurable and comparable to previous years since 1975. The course is set in a natural environment, with registration and additional information likely available on the website. The course includes forest and urban sections; the main race consists of two 3000 m segments.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Jablonné v Podještědí, Liberec, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: The Run around Lemberk is a traditional autumn running race held around the chapel near Markvartický Pond between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances from children's categories to adult runs of 5 and 10 km, including relay races. The start is on a green tourist trail, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing rooms, and winners in categories receive diplomas and material prizes.
course_highlights: Trails run along the green tourist trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Various distances from 50 m for children to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League - O pohár Českolipského deníku
additional: Registration from 8:30 AM at the start and finish area. Men's and women's changing rooms are available in limited capacity in a tent near the start. The top three in each category will receive a diploma and a material prize. Veteran categories are only available for the 10,000 m distance. The race is included in the Českolipská District Running League - O pohár Českolipského deníku. Course lengths range from 300 m to 10,000 m, with veteran categories, relay races, public run, registration from 8:30, start at 9:30, limited changing rooms in a tent.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4-Kunratice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Small Kunratice is a traditional running race in Kunratický Forest in Prague, which is already in its 23rd year. The race offers a 3-kilometer course starting in the south of the forest near Kunratický Mill. The event is suitable for the general public and is part of a sport and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and visitors can try various activities such as slackline or disc golf. The race is scheduled to start in the morning, allowing for a pleasant sporting gathering in nature.
course_highlights: 3-kilometer course in Kunratický Forest
Start in the south of the forest near Kunratický Mill
Running in a natural environment with additional sports activities in Nové Roztyly Park
additional: The race is part of a sport and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where activities such as slackline walking, sack jumping, spider obstacle course, and disc golf are available. The race includes various categories and is part of the SABZO series, featuring a terrain course in the natural environment of Krč Forest.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Havířov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 290 Kč - 700 Kč (on the day), 4000 Kč - 5000 Kč (team categories)
description: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the center of Havířov, offering several categories and distances for the general public, including children's races and relay races. The course runs through two laps around the city center with start and finish at Republic Square, where the atmosphere is enhanced by fans and spectators. The race has a charitable character and supports disabled athletes from the HSC Moravia club. The 10th anniversary edition attracted a record number of participants and notable sports personalities, such as Pavel Maslák. Registration is possible on the race day, and it also promotes corporate well-being and team cooperation.
course_highlights: Run of 10 km through the center of Havířov (2 laps)
Course runs through the city center with finish at Republic Square
Professional electronic timing with chip
additional: Registration is possible until 11:00 on race day at the Lučina Cultural House. The race is designated as the Czech Republic Veterans Road Running Championship. Start packages can be picked up at the company's headquarters. The race supports disabled athletes from the HSC Moravia club, with part of the entry fee going to their activities. Corporate teams are offered a 12-week training plan and online consultations with a coach. Refreshments are provided on the course and after the race. Breaking the course record is financially rewarded. The race features 2 laps, prize money, discounts for locals and tenants, relay race, corporate categories, and online training support.

name: 67. ročník silničního běhu Hronov - Náchod a 6. ročník dětského běhu
description: The Hronov - Náchod Road Race is a traditional event with a long-standing history, taking place for the 68th time. The race offers a sporting experience on a road course between the towns of Hronov and Náchod and is complemented by a children's run, which encourages participation of younger runners. The event is organized by the District Association of the Czech Union of Sport Náchod, which supports sports and physical education in the region. The race is part of the Sportchallenge ČUS project and is open to the general public.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Traditional race with over 60 years of history
Includes a children's run for younger categories
additional: The event includes a road race and a children's run, registration via sportchallenge.cz, and is part of the regional sports calendar.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: The Panorama Trail is a 45-kilometer trail running race in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The race is not about time results but about the experience and closeness to nature, where runners traverse rocky paths, cross streams, and run through forested environments. Entries can be made individually or in teams of three, allowing participants to share the challenge. The event offers a premium experience in every detail, from the race packet to the finisher’s medal received at the finish line.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer distance passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points along the course (Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya, Hollóháza)
additional: Race number pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzér race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for baggage transport. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km trail, 1800m+ elevation gain, 10% asphalt, connecting three castles, natural terrain.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelná bežecká súťaž na trati dlhosti 2 míle (3,218 km) s kategóriami pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov. Preteky sa konajú v Bratislave na Kuchajde a organizuje ich Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Štart je tradične o 10:00 hod. a súčasťou sú aj detské behy na cca 200 metrov. Beh 2 míle Bratislava je súčasťou série kôl, ktoré sa konajú počas roka a ponúkajú príležitosť pre bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií a výkonnostných úrovní.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km)
Deti bežia cca 200 metrov
Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Kuchajdy v Bratislave
additional: Kategórie: deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky, veteráni. Organizátor: Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Telefónne kontakty: +421 2 444 542 61, +421 905 648 315. Preteky sa konajú na cestnom povrchu v Kuchajde, registrácia je možná priamo na mieste, štart je naplánovaný na 10:00 hod. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Vojenská letecká základňa v Prešove, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
price_range: 22 € až 25 € v závislosti od termínu registrácie, 12 € pre detský beh
description: Challenge Airport Run je jedinečný bežecký zážitok na Vojenskej leteckej základni v Prešove, ktorý spája šport s atmosférou vojenského výcviku. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou, pričom každý účastník nesie symbolický záťažový batoh, čo podčiarkuje odvahu a vytrvalosť. Podujatie ponúka neopakovateľnú atmosféru medzi vrtuľníkmi a vojenskou technikou, ktorá je pre verejnosť zriedkavo prístupná. Okrem športového výkonu je to aj pocta disciplíne a sile, s bohatým sprievodným programom a originálnymi štartovacími balíčkami.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po areáli vojenskej leteckej základne v Prešove
Bežci nesú záťažový batoh symbolizujúci tradíciu a vytrvalosť
Atmosféra medzi vrtuľníkmi a vojenskou technikou s army štýlom
additional: Štartovné číslo s čipom, medaila v tvare dog tagu, tričká s vojenským dizajnom, sprievodný program s tombolou, možnosť detských behov, pitný režim zabezpečený, štartovacie balíčky v army štýle. Podujatie zahŕňa asfaltové a panelové cesty, kategórie s vojenským vybavením, štart od 9:00 do 9:15, možnosť zúčastniť sa s vojenským vybavením alebo ako civilný bežec.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Dubník, Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov

price_tiers.distance: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník

description: Slaňaki CUP - Beh do vrchu Dubník je tradičný beh do vrchu, ktorý sa koná v Zámutove, okres Vranov nad Topľou. Trať má dĺžku 11,2 km s prevýšením 600 metrov a cieľ je pri najvyššej stavbe na Slovensku, vysielači Dubník vo výške 318 metrov. Pretek je súčasťou Slovenského pohára v behu do vrchu a je určený pre širokú kategóriu bežcov mužov a žien rôzneho veku. Organizátormi sú Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov a Penzión Kondor Zámutov. Pretek ponúka výzvu pre bežcov, ktorí chcú otestovať svoju vytrvalosť a silu v náročnom horskom teréne.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 11,2 km s prevýšením 600 m
Cieľ pri najvyššej stavbe na Slovensku - vysielač Dubník (318 m)
Náročný horský terén vhodný pre beh do vrchu
additional: Kategórie pretekárov sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane juniorov, mužov a žien v rôznych vekových skupinách. Štart je pred Obecným úradom v Zámutove. Organizátori sú Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov a Penzión Kondor Zámutov. Pretek sa koná v októbri 2026, registrácia je možná online, súčasťou je aj občerstvenie a pietny beh.

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Crossing Czech Paradise is a trail run in a picturesque and little-known corner of Czech Paradise, offering a diverse and undulating route through sandstone cliffs, forest paths, and white sandy roads. The race is 100% trail and suitable for nature lovers and technical runners. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, which is accessible from Prague in less than an hour. The race day also includes children's races and accompanying program including a children's corner.
course_highlights: 99% of the route runs through forest trail paths and between sandstone cliffs
The route offers running on white sand, grass, and pine needles with an elevation gain of up to 440 m
Picturesque spring forests and technical descents on sandy roads
additional: Children's corner for kids from 3 to 10 years with art supplies and supervision by a teacher, open 30 minutes before the start and closed 5 minutes after the last runner finishes. There are sufficient toilets, refreshments, and restaurants at the start and finish locations. Family registration with a discount on children's entry fee is available. The route is marked, and maps will be available on-site. The time limit for completing the shorter route is 2 days, longer routes 3 days (for orientation). Trail races in nature, children's races, easy access from Prague, technical routes, diverse nature, registration including gift vouchers.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: The Autumn Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy Sady in Šternberk, offering a 7 km course for men and 3.5 km for women. The race is part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region and provides runners with the opportunity to test their strength in a pleasant autumn environment. The course runs through mixed terrain, ensuring an interesting and dynamic run for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the natural environment of Tyršovy Sady
7 km course for men and 3.5 km for women
Part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race takes place at the Kiosk pavilion in Tyršovy Sady in Šternberk, is part of a series of races with various distances, and offers the possibility to participate in both trail and road courses.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The Zlín Run "Across the Wallachian Hills" is a traditional running race held in Zlín, offering runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of the Wallachian landscape while enjoying a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Youth Stadium and the course takes participants through picturesque hills and natural scenery. Organizers emphasize high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Zlín Running Series, which includes various running events in the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Wallachian hills with scenic views
Start and finish at the Youth Stadium in Zlín
Natural and forest terrain with diverse surfaces
additional: The race is part of the year-round Zlín Running Series, which offers various running events in the region. Organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization. The website provides information about other races and a running school for those interested in running. The race takes place in the center of Zlín, with registration at the Zlín City Hall. Various age categories and prizes for the best runners and record holders are available.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
location: Olympia park, Modřice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and its surroundings, which has been run continuously since 1967. It offers various distances - 25 km, 16 km, 8 km, and relays - and is open to the general public, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at Olympia Park near the rope park in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The start of the first category is at 11:00, allowing for convenient participation for families and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Road courses of 25 km, 16 km, and 8 km
Start and finish at Olympia Park near the rope park in Modřice
A traditional race with a history since 1967, uninterrupted except in 1968
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project and is intended for the general public, including beginners. All previous editions have been completed by Brno runner Karel Fuksa. The race takes place as part of the traditional running calendar with support from the Czech Athletic Federation. The event offers various course lengths, relay options, start and finish at Olympia Park, on-site registration and bib pickup, and live race tracking.

name: Horokros
description: Horseshoe Cross is part of the Chlapácký běh series, offering a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque environment of the Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is designed for runners seeking a terrain challenge with diverse surfaces and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series values regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique environment of the Jeseníky Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain in Jeseníky
Natural obstacles and diverse surfaces
Beautiful views and mountain environment
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, where competitors who have completed at least 6 races in a season are officially recognized. It is part of the Chlapácké běhy series, held in Jeseníky, with specific terrain conditions not specified.

name: Běh na Žaltman
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Žaltman Run is a public uphill running race with a mass start, which is part of the Krakonoš Czech Cup series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge in beautiful nature. The race course runs through challenging terrain with elevation gain, attracting runners of all levels. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes all athletes and mountain running fans.
course_highlights: Challenging uphill run with elevation gain
The course runs through picturesque nature of Malé Svatoňovice
Part of the Krakonoš Czech Cup series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia
additional: The race is part of the Krakonoš Czech Cup series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia, suitable for runners seeking mountain and terrain challenges.

name: Běh okolo Rané
location: Rané u Loun, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Raná Run is a race held around Raná near Louny in the Ústí Region, offering men a course of 8.5 km and women 4.25 km. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and provides runners with the opportunity to enjoy running in a natural environment with scenic views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners seeking a quality race with regional tradition.
course_highlights: Course for men 8.5 km and for women 4.25 km
Surroundings of Raná near Louny with natural scenery
Part of the Louny Running Cup
additional: The race is part of the running cup, detailed information about registration and entry fees has not yet been published.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
location: Gutman Borpince, Kötcse, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The II. South Balaton Starry Trail is a scenic running race scheduled for October 18, 2026, in Kötcsé, near Gutman Winery. The race takes participants through the hills of Somogy, along panoramic routes around Starry Hill and its surroundings, with various distances including a half marathon and relay races. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, while at the finish line they will receive a unique finisher's medal and gifts. The event's atmosphere is enhanced by the Starry Trail Festival wine glass, allowing runners to taste local wines alongside the running experience.
course_highlights: Panoramic summit of Starry Hill at 313.5 meters
Varied terrain through autumn vineyards and Somogy forests
Touch of Romantic White Stone Castle and Nezde Saka Golkota on the half marathon route
additional: The race takes place at Gutman Winery, a historic brewery site offering stunning Balaton views. The race kits include gifts and a Starry Trail Festival wine glass for participants. Multiple distances and age categories are available, including mini and junior races for preschoolers and children aged 7-10, as well as a virtual completion option. The event features trail running and hiking, wines, outdoor cooking, a family-friendly atmosphere, and views of the autumn Balaton landscape.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: The Veresegyház Running Day is a family-friendly running event held around the Búcsú Square in Veresegyház. Participants can choose from several distances, from a mini run to a half marathon, and can compete individually or in teams. The race is also a point collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category where teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. The event is a friendly, community-oriented occasion that promotes the joy of running and a sporty lifestyle.
course_highlights: Distances: mini run (300 m), 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km
Team running with 3-person teams, not relay race
Race location: Búcsú Square, Veresegyház, urban park area
additional: Team running is free of charge, but only participants with valid individual registration can participate. Team registration must be submitted via email with the names, distances, and team name of the three runners. The race is a point collection station for the Ötpróba program; registration with a voucher is also possible, providing a discount of 5000 HUF for all distances except the mini run. The event features sponsorships, medical supervision, a health screening bus, refreshing massages, a raffle, and Ötpróba program point collection for participants.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is a trail half marathon set in the beautiful surroundings of Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified course of 21.0975 km, which runs along forest paths, educational trails, and tracks with minimal asphalt, without significant inclines. The event also includes races over 10 km, a relay, and children's races, all with comfortable facilities and refreshments along the route. The race is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners who want to explore the beautiful corners of the forest and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with accompanying programs.
course_highlights: Trail course through forest and gravel paths with minimal asphalt
Certified half marathon course of 21.0975 km with approximately 120 m elevation gain
The route passes around abandoned medieval villages and the educational trail of Klánovice Forest
additional: Start numbers can be picked up on Saturday, October 17th from 16:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, October 18th, at the latest one hour before the race start at the Sports Hall near the Elementary School in Klánovice. There are 6 refreshment stations along the route, and at the finish line, there are cakes from a local bakery (including gluten-free options). Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available in a covered hall. Child runners are supervised at a nursery about 200 meters from the facilities. Parking is organized within walking distance; parking at the start is not available. It is recommended to travel by train or bus. The race offers refreshments on the route, child supervision, massages, and other services. Registration opens on October 17, 2026. The event is part of a broader running day with various categories and activities for all age groups.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
description: Mizuno Neon Run in Olomouc is a night running event full of colors, lights, and fun, which is not a race but an experience for all participants. This neon run offers a wild and crazy glowing experience that celebrates the joy of movement and shared fun. Get ready to shine and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere at the Flora Exhibition Grounds in Olomouc.
course_highlights: Night run full of colors and neon lights
Fun and informal atmosphere without time measurement
Event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The event is not a race and does not measure time. It takes place at night with neon lighting and entertainment elements. The route runs through the Flora Exhibition Grounds in Olomouc. Organized by Eventmedia s.r.o. The event includes neon equipment, live performances, the charity run FénixRun, and various categories including children and family teams. The run is not timed, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: Beh hrebeňom Čergova je najdlhší horský beh v pohorí Čergov, určený pre milovníkov behu v prírode a trénovaných bežcov. Trať vedie z obce Kamenica cez najvyššie vrcholy pohoria, ako sú Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá a Sedlo Besná, s dĺžkou 32 km a prevýšením 1413 metrov. Bežci si môžu vychutnať nádherné kruhové výhľady a náročný terén na turistických chodníkoch. Pretek sa koná 24. októbra 2026 so štartom o 9:00 hod. na Farme Kamenica a cieľom v Sedle Besná pri Hoteli Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km horský beh s prevýšením 1413 m
Prechod cez najvyššie vrcholy Čergova: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá, Sedlo Besná
Trať vedie po turistických chodníkoch značených modrou a zelenou značkou
additional: Pre všetkých pretekárov je zabezpečený veľký autobus, ktorý ich ráno prevezie z obce Drienica do obce Kamenica (odchod o 7:15 z parkoviska pri Hoteli JAVORNÁ). Organizátor zabezpečuje aj odvoz osobných vecí zo štartu do cieľa. Prezentácia pretekárov je v deň preteku od 7:00 do 8:30 hod. na Farme Kamenica. Vyhlásenie výsledkov a obed sú v Hoteli Šport Lysá. Pretek sa koná 24. októbra 2026, je určený pre mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, s možnosťou zúčastniť sa na horskom traili v krásnom prostredí Čergovského pohoria.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
description: Rajecká 12-minútovka je dynamický bežecký závod organizovaný Maratón klubom Rajec, ktorý sa koná na ihrisku pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici v Rajci. Tento krátky, intenzívny beh je ideálny pre bežcov všetkých úrovní, ktorí chcú otestovať svoju rýchlosť a vytrvalosť v limitovanom čase. Podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej tradície v regióne a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s podporou miestnej komunity. Organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu trate a príjemné prostredie pre všetkých účastníkov.
course_highlights: Beh na ihrisku pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici v Rajci
Intenzívny 12-minútový časový limit
Príjemná atmosféra s podporou miestnej komunity
additional: Registrácia prebieha online s možnosťou neskoršej platby za príplatok. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie a bežecké úrovne. Po behu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie výsledkov priamo na mieste. Pretek sa koná na ihrisku pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici v Rajci, s možnosťou zlepšiť osobné rekordy v priateľskej atmosfére.

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Cultural center near the church, Bojničky, Trnava District, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 € pre prihlásených on line do 23.10.2024 aj so zaplatením štartovného

description: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca je bežecké podujatie organizované Atletickým klubom Bojničky a obcou Bojničky. Pretek sa koná v kultúrnom dome pri kostole v Bojničkách a ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy a nordic walking na 6 km trati. Štartovné je dostupné online aj na mieste, pričom pre študentov je zvýhodnené. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Trať vedie vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a nordic walking
Štart v kultúrnom dome pri kostole v Bojničkách
additional: Kategórie: Muži (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Ženy (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking muži a ženy na 6 km trati. Štartovné je možné zaplatiť online alebo na mieste v deň preteku. Podujatie zahŕňa aj Nordic walking, registrácia je možná online, miesto konania je kultúrny dom pri kostole v Bojničkách.

name: Ružínska desiatka
price_range: 15,-€ online, 20,-€ na mieste; detské preteky 5,-€ online, 7,-€ na mieste
description: Ružínska desiatka je bežecký pretek organizovaný Športovým klubom Jaklovce v spolupráci s obcou Jaklovce, ktorý sa koná pri Ružínskej priehrade. Trať vedie prevažne po asfaltovom povrchu s malým podielom štrku, ponúkajúc tak rýchly a príjemný beh. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách na 10 km a 5 km, pričom sú pripravené aj detské behy. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 11:00, detské kategórie začínajú o 10:00. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a bežeckých nadšencov všetkých úrovní.
course_highlights: 90 % asfaltový povrch, 10 % štrk (makadam)
Trasa vedie okolo Ružínskej priehrady v Jaklovciach
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti s rôznymi vekovými skupinami
additional: Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00, hlavných kategórií o 11:00. Kategórie zahŕňajú rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, vrátane absolútnych porádí a špeciálnych ocenení pre najstarších, najmladších a najlepších Jaklovčanov. Povrch trate je prevažne asfaltový s malým podielom štrku. Preteky zahŕňajú kategórie na 5 km a 10 km, detské behy, tombolu a nafukovací skákací hrad.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: The Třebíč Marathon 2026 invites you to run through the picturesque streets of the historic center of Třebíč, where you will enjoy the atmosphere of UNESCO monuments including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. You can choose from a marathon, half marathon, 10K, and children's races, all offering a great sporting experience for everyone. On the course and at the finish line, you can look forward to refreshment stations, and after the race, relaxation and an AfterRun party, which is the perfect way to end the day. Come and enjoy an unforgettable day full of movement and great atmosphere in the heart of Třebíč.
course_highlights: Picturesque streets of the historic center of Třebíč
Atmosphere of UNESCO monuments including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations on the course with a great atmosphere
additional: The entry fee must be paid within 14 days of registration, otherwise the registration will be canceled. The organizer notes that start packages are limited in number and may not be available at on-site registration. Online registration and payment are only possible until October 20, 2026, at 24:00; after that, registration is only available on-site. The races include marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and children's races; registration deadline is October 20, 2026; entry fees range from 100 CZK to 1400 CZK depending on category and registration date.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
location: Cholín u Slapské přehrady, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 550 Kč / 33 km, 600 Kč / 47 km, 700 Kč / 61 km (při včasné registraci), vyšší ceny po 30.09.2025

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 950 Kč zaplacených po 30. 9. 2025 a na místě.

tiers.label: tier_2
