tiers.description: 850 Kč zaplacených po 30. 9. 2025 a na místě.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 750 Kč zaplacených po 30. 9. 2025 a na místě.

description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race set in the picturesque surroundings near Slapská Dam in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses with distances of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, which lead through varied terrain with significant elevation changes. The race is suitable for experienced runners who want to test their abilities in nature and also earn points towards the UTMB index. The race center is located in the village of Cholín, with starts divided according to the courses, taking place on Saturday. Organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with an elevation gain of 2300 m up and 2400 m down
47 km course with an elevation gain of 1850 m up and down
Scenic routes around Slapská Dam with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 near Živohošťský Bridge. The race cutoff time is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 CZK per night on a bed or on a mat in a communal room. Registration changes are possible free of charge until October 12, 2025, and afterward for a fee of 100 CZK. The terrain includes trails, unmarked paths, rocky areas, and ascents; the race offers accommodation options, start times, and limits; it also contributes to the UTMB index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross Country is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc, held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race offers a challenging 9 km trail in the terrain, which tests the endurance and strength of runners. The main category starts at 10:15 AM, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletic Federation. Organizers invite runners of all levels to participate in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country trail in the terrain
Start and finish at AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suitable for endurance runners
additional: The race takes place at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run is an outdoor adventure running race held in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13, and 22 kilometers, mainly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The course is gently undulating with a few hills and suitable for hobby runners and casual participants who want to enjoy beautiful nature and autumnal colorful scenery. The race is well marked, and the shallow fords along the route are easily crossed. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Trail course mainly through forests and meadows off asphalt
Longest route of 22 km with three interconnected loops and a gentle elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run through fallen leaves with well-marked trail and shallow fords
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and flags. The fords are shallow and can be crossed dry-footed via a bridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running, registration details are not specified, autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories including a half marathon, 10 km, and shorter distances for children and youth. It also features canicross with categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest environment of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family and beginner runners.
course_highlights: Forest routes GELOREN and MIZUNO with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km)
Canicross tracks from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, chip timing, and a unique finisher medal
additional: The registration fee includes a unique finisher medal, Speedcup cup, chip timing, hydration, refreshments, race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment rental is available upon request. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, prize money for elite canicross runners. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December. The event includes charitable activities and equipment rental options.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful nature within reach of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course leading through a picturesque valley with natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to experience a sporting challenge in a peaceful and scenic environment.
course_highlights: The course runs on paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with scenic views and natural sections
Race near Prague with the atmosphere of a natural park
additional: The course is accessible during the race, with no specified wave divisions or capacity limits. Participants will receive payment instructions via email after registration. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series with other races in Průhonický Park, Divoká Šárka, and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks of Prague, registration on the website, pre-race runs, and shoe testing events with KEEN footwear.

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Run Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Velké Karlovice and its surroundings in the Beskydy Mountains. The race offers athletes of all ages and fitness levels the opportunity to test their strength in beautiful nature with views of the Wallachian hills. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come enjoy running in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and surroundings
Running in the nature of Beskydy with Wallachian hills
Traditional race with a long history since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers races in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizer is MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The contact phone number for the race director is +420 602 275 790. The race routes go along asphalt and forest paths, with the possibility of relaxation in thermal pools. Registration begins at 8:00 AM, races start at 9:30 AM. Maps of the routes are available at mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running race held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The race offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and a mixed team race, with every runner, whether a beginner or experienced, welcome. The atmosphere is professional, with participation from the world elite and rich amenities including refreshments, music, and sports shopping. The course runs on a single loop, with start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
Opportunity to run with elite world runners
additional: Registration fees can also be purchased on-site in cash or via QR code at check-in. The race pack includes an original functional Macron T-shirt, finisher's medal, refreshments during and after the race, a rich expo, and free taping and physiotherapist care. The race takes place on a single loop with partial traffic restrictions during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The race includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. The event is supported by the city of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail running race that takes participants through the wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hiding in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the challenging ascent of Szádvár, the panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain, and the charming wine cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This demanding race will be held in October in Szögliget, inviting adventure seekers.
course_highlights: Wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
Monastery ruin among the trees
Panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, and the terrain is diverse, featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online, and during the race, they can enjoy the scenic landscape and the challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap Running Race is held in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half marathon distance in four laps. For those who wish to run fewer laps, there is an option to complete fewer rounds. The race operates with a voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place on-site. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The award ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The race route consists of 4 laps for the half marathon distance
Option to run fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration is on-site, recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Award ceremony at 12:00 PM. The top three male and female finishers receive a unique medal. hilly terrain, 4 rounds for a half marathon, options for fewer rounds, refreshments provided, medals for all, awards for top finishers

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros - jeseň je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v Bratislave, v lokalite Knižková dolina, Bratislava - Rača. Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť jesennú atmosféru v príjemnom prostredí amfiteátra a okolia. Organizátori OZ PERUN zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a občerstvenie pre účastníkov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a bežeckých nadšencov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Pretek v prírodnom prostredí Knižkovej doliny
Štart a cieľ v amfiteátri Bratislava - Rača
Jesenná atmosféra a kvalitné občerstvenie

The race facilities are at Haken Stadium in the center of Milovice, with refreshments and sanitary facilities.
course_highlights: Easy natural route of 5.8 km with partially paved and road surfaces
Children's oval routes around Haken Stadium with gravel surface
Finish with a medal in the shape of the republic and an accompanying program with a live band
additional: The race is held in a format of a RACE without timing measurement, but the final time and winners are announced. Registration and race packets are collected at the stadium facilities. There is a public tent for changing, Toi Toi toilets, and a restaurant RKDM approximately 100 meters from the venue. Refreshments are provided by a catering company, including draft beer and lemonades. Trail and road routes, children's routes, cultural program, refreshments, parking nearby, start at Haken Stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Race of the Republic in Písek is a traditional event held on October 28th in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a course for adults measuring 5.35 km, leading through the picturesque environment of Palackého Sady, across Kamenný Bridge, and along the river. For children, shorter distances from 100 m to 1.5 km are available, running on paved and asphalt paths. At the finish line, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic and a starter pack with gifts. The main race is limited to 150 runners, with on-site registration available if capacity has not been reached.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic Kamenný Bridge and along the Otava River
The surface of the route combines paving, asphalt, gravel, and forest paths
Start and finish are in Palackého Sady near the music pavilion
additional: The race time is measured with professional timing equipment. The starter pack includes a race number and gifts from organizers and partners. New registrations and packet pick-up close 30 minutes before the race start. The main race is limited to 150 runners, with on-site registration possible if capacity is not filled. Routes range from 100 m to 5.35 km, registration on-site possible, start in Palackého Sady, with refreshments, changing rooms, toilets, showers, parking at Fügner Square and near the post office.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena u vstupného znamená cenu startovného pro dospělé, snížené pro děti
description: The Sokol Race of the Republic in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28th. The race offers courses for adults in lengths of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km, which run through the city center on asphalt roads. For children, shorter circuits of 700 m, 350 m, and 100 m are prepared around T.G. Masaryk Square. The start and finish are located at the central square, where facilities including changing rooms, a storage area, and refreshments are available. Participants can expect professional timing and a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic at the finish line.
course_highlights: Flat course passing through the historic center of Prostějov
Circuit of 2.5 km on asphalt, run 1x, 2x, or 4x depending on the race length
Start and finish at T.G. Masaryk Square with good accessibility and facilities
additional: The starter pack includes a bib number and gifts from organizers and partners. Payment on site is possible via Apple Pay or Google Wallet. A medal in the shape of the republic is prepared at the finish. There are changing rooms, a valuables and backpack storage, sufficient toilet facilities, and musical performances with athlete demonstrations. Courses for adults are 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; children's courses are 0.1 km, 0.35 km, 0.7 km; online registration is available; over 200 participants have registered.

name: Podzimní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka, Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150,- Kč dospělí, 50,- Kč děti a žactvo
description: Autumn Run Dražovkou is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Dražovka near Hořovice. The main course measures approximately 7.2 km and mainly runs through forest paths in hilly terrain, offering runners a pleasant challenge and beautiful natural scenery. The race is suitable for various age categories, including children and youth, who have their own shorter courses. Start and registration are at the same location by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest, ensuring convenient access and a forest running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main course 7.2 km, women run 3.6 km
Mainly forest paths in hilly terrain
Youth, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap, others run two laps
additional: Start and registration are at the same place by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest. The race offers children's races. Youth, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap, other runners two laps. The race includes children's and pupil categories, with start and registration at the water tower in Dražovka, and the course runs through forest paths.

name: Vinařský maraton
location: Velké Bílovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: 1.090 Kč při on-line přihlášce do 30. 10. 2026 do 23:59 hodin (prosíme, uhraďte startovné převodem nejpozději do 30.10. 2026 12:00, po tomto datu je nutné mít s sebou potvrzení platby nebo uhradit na místě).

description: The Winegrowers Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Báječné ženy v běhu association, held in Velké Bílovice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers a marathon course and a half-marathon route passing through picturesque vineyards and the villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice. The event also features a charity run called Vinařská míle, open to children and adults. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the running community as well as local charitable projects.
course_highlights: The route passes through vineyards and picturesque villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice
Marathon and half-marathon courses with beautiful views of South Moravian landscape
Charity run Vinařská míle for children and adults
additional: The race capacity is 800 runners. The registration fee applies also to relay participants, who must register under the same relay name. Changing rooms are available at the school premises, and a baggage storage is provided in a tent at the multifunctional playground. The organizer is not responsible for items left outside the official storage. Payment of the registration fee can be made on-site in cash or via QR code if capacity allows. The race takes place in October, with a capacity of approximately 800 runners. Registration is possible online or on-site. The race routes include various wine regions, including Vrbice, Hradištěk, and Čejkovice, with options to participate in different categories, including relay races and special categories for the visually impaired.

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Labský Valley Run is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque environment of Dolní Žleb near Děčín. The race offers courses of various lengths, mainly along forest roads and trails with varied terrain. It is organized by the Labáci group, which continues a long-standing tradition of local organizers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shortened course in varied terrain
Predominantly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn environment of Labský údolí
additional: Registration for participants takes place on the race day from 10:45 AM at the pub "U Kosti" in Dolní Žleb. Recommended arrival by train. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registrations will open in spring 2026. Registration is open until October 30, 2025, with the race scheduled for November 1 at 12:00 PM, and registration closes at 10:45 AM. There is an option to travel by train from Děčín.

name: Lhotecká Kaštanka
description: Lhotecká Kaštanka is a race approximately 15 km long, running on asphalt and solid forest paths in the Lhota area in the Central Bohemian Region. This run is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup and offers runners a pleasant route with natural surroundings. The race is suitable for runners seeking quality asphalt and forest running in a picturesque landscape. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 15 km
Run on asphalt and solid forest paths
Part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup
additional: The race takes place on October 31, 2026, in the Lhota area, and is intended for runners who want to enjoy a sports day in nature.

name: Krospůlmaraton
location: Sosnová u České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The half marathon in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race organized as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa. The race takes place on October 31, 2026, and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in the pleasant autumn environment of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional runs that promote sports activity and community gathering of runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country
Included in the regional running league
Held in the picturesque environment of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional series of runs; the exact course profile is not specified, but a terrain character suitable for running in nature is expected.

name: Motolské jamky
location: Golfový areál Golf Club Praha, Motol, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 600 Kč (10 km), 500 Kč (5 km), 100 Kč (dětský závod)
description: Trail Running Cup - Run over Motolské jamky is a running race held in the picturesque environment of the Golf Course Golf Club Prague in Motol. The race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy a challenging trail terrain in Prague 5 with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for all nature running enthusiasts. The race start is traditionally at 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Golf Club Prague Motol area
Natural and varied terrain with views
Location in Prague 5 with accessibility
additional: Registration, regulations, and results are available at the external link https://tech.orgsu.org/Site/SG/3. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series with additional races throughout the year. Trail routes include the golf course, registration closes 30 minutes before the start, parking is available directly at the venue.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, with the start in the morning. The race is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has been supporting the running community for over 35 years.
course_highlights: Length of the course 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups and running levels
Picturesque environment near the fountain in the park
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The start location is near the fountain in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The top three places in each category are awarded. The race is part of an annual trophy competition with points awarded based on age coefficient. It is part of a series of 2-mile runs in Olomouc, held on an asphalt track, with registration from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: HRUŠTICE 10 km - Memoriál Zdeňka Drobníka
location: Turnov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 200 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie Z, Z35, Z45, M39, V40, V50, V60

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race - Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974, which has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley since 2024. The race is a popular autumn event that attracts runners from the surrounding area every year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere connected with local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, where chip timing and professional organization are provided. After the race, a raffle for material prizes takes place, traditionally featuring semi-precious stones from the region.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the highland plateau above Turnov
Traditional material prizes made of semi-precious stones from the region
additional: All categories start together. Registration and bib number pickup are from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is possible until 10:00 with a higher starting fee. After the race, there is a raffle of bib numbers for material prizes. The race facilities are at the athletic clubroom of AC Turnov at the Ludvík Dáněk stadium. The race is part of a long-term series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to the general running public.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher za celou sérii), 316 Kč (voucher za 6 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races set in the beautiful natural surroundings around the Berounka River, motivating runners of all levels to engage in regular activity. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage passing through the Křivoklát forests with views of the surroundings and a final downhill run from the Děd lookout tower to the finish line. The route is well marked and offers stunning natural scenery, refreshments, and a place to store belongings. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage with headlamp
Route passes through Křivoklát forests with views near the oak alley
Steep climb to Děd lookout tower and downhill back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Each participant will receive a start number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp for the night run. The top three in each category will receive diplomas. Night stage, trail running, marked routes, scenic views, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and storage, winners announced in categories, headlamp required.

name: Běžecká série Berounka - Beroun
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 trail races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, taking place from January to December 2026. The routes lead along the best running trails in the area with varying elevation changes and offer stunning views of nature and the surrounding landscape. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to gain motivation for regular running. Starts are mostly accessible by train, and local pubs provide facilities. At the end of the series, there is a ceremonial announcement of winners in several categories.
course_highlights: Routes lead along educational trails and nature reserves with views of Český kras
Challenging ascents and descents with elevation gains of over 330 meters on some routes
Start and finish near train stations with options for refreshments and facilities
additional: Each participant receives a starting number. There are refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms, and showers on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp due to the nocturnal nature of some races. The series counts the 10 best races of each runner, and at the end, winners are announced in 12 categories. The races take place in various locations around Beroun, with starts mostly accessible by train. The winners are announced in December. The races are divided into 12 categories.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Lázně Velichovky Trail is the third annual autumn trail race held in the historic Velichovky Spa. It offers a diverse and beautiful running terrain with start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa services including a café and provides original medals, gifts, and a race packet. The atmosphere is friendly and the race is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts and spa environment lovers.
course_highlights: The most colorful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, a race packet, an electronic chip for timing, refreshments during and after the race, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services, and an accompanying program. There is also a sale of Gladiator Race clothing and parking near the race center. Registration is available online via reg-sportvisio.cz. Medals, chip timing, race photos, diplomas, refreshments, and spa services are provided.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: RUN AND FUN - pouze do 31. 8. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: NO FUN, JUST RUN - pouze do 24. 10. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race that connects Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4-5 members run a total of 164 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains over the course of one day. The race offers a unique team experience with the option to choose from two start packages, which include various benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet, and finisher medals. The event is suitable for men's, women's, mixed, and corporate relays and is supported by the main partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
Combination of cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains
Relays of 4-5 team members with at least 3 segments per runner
additional: Start packages are team-based for 5 people. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, dinner in the form of a buffet, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking, and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking, and a finisher party. There are mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, a speaker, and full event organization. When registering, it is necessary to fill in the team captain's details and later add the team composition and T-shirt sizes. Each team member must run at least 3 segments, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraising campaign for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration begins in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: The Práchně Run is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a course length of 9.5 km. From 2024, an updated route will be used, which follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, where facilities for runners including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments are provided. The results are announced approximately at 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and smooth course of the event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD with full facilities
Mixed race type in the picturesque environment of Horažďovice
additional: Results are announced approximately at 12:00 in Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway, with start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, and facilities provided after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race on a 3.2 km course designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The route mainly passes through gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps around a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Timing is recorded for each runner, and the top three in both adult and children categories receive small prizes. The recommended ways to reach the start are by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The races are held on the first Saturday of each month, starting at 9:00 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55. Participants can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The main course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with a length of 3.2 km, and the children's course is 800 meters long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races including a marathon, half marathon, relay half marathon, decimarathon, and youth races. The Memorial of MUDr. Josef Podmolík is the highlight half marathon race, held in the beautiful environment of Otrokovice. Participants can enjoy a quality course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a rich program for all age groups. Registration and winners' ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half marathon and marathon course in Otrokovice with chip timing
Decimarathon circuit of 4.2195 km
Youth races with various distances from 200 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners are required to pick up their start number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are announced gradually after each race, and attendance at the awards ceremony is mandatory. Registration is done via email. The event includes various age categories and races on city streets and in the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometers. The start and finish are located at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream, with turnarounds in V Kozle settlement (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide age category and offers refreshments at the finish line, as well as monetary and material prizes for the best runners.
course_highlights: Routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream
Turnaround for the 11 km route is in V Kozle settlement, for the 18 km route in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: Registration and check-in on-site on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Pre-registered runners with payment by November 5th will receive a start number with their name. Refreshments at the finish line include tea and cookies. The race takes place in full road traffic; participants must follow traffic rules and run at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby parking lots are recommended due to blue zones. The race offers online registration as well as on-site registration, medals, certificates, and monetary prizes are awarded.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional city road race 5 kilometers long, held in the Baťovský area in Zlín. The race is intended for both adults and children, organized by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with Běhy Zlín. The event offers a quality sports experience in the center of the regional city with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized course.
course_highlights: The route passes through the former Baťovský area in Zlín
Road race over 5 kilometers in an urban environment
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of the year-round Zlín running competition. Organizers provide online results and event photos. Children's categories are also offered within the race. The organization ensures quality timing and supports the regional running community. The race is part of a series of runs in Zlín, offering various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for each participant, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended) and a mobile valuables storage. WC cabins are available on site. The start is at 9:07 AM, registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora - Stromovka Park, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, with changing rooms and toilets available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two routes approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km long. The routes run through flat Polabian forest with surfaces combining paved and unpaved roads, footpaths, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, which provides refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities. The race is suitable for the general public, with a capacity limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children's races of various lengths depending on age.
course_highlights: Routes run flat through the beautiful Polabian forest
Start after about 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at 8 km and 17 km (21 km route), one station at 8 km (12 km route)
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking is available on-site for a fee of 50 CZK per car. Children's races range from 200 to 1000 meters depending on age. The route is marked with flags, signs, and flour arrows, with each kilometer approximately indicated. The race includes children's races, online registration is possible, and the route may be adjusted due to nearby reconstruction.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team running experience in the beautiful environment of Hostivař. The race is designed for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge while experiencing the atmosphere of a friendly race. The course runs through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come run and enjoy a great sporting event in a friendly community.
course_highlights: Relay run in pairs
Scenic environment of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay discipline, with registrations available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek, which has been taking place since 1980 with breaks and a revival of the tradition in 1996. The race offers various running disciplines including youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The event celebrates movement and sportsmanship, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages and is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The start is at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and the race is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs around Frýdek-Místek with a history dating back to 1980
Main race of 10 km with accompanying youth races and a health run
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race includes a non-competitive run for parents with children, youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and includes road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic

The race takes place around the Labe River and near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club. Organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural environment. Regulations and further information are available on the club's website.
course_highlights: Cross country race in natural terrain around the Labe River
Start and finish near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club
Traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: The "Fuss egy napot!" is an ultramarathon event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The aim of the event is to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a community sports experience. Runners can test their strength over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes carnival atmosphere and the joy of collective movement.

Natural, varied terrain
Community and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances; the registration deadline is November 5, 2025. There are limited facilities on-site for changing clothes and equipment, and access to the lake is not guaranteed during the run.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: The Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, on the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. Participants will run along a dark, eerie course with ghostly figures and spooky effects accompanying them. The races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer, multi-lap races, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the end of the race, music and celebration await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Route through the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visual effects and frightening effects
Varied distances, including a 21 km circuit race and tunnel running
additional: The race takes place in Budapest's X district, at Rottenbiller Park. Easily accessible by public transport, parking options are limited. The race program includes multiple runs, from the 2.5 km Halloween tours to the 21 km individual and relay races. Registration on site is possible until 45 minutes before the start of the race, provided online registration is not full. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, themed dark atmosphere, various distances, location Budapest, Rottenbiller Park, online and on-site registration, award ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-oriented trail running race in Esztergom, offering challenges on three different distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km. The race route runs on trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the beauty of nature and the varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, featuring cup-free refreshment stations and supported by the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where runners also have access to comfortable changing and luggage storage facilities.
course_highlights: Trail running on trails and marked hiking paths
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km with varying difficulty levels
Minimal road sections, close to nature experience
additional: The race uses chip timing, which can be rented for a deposit of 2000 HUF. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring their own water bottle or cup. Race packets are available on the race day at the race center; early pickup is not possible. Registration cancellations are accepted until October 15, 2026; afterward, registration can only be transferred to the next year. Separate female and male changing rooms and built-in toilets are available at the race center; there are no washbasins. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top three female and male overall finishers will receive special awards. Hydration equipment is mandatory for the race, and on-site changing and luggage storage services are provided. Environmentally friendly solutions are implemented to support participants.

description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the District Running League Českolipsko and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on roads and in terrain, offering a diverse environment for competitors. The race is a popular event within the regional running community and provides opportunities for personal achievements and meeting running enthusiasts.

Part of the Českolipsko regional running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026, registration and further details are not specified, the event is part of a broader series of regional runs.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the ash track stadium of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and runs along field paths, ensuring a pleasant terrain for running. name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech Republic, held annually on the second Sunday of November in Kunratický Forest in Prague. The race has been held continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging profile and variable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. It attracts a wide range of runners from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3100 meters. The organizer is the athletic club Spartak Praha 4.
course_highlights: Challenging course profile in Kunratický Forest
Six courses from 370 m to 3100 m
Interval start in pairs with a 10-second gap
additional: All categories start in pairs with a 10-second interval. Official BUSHMAN brand T-shirts can be purchased exclusively during registration. Pickup of ordered T-shirts takes place at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3600, with 2700 runners crossing the Hrádek. Changes to registration are possible until October 14, 2026 via email, thereafter only upon presentation. The race takes place in November, with a limited number of participants set at 3400, online registration opens on October 5, 2026, on-site registration available, with various age and performance categories.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: The Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race through the hills of Dunaföldvár, offering a stunning panorama and an impressive start/finish area at the Ispánház. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to the 23 km course, with separate awards for women and men categories. The routes mostly run on dirt roads with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy close contact with nature. The race operates as an eco-friendly event, and organizers ask runners to bring their own water bottles or cups to refreshment points.
course_highlights: Trail running routes through the hills of Dunaföldvár
Beautiful panoramic views of the southern Danube Bend from the Calvary and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads with minimal paved sections

description: The Garmin WTF BUDA is a special trail running race in the Buda Hills, offering both asphalt and trail distances. Participants can choose from trail distances of 7, 12, 21, and 32 km, as well as asphalt distances of 10 and 18 km. The race is part of a unique hybrid event series where trail and road runners start together and celebrate their achievements at the finish line. The time limit for all distances is 5 hours, with additional partial time limits for longer distances to ensure safe completion. The registration fee includes refreshments, timing, baggage storage, and custom medals.

Mixed trail and asphalt routes around Budapest Szépjuhászné railway station

The race is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular among runners who enjoy challenges in a natural environment. Traditionally, runners of all ages and performance levels gather here.

Challenging course in the natural environment of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series

name: Beh na Minčol
description: Beh na Minčol je najťažší beh do vrchu v blízkom okolí, ktorý vedie krásnym prostredím Višňovskej doliny. Trasa začína dolinou a pokračuje prudkým stúpaním na hlavný hrebeň až na vrchol Minčola s nádhernými výhľadmi na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na náročný profil s minimom priestoru na oddych a záverečný prudký výstup, kde väčšina zvolí rýchlu chôdzu. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie pretekárov s cenami pre najlepších v kategóriách.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom s modrou značkou
Náročné prudké stúpania od začiatku až do konca
Krásne výhľady z vrcholu Minčola na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry
additional: Štart je na parkovisku pri vstupe do doliny, cieľ na vrchole Minčola (1363 m.n.m). Občerstvenie je zabezpečené na trati približne na 2 km a v cieli. Po dobehu sa podáva obed (domáca kapustnica a nápoj) v lyžiarskom stredisku Holý Diel. Pretekári majú možnosť odovzdať veci do drop bagu, ktoré budú prevezené do zázemia s vyhlásením výsledkov. Vyhodnotení budú prví traja v každej kategórii, ak v kategórii štartujú minimálne traja pretekári. Podujatie je súčasťou tradičného kalendára bežeckých akcií v Malé Fatre, s možnosťou registrácie online, občerstvenia na trati a v cieli, ako aj ocenení najrýchlejších bežcov. Po behu je pripravená tradičná kapustnica a spoločenský program.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race around Pilsen, offering scenic routes in nature with minimal asphalt. The race is suitable for both enthusiasts of healthy outdoor activity and competitive athletes and top trail runners. Participants can choose from routes of 42 km with an elevation gain of 700 m, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children's and pupils' courses including a multigenerational relay. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora, where the start and finish are also held. Organizers adhere to the motto "I don't run on asphalt" and prepare the race with an emphasis on running in nature and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along footpaths on both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around Bolevecké ponds
Climb to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 m on the marathon route

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain run of the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking place through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 30 km with ascents to Olivetská Mountain, passing over the Černá Nisa dam, and a steep climb through Bílý Štolpich. For less experienced runners, there is a shorter 10 km route and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The race is open to all running and nature enthusiasts, whether registered for the entire trilogy or just participating in this race.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain run across the Vysoký Hřeben and Kanál
Twice ascending Olivetská Mountain and passing over the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizerské Mountains - Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start; the start corridor is open for two hours, allowing runners to choose their start time. The route is not marked; the race is partially orienteering. There are three variants available: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The event is open to all interested participants, offering registration options for different routes, and emphasizing the natural beauty and sporting experience in the mountain environment.

The event is suitable for runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also an opportunity to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and actively spend time in nature.

Opportunity to participate in various age categories

The course runs along paths around the Berounka River, through forests near Bolevecké rybníky, and includes a challenging ascent to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 meters. Organizers emphasize running in nature without asphalt, which is appreciated by both recreational runners and top trail runners. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora.

name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sportegyesület in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7 km, 21 km, and 42 km distances, each involving conquering 1, 3, or 5 Tanúhegy peaks, with stunning views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding landscape. The start and finish are at the Halászkert, and the race also serves a charitable purpose, with the timing chip deposit fee being donationable to the Ürömi Állatotthon. The shortest distance includes a dog-friendly race, and everyone is welcome to participate in the event scheduled for November 14, 2026.

description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Súťažia kategórie detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov, pričom pretekári môžu získať body aj za zlepšenie svojich časov v roku.

name: Beh na Husárik
