description: Beh na Husárik je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Klubom Kysuckého maratónu Čadca, Mestom Čadca a Horským hotelom Husárik. Tento pretek sa koná na počesť dňa študentstva a ponúka bežcom možnosť zmerať si sily v krásnom horskom prostredí. Štart je vždy o 11. hodine a pretek je známy svojou priateľskou atmosférou a pohárom primátora mesta Čadca ako ocenením pre víťazov. Beh na Husárik je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá má záujem o šport a prírodu.
course_highlights: Horské prostredie okolo Horského hotela Husárik
Pretek na počesť dňa študentstva
Pohár primátora mesta Čadca pre víťazov
additional: Online registrácia je ukončená, prihlásiť sa je možné aj v deň preteku za zvýšené štartovné 8 EUR. Pretek sa koná 15. novembra 2026, štart o 11:00, možnosť online registrácie, trať je kopcovitá a trailová, organizované v Čadci v blízkosti Horského hotela Husárik.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
organizer: Mesto Strážske, bežecký klub MBO Strážske
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske je tradičným športovým podujatím, ktoré si každoročne pripomína výročie oslobodenia mesta. Tento 49. ročník prilákal bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií, od detí až po dospelých, ktorí súťažili na rôznych dĺžkach tratí. Atmosféra je športová a priateľská, s ocenením najrýchlejších bežcov a bohatou históriou víťazov. Organizátorom je mesto Strážske v spolupráci s bežeckým klubom MBO Strážske, ktoré podporujú rozvoj bežeckého športu v regióne.
course_highlights: Viacero kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia
Trate prispôsobené pre mládež aj dospelých
Historická tradícia od roku 1970
additional: Podujatie má dlhoročnú tradíciu s ocenením najrýchlejších bežcov v jednotlivých kategóriách. Po behu sa odovzdávajú ceny vrátane tomboly s hodnotnými cenami, napríklad horským bicyklom. V minulosti sa podujatia zúčastnilo vyše 300 bežcov, vrátane domácich a zahraničných športovcov. Podujatie zahŕňa viacero kategórií a výsledky a historické víťazstvá sú verejne dostupné. Registrácia je možná online, a trať nie je špecifikovaná.

name: Hermanovská desiatka
location: Hermanovce nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 10,- € Povinná do 10.11.2025 cez QR kód

description: Hermanovská desiatka je bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovským bežeckým oddielom. Pretek sa koná pred budovou Obecného úradu v Hermanovciach nad Topľou a ponúka kategórie pre deti, mládež aj dospelých. Štart pre deti a mládež je o 12:00 hod., pre dospelých o 14:00 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.
course_highlights: Súťaž pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, mládeže a dospelých
Organizované v malebnom prostredí Hermanoviec nad Topľou
Možnosť registrácie cez QR kód a nízke štartovné 10 €
additional: Štart pre deti a mládež je o 12:00 hod., pre dospelých o 14:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane domácich kategórií. Registrácia je povinná do 10.11.2025 cez QR kód. Pretek je určený pre bežcov všetkých úrovní, s kategóriami pre deti, mládež a dospelých. Podujatie sa koná 15. novembra 2026, štart je o 12:00 pre deti a o 14:00 pre dospelých.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € pre dospelých, 5 € pre seniorov a podujatie 'Prebehni sa s nami', zadarmo pre deti a mládež

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 rokov a ženy nad 50 rokov 6 €

description: Ferčekovská desiatka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Ferčekovce pri Spišskej Novej Vsi, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti, dorast a dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na lesných cestách a trávnatých, zvlnených terénoch, čo vytvára príjemné a prírodné prostredie pre bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií. Organizátorom je Športový klub Ferčekovce v spolupráci s mestom Spišská Nová Ves. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rodín a bežeckých nadšencov, ktorí si môžu vybrať z viacerých kategórií a vzdialeností.
course_highlights: Povrch: lesná cesta a tráva
Zvlnený terén v prírodnom prostredí
Viacero kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia
additional: Štart detí a dorastu je o 11:00, pretek Prebehni sa s nami štartuje o 12:15 a dospelí na 5 a 10 km o 13:00. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane špeciálnych kategórií pre seniorov. Štartovné je nižšie pri online registrácii, na mieste je jednotná cena 15 €. Podujatie zahŕňa občerstvenie, medaily pre všetkých finišerov, možnosť registrácie online, a rôzne kategórie pre všetky vekové skupiny.

name: Krosová 12°
description: The Cross 12° is a running race over 12 km or 6 km, which takes place on a hilly 6 km circuit around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race offers runners a challenge in the form of demanding terrain with elevation gain, ideal for lovers of natural runs and hilly courses. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running in terrain with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. After the race, it is possible to use recommended running gear and accessories, which are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km circuit with elevation gain
Option to choose between 12 km and 6 km courses
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course length options: 12 km and 6 km, run on a hilly circuit. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for variable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and the choice between two race distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17th Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová that commemorates an important day in Czech history. It offers two main courses - the certified 10 km Free Ten and the 5 km Revolutionary Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Registration and check-in take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the start in the morning. The routes lead through the picturesque environment of Ostrava-Hrabová with good public transport access and the possibility of using shared bikes from Nextbike.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course Free Ten
5 km Revolutionary Five
Routes lead through Ostrava-Hrabová with good public transport access
additional: Registration and check-in on site take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The start of individual races is in the morning. Transport is provided by public transport lines 27, 39, 41, 77 with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared bikes from Nextbike are also available. The race includes various course lengths, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition with results from previous editions.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 300,- při registraci on-line od 12. 11. do konání závodu, platba převodem nebo v hotovosti při prezentaci

description: The Satin Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering courses for all age groups including a family run for parents with children. The race takes place on a football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal, and small refreshments after the race including tea and mulled wine. Organizers ensure the safety of the course and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Courses of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish on the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Runners registration begins at 08:45 at the race site. After the race, there is small refreshments available including tea, mulled wine, and homemade buns. Participants will receive a start number with a chip and safety pins. Parking is available at Penny Market. The organizers ensure course and race security. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories Fighters, Champions, and Legends. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments, and fun activities for families; registration is possible on-site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17th Run in Přerov is a traditional athletic event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. This race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and levels to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and test their strength on an interesting course. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country race over 9 km with children's categories available
Part of the Olomouc Region Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix
Affordable registration and results available online
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offering various courses including cross country and attracting a wide participation from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter circuit that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00 AM, and participants can compete in several age categories. The event facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers, and after the race, an award ceremony with material prizes. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Circuit length of 5000 meters (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 AM at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers provided. Results announcement at 12:30 PM in the sports hall buffet with material prizes. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women. Participants run 4 laps. Safety signage for roots and stones. Refreshments at the finish line. Raffle. Festive start with a shot by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17th Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the sports club SK Městská policie Kadaň. The race takes place in Roosevelt Gardens and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support of the local running community. The regulations and additional information are available for download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: Race runs through Roosevelt Gardens in Kadaň
Course suitable for various age groups
Friendly atmosphere and support of the local running community
additional: The race regulations are available for download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with contact person Bc. Jiří Vlasák. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g., 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The location is in Roosevelt Gardens in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The city run in Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city center on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km long route, which is composed of five laps. A shorter loop of 200 meters is prepared for children and youth. The event is suitable for the general public and is organized by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city center
Children's loop 200 meters long
Road race with a length of 9.7 km
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the Lipky housing estate near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organizer is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s., contact person Jiří Brych. The race is held in the Lipky housing estate, with starts scheduled at 10:00 and 12:00, and registration is possible via the sports portal sport-reg.cz.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17th Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in the Liboháj forest park. The main race covers 6 km, divided into two three-kilometer loops, and is complemented by a popular 3 km run. The event is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also features an additional race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The race starts on the ski slope at 11:00 AM, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45 AM. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj forest park with roads and trails
Main race 6 km (2x 3 km loops), popular run 3 km (1 loop)
Additional race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Registration for competitors takes place from 10:00 to 10:45 AM. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup. The additional race on the ski slope is intended for brave competitors. Weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery and icy after overnight rain. The course runs on roads and trails in the forest park, with a competitive bonus on the ski slope, as part of the ISCAREX 2025 cup.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce je tradičný večerný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v centre mesta Michalovce. Pretekári bežia mestskými ulicami s dĺžkou trate približne 5,8 km, ktorá je tvorená viacerými okruhmi. Po dobehnutí na cieľ ich čaká občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s možnosťou osobnej prezentácie v deň preteku.
course_highlights: Večerný beh centrom mesta Michalovce
Trať dlhá 5,8 km, tvorená okruhmi po 1 450 m
Občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila po dobehnutí
additional: Prezentácia prebieha vo vestibule Mestského úradu od 16:30 do 17:45, odporúčajú sa čelové LED lampy kvôli bezpečnosti. Po dobehnutí sa štartové číslo vracia a pretekári dostanú medailu. Vyhlásenie výsledkov je o 19:30 v telocvični 8. ZŠ P. Horova. Trať je skrátená na 5,8 km, beží sa na asfaltových a kamenných povrchoch, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, štartovné pri registrácii je 20 €, znížené pri online registrácii do 19.11.2025

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše je bežecké podujatie v obci Šemša v okrese Košice okolie, ktoré ponúka tri trate rôznej dĺžky: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km. Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách, cestičkách, poľných cestách a asfalte, čo vytvára príjemné a rozmanité bežecké prostredie. Preteky sú otvorené pre všetky vekové kategórie bez rozdelenia na vekové skupiny a organizuje ich občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny, pričom dlhšia trať začína o 10:00 a kratšie trate o 11:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú lesný beh s rôznou náročnosťou a dĺžkou trasy.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách a cestičkách
Zahrnuté sú poľné cesty a asfaltové úseky
Tri dĺžky tratí: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km
additional: Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny: o 10:00 štartuje 22 km trať, o 11:00 štartujú trate 5,5 km a 11 km. Kategórie sú bez vekových obmedzení, určené pre deti, mužov a ženy. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Povrch trate je rôznorodý, zahŕňa lesné cesty, poľné cesty a asfalt. Preteky sa konajú na teréne s lesnými cestami, poľnými cestami a asfaltom. Registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre deti, mužov a ženy, s možnosťou výberu medzi krátkymi a dlhými traťami.

name: Beh na Kysacký hrad
organizer: Klub orientačného behu Kysak, Obec Kysak

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 8,00 € - dorastenci, dorastenky, juniori, juniorky a pretekári nad 60 rokov, pri prihlásení cez prihlasovací formulár a platbe prevodom do 18.11.2024.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 12.00 € - účastníci preteku Beh na Hrad v kategórii „M - A, B, C a Ž - E, F, G“, pri prihlásení cez prihlasovací formulár a platbe prevodom do 18.11.2024.

description: Beh na Kysacký hrad je bežecké podujatie organizované Klubom orientačného behu Kysak a obcou Kysak, ktoré sa koná pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými cestami (85 %) s menším podielom asfaltu (15 %). Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie od dorastencov až po veteránov, s rozdelením podľa veku a pohlavia. Štartovné je rozdelené podľa kategórií a platí sa pri registrácii a platbe prevodom do určitého termínu. Podujatie ponúka príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť súťažiť v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: 85 % lesné cesty, 15 % asfalt
Štart pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku
Viacero vekových kategórií od dorastencov po veteránov
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia: dorastenci, juniori, muži a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Miesto štartu je pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Pretek je organizovaný v prostredí historického Kysackého hradu s možnosťou registrácie cez online formulár a platbou bankovým prevodom do 18.11.2024. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a pohlavia.

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region, offering men a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice and women a 5 km course, which turns back earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain. For more information, contact the organizer. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test strength on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road terrain
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For race information, contact Jiří Sedláček at 606280856 and Jan Šír at 732851697. Race details are available via phone numbers of Jiří Sedláček (606280856) and Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course set in the picturesque environment of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in the region. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Olomouc County Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix series and attracts runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The route runs through the scenic landscape of Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest surface
Part of the Olomouc County Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix
additional: The race takes place on April 21, 2026, as part of a series of local runs, with the course mainly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Čáp Run is a public uphill race with mass start held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful nature. The race is suitable for the general public and provides an opportunity to test strength in challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Uphill run with mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series with tradition and history
additional: The race features categories, registration is possible for an entry fee of 50 CZK, and it takes place in terrain with demanding elevation changes. Results are regularly published, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a night trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory and the course is marked with reflective elements, ensuring safety and a unique atmosphere. After finishing, participants are served tea and refreshments. This race is ideal for night running and trail enthusiasts who want to experience running in an unconventional environment with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Night trail course 5 km
Course marked with reflective elements
Mandatory headlamp for safe running
additional: At the finish line, tea and refreshments are provided for racers. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. Organized by Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, with mandatory headlamps, reflective markings, refreshments at the finish, and is suitable for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slaný Runs are a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories including the main 12 km category and children's categories. The event is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Main category of 12 km around Slaný
Children's and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided by V.B.T. Grammar School Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November, with the last edition on November 29, 2025. The organizers thank all competitors for their participation and look forward to the next edition. In the past, about 70 runners participated in the main category and several dozen children and youth. The main race is 12 km long, registration takes place at V.B.T. Grammar School Slaný, and the race will be held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at 10:00 AM.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 111 Kč

description: The Devil's Winter Trail is an off-road run through hills, forests, and between rocks around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two routes of 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the possibility to change the route free of charge. Participants will enjoy challenging winter terrain with several refreshment stations and intense experiences on the hellish trail. The start is jointly at 10:00 AM, and the time limit is 7 hours. Included in the registration fee are timing services, gifts, refreshments on the course and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Off-road run through hills, forests, and between rocks
Two routes: 33.3 km and 16.6 km with free change option
3 refreshment stations on the long route and 1 on the short, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with checkpoint time limits at 15 km (3 hours) and 25 km (5 hours). Participants must bring their own cup for drinks; a devilish running cup can be purchased at the presentation. The registration fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), a timing chip for measuring times and splits, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main meal, beer, soda, mulled wine, tea). The route is marked, with refreshment stations, a personal cup for drinks, nearby accommodation, and registration available on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Small Monaka Prize is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This event is part of the Monaka race series and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to participate and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular among local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
Pleasant atmosphere and friendly environment
Opportunity to participate in various categories and performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course length has not yet been published.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) - November is a regular running race in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Republic Championship. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and the opportunity to share experiences in the restaurant at Hamr Braník is provided.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified device, suitable for the Czech Republic Championship limit at 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The start of the 10 km race is at 14:00, and the 5 km race at 14:05. Registration begins at 13:00 at the blue tent near the cycle path close to U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, and refreshments can be enjoyed at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available at the organizer’s tent. The race is timed with chip timing, and each runner also has a measured "chip" time. The race takes place in November 2026, with registration likely through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in a beautiful environment along the Dřevnice River. The race offers courses of 5 km and 10 km, which run on flat circuits crossing bridges and cycle paths. The event also includes a family mask run over 1.5 km, an accompanying program for children, and a St. Nicholas and devil costume parade. Runners receive a starter pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of the Advent season.
course_highlights: The route runs along a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete and iron bridge
Flat circuits around the football field in Zlín-Louky
additional: Family mask run over 1.5 km with a gingerbread reward at the finish. Accompanying program for children, St. Nicholas and devil costume parade. The starter pack includes gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. Charitable tombola for Krtek with sales and prize distribution during the event. Races of 5 km and 10 km, family and children's runs, charity event, start and finish at the football field in Zlín-Louky, rich accompanying program and starter pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lovoš Run is a traditional uphill running race held in Lovosice in the Ústí Region. The race offers a challenging terrain run with a climb to the top of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural environment. The event is organized with a friendly atmosphere and the possibility of registration in advance or on-site.
course_highlights: Uphill run in terrain
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging ascent to the top of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is provided from 12:30 to 13:30, the bus with backpacks departs at 13:30, and it is necessary to keep track of the departure time. The race is part of a series of sports events in Král středohoří, offering the possibility of registration in advance or on-site, with the start at 14:00. Luggage departure time is at 13:30.

name: Stupenská sedmička
location: TJ Sokol Stupno, Stupno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč do neděle 25. 10. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 250 Kč do neděle 22. 11. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race offers a 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The race atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with ample facilities and refreshments after the run. The registration fee includes a participant medal, timing, race photos, material prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes considering their health and abilities.
course_highlights: 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several forest hills
Crossing a road under volunteer supervision and running along an MTB trail
additional: The registration fee includes refreshments after the race such as tea, water, mulled wine, beer, soda, homemade buns, salty snacks, Christmas rolls, bananas, and energy bars. After the race, winners will be announced and a raffle will be drawn. The start number is equipped with a chip for timing, which must be returned after the race (500 CZK fee for loss). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at TJ Sokol Stupno. Participants are advised to write any allergies and emergency contact on the back of their start number. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration includes gift vouchers, with proceeds supporting charity. A detailed route description is available.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, volunteer-organized running race in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint, which covers the half marathon distance by completing four laps. Participants can run as many laps as they wish, with a suggested registration fee of 500 HUF per lap to support the event costs. Every participant is greeted with an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and receives a commemorative medal; the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration is on-site.
course_highlights: The course is located in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half marathon distance is completed by running 4 laps
Participants can run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on-site, with a recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, warm tea, mulled wine, and apples are available for participants. 4 laps constitute a half marathon, but fewer laps can be run. Registration is on-site. Refreshments included.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Prague - Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail run taking place on December 5, 2026. The race offers three courses: 42 km with individual start, 21 km, and 10 km with mass start. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation gain from 125 to 593 meters. Participants can use transportation for their belongings from the start to the finish line and are awarded absolute winners as well as category winners by age and gender. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment with various race distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník, finish in Kytín
Transport of participants' belongings from start to finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start, while the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. Aid stations are located at 10 km, 16 km, 27 km, 33 km, and at the finish line for the 42 km course. Parking is available near the start and finish areas. Participants run at their own risk and should exercise caution when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and maps of the route and information about participant categories are provided.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: St. Nicholas Run Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. This event attracts local runners and visitors who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Specific details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sports calendar and has a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sports calendar, and results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race on a 3.2 km course designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The route mostly passes between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon roll as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each competitor, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with the children's course being 800 meters long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. Start options include cycling, walking, driving, roller skating, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is friendly and encourages joy in running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park; adults run two laps, children run one lap.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful environment of the Royal Game Reserve - Stromovka
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age coefficient for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Ostrov on Za elektrárnou street. The course length is 3.2 km, asphalt surface, registration is voluntary, and running without bibs is possible.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd in the area near the ski jumps. The race offers a challenging royal route of 22 km with an elevation gain of 1180 meters, closing the skyrunning season of 2025. In addition to the main race, shorter routes and children's races are available, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The race atmosphere is complemented by the announcement of winners and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Royal route Winter SkyRace®: 22 km with 1180 m elevation gain
Other routes: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children's races on 200 m, 500 m, and 1200 m
additional: The winners are announced from 15:30. The race takes place in the area near the ski jumps at Ještěd. There are also Canicross races of the same lengths as the main routes. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple routes, children's races, canicross, registration, race equipment, and refreshments.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI Ještěd SkyRace® is a trail running race held on the Ještěd ridge in the Liberec region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery appreciated by both experienced runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality organization, and rich accompanying program including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with various course lengths (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Rich accompanying program including healthy and diverse refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially prepared race kit. There is healthy and diverse catering including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race is available. Races on different courses, a series of races in summer and winter, registration options, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť covering a distance of 5.7 km, offering not only a sporting experience but also social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup. Runners are welcome to participate in devil costumes, which adds a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories based on age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol Hall and is popular among locals and visitors.
course_highlights: Traditional winter run over 5.7 km
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Announcement of the Sokol Cup after the race
additional: The race takes place on December 6, 2025, from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, Sokol Hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in various age groups). After the race, there will be social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course, registration via naZávody.cz, suitable for all age groups and mask enthusiasts.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka-Pustevny uphill run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoka and around Pustevny. This race offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners' endurance and strength in the beautiful environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular among athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes all who enjoy mountain running and want to experience the unique atmosphere of this race.
course_highlights: Ascent to Pustevny with an elevation gain of 400 m
Course length approximately 5.7 km
Mountain environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is suitable for children, weather can affect conditions, registration details are not specified, the event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a cozy, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their strength over a 3 or 6-kilometer distance. A portion of the registration fee goes to charitable causes, making the run not only a sport activity but also a helping initiative. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to participate in a pleasant winter running program.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 or 6 km distance
Family-friendly, charity-focused running event
In the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: 500 forints of the registration fee will be donated to charity. Participants can choose to run either 3 or 6 kilometers. There is also an option for a family registration on a 2 km course, with up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes; registration fee payment is mandatory. Participation is open to all age groups. The race takes place in Bölcske, Csorda út 1435/6.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jogging is a charity running event held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center in Kecskemét. The purpose of the run is to raise funds to support children fighting Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes, for the NM Muscles Healing Foundation. The event offers community solidarity and a sporty experience for participants while serving a noble cause. The organizers thank all runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center
Charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Community and sporty experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also participate in the background work of the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and sick children. The event is part of the Advent preparations, with the run supporting the healing of sick children, and it is traditionally held every year to foster community unity.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na 2 míle (3,218 km) organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team v areálu kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Závod je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série, kde bežci zbierajú body do Putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, pričom výsledné časy sa prepočítavajú podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 2 míle (3,218 km), deti cca 200 m
Miesto konania: Areál kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava
Prezentácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Kategórie sú deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky a veteráni. Súťažiaci sú bodovaní podľa počtu účastníkov v kategóriách, juniori a juniorky sú bodovaní samostatne. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje rok narodenia a najlepší čas v danom roku. Na dve účasti je vyhlásená amnestia, kedy sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov. Preteky majú rôzne kolá počas roka, vrátane decembrového 12. kola. Registrácia je možná na mieste, podrobnosti o cene nie sú špecifikované, a trať je prevažne asfaltová v mestskom prostredí.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7€.

description: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke je adrenalínový nočný beh určený pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov. Podujatie sa koná 6. decembra 2025 so štartom o 19:00 zo Základnej školy Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na jedinečný zážitok v nočnom prostredí s výhľadom z rozhľadne. Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7 € a záujemcovia sa musia prihlásiť do 5. decembra 2025.
course_highlights: Nočný beh s adrenalínovou atmosférou
Trasa vedie na rozhľadňu na Balážke
Podujatie určené pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov
additional: Podujatie je jedinečné nočné podujatie s minimálnym štartovným 7 €. Účastníci musia byť starší ako 15 rokov. Registrácia je možná do 5. decembra 2025. Štart je zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. nočný beh, štart zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova, registrácia do 5.12.2025, možnosť zľavnených štartov pre skupiny a na kostýmy, podujatie zahŕňa občerstvenie a sprchy

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Little Prize of Velká Veranda is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Chocen. The race is 4,300 meters long and runs along forest roads and paths with an elevation gain of approximately 200 meters. The route is marked with flags and includes a short section of asphalt. This race is also a Memorial of Jirka Švadlena and is popular among runners seeking challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 meters through forest roads and paths
Hilly profile with approximately 200 meters of elevation gain
Route marked with flags, approximately 400 meters of asphalt
additional: The race offers approximately 400 meters of asphalt, suitable for runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. There is also a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, with the start at the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Picturesque park environment with a fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The race location is at the fountain in Smetanovy Sady, except for two races in June and August, which are held by the river on U Dětského domova street. The top three places in each category are awarded. The race is held on an asphalt track, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the event is part of a series of runs in Olomouc with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, which was held for the 33rd time in 2025. The race features three distances: 200 meters for young children, and 1900 and 5900 meters for adults and seniors. More than 200 participants took part in the event, each receiving a unique finisher medal, and Santa's gifts are also waiting for the youngest runners. The atmosphere of the race is family-like, with many prizes and special awards given out by the organizers, and participants can celebrate December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1900 m, and 5900 m
Unique finisher medal for the 1900 m and 5900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere with Santa gifts for children
additional: At the race, runners over 70 years old are honored with a certificate, and the most sporty families are recognized with special awards. The main sponsors of the event are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which offer cake and pastries to participants. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, award ceremonies, gifts, and a joyful winter running celebration.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, taking place from January to December 2026. The routes run along trails with stunning views and diverse terrain, often near nature reserves and historic sites. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with the goal of motivating regular running. Starts are usually at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails run along with views of the Berounka River and the Czech Karst Protected Landscape Area
Challenging ascents and natural reserves, such as Klapice and Radotín Rocks
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs
additional: On-site at the races, there is the possibility of refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race numbers. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The ranking is based on the 10 best scored races in the series. Starts are mostly near train stations and in local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races around Berounka, mainly accessible by train, winners announced in December, 12 categories, scoring based on the best 10 races.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of the former lignite mine, which has been transformed into the beautiful natural environment of Lake Milada on the border of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, in Chabařovice and offers routes of 12.5 km and 5.3 km, including children's races Olympia. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the magical snowy and icy scenery of the lake. All races have a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere and are suitable for children, families, and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the natural environment of the former lignite mine transformed into Lake Milada
Winter run in the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: 12.5 km and 5.3 km, plus children's races
additional: Start packages and medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and picked up on race day. A children's T-shirt is provided free to the first 100 registered children. The race capacity is limited to 500 runners. The accompanying program includes St. Nicholas, Krampus, and the Angel, as well as the Olympia children's corner. Terrain in the area of the former mine, winter/ice conditions, family and children's categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The Mikulášský Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the physical education club Maratonstav Úpice. The race takes place at the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The start number is valid for the entire series of races organized by the organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the square in Úpice at A. Jiráska Theatre
Categories for children and adults with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the possibility to participate in the race series
additional: The race office is open one hour before the start of the first category. Registration closes at 13:30 for children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The start number is valid for the entire race series and must be with you for each subsequent race. Results are not announced after individual races but are published on the organizer's website. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, at the square in Úpice, with the start scheduled at 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration is conducted one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026, and has both charitable and competitive aspects. The goal of the race is to motivate more people to engage in sports, help those in need, and offer participants a way to escape pre-Christmas stress by running through the Christmas-lit Zruč. The course passes through a beautiful castle park and surrounding areas with a Christmas atmosphere, which can be viewed in a video or downloaded as a GPX file for smartwatches. After the race, a warm soup and mulled wine are prepared for a pleasant conclusion to the event.
course_highlights: Run through the Christmas-lit Zruč
The route passes through a castle park and surroundings with a Christmas atmosphere
Option to download a GPX file of the route for smartwatches
additional: The race has a charitable character and after the run, participants are served warm soup and mulled wine. The absolute winner and winner have a record time of 19:10. The course is illuminated with Christmas lights, and the atmosphere is enhanced by Christmas decorations. The event offers two routes of 900 meters and 5500 meters, suitable for children and adults, and is associated with a Christmas atmosphere and the possibility to download a GPX file of the route.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The pre-Christmas run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for youth and adults, with youth running on asphalt circuits in the stadium area from 180 meters to 1.7 km. Adults run on one-kilometer circuits, men 8 km and women 3 km, with the possibility of different lengths within the stadium area. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt circuits in the stadium area for youth from 180 m to 1.7 km
One-kilometer circuits in Staré Město for adults - men 8 km, women 3 km
Race history since 1984 with a long-standing tradition
additional: Race in the stadium area with on-site registration, refreshments at the stadium clubroom, various courses from 200 m to 8 km

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: The Little Monaka Prize - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Little Monaka Prize series and offers runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. The organizer is KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Traditional Christmas run in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany
Friendly atmosphere and quality organization
Part of the Little Monaka Prize series with a long-standing tradition

description: The Winter Run at Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on January 16, 2027. The race offers two main runs - a challenging main race of 19.9 km across Velký and Malý Blaník, and a supporting race of 11.2 km. The routes lead through beautiful nature of Podblanicko with significant ascents, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are directly in the center of Načeradec with cozy facilities. The race capacity is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race 19.9 km with an elevation gain of 542 m across Velký and Malý Blaník
Supporting race 11.2 km with an elevation gain of 238 m and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and at the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the building of the Municipal Office in Načeradec, approximately 270 meters from the race facilities. Parking is available at several designated areas with traffic signs and assistance from volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. Organizers offer free valuables storage in the changing rooms of the elementary school. The start of the supporting race is at 10:45 AM. The registration fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse conditions, the race may be adjusted to individual starts or postponed. Registration is possible online with a refund option until December 31, 2026. The race takes place in January with a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The course mainly runs on forest and field paths. The main race starts at 10:10 AM.

name: Běh po Bremstě
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč dospělí, 30 Kč děti za závod
description: The Bremsta Run is part of the Winter Running League organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice in the Jestřebí Mountains region. The race offers courses for adults approximately 5 to 7 km long and shorter courses for youth from 0.5 to 3 km, with possible adjustments depending on weather conditions. The start is in Malé Svatoňovice, where the race registration and office are also located. The race is suitable for runners of all ages and is part of a series where the five best races are scored. The organizer emphasizes safety, including mandatory reflective elements for all participants.
course_highlights: Course in the Jestřebí Mountains region with a length of 5 to 7 km for adults
Short courses of 0.5 to 3 km for youth with possible adjustments depending on weather
Start and registration in Malé Svatoňovice (SŠBPA)
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM, children's categories start at 10:00 AM, the main race begins immediately after the children finish. The number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in all weather conditions and at participants' own risk. All runners must have reflective elements. The race office is open one hour before the start of the first category. The races are open to the general public, registration is possible 15 minutes before the start, reflective gear is required, and weather conditions may affect the course conditions.

name: Běh Velbabou
description: The Velbabou Run is a traditional winter cross-country race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná Jednota Úpice in the village of Radeč. The race takes place as part of the Winter Cross-Country League and offers starts for children's categories as well as the main race. The course runs through a scenic environment with a museum in Radeč as the starting point. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners who want to enjoy winter running in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the museum in Radeč
Part of the Winter Cross-Country League with overall validity of the start fee
Race courses for children and adults
additional: The main race starts immediately after the children's categories finish. Registration is possible until 9:30 AM at the race office on site. The start number is valid for the entire Winter Cross-Country League series. The race takes place in winter, registration includes fees, the course is not specified.

name: Běh po cyklostezce
description: The running race along the cycle path is a traditional race organized by the physical education club Maratonstav Úpice. The race takes place in Úpice near the tennis courts by the river Elbe and is part of the Winter Running League. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. Participants can enjoy running in a picturesque environment with good organization and a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the tennis courts in Úpice
The route runs along the cycle path by the river Elbe
Part of the Winter Running League with children's categories
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories. The number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in February 2027, registration is possible on-site or via the website. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, starting at the tennis courts in Úpice.

name: Běh Kvíčalou
description: The Kvíčala Run is a traditional winter cross-country race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná jednota Úpice. The race takes place in Úpice in the Hradec Králové Region and is part of the Winter Cross-Country League. It starts on Saturday morning, with children's categories running first, followed immediately by the main race. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including children and adults.
course_highlights: Winter cross-country race in Úpice (Kvíčala)
Children's categories start at 10:00, main race begins after children finish
Part of the Winter Cross-Country League with tradition and community
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM. The number is valid for the entire Winter Cross-Country League series. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories. Registration is possible online. The race takes place in February and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.

name: Winter TRAIL 2026
price_range: Early od 0 Kč, běžná od 149 Kč
description: Winter TRAIL 2027 is a road run with the spirit of an excursion, offering courses of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 21 km relay through meadows and scenic hills of the Chřiby region. The race takes place in Halenkovice and offers beautiful views, diverse terrain, and a pleasant atmosphere. It also includes a 2 km family orienteering run for parents with children. The start is at the New Elementary School in Halenkovice, and race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 9:30. The event is suitable for the general public and emphasizes safety and fun in nature.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain between meadows and scenic hills of Chřiby
Beautiful views during the run
2 km family orienteering run for parents with children
additional: Race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 9:30. The run is at participants' own risk, with first aid available on the course. Increased caution is recommended at crossing points with ground communications. Virtual trail race with elevation gain, flexible timing, no fixed route, participants can choose time and place of running, multiple course lengths, registration via email, option to purchase awards and merchandise.

name: Úpická desítka
description: The Úpice Ten is a traditional road race over 10 km held in Úpice. The course is precisely measured, flat, and runs on an asphalt road from the city center towards Havlovice into Ratibořické údolí and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including youth runners who may start with the approval of the race director. After the race, results are announced in the Municipal Hall in Úpice with monetary prizes for the best in adult categories.
course_highlights: Precisely measured 10 km course
Flat asphalt road
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Hall in Úpice
additional: Children's categories start without an entry fee and register only on the spot. Youth runners (born 2009-2010) can participate in the main race after approval by the race director. Registration is open until 12:00 for children and until 12:30 for youth and adults. Results are announced at 15:00 in the Municipal Hall in Úpice. The race is governed by athletics and road traffic rules, participation is at your own risk. Registration is possible online and on-site. The race takes place under favorable conditions on an asphalt road, with categories for children and adults. Winners in categories will receive prizes.

name: Jarný beh Bojničky
price_range: 10 € online, 12 € na mieste, deti a dorast zdarma

price_tiers.distance: všetky kategórie okrem detí a dorastu

description: Jarný beh obce Bojničky je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Atletickým klubom Bojničky a obcou Bojničky. Preteky sa konajú v obci Bojničky pred Kultúrnym domom a sú súčasťou Nitrianskej bežeckej ligy 2026. Súťažiť môžu deti, dorastenci, dospelí a Nordic Walking účastníci, pričom sú pripravené kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia. Novinkou je súťaž trojčlenných družstiev mužov a žien na 5000 m Nordic Walking. Štart pretekov je rozdelený podľa kategórií od 9:45 do 12:15 hod.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú pred Kultúrnym domom v Bojničkách
Súťaž trojčlenných družstiev na 5000 m Nordic Walking (5,2 km)
Kategórie pre deti, dorast, dospelých a Nordic Walking
additional: Štart pretekov je rozdelený na viaceré kategórie: 9:45 hod. beh občanov obce Bojničky, 10:10 hod. detské kategórie, 11:20 Nordic Walking, od 12:15 hod. dospelí. Súťaže sú súčasťou Nitrianskej bežeckej ligy 2026. Trať je asfaltová, registrácia je možná online do 9. apríla 2026, preteky sú súčasťou Nitrianskej bežeckej ligy 2026, sú dostupné mapy a podrobnosti o kategóriách na oficiálnej stránke.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail je horský bežecký pretek v Divíne, ktorý ponúka dve náročné trate s krásnymi výhľadmi a výrazným prevýšením. Pretek je organizovaný OZ Ostrôžky a je vhodný pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v prírode. Trať Ostrôšky ultra má dĺžku 47 km s prevýšením 2000 m, zatiaľ čo Langoš trail je kratší s dĺžkou 27 km a prevýšením 950 m. Štart preteku je rozdelený na dve vlny, pričom dlhšia trať začína o 7:30 a kratšia o 9:00.
course_highlights: Ostrôšky ultra: 47 km s 2000 m prevýšením
Langoš trail: 27 km s 950 m prevýšením
Horské traily s krásnymi výhľadmi v okolí Divíny
additional: Štart preteku je rozdelený na dve vlny: 47 km trať štartuje o 7:30, 27 km trať o 9:00. Organizátorom je Lukáš Krnáč a OZ Ostrôžky. Štartovné sa platí podľa termínov, na mieste je najvyššia cena. Trailové preteky s rôznymi kategóriami, registrácia online, začiatky pretekov o 07:30 a 09:00, v roku 2026 sa konajú už druhýkrát po prvom ročníku v roku 2025.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
description: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Kálnica na počesť padlých rumunských vojakov pri oslobodení obce. Preteky sa konajú na trase z Kálnice do Rakoľúb a späť, s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Povrch trate je asfaltový, rovinatý s miernym prevýšením a zákrutami. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, ktoré môžu bežať v sprievode dospelej osoby. Štart pretekov je pri Kultúrnom dome v Kálnici.
course_highlights: Trasa Kálnica - Rakoľuby - Kálnica
Dĺžky tratí: 1500 m, 5500 m a 11000 m
Asfaltový povrch s miernym prevýšením 36 m
additional: Online prihlasovanie končí 10.4.2025 o 23:55 alebo pri naplnení účastníckeho limitu. Po tomto termíne je možná registrácia na mieste v deň pretekov, ak nebude limit naplnený. Zaplatené štartovné sa nevracia, ale je možné ho presunúť na inú osobu cez účet na vysledkovyservis.sk alebo za manipulačný poplatok 4 € bez účtu. Trať je asfaltová, rovinatá s miernym prevýšením; registrácia je možná online do 10.4.2025; štartovné zahŕňa občerstvenie a tombolu; preteky sa konajú 11. apríla 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolenská corrida je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná na pešej zóne Námestia SNP vo Zvolene. Pretekári absolvujú päť okruhov po 1 km bez prevýšenia, celkovo teda 5 km. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské preteky a voľný beh rodičov s deťmi, ktoré sú bez štartovného. Podujatie je súčasťou Zvolenskej bežeckej ligy a ponúka profesionálnu organizáciu a meranie časov.
course_highlights: Okruh dlhý 1 000 m na pešej zóne Námestia SNP
Bez prevýšenia, vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie
Celkom 5 okruhov, teda 5 km pre hlavný beh
additional: Detské preteky sú bez štartovného, kategórie podľa veku s dĺžkami 50 m, 250 m a 500 m. Mama/Oco Corrida je voľný beh rodičov a detí s dĺžkou 1 km, tiež bez štartovného. Registrácia na hlavný beh prebieha elektronicky do kapacity 200 účastníkov, detské preteky a Mama/Oco Corrida sa registrujú na mieste od 9:00 hod. Program zahŕňa prezentáciu, štart detských pretekov o 10:00, Mama/Oco Corrida o 10:30, hlavný beh o 11:00 a vyhodnotenie o 12:00 s tombolou. Podujatie zahŕňa hlavný 5 km beh, detské behy a rodinné behy, registrácia online alebo na mieste, medaily pre prvých 170 účastníkov, začiatok hlavného behu okolo 11:00 hod.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: Furčiansky maratón - Memoriál Štefana Semana je tradičný bežecký maratón organizovaný O5 Bežeckým klubom Furča Košice. Tento 23. ročník sa uskutoční 11. apríla 2026 v Košiciach a ponúka bežcom možnosť zmerať si sily na certifikovanej trati. Maratón je známy svojou komunitnou atmosférou a podporou bežeckých aktivít v regióne. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť kvalitný a dobre pripravený maratón.
course_highlights: maratón, štafetové kategórie
tradičné podujatie s históriou
lokalita v Košiciach s výbornou atmosférou
additional: Online výsledky sú dostupné od 10:00 hodiny v deň preteku. Prihlasovanie na Furčiansky Maratón 2026 je ukončené. Organizátor je O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. Podujatie zahŕňa maratón, extrémny maratón a štafetové preteky, s rôznymi vekovými kategóriami a registračnými poplatkami. Súčasťou je aj spomienka na Štefana Semana a podpora bežeckej komunity.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: Jarný beh Michalovčanov je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v sobotu 11. apríla 2026 v Michalovciach pri V. ZŠ na Školskej ulici. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na súťaž v rôznych vekových kategóriách, vrátane detí do 9 rokov, ktoré bežia 400 metrov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru jarného športového dňa s vyhlásením výsledkov a ocenením medailistov.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ pri V. ZŠ, Školská 2, Michalovce
Bežecké trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie
Krátky beh 400 m pre deti do 9 rokov
additional: Program podujatia zahŕňa štart behu na 400 m o 9:30 pre kategórie chlapcov a dievčat do 9 rokov a vyhlásenie výsledkov s ocenením medailistov o 10:30. Detský beh začína o 10:00, hlavný beh o 10:15; štartovné zahŕňa rôzne vekové kategórie; miesto konania je Michalovce, V. ZŠ, ŠKOLSKÁ 2

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: ČSOB Bratislava Marathon je rodinné bežecké podujatie s dlhoročnou tradíciou, ktoré sa koná v Bratislave a priláka bežcov zo Slovenska i zo zahraničia. Ponúka rôzne disciplíny od maratónu, polmaratónu, štafetových behov, cez desiatku, minimaratón až po detské behy a preteky lezúňov. Atmosféra je plná emócií, fair-play a spolupatričnosti, kde víťazom je každý, kto sa postaví na štart a prekoná sám seba. Podujatie podporuje aj charitatívne aktivity a zdôrazňuje hodnotu vzájomnej pomoci a solidarity.
course_highlights: Maratónska trať s dĺžkou 42,195 km v centre Bratislavy
Desiatka s Mattoni a Garmin Run Series Minimaratón ako kratšie disciplíny
Detské behy a preteky lezúňov pre najmenších bežcov
additional: Štart desiatky s Mattoni je v sobotu 11.04.2026 o 16:00 hod., minimaratón Garmin Run Series štartuje v sobotu 11.04.2026 o 14:00 hod., detské behy začínajú v sobotu 11.04.2026 od 10:00 hod. podľa vekových kategórií. Štafetové behy majú špecifické štartové čísla s čipmi na meranie času. Účastnícke limity sú stanovené pre jednotlivé disciplíny (napr. 2000 pre desiatku, 1500 pre minimaratón a detské behy). Preteky sa konajú v Bratislave, registrácie sú otvorené s rôznymi cenami, trať zahŕňa mestské ulice a atraktívne prostredie Eurovea Galleria.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka je bežecký pretek v Kysuckom Novom Meste, ktorý ponúka trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane žiakov a dospelých. Štartuje sa v západnej časti ulice Murgašova, pričom pretekári môžu súťažiť na 1 km trati pre žiakov alebo na 10 km trati pre dospelých a juniorov. Pretek je organizovaný Mestským kultúrno-športovým strediskom Kysucké Nové Mesto a ponúka kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:05 a pre ostatné kategórie o 10:30 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú bežeckú verejnosť a podporuje športový život v regióne.
course_highlights: Trať vedie západnou časťou ulice Murgašova v Kysuckom Novom Meste
Dostupné kategórie pre žiakov na 1 km a dospelých na 10 km
Kategórie rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia vrátane juniorov a juniorky
additional: Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:05 hod., pre kategórie mužov, žien, juniorov a juniorky o 10:30 hod. Organizátorom je Mestské kultúrno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto. Kontaktná osoba: Kováčiková Renáta, tel.: 0902 405 190. Miesto štartu pre 10 km je západná časť ulice Murgašova. Pretek zahŕňa kategórie pre deti, juniorov, mužov a ženy, s odštartovaním od 10:05 do 10:30; trať vedie ulicami Kysuckého Nového Mesta, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: Majstrovstvá Slovenskej republiky v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok sú významnou atletickou udalosťou, ktorá sa uskutoční v Bratislave. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na kvalitne pripravenú trať a profesionálnu organizáciu pod záštitou Slovenského atletického zväzu. Podujatie je súčasťou seriálu pretekov a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych kategóriách vrátane veteránov. Registrácia prebieha online a je určená pre širokú bežeckú komunitu.
course_highlights: Trať maratónu v Bratislave s mestským charakterom
Preteky pre mužov, ženy a veteránov v rôznych kategóriách
Organizácia pod záštitou Slovenského atletického zväzu
additional: Registrácia prebieha online a musí byť ukončená do 7. apríla 2026 do 12:00 hod. Štartové čísla sa vydávajú vedúcim výprav pri prezentácii v kancelárii pretekov. Rozcvičovanie je povolené mimo súťažnej trate. K dispozícii sú prezliekacie priestory pre chlapcov aj dievčatá. Oficiálne výsledky budú zverejnené na stránke Slovenského atletického zväzu. Podujatie je súčasťou ČSOB Bratislava maratónu 2026 a je určené pre všetky vekové kategórie vrátane veteránov.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: Trenčianska bežecká liga je séria deviatich bežeckých podujatí organizovaných od roku 2015 v okolí Trenčína, určená pre širokú verejnosť vrátane výkonnostných bežcov aj nadšencov. Každý mesiac od marca do novembra sa koná jedno kolo na rôznych zaujímavých a pestrých tratiach. Preteky ponúkajú priateľskú atmosféru, motiváciu a možnosť stretnúť sa s ľuďmi, ktorí podporujú zdravý životný štýl. Výsledky a bodovanie po každom kole slúžia ako motivácia pre ďalší tréning a zlepšovanie výkonov.
course_highlights: Trať 8,95 km s prevýšením 130 m v Trenčianskych Stankovciach, prevažne terén s 20 % asfaltu
Trate vedú cez poľné cesty, hrádzu okolo rybníka, obecné cesty a kopce
Štart a cieľ na futbalovom ihrisku v Trenčianskych Stankovciach
additional: Prezentácia a registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:00 hod. Štartovné sa platí na mieste. Bežci môžu prispieť dobrovoľným príspevkom pre Spojenú školu internátnu v Trenčíne. Beh so psom je povolený, avšak bežec so psom dostane 1 bod za účasť bez bodovania podľa poradia. Ligové kolo sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku v Trenčianskych Stankovciach. Podujatie podporuje komunitu a zdravý životný štýl, je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie a úrovne bežcov.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom je nočný beh organizovaný študentskou organizáciou Woodenworld pri Technickej univerzite vo Zvolene a Mesto Zvolen. Bežci absolvujú 7 km trať s prevýšením 40 metrov, ktorá vedie mestom Zvolen, okolo významných miest ako Zvolenský zámok, Námestie SNP a rieka Hron. Podujatie ponúka elektronické meranie času, občerstvenie, ceny pre umiestnených a spomienkový predmet. Štart je o 20:30 pred Technickou univerzitou a pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť vrátane študentov a zamestnancov univerzity.
course_highlights: 7 km trať s prevýšením 40 m vedúca mestom Zvolen
Prechod okolo Zvolenského zámku a Námestia SNP
Trasa vedie popri rieke Hron a končí na Technickej univerzite
additional: Registrácia online do 13.4.2026 za 12 €, na mieste v deň preteku od 18:30 do 20:00 za 15 €. Štartovné zahŕňa štartovné číslo, meranie času elektronickou časomierou, občerstvenie, ceny a spomienkový predmet. Súťažiaci pod 18 rokov štartujú so súhlasom zákonného zástupcu. Zamestnanci a študenti TU Zvolen môžu uviesť klub "Technická univerzita" pre vyhodnotenie najlepších bežcov TU. Pretek sa koná v nočnom prostredí, s trasou vedúcou cez významné zvolenské pamiatky, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, súťažia kategórie pre mužov a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách.

name: 57. ročník Běhu vítězství, 53. ročník Hranické dvacítky a 10. ročník Hranické desítky
price_range: Vstup je zdarma, účastníci platí startovné
description: The 57th Victory Run, the 53rd Hranice Twenty, and the 10th Hranice Ten will take place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Hranice. description: The Zlín Forest Hour Run is a unique one-hour race in the Czech Republic, held in a forest on a slightly undulating one-kilometer loop in the Forest District of Zlín. The race is open to the general public, including children and juniors, and runs for 60 minutes along a forest trail that is fully marked. The start and registration are at the observatory, with the start at 10:00 AM. After the race, refreshments are provided and results are announced in various age categories. This race has a long tradition and is known for its specific forest environment.

Children's courses in the castle garden on paved paths
